cmdblocks.text: Rokugan, the Emerald Empire. Eight travelers, eight roads. All eight are open to you now.
Hiruma Natsuko (Crab), a scout on the Kaiu Wall.
Kakita Rensei (Crane), a duelist, newly graduated.
Akodo Shizue (Lion), a tactician from a minor Akodo house.
Isawa Haruki (Phoenix), a young shugenja who counts on his fingers.
Kitsuki Gendo (Dragon), a junior yoriki with gaijin spectacles.
Shosuro Mitsue (Scorpion), an actress-agent nobody knows.
Ide Tamotsu (Unicorn), an emissary who likes everybody.
Sayo (Ronin), a wave-woman herbalist, born on a rice barge.
Whose journey begins?

cmdblock.text: The academy gate. Rensei's bout comes first.

cmdblocks.text: The Kakita Dueling Academy. Where the Crane teach that a single cut, perfectly made, ends any war.
A courtyard of white sand. Kakita Rensei kneels, then rises into the graduation kata: slow, flawless, his white-dyed hair tied high.
Kakita Rensei. Final bout. Bokken.
cmdblocks.name: Kakita sensei

cmdblocks.text: Try not to cry when you lose, little brother.
cmdblocks.name: Senior student

cmdblocks.text: I'll try not to make you, senpai.
cmdblocks.name: Kakita Rensei

cmdblocks.text: Iaijutsu: Kakita Rensei's School technique. Focus skips his action and builds a stack of Focus, up to three.
At full Focus, Strike: one perfect cut, a certain critical. (Battle menu: School.)
The senior student's bokken spins out of his hands. Silence. Then polite, approving murmurs.
On the veranda, Kakita Masanori - Rensei's father - watches with no expression at all.
Your left foot hesitated.
cmdblocks.name: Kakita Masanori

cmdblocks.text: Yes, Father.
cmdblocks.name: Kakita Rensei

cmdblocks.text: On the third step. A quarter-breath.
cmdblocks.name: Kakita Masanori

cmdblocks.text: Yes, Father.
cmdblocks.name: Kakita Rensei

cmdblocks.text: Adequate.
cmdblocks.name: Kakita Masanori

cmdblocks.text: He walks away. The courtyard empties. Rensei stays.
Dusk. Rensei performs the kata again. Again. Again. The left foot does not hesitate.
Night. He performs it again anyway.
...Adequate.
cmdblocks.name: Kakita Rensei

cmdblocks.text: Dawn. Objective: Lady Doji Sanae's palanquin waits at the academy gate.

cmdblock.text: The students' quarters. Rensei's bedroll is already packed. The academy has no more room for him.
The Kakita smith. A sign on the door: "Graduates of rank only." (Opens at Rank 2.)
The dojo. Rensei's name is on the graduates' board: last in the row, in fresh ink.
An old sensei is sweeping the floor. "Last in the row. Then you have the most to learn. Stand. Draw. Slower."

cmdblocks.text: A plain palanquin on a mountain road. Kakita Rensei walks beside it in his new yojimbo's armour, rigidly correct.
Kakita Rensei.
cmdblocks.name: Doji Sanae

cmdblocks.text: My lady.
cmdblocks.name: Kakita Rensei

cmdblocks.text: You may stop walking as though your spine were a spear. We have four days of road.
cmdblocks.name: Doji Sanae

cmdblocks.text: Yes, my lady.
cmdblocks.name: Kakita Rensei

cmdblocks.text: Do you know what I do, Rensei-san?
cmdblocks.name: Doji Sanae

cmdblocks.text: You are Doji Sanae, Keeper of the House Honour, my lady.
cmdblocks.name: Kakita Rensei

cmdblocks.text: And what does the Keeper of the House Honour do?
cmdblocks.name: Doji Sanae

cmdblocks.text: ...Keep it, my lady?
cmdblocks.name: Kakita Rensei

cmdblocks.text: I see to it that certain things never happened.
cmdblocks.name: Doji Sanae

cmdblocks.text: A Kakita prodigy named Kakita Morishu shamed his house a year ago and vanished.
cmdblocks.name: Doji Sanae

cmdblocks.text: Now a Lion lord near Beiden Pass complains of a "Crane bandit" in his forest.
cmdblocks.name: Doji Sanae

cmdblocks.text: We are going to make the problem disappear. Quietly.
cmdblocks.name: Doji Sanae

cmdblocks.text: And my part?
cmdblocks.name: Kakita Rensei

cmdblocks.text: You keep me alive while I arrange it.
cmdblocks.name: Doji Sanae

The boy looks terrified, Sanae.
cmdblocks.name: Kitsuki Seigen

cmdblocks.text: The boy is terrified, Seigen. It's his first assignment.
cmdblocks.name: Doji Sanae

cmdblocks.text: Good. Terrified men notice things.
cmdblocks.name: Kitsuki Seigen

cmdblocks.text: You are... Dragon, sir?
cmdblocks.name: Kakita Rensei

cmdblocks.text: Retired magistrate. Kitsuki. I solve the Crane's embarrassments for money and bad tea.
cmdblocks.name: Kitsuki Seigen

cmdblocks.text: The Academy taught us that the Kitsuki method-
cmdblocks.name: Kakita Rensei

cmdblocks.text: They teach nothing useful at the Academy. That's why it's so expensive.
cmdblocks.name: Kitsuki Seigen

cmdblocks.text: (...What if what "never happened" did happen?)
cmdblocks.name: Kakita Rensei

cmdblocks.text: Then you will learn something they don't teach at the Academy.
cmdblocks.name: Doji Sanae

cmdblocks.text: Pleasant Eaves of Mountains' Cloak Forest Village. A long name for a short street.
Shouting. Village youths kick a thin man curled in the mud: Ebisu, an eta firewood-gatherer, clutching a cloth bundle.
Eta filth! Where'd you steal a sword?
cmdblocks.name: Village youth

cmdblocks.text: Found! Found it! By the water! Wanted... wanted sake...
cmdblocks.name: Ebisu

cmdblocks.text: Would you shame yourselves before a Kakita blade, gentlemen?
cmdblocks.name: Kakita Rensei

cmdblocks.text: The youths see the Crane mon on his armour and back away.
A Crane... Sorry, my lord. Sorry.
cmdblocks.name: Village youth

cmdblocks.text: Rensei's hand goes to his hilt. The youths scatter.
(Honor -1)
Please. Buy yourselves... dinner. Elsewhere.
cmdblocks.name: Kakita Rensei

cmdblocks.text: Crimson to the ears, Rensei counts the coins into their hands.

cmdblocks.text0: Charm: "Would you shame yourselves before a Kakita blade?"

cmdblocks.text: Ebisu unwraps the bundle with shaking hands. A wakizashi in a plain scabbard. Kakita Rensei draws it a finger's width.
The steel catches the dusk. For a moment the whole street seems to reflect in it - and Rensei sees himself, measured against something perfect, and falling short.
...Heaven's Glory Reflected in the Soul's Steel.
cmdblocks.name: Kakita Rensei

cmdblocks.text: You know it?
cmdblocks.name: Kitsuki Seigen

cmdblocks.text: Every Kakita student knows the name. It was made by the first Kakita's own student. It belongs to...
cmdblocks.name: Kakita Rensei

cmdblocks.text: To Kakita Morihoshi's house. To his son.
cmdblocks.name: Kakita Rensei

cmdblocks.text: To the boy we came to make disappear.
cmdblocks.name: Doji Sanae

cmdblocks.text: Got Heaven's Glory.
The village headman, Torishigawa, an unremarkable old man, watches from his doorway - very attentively.
Across the street, a young woman in Matsu colours sets down a pilgrim's staff: Matsu Kiku.
That eta will be beaten again the moment you leave. I'm Matsu Kiku. I'm going your way.
cmdblocks.name: Matsu Kiku

cmdblocks.text: You don't know our way.
cmdblocks.name: Kakita Rensei

cmdblocks.text: Into that forest. Everyone who looks at that sword goes into that forest. Please let me come.
cmdblocks.name: Matsu Kiku

cmdblocks.text: I'm on pilgrimage. I'm trying not to hit anyone. It would help to have someone to stand behind.
cmdblocks.name: Matsu Kiku

cmdblocks.text: Matsu Kiku will answer the Guest call in battle. (One guest at a time.)
Matsu Kiku will wait at the inn. (Swap guests there.)

cmdblocks.text0: Take Matsu Kiku along. (Seigen waits at the inn.)
cmdblocks.text1: Keep Kitsuki Seigen. (Kiku waits at the inn.)

cmdblocks.text: The offering water clouds over, then clears. The Taint is gone.
The water stays clear. There is nothing in you for it to take.
Rensei kneels on the mud-stained step. For a moment nobody is grading him. (MP restored.)

cmdblock.text: The Green Ronin gives back what the Lion take. My prayers go where he goes. Where do you go, Crane?

cmdblocks.text: Mutual honour! I haven't had any in years. Lead on.

cmdblock.text: A traveler! Togashi Yosai. I hunt men who skin monks, and the Fortunes hunt me. We're all very busy.
cmdblock.name: Togashi Yosai

cmdblock.text: I've got tattoos that breathe fire and tattoos that steal wounds, and none of them do my taxes.
cmdblock.name: Togashi Yosai

cmdblock.text: Somewhere a woman is writing two letters at once. Nobody ever reads the second one. Strange times.
cmdblock.name: Togashi Yosai

cmdblock.text: Bandits in the dark ahead, behind the lanterns. Not this way. Not yet.

cmdblocks.text: Mountains' Cloak Forest. At night, the lanterns come out.
Paper lanterns drift between the trees, glowing, swaying - too evenly. A weeping voice from deep in the woods.
Help me... I've lost my way... help me...
cmdblocks.name: Ghost Maiden

cmdblocks.text: That's a ghost.
cmdblocks.name: Matsu Kiku

cmdblocks.text: That's a girl with a good voice and a rope.
cmdblocks.name: Kitsuki Seigen

cmdblocks.text: How can you tell?
cmdblocks.name: Kakita Rensei

cmdblocks.text: Ghosts don't cough. Listen.
cmdblocks.name: Kitsuki Seigen

cmdblocks.text: Help me... -cough- ...help me...
cmdblocks.name: Ghost Maiden

cmdblocks.text: Objective: find the ropes that work the lanterns. Somewhere in here is a girl with a good voice.

cmdblock.text: A rope tied to a tree, running up into the branches: a pulley line. The lanterns ride on it.

cmdblocks.text: Rensei cuts it. One lantern drops out of the sky. Somewhere in the dark, a bandit swears.

cmdblock.text: A cut rope, hanging.
Another line, and the ground ahead is too soft: fresh-dug earth under leaves.

cmdblocks.text: The line goes slack. Leaves slide into a black square in the path: a pit, as deep as a man is tall. Rensei steps around it.

cmdblock.text: The slack line, and the pit beside it.
The ground gives way. Rensei drops into a pit full of leaves.

cmdblock.code: foreach( p in ::rpgstat.members) if( p && !p.isDead()) p.HP = Math.max( 1, p.HP - p.MAXHP / 10);

cmdblock.text: A knotted rope up the pit wall.
The last lantern. Behind it, a girl on a branch with a rope in her hands, mouth open for the next "help me".

cmdblocks.text: Rensei cuts it. The girl drops into a bush, unhurt. Her twin sister bursts out of the dark, and behind her, farmers with sticks.
The bandits limp off into the trees, alive. One of them looks back at Rensei for a long moment.
The rest of them scatter into the dark.
Objective: follow the bandits' trail deeper into the forest.

cmdblock.text: The ghost lantern, cut down.
A waterfall in a glade. Spray, mossy rocks, and nothing else you can see.
Ebisu's spot: a flat rock by the water, scuffed where something heavy lay. In the moss beside it, an inro on a broken cord.
Got Morishu's Inro.
Got an Old Whetstone.
A letter to his mother. He never sent it.
cmdblock.name: Kakita Rensei

cmdblock.text: The bandits' trail. Something in the clearing first.

cmdblocks.text: A clearing. Two Crane samurai stripped to their underclothes, tied to a tree: Kakita Adoru, furious, and Kakita Yasurugi, utterly silent.
You! Crane! Untie us at once! We are on our lord's business!
cmdblocks.name: Kakita Adoru

cmdblocks.text: What business?
cmdblocks.name: Kakita Rensei

cmdblocks.text: Our lord's! Untie us!
cmdblocks.name: Kakita Adoru

cmdblocks.text: Their lord's business, it seems, involves this.
cmdblocks.name: Kitsuki Seigen

cmdblocks.text: He reads. His face goes still.
It's from Kakita Morihoshi to his son. Very polite. Exquisite brushwork.
cmdblocks.name: Kitsuki Seigen

cmdblocks.text: It invites him to cut his own belly.
cmdblocks.name: Kitsuki Seigen

cmdblocks.text: Silence. Kakita Rensei looks at Yasurugi. Yasurugi looks back: the calmest look Rensei has ever received, and the coldest.
...Untie them. Gently. Return their swords.
cmdblocks.name: Doji Sanae

cmdblocks.text: My lady-
cmdblocks.name: Kakita Rensei

cmdblocks.text: Return their swords, Rensei-san. They are Kakita. We do not leave Kakita tied to trees.
cmdblocks.name: Doji Sanae

cmdblocks.text: Yasurugi takes his sword and walks into the dark without a word.
Objective: the bandits' trail runs on, east, toward the hills.

cmdblock.text: A small stone shrine to the Fortunes, half buried in the rock. Someone left it a rice ball.

cmdblocks.text: (Rested. HP and MP restored.)

cmdblock.text: An old Kakita training post, notched by a hundred cuts. Someone practised here alone, for a long time. A kozuka is wedged in the top.
Got a Kozuka.
The training post. A hundred cuts, all the same height.

cmdblock.text: The road down to Goroso's castle. Not before the village has had its say.

cmdblocks.text: Not a bandit camp: a hidden village. Children. Rice paddies cut into a hillside. Forty people who don't belong to anyone.
It's them - the Crane who cut the ropes instead of throats. Let them through!
cmdblocks.name: Bandit

cmdblocks.text: Spears level at the gate.
The gate guards throw down their spears, and somebody runs for Imuro.
A big jovial man pushes through: Imuro, a Bo across his shoulders.
Crane! In the Green Ronin's village! Have you come to arrest us or to have tea?
cmdblocks.name: Imuro

cmdblocks.text: Is... tea an option?
cmdblocks.name: Kakita Rensei

cmdblocks.text: It is now! Sit!
cmdblocks.name: Imuro

cmdblocks.text: A tea mat. A pregnant young woman serves it with shaking hands: Sariko.
I am the Green Ronin!
cmdblocks.name: Imuro

cmdblocks.text: No, you aren't.
cmdblocks.name: Kitsuki Seigen

cmdblocks.text: ...No, I'm not.
cmdblocks.name: Imuro

cmdblocks.text: He's my friend. Kakita Morishu. When he came here he couldn't hold a cup without spilling it.
cmdblocks.name: Imuro

cmdblocks.text: Then two Lions came to beat our headman for a late tax. He killed both with two cuts. Two. Like breathing.
cmdblocks.name: Imuro

cmdblocks.text: Then he sat down in the mud and shook for an hour.
cmdblocks.name: Imuro

cmdblocks.text: Two cuts... and then he shook.
cmdblocks.name: Kakita Rensei

cmdblocks.text: You understand that?
cmdblocks.name: Imuro

cmdblocks.text: ...I understand the second part.
cmdblocks.name: Kakita Rensei

cmdblocks.text: Where is he? He went into the forest at dawn and didn't come back.
cmdblocks.name: Sariko

cmdblocks.text: A runner bursts in, out of breath.
Imuro! Lord Goroso's sergeant - Akodo Tama - he caught Morishu at the waterfall!
cmdblocks.name: Runner

cmdblocks.text: He's to be executed in the castle yard. At dawn tomorrow.
cmdblocks.name: Runner

cmdblocks.text: Sariko's cup falls and breaks.
Objective: Lord Akodo Goroso's castle, down the valley road. The execution is at dawn.

#5#.msg: Tea's still hot, Crane. Lion tea, taxed twice. Drink it slowly.
#5#.name: *villager-5

#6#.msg: He went into the forest at dawn. He always comes back by dusk. Always.
#6#.name: *villager-6

#7#.msg: We're not ghosts tonight. Imuro says ghosts need a night off.
#7#.name: *villager-7

#8#.msg: Are you the Crane who didn't kill anybody?
#8#.name: *villager-8

cmdblock.text: The village granary. Imuro has left the lid off a crate of rice balls.
Take them. You'll need them more than the Lion tax-man.
cmdblock.name: Imuro

cmdblock.text: A straw mat by the fire. Somebody has left a cup out for you.
Travel Banter: "Spilled Tea"
You flinched when he said "shook for an hour".
cmdblock.name: Matsu Kiku

cmdblock.text: I did not.
cmdblock.name: Kakita Rensei

cmdblock.text: You did. I flinch at things too. Mostly at myself.
cmdblock.name: Matsu Kiku

cmdblock.text: ...What do you do about it?
cmdblock.name: Kakita Rensei

cmdblock.text: Walk a very long way on pilgrimage and hope it falls off somewhere.
cmdblock.name: Matsu Kiku

cmdblock.text: The village kept a cup for me. Kind of them. Call me when you want to think, boy.
cmdblock.name: Kitsuki Seigen

cmdblocks.text: Kitsuki Seigen will answer the Guest call.

cmdblock.text0: Ask Kitsuki Seigen to come along.

cmdblock.text: These people are kinder than my family. Need me?
cmdblock.name: Matsu Kiku

cmdblocks.text: Matsu Kiku will answer the Guest call.

cmdblock.text0: Ask Matsu Kiku to come along.

cmdblock.text: The village shrine, small and well swept. The offerings are for the Green Ronin.

cmdblocks.text: The offering water clouds over, then clears. The Taint is gone.
The water stays clear. There is nothing in you for it to take.
Rensei kneels. Somewhere a child is laughing at a chicken. (MP restored.)

cmdblock.text: You're the Crane who cut our ropes instead of our throats. Want to borrow the lanterns?
cmdblock.name: Lantern Twins

cmdblocks.text: Your current hireling heads home.
Our lanterns, our ropes. Three swings, and we go home before Imuro worries.
cmdblocks.name: Lantern Twins

cmdblocks.text: Lantern Twins follows Rensei. (In battle: Support. 3 uses, then home to the Green Ronin's village.)
Coin first, Kakita-sama.
cmdblocks.name: Lantern Twins

cmdblocks.text: Everybody's heard about the Crane with the speeches. No.
cmdblocks.name: Lantern Twins

cmdblocks.text: (Word of the Crane with the speeches has got around. Make amends at the inn.)
Your lanterns fooled a Kakita. Would you fool something worse, for me?
cmdblocks.name: Kakita Rensei

cmdblocks.text: ...Yes!
cmdblocks.name: Lantern Twins

cmdblocks.text: Your current hireling heads home.
Our lanterns, our ropes. Three swings, and we go home before Imuro worries.
cmdblocks.name: Lantern Twins

cmdblocks.text: Lantern Twins follows Rensei. (In battle: Support. 3 uses, then home to the Green Ronin's village.)
You bow like our grandfather's scarecrow.
cmdblocks.name: Lantern Twins

cmdblocks.text: (The Green Ronin's village thinks a little less of the stiff young Crane.)

#97#.msg: The road's closed for now. Orders. When it opens, you'll hear of it.
#97#.name: *villager-97

cmdblocks.text: Lord Akodo Goroso's castle stands on a hill raised by ten thousand peasant baskets. It guards Beiden Pass.
The hall. Lord Akodo Goroso: scarred, two fingers missing, utterly certain. Doji Sanae kneels before him. Kakita Rensei kneels at the back, by the door. Goroso does not look at him once.
The Crane send their Keeper of Honour to plead for a bandit.
cmdblocks.name: Akodo Goroso

cmdblocks.text: The Crane send their Keeper of Honour to understand, my lord. A Kakita in your cells is a Crane matter.
cmdblocks.name: Doji Sanae

cmdblocks.text: A bandit in my cells is my matter. Heaven has an order. He broke it. He dies at dawn.
cmdblocks.name: Akodo Goroso

cmdblocks.text: Sanae is dismissed. Rensei is told to wait in the corridor. He waits. He is ignored.

cmdblocks.text: In the corridor: two voices, around a corner. A "merchant" with swords under his cloak - Bayushi Depura - and the sergeant, Akodo Tama.
A public execution would be so... instructive, sergeant. For the Crane. For everyone.
cmdblocks.name: Bayushi Depura

cmdblocks.text: The lord's already decided.
cmdblocks.name: Akodo Tama

cmdblocks.text: Then let's make sure nobody undecides him. A Crane's body in a Lion yard - imagine the poems.
cmdblocks.name: Bayushi Depura

cmdblocks.text: Depura passes Kakita Rensei on his way out. He glances at the boy in white, smiles politely, and forgets him instantly.
(...He looked straight at me and didn't see me.)
cmdblocks.name: Kakita Rensei

cmdblocks.text: (Father always said a Kakita should fill a room. It's useful to be empty.)
cmdblocks.name: Kakita Rensei

cmdblocks.text: Objective: the guest room, at the end of the corridor. Lady Sanae will be waiting.

cmdblocks.text: My father isn't cruel. He's... certain.
cmdblocks.name: Akodo Seoko

cmdblocks.text: The Crane with the speeches? No.
cmdblocks.name: Akodo Seoko

cmdblocks.text: (Make amends at the inn.)
Akodo-san. You study the Way of the Lion. Does it say a man may not speak at his own trial?
cmdblocks.name: Kakita Rensei

cmdblocks.text: It says Heaven decides. My father thinks Heaven sounds like him. Certainty is worse than cruelty, Kakita-san.
cmdblocks.name: Akodo Seoko

cmdblocks.text: ...If someone wanted the yard's side gate open at dawn, I would not be the one to bar it.
cmdblocks.name: Akodo Seoko

cmdblocks.text: A Crane telling an Akodo about justice. Go away.
cmdblocks.name: Akodo Seoko

cmdblocks.text: The Crane are very welcome. The Crane are always very welcome.
cmdblocks.name: Akodo Tatanko

cmdblocks.text: The Crane with the speeches? No.
cmdblocks.name: Akodo Tatanko

cmdblocks.text: (Make amends at the inn.)
My lady, the estate's accounts must weigh on you. May I ask what the forest has cost?
cmdblocks.name: Kakita Rensei

cmdblocks.text: Forty families ran into that forest. Forty families of rice, gone untaxed.
cmdblocks.name: Akodo Tatanko

cmdblocks.text: Bring the labour back, and my husband's honour will survive a great deal.
cmdblocks.name: Akodo Tatanko

cmdblocks.text: You are very young, Kakita-san. It is charming. Elsewhere.
cmdblocks.name: Akodo Tatanko

cmdblocks.text: (The castle thinks a little less of the stiff young Crane.)
The Crane are very welcome. The Crane are always very welcome.
cmdblocks.name: Akodo Tatanko

cmdblock.text: The Crane are very welcome. The Crane are always very welcome.
cmdblock.name: Akodo Tatanko

cmdblock.text: The guest room. Lady Sanae is inside, writing.
There are four ways this ends, Rensei-san. I will tell you all four, and then you will choose.
cmdblock.name: Doji Sanae

cmdblock.text: One. A blade slipped into his cell. He takes the honourable path tonight. The House is clean.
cmdblock.name: Doji Sanae

cmdblock.text: Two. We do nothing. He dies in the yard. The House is shamed, but not involved.
cmdblock.name: Doji Sanae

cmdblock.text: Three. His bandit friends strike from the crowd. Goroso is humiliated. The Lion will remember.
cmdblock.name: Doji Sanae

cmdblock.text: Four. We demand trial by challenge. Goroso names a champion. Morishu fights for his own life.
cmdblock.name: Doji Sanae

cmdblock.text: He can't hold a cup without shaking.
cmdblock.name: Kakita Rensei

cmdblock.text: Then he will need a second.
cmdblock.name: Doji Sanae

cmdblock.text: ...You're deciding what kind of Crane I am.
cmdblock.name: Kakita Rensei

cmdblock.text: No. You are. Take your time. You have until dawn.
cmdblock.name: Doji Sanae

cmdblocks.text: Dawn.
Dawn.
Akodo Seoko will leave the side gate unbarred.
Dawn.
Dawn.

cmdblock.text1: Let the law take its course.

cmdblock.text: The harbour office. A lacquer box, locked.
The harbour office's box. Inside: a copy of the Daidoji-Crab trade treaty, and a jar of sake no one will miss.
Got Fine Sake.
An empty lacquer box.

cmdblock.text: Got a Tide Chart.
Low tide at dawn and dusk. The chart says so, and the chart is never wrong.
cmdblock.name: Harbour master

cmdblock.text: Suitengu's shrine. Shells and dried fish on the offering step: sailors' prayers.

cmdblocks.text: The offering water clouds over, then clears. The Taint is gone.
The water stays clear. There is nothing in you for it to take.
Rensei kneels and listens to the tide come in and go out. (MP restored.)
Confessions. The most compromised Crane general kneels for seppuku at dawn. On the Crab side, the old wrestler general Hida Chuto walks off into the Shadowlands "to look for Hida".
"A Scorpion provocateur, operating on both sides of the border, has been exposed."

cmdblocks.text: ...There was a Scorpion. At Goroso's castle. Bayushi Depura.
cmdblocks.name: Kakita Rensei

cmdblocks.text: Then my report is accurate. Merely incomplete.

cmdblocks.text: He hands her a small porcelain cup, wrapped in white silk.

cmdblocks.text: You're very strange for a Crane.

cmdblocks.text: You're very polite for a Crab.

cmdblocks.text: Don't tell anyone.

cmdblocks.text: I never gossip. Ask anyone at the Academy.
cmdblocks.name: Kakita Rensei

cmdblocks.text: The land-bridge at low tide. Hiruma Goro, rolling his shoulders, ready to go home.

cmdblocks.text: Hiruma Goro will answer the Guest call in battle. (Swap guests at an inn.)
"The Iron Cranes" - complete.
Two women seduced two armies - and they were never two women. Rensei freed the generals he could, refused a bargain of open doors, and learned that the woman behind it all is a Doji.
Heaven's Glory answers his hand now.
Got Heaven's Glory (a blade).

cmdblock.text: How strange. I served with Moteuchi. He died in the south. Of a fever.

cmdblock.text: A tiny silence. Miyako's smile doesn't move at all.
Minutes later: a cry from the dark end of the garden. Miyako, dishevelled, weeping, clutching a torn sleeve.

cmdblocks.text: Doji Miyako's chamber in the port castle. Empty - then not. She sits in the window, radiant, unhurried. Six floating doorways of light open around the room. In each, a sleeping child.
In Rensei's door: his little cousins, asleep at the Kakita estate.
In Hiruma Natsuko's: Squeak and the young nezumi, in their dry cave.
In Hiruma Natsuko's: Hida Sachiko and Hiruma Ryoichi, asleep in the Wall barracks.
Serve, and they live. Refuse, and - well. Doors open both ways.
cmdblocks.name: Doji Miyako

cmdblocks.text: I bargain honestly, you know. Ask anyone I've owned.
cmdblocks.name: Doji Miyako

cmdblocks.text: Together:
No.
cmdblocks.name: Hiruma Natsuko

cmdblocks.text: No.
cmdblocks.name: Kakita Rensei

cmdblocks.text: Two of you in one night! I do love a pair.
cmdblocks.name: Doji Miyako

cmdblocks.text: Rensei's hand is on his sword. His left foot does not hesitate.

cmdblocks.name: Kakita Rensei

cmdblocks.text: A Crane who says no to me. How novel.
cmdblocks.name: Doji Miyako

cmdblocks.text: She laughs. The doors close. The children are gone - only images. She stands, and the window fills with smoke, and she is a white bird, and then nothing.
...Not two women. One.
cmdblocks.name: Kakita Rensei

cmdblock.text: Lady Sanae's quarters. She is not receiving, Kakita-sama.
cmdblock.name: Doji servant

cmdblock.text: Kakita-sama. Lady Sanae has been asking for you since dawn. She is... smiling.
cmdblock.name: Doji servant

cmdblock.text: CHAPTER 3 - The White Squid. (Recommended level 30)

cmdblocks.text: The Crane coast. A tribute meant for the Emperor's own hands was taken at sea. The Crane do not take embarrassments lightly.
The White Squid pirates took the tribute. A lacquered screen for the Emperor's winter palace.
cmdblocks.name: Doji Sanae

cmdblocks.text: The Emperor will receive a new gift, Rensei-san.
cmdblocks.name: Doji Sanae

cmdblocks.text: What gift, my lady?
cmdblocks.name: Kakita Rensei

cmdblocks.text: The pirate captain's head.
cmdblocks.name: Doji Sanae

cmdblocks.text: A ship. A crew. A grizzled ship's master who looks at Kakita Rensei the way a horse looks at a new rider.
You are a captain now.
cmdblocks.name: Doji Sanae

cmdblocks.text: I've never been on a boat.
cmdblocks.name: Kakita Rensei

cmdblocks.text: Then you'll learn, the way Kakita learn everything. Perfectly, and while terrified.
cmdblocks.name: Doji Sanae

cmdblocks.text: One more thing. The Imperial magistrate Otomo Shinken is also hunting these pirates.
cmdblocks.name: Doji Sanae

cmdblocks.text: If she reaches them first, the Emperor gets the credit and the Crane get nothing. Not that I'd mind. But the court would.
cmdblocks.name: Doji Sanae

cmdblocks.text: Ship travel unlocked: your ship is moored at the west pier.
(Rested. HP and MP restored.)
Objective: the docks. Everyone on the coast has a story about the White Squid.

cmdblock.text: My lady expects a head, Kakita-sama. A wrapped one, ideally.
cmdblock.name: Doji servant

cmdblock.text: The pirate captain's head, Rensei-san. The Emperor's winter palace is cold, and his patience is short.
cmdblock.name: Doji Sanae

cmdblock.text: They struck Shimo-ura and Kitahama on the same morning. Forty ri apart!
cmdblock.name: Fishwife

cmdblock.text: Ryohei the Eldest. Fights with a little stick-and-chain. Deadly.
cmdblock.name: Drunk sailor

cmdblock.text: Chihaya the Quick - walked along an oar like a road. Laughing.
cmdblock.name: Net-mender

cmdblock.text: White Squid charms! Bless your boat! Theirs work. Mine don't.
cmdblock.name: Charm-seller

cmdblock.text: A Crab lord in damp silk elbows through the crowd: Yasuki Tessai.
You're hunting the Squid? So am I. They've cost me three ships and my best cook.
cmdblock.name: Yasuki Tessai

cmdblock.text: Ally with me. I bring a second ship and gold. I want the loot.
cmdblock.name: Yasuki Tessai

cmdblocks.text: Ha! Two ships, then. Mine follows yours - and the loot follows me.
cmdblocks.name: Yasuki Tessai

cmdblocks.text: Yasuki Tessai's ship will sail with yours. (His archers will loose a volley in a sea fight; he will claim his share of the pirates' loot.)
Forgive me, Tessai-sama. The Crane prefer to owe no one.
cmdblocks.name: Kakita Rensei

cmdblocks.text: The Crane owe everyone. They just pay in compliments.
cmdblocks.name: Yasuki Tessai

cmdblocks.text: No help at sea, then - and every chest you find is yours.

cmdblock.text: The ship's master marks the sea chart: a cove fort on the first island, where a white ship was seen. Objective: your ship, at the west pier.
My ship follows yours, Kakita-sama. Loot first, compliments after.
cmdblock.name: Yasuki Tessai

cmdblock.text: Go on, Crane. I'll be here, counting what you didn't bring back.
cmdblock.name: Yasuki Tessai

#9#.msg: Mind your back, Kakita-sama. These crates don't care about rank.
#9#.name: *villager-9

#10#.msg: The Squid's crews wear paper charms. My sword went round one like water round a rock. Arrows, though. Or a good wind.
#10#.name: *villager-10

#11#.msg: Lady Sanae is furious, they say. Furious is when she smiles.
#11#.name: *villager-11

cmdblocks.text: Back at port. The Imperial magistrate Otomo Shinken arrives with a fleet, just too late, and takes the credit very gladly.

cmdblocks.name: Otomo Shinken

cmdblocks.text: Indeed, magistrate.
cmdblocks.name: Kakita Rensei

cmdblocks.text: Doji Sanae's quarters. She reads Tadanobu's letters. A very small, very satisfied smile.
You were told to bring a head.

cmdblocks.text: I brought a confession, my lady. It has a head attached.

cmdblocks.text: ...Adequate.
cmdblocks.name: Doji Sanae

cmdblocks.text: My lady?
cmdblocks.name: Kakita Rensei

cmdblocks.text: I've heard your father uses that word. I thought you might like to hear it from someone who means it kindly.
cmdblocks.name: Doji Sanae

cmdblocks.text: And the Emperor's screen?
cmdblocks.name: Doji Sanae

cmdblocks.text: In the hold, my lady. Slightly damp.
cmdblocks.name: Kakita Rensei

cmdblocks.text: ...Still on that island, my lady. In a crate. I was busy with the confession.
cmdblocks.name: Kakita Rensei

cmdblocks.text: And the brothers?
cmdblocks.name: Doji Sanae

cmdblocks.text: Gone home, my lady. To raise children who'll tell stories about a seasick Crane.
cmdblocks.name: Kakita Rensei

cmdblocks.text: "The White Squid" - complete.
Four brothers, four white ships, and a charm-maker who made lies work. Rensei learned to sail, refused to take a head, and found a Lion's signature behind the piracy.

cmdblock.text: Chihaya the Quick? Steel never touches her, they say. A Tsuruchi arrow doesn't need to touch her twice.
cmdblock.name: Tsuruchi Archer

cmdblocks.text: Your current hireling heads home.
Three arrows. The daikyu doesn't miss; I might, but it doesn't.
cmdblocks.name: Tsuruchi Archer

cmdblocks.text: Tsuruchi Archer follows Rensei. (In battle: Support. 3 uses, then home to the Crane port docks.)
Coin first, Kakita-sama.
cmdblocks.name: Tsuruchi Archer

cmdblocks.text: Everybody's heard about the Crane with the speeches. No.
cmdblocks.name: Tsuruchi Archer

cmdblocks.text: (Word of the Crane with the speeches has got around. Make amends at the inn.)
A Tsuruchi daikyu and a Kakita blade, against pirates who laugh at both. Shall we stop the laughing?
cmdblocks.name: Kakita Rensei

cmdblocks.text: Now that's a speech I can shoot to. I'm in.
cmdblocks.name: Tsuruchi Archer

cmdblocks.text: Your current hireling heads home.

Mantis don't work for compliments, Crane. We work for koku.
cmdblocks.name: Tsuruchi Archer

cmdblocks.text: A cove fort. A barefoot ronin woman balancing on a mooring rope over the water, laughing: Chihaya the Quick.
A Crane! On a boat! You look like a heron in a bathtub!
cmdblocks.name: Chihaya the Quick

cmdblocks.text: I'm told the bits underneath are the problem.
cmdblocks.name: Kakita Rensei

cmdblocks.text: Chihaya wears a pirate charm (it shows on her status): blades slide off her. Break her (Suki) to shatter it. Her weak points: Yumi and Air.

Take me in if you like. Ryohei'll buy me back. He always does.
cmdblocks.name: Chihaya the Quick

cmdblocks.text: In her sash: letters. Signed by a patron. Lion.
"...Matsu Tadanobu." A Lion. Paying pirates to bleed the Crane.
cmdblocks.name: Kakita Rensei

cmdblocks.text: Got Tadanobu's Letters.
Chihaya's charm is paper and ink, and it worked. The Asahina know charms. Objective: the Temples of the Sun (the sea chart).

cmdblock.text: The lookout. The ladder rungs were cut away; somebody up there didn't want visitors.

cmdblocks.text: Rensei goes up hand over hand, very carefully, the way Kakita do everything. On the platform: a pirate's stash.
Got Pirate Charm x2.

cmdblock.text: The lookout. Nothing left on the platform but gull feathers.
Bootprints in the sand, and drag marks: a white ship has beached here before. (Danger 30-33)

cmdblock.text: The boat's at the steps, captain. Back aboard?
cmdblock.name: Ship's master

cmdblock.text: The sun is generous to pilgrims. Is there something you need, Kakita-sama?
cmdblock.name: Asahina priest

cmdblock.text: An Asahina temple of white wood and sunlight. A shugenja-priest examines Chihaya the Quick's charm and goes very pale.
It's false. But it works. It's made with - with Bloodspeaker techniques.
cmdblock.name: Asahina priest

cmdblock.text: The craft of Asahina Yajinden. Iuchiban's artificer. One of ours, long ago.
cmdblock.name: Asahina priest

cmdblock.text: Someone of his line is making these. The Asahina would be grateful if this... stayed in the family.
cmdblock.name: Asahina priest

cmdblock.text: ...Lady Sanae would understand that request.
cmdblock.name: Kakita Rensei

cmdblock.text: Got the Asahina Ward-paper.
The Asahina Ward-paper (accessory): while Rensei wears it, the false charms on his enemies work at half strength.
Yosuke the Bold drinks in the south isles, the sailors said. The ship's master marks the chart: the south isles, through the storm season. Objective: the south isles (the sea chart).
Bloodspeaker ink Taints whatever it touches. Carry jade - the charm-house has it - or the sea salt your ship's master sells.
cmdblock.name: Asahina priest

cmdblock.text: And keep the ward-paper on you. It weakens his lies.
cmdblock.name: Asahina priest

cmdblock.text: The sun shrine. A mirror on the altar, polished until it hurts to look at.

cmdblocks.text: The offering water clouds over, then clears. The Taint is gone.
The water stays clear. There is nothing in you for it to take.
Rensei kneels in the light and lets it warm the salt out of his bones. (MP restored.)

cmdblock.text: An offering box sealed with a sun-ward. Only a blessing would open it.

cmdblocks.name: Togashi Yosai

cmdblocks.text: Night. A storm. Waves over the bow. A sailor screams and points: a vast coil rising in the black water - and sinking again.
The Orochi! I saw it! I saw it!
cmdblocks.name: Sailor

cmdblocks.text: You saw a wave, boy.
cmdblocks.name: Ship's master

cmdblocks.text: Waves don't have eyes!
cmdblocks.name: Sailor

cmdblocks.text: Through the rain: a white ship, and a ronin at its prow, laughing into the storm: Yosuke the Bold.
Crane! You picked a fine night to die!
cmdblocks.name: Yosuke the Bold

cmdblocks.text: Yosuke's crew wear the false charms too. (The Ward-paper weakens them.)
Yosuke's ship veers away into the dark.
...Is it always like this?
cmdblocks.name: Kakita Rensei

cmdblocks.text: No, captain. Usually it's worse.
cmdblocks.name: Ship's master

cmdblocks.text: By dawn the storm has blown itself out. Ahead: white sand, shining.

cmdblock.text: White sand, captain. I don't trust white sand. Back aboard?
cmdblock.name: Ship's master

cmdblocks.text: A shining white-sand island. A Mantis bushi with a nunchaku waits alone on the beach under a white flag: Ryohei the Eldest, tactician, tired.
Captain Kakita. I'm the eldest. Ryohei.
cmdblocks.name: Ryohei the Eldest

cmdblocks.text: My brothers will die for the White Brother. I'd rather they didn't.
cmdblocks.name: Ryohei the Eldest

cmdblocks.text: Give me safe passage and I'll give you the shrine's back door. And my brothers' surrender.
cmdblocks.name: Ryohei the Eldest

cmdblocks.text: Go. Take your brothers. Leave Katsuo to me.
cmdblocks.name: Kakita Rensei

cmdblocks.text: You're a strange Crane. I'll tell my children about you.
cmdblocks.name: Ryohei the Eldest

cmdblocks.text: Ryohei the Eldest walks back down the beach under his white flag. His directions are good: the shrine's back door is in the hidden cove, behind the rocks.
You've had your brothers raid forty villages. No.
cmdblocks.name: Kakita Rensei

cmdblocks.text: ...I thought you'd say that. You have that face.
cmdblocks.name: Ryohei the Eldest

cmdblocks.text: Ryohei unwinds his nunchaku and walks up the cliff path, toward the shrine.
Objective: the White Squid shrine, up the cliff path.

cmdblock.text: A wrecked crate on the sand, stamped with the Doji mon. Inside, wrapped in oilcloth: a lacquered screen.
Got the Emperor's Screen.
The wrecked crate. Empty now; the screen is in the hold.
Footprints in the wet sand lead into a cleft behind the rocks. A door in the rock, barred from the inside. (Hunting)
Ryohei's back door, in the cleft behind the rocks. Unbarred, as promised.

cmdblock.text: Kyuden Doji receives no one today, Kakita-sama. The court is in mourning for its own reputation.
cmdblock.name: Daidoji guard

cmdblock.text: Kakita-sama. Lady Sanae is in her rooms. She asked for tea for two, and she does not drink tea.
cmdblock.name: Daidoji guard

cmdblock.text: CHAPTER 4 - The Play No One Performs. (Recommended level 41)

cmdblocks.text: Kyuden Doji. The most beautiful castle in the Empire. Beauty, the Crane say, is what you show. The rest you keep in boxes.
The woman behind the border crisis, Rensei-san. You saw her face.
cmdblocks.name: Doji Sanae

cmdblocks.text: Two faces, my lady. One woman.
cmdblocks.name: Kakita Rensei

cmdblocks.text: She was a Doji.
cmdblocks.name: Doji Sanae

cmdblocks.text: ...My lady?
cmdblocks.name: Kakita Rensei

cmdblocks.text: Doji Nashiko. Four centuries ago. She was jilted by the Emerald Champion, Doji Komatsu.
cmdblocks.name: Doji Sanae

cmdblocks.text: So she destroyed his entire court. With maho.
cmdblocks.name: Doji Sanae

cmdblocks.text: The Crane cannot have a demon in the family tree. Find everything the archives hold on her.
cmdblocks.name: Doji Sanae

cmdblocks.text: Then we will decide what the archives held.
cmdblocks.name: Doji Sanae

cmdblocks.text: ...Yes, my lady.
cmdblocks.name: Kakita Rensei

cmdblocks.text: (Bury it. She wants me to help bury it.)
cmdblocks.name: Kakita Rensei

cmdblocks.text: (Rested. HP and MP restored.)

cmdblock.text: Go up, Kakita-sama.

The inn's common room. Even the sake cups match.

cmdblocks.text: Why help me?

cmdblocks.text: Because she's a Doji. And the House should be the one to finish her.

cmdblocks.text: That night. Rensei's sword lies on its stand. Someone has rewrapped the hilt in new white silk. There's no note. There doesn't need to be.
...Father.

cmdblocks.text: Got The Empress of Nothing (Lady Sanae's copy).
Got Father's Hilt-wrap.
"The Play No One Performs" - complete.
A play about a demon, banned for four hundred years. Rensei rehearsed it in secret, faced his father on the white sand - and found a new hilt-wrap on his sword with no note at all.

cmdblocks.text: A disused rehearsal hall. Kakita Rensei recruits three court actors who owe him favours - and swears them to silence.
A forbidden play? At night? Finally, Kyuden Doji has culture.
cmdblocks.name: Actor

cmdblocks.text: Oh, please let me direct.
cmdblocks.name: Shosuro Mitsue

cmdblocks.text: You're a Scorpion.
cmdblocks.name: Kakita Rensei

cmdblocks.text: I'm an actress. The Scorpion part is a hobby.
cmdblocks.name: Shosuro Mitsue

cmdblocks.text: The rehearsal: three cues and two choices. When "NOW!" appears, confirm at once.
The lady gazes - and sees jade where there is only stone!
cmdblocks.name: Court actor

cmdblocks.text: NOW!
(On the beat.)
(A beat late.)
How should the title be spoken?
Yes. Mean it. She can tell flattery from worship.
cmdblocks.name: Shosuro Mitsue

cmdblocks.text: How do you know?
cmdblocks.name: Kakita Rensei

cmdblocks.text: Because I can.
cmdblocks.name: Shosuro Mitsue

cmdblocks.text: Yes. Like that. As if your life depended on it.
cmdblocks.name: Old actor

cmdblocks.text: She'd tear your throat out for that tone, young lord.
cmdblocks.name: Court actor

cmdblocks.text: And here - the false jade, laid at her feet!
cmdblocks.name: Court actress

cmdblocks.text: NOW!
(On the beat.)
(A beat late.)
The margin note: two truths at once.
It sounds like chaos!
cmdblocks.name: Court actor

cmdblocks.text: Exactly. She can only follow one.
cmdblocks.name: Kakita Rensei

cmdblocks.text: Clear, and useless: she would hear every word.

cmdblocks.text0: Two actors speak at the same time.

cmdblocks.text: Now. The title.
cmdblocks.name: Old actor

cmdblocks.text: NOW!
(On the beat.)
(A beat late.)
When the last word lands, nobody in the hall breathes. It works.
It holds together, mostly. It might work.
Rensei swears the actors to silence. They swear it delightedly, which worries him.
Morning.

cmdblocks.text: The border conference. Two armies, one meadow, and a lot of very sharp politeness.
Night. Shadows move between the tents. A figure in white silk slips into one Crane general's tent - then another - then a third. Later, a black ponytail ducks into a Crab tent.
At the camp's edge, Hiruma Natsuko peels away toward the Crab lines. Rensei goes on alone.
At the camp's edge, Hiruma Goro peels away toward the Crab lines. Rensei goes on alone.
Sentries, glassy-eyed, block the lane between the tents.
The lady said - the lady said the Crab come at dawn-
cmdblocks.name: Seduced Sentry

cmdblocks.text: The lady says a lot of things.
cmdblocks.name: Kakita Rensei

cmdblock.text: A Crane sentry stands at the rope line, eyes glazed, spear crosswise.

cmdblocks.text: The general wants to see me. Urgently. About the lady.
cmdblocks.name: Kakita Rensei

cmdblocks.text: The sentry blinks, and lets him through. The next line of sentries never sees him.
The lady said no one... The lady said...
cmdblocks.name: Seduced Sentry

cmdblocks.text: He won't move. (Fight through the next line instead.)

cmdblock.text: The rope line, unguarded.

cmdblocks.text: More sentries. Their eyes shine pink in the torchlight.

cmdblock.text: Young, swarthy, coiled like a spring: Daidoji Uji, half-dressed, already buckling armour.
The Crab are coming at dawn. I've been told. We strike first.
cmdblock.name: Daidoji Uji

cmdblocks.text: Who told you, my lord? A woman? At night? In your tent?
cmdblocks.name: Kakita Rensei

cmdblocks.text: ...How do you-
cmdblocks.name: Daidoji Uji

cmdblocks.text: The Lion your general cut down. He caught her in a lie about a dead uncle. Minutes later he was dead.
cmdblocks.name: Kakita Rensei

cmdblocks.text: ...Moteuchi died in the south. Of fever. I was at his funeral.
cmdblocks.name: Daidoji Uji

cmdblocks.text: There was a Lion...
cmdblocks.name: Kakita Rensei

cmdblocks.text: Rensei didn't hear enough to say it. He argues instead.

cmdblock.text1: Tell him about Tadaka. (Needs: you heard Tadaka's question)

cmdblock.text: Across the meadow, Hida Yakamo - young, blunt, impatient - is already half-persuaded.

cmdblocks.text: An outside hand? On both sides? Fine. If you're wrong, scout, you're cleaning latrines.
cmdblocks.name: Hida Yakamo

cmdblocks.text: I've been threatened with latrines before. I'm still here.
cmdblocks.name: Hiruma Natsuko

cmdblocks.text: An outside hand. Hm. Somebody playing us like a drum.
cmdblocks.name: Hida Yakamo

cmdblocks.text: Like a drum, my lord. Both sides.
cmdblocks.name: Hiruma Goro

cmdblocks.text: Company! Then I'll wait at the next inn and recount my enemies. It's a long list. I'm very popular.
(Togashi Yosai waits beside the inns. Ask him along again when no one else travels with you.)
Dawn. Three Daidoji generals ride out ahead of their lines, eyes glassy, swords drawn. Behind them on the ridge, in white: Doji Miyako, watching.
She said the Crab would come at dawn. She said only I could save her.
cmdblocks.name: Daidoji general

cmdblocks.text: She says that to everyone, general. I heard her say it twice last night.
cmdblocks.name: Kakita Rensei

cmdblocks.text: Miyako's charm holds them, and it heals them while they fight. Break them (Suki) to free them: Yari, Tanto and Water find the gaps.
All three generals stand blinking in the dawn. Free.
Not every general walks away from the meadow.
On the ridge, the woman in white is gone.

A general's fan, dropped in the grass when he woke.
Got the Daidoji War Fan.

If anyone asks, I'm your... what am I?
cmdblocks.name: Hiruma Natsuko

cmdblocks.text: My "esteemed Crab colleague".
cmdblocks.name: Kakita Rensei

cmdblocks.text: Nobody's ever esteemed me. It itches.
cmdblocks.name: Hiruma Natsuko

cmdblocks.text: Lady Sanae sends Hiruma Goro - already travelling with the party - across the land-bridge with a letter. Rensei goes with him.
Lady Sanae sends Hiruma Goro, a big Crab bodyguard on loan from the Yasuki, across the land-bridge with a letter. Rensei goes with him.
Crab dinner. I know how those go. Somebody always ends up in the fish pond.

cmdblocks.text: Togashi Yosai joins the party. (Dragon's Breath, Arrowroot; his tattoos heal him a little every turn.)
I'll be here. Probably. Statistically.
cmdblocks.name: Togashi Yosai

cmdblocks.text: You've already got company. I'll keep the bench warm. Benches love me.
cmdblocks.name: Togashi Yosai

cmdblocks.text: The Crab hall at Yasuki Yashiki. Hida generals. And beside them, a lovely black-ponytailed Kuni apprentice with a gentle smile: Kuni Miyubi.
A Crab custom: sake served scalding hot, as a dare. Generals wince and swear. Miyubi drains her cup without a flicker.
Nobody drinks Crab sake like that. Not even Crab.
cmdblocks.name: Hiruma Natsuko

cmdblocks.text: I've seen a troll flinch at that sake.
cmdblocks.name: Hiruma Goro

cmdblocks.text: Two Hida generals start shoving over a remark. A sumai ring is cleared.
Why are you angry, general? Really?
cmdblocks.name: Hiruma Natsuko

cmdblocks.text: Because - because we raided an Asahina estate. Last month. On her word.
cmdblocks.name: Hida Masakazu

cmdblocks.text: She found maho masks there. She said they were planning to - Gods. Did anyone else see the masks?
cmdblocks.name: Hida Masakazu

cmdblocks.text: Hiruma Goro takes the loser's belt and puts him in the sawdust. Hida Masakazu sits up, red to the ears.
We raided an Asahina estate. Last month. On her word.
cmdblocks.name: Hida Masakazu

cmdblocks.text: She found maho masks there. She said they were planning to - Gods. Did anyone else see the masks?
cmdblocks.name: Hida Masakazu

cmdblocks.text: A one-handed Kuni with a burned face, Kuni Akuja, holds up "relics" Kuni Miyubi found. He looks at her with naked jealousy.
She found in one night what I've hunted for ten years. Isn't that remarkable.
cmdblocks.name: Kuni Akuja

cmdblocks.text: Objective: back across the land-bridge. Lady Sanae will want a report, in her rooms at the castle.

cmdblocks.text: The cells, before dawn. Kakita Yasurugi waits in the dark beside Kakita Morishu's door.
Kakita Yasurugi says nothing. He only draws.
Then I'll stand in your way.
cmdblocks.name: Kakita Rensei

cmdblocks.text: The duel: he Focuses, then Strikes. Strike first, or he will. (A Kakita turns katana aside; a tanto gets inside his guard.)
...Better.
cmdblocks.name: Kakita Yasurugi

cmdblocks.text: He bows to Rensei - a full bow - and walks out past the cells. Nobody stops him.
He bows to Rensei - a full bow - and walks out through the crowd. Nobody stops him.
...Heaven has spoken. The ronin lives.
cmdblocks.name: Akodo Goroso

cmdblocks.text: The village in my forest - it is under his protection now. And under my taxes.
cmdblocks.name: Akodo Goroso

cmdblocks.text: Most generous, my lord.
cmdblocks.name: Torishigawa

cmdblocks.text: Most generous.
cmdblocks.name: Doji Sanae

cmdblocks.text: Kakita Morishu, untied, stands in front of Kakita Rensei with the sword Heaven's Glory held out in both hands.
It shows you what you should be. I can't bear to look at it anymore.
cmdblocks.name: Kakita Morishu

cmdblocks.text: You still can. Please.
cmdblocks.name: Kakita Morishu

cmdblocks.text: Rensei takes Heaven's Glory. (It will answer his hand once he reaches Rank 2.)
Chaos in the crowd. Kakita Morishu escapes into the forest for good - with Heaven's Glory.
Lord Goroso writes to the Crane that night, in a fury that will feed the coming war.
Kakita Morishu dies before the sun is up. In the village, Sariko's cry carries a long way. Lady Sanae returns the sword to its box for the Kakita vaults.
On the road east. Kakita Rensei walks beside the palanquin. For once he is not walking like a spear.
My lady. The letter. The death poem. Would my father ever...
cmdblocks.name: Kakita Rensei

cmdblocks.text: Your father is a hard man who would never write such a letter.
cmdblocks.name: Doji Sanae

cmdblocks.text: That is why I make sure no one ever has to find out whether that's true.
cmdblocks.name: Doji Sanae

cmdblocks.text: ...Is that what you'll write in your report? That nothing happened?
cmdblocks.name: Kakita Rensei

cmdblocks.text: You learn quickly. The Academy will be furious.
cmdblocks.name: Doji Sanae

cmdblocks.text: I told you they teach nothing useful there.
cmdblocks.name: Kitsuki Seigen

cmdblocks.text: "Heaven's Glory" - complete.
Sent to make a fallen prodigy disappear, Rensei found a man who could cut twice and then shake for an hour - and had to decide what kind of Crane to be.
Kitsuki Seigen and Matsu Kiku take their leave for now. (Either will answer the Guest call again when you find them on the road.)

The Crane demand trial by challenge. So be it. Heaven will choose.

cmdblocks.text: I name my champion. A Kakita, at his own request.
cmdblocks.name: Akodo Goroso

cmdblocks.text: The Lion-Phoenix-Crane border. Where three clans' maps overlap, and none of them agree.
River fog. Lion riders on the bank. Akodo Gusai, soot-smeared and grinning, raises a torch.
Phoenix warehouses! Full of rice for the Crane army! Burn them!
cmdblocks.name: Akodo Gusai

cmdblocks.text: Cousin, we came to scout the warehouses.
cmdblocks.name: Akodo Shizue

cmdblocks.text: I've scouted them. They're flammable.
cmdblocks.name: Akodo Gusai

cmdblocks.text: Gusai-
cmdblocks.name: Akodo Shizue

cmdblocks.text: Hold the horses, Shizue! You're good at standing still.
cmdblocks.name: Akodo Gusai

cmdblocks.text: He charges. Phoenix guards rush out.

cmdblocks.text: Lion rider joins the party.
Command: Akodo Shizue's School technique. An Akodo order: the party hits harder, and acts first next turn.
Lions break shields fastest when they strike in order. Weaknesses and Suki work the same for everyone. Think three moves ahead.
The warehouses burn. Across the water, smaller flames: a roadside shrine being smashed by Gusai's men.
Gusai! The shrine is not a warehouse!
cmdblocks.name: Akodo Shizue

cmdblocks.text: Then it shouldn't stand next to one!
cmdblocks.name: Akodo Gusai

cmdblocks.text: Inside the broken shrine, a samurai, Akodo Hojiki, lifts a lacquered box. It splits open: a skull bound in jade chain. The chain is in pieces. He cuts his palm on a jade shard and wraps the cut with a small green stone.
...For luck.
cmdblocks.name: Akodo Hojiki

cmdblocks.text: Hojiki looks up and sees Akodo Shizue watching. He bows, embarrassed. The fog swallows the shrine.
(Rested. HP and MP restored.)
A week later.

cmdblocks.text: A small castle. Lord Akodo Hiruto stands at the gate, calm as a stone. Phoenix banners approach: the arrogant heir Isawa Kamasari, his yojimbo Shiba Ashimita, and an Imperial magistrate in muted silk, Miya Yachiko.
Lord Hiruto. My uncle, Isawa Hoju, is dead. By blood magic.
cmdblocks.name: Isawa Kamasari

cmdblocks.text: We followed the stink of maho west. It ends at your gate.
cmdblocks.name: Isawa Kamasari

cmdblocks.text: Then you'll want to come in.
cmdblocks.name: Akodo Hiruto

cmdblocks.text: The Emperor's interest is in peace, my lord. And the truth, of course.
cmdblocks.name: Miya Yachiko

cmdblocks.text: Of course.
cmdblocks.name: Akodo Hiruto

cmdblocks.text: Later. Hiruto, alone with his family in the hall: his eldest Akodo Hojato, the sullen Akodo Gusai, and Akodo Shizue.
You will investigate. All of you.
cmdblocks.name: Akodo Hiruto

cmdblocks.text: Father, bushido and honour are all we-
cmdblocks.name: Akodo Hojato

cmdblocks.text: Bushido and honour have never once found a murderer, Hojato.
cmdblocks.name: Akodo Hiruto

cmdblocks.text: Find the truth. If it's a Lion's truth, it is still the truth.
cmdblocks.name: Akodo Hiruto

cmdblocks.text: And if the truth starts a war, uncle?
cmdblocks.name: Akodo Shizue

cmdblocks.text: Then we will at least know what we are fighting about.
cmdblocks.name: Akodo Hiruto

cmdblocks.text: That will be rare.
cmdblocks.name: Akodo Hiruto

cmdblocks.text: (Rested. HP and MP restored.)

cmdblock.text: The bathhouse. The water is always cold now, the servants say.
The bathhouse. On the wet floor, half under the duckboards: a small green stone. Real jade, cold and clean.
Got Hojiki's Jade Stone.
Hojiki's wound-stone, then, is not jade at all.

cmdblocks.text: (A clue: Real jade on the bathhouse floor. Hojiki's wound-stone was swapped.)
Scouts ride in through the gate.
Crane banners. Three ri. Watching, not moving.
cmdblocks.name: Akodo Ukita

cmdblocks.text: A cry from the chapel. Kitsu Togawa has been found choked - from the inside.
Not a hand. Something inside him.
cmdblocks.name: Akodo Ijako

cmdblocks.text: A scream from the guest wing. Matsu Nagai has drawn on the Phoenix, his eyes red.
Phoenix! You killed my children! You bound me!
cmdblocks.name: Matsu Nagai

cmdblocks.text: Matsu Nagai is possessed. (Weak: Jade - Hojiki's real stone, if you have it - and Water.)
Matsu Nagai collapses, himself again, weeping. Isawa Kamasari is furious.
Enough! Hojiki was named by the dead! I will have him in chains!
cmdblocks.name: Isawa Kamasari

cmdblocks.text: Give me one more day, Isawa-sama.
cmdblocks.name: Akodo Shizue

cmdblocks.text: For what? Lion honour?
cmdblocks.name: Isawa Kamasari

cmdblocks.text: For the truth. You said you followed it here. Let me follow it a little further.
cmdblocks.name: Akodo Shizue

cmdblocks.text: My lord. Let me test her.
cmdblocks.name: Shiba Ashimita

cmdblocks.text: If she can stand against me, she's earned her day.
cmdblocks.name: Shiba Ashimita

cmdblocks.text: Win or lose, Shiba Ashimita grants the day.
You fight like someone listening for the next move.
cmdblocks.name: Shiba Ashimita

cmdblocks.text: You fight like someone listening for something else entirely.
cmdblocks.name: Akodo Shizue

cmdblocks.text: My grandfather. He screams. He has since I was born.
cmdblocks.name: Shiba Ashimita

cmdblocks.text: You get used to it. No. You don't.
cmdblocks.name: Shiba Ashimita

cmdblocks.text: Shiba Ashimita will answer the Guest call in battle. (One guest at a time.)
(Rested. HP and MP restored.)
Five clues. Objective: Akodo Hojiki, in the barracks.

cmdblock.text: The bathhouse. Cold water, and nothing on the floor.
I won't lie for anyone. Ask me anything.
cmdblock.name: Akodo Ukita

cmdblock.text: The ghost that accuses Hojiki? It walks at the hour of the ox, by the water barrel. I see oddly well at night. Wait with me.
cmdblock.name: Akodo Ukita

cmdblocks.text: Night. The courtyard is very still.

cmdblock.text: A ghost that casts no reflection. My grandmother would have liked you, Akodo-san.
cmdblock.name: Akodo Ukita

cmdblock.text: The water barrel. By day, only water.
Hojiki! Hojiki killed me! The Lion killed me!
cmdblock.name: Peasant ghost

cmdblocks.text: Look in the water, Shizue. No face.
cmdblocks.name: Akodo Ijako

cmdblocks.text: A ghost that lies. Then it isn't a peasant.
cmdblocks.name: Akodo Shizue

#17#.msg: Bah. Ghosts. Train harder.
#17#.name: *villager-17

cmdblock.text: The west tower, dark against the sky.
Shizue faces the west tower and holds up the Jade Chains.
Ice. The lock burns with cold. The spirit is here.
He's impatient now. He'll do something tonight.
cmdblock.name: Akodo Ijako

cmdblock.text: Objective: the hall, tonight. Everyone will gather.

cmdblocks.text: (Rested. HP and MP restored.)

cmdblock.text: The west tower. The chains are ice in Shizue's hands.

#19#.msg: The bath is always cold now.
#19#.name: *villager-19

cmdblocks.text: Lord Hiruto's castle. Lord Akodo Hiruto receives the Phoenix embassy without warmth. A young Akodo tactician stands at his side and says nothing at all.
My grandfather has gone quiet. He's never quiet.
cmdblocks.name: Shiba Ashimita

cmdblocks.text: ...There's something in the west tower. He doesn't want to go near it.
cmdblocks.name: Shiba Ashimita

cmdblocks.text: Then I'll go. He can stay with you.
cmdblocks.name: Isawa Haruki

cmdblocks.text: Objective: the west tower.
Lord Hiruto's castle. Akodo Shizue plays go with her uncle, Akodo Hiruto.
The stones click for a long time. She lets him win, once.
You let me win.
cmdblocks.name: Akodo Hiruto

cmdblocks.text: You noticed.
cmdblocks.name: Akodo Shizue

cmdblocks.text: I notice everything.
cmdblocks.name: Akodo Hiruto

cmdblocks.text: A pause.
Thank you.
cmdblocks.name: Akodo Hiruto

cmdblocks.text: And the Champion read your report. The whole court knows the Lion charged first.
cmdblocks.name: Akodo Hiruto

cmdblocks.text: A pause.
I've never been prouder of a disgrace.
cmdblocks.name: Akodo Hiruto

cmdblock.text: The east gate: the road to the Phoenix lands. Lord Hiruto's orders: nobody leaves until this is settled.
The Lion road west, to the Akodo lands. Not yet.
The dead in town are quieter than in the castle. Call me when you need them.
cmdblock.name: Akodo Ijako

cmdblocks.text: Akodo Ijako will answer the Guest call.

cmdblock.text0: Ask Akodo Ijako to come along.

cmdblock.text: My grandfather wants to know why we're at an inn. Need me?
cmdblock.name: Shiba Ashimita

cmdblocks.text: Shiba Ashimita will answer the Guest call.

cmdblock.text0: Ask Shiba Ashimita to come along.

#11#.msg: The fields won't grow. The kami left.
#11#.name: *villager-11

#12#.msg: Just passing. Buying. Selling.
#12#.name: *villager-12

#13#.msg: My grandfather won't talk to me any more. He's dead, but he used to talk.
#13#.name: *villager-13

#14#.msg: I guard the gate. Nobody asked which side.
#14#.name: *villager-14

cmdblock.text: The tea house's back room: a jar of good sake, and a folded note in a Crane hand.
Got Fine Sake.
Got a Crane Spy's Note.
The back room. Empty cups.
The town shrine. Silent: the kami here have fled or been devoured. It offers no rites.
The town shrine. The kami are coming back: a bell rings by itself.

cmdblocks.text: The offering water clouds over, then clears. The Taint is gone.
The water stays clear. There is nothing in you for it to take.
Shizue kneels. For the first time since the raid, something listens. (MP restored.)

cmdblock.text: Spear for hire, Akodo-sama. Lord Hiruto pays us to stand still. I'd rather stab something.
cmdblock.name: Lion Ashigaru

cmdblocks.text: Your current hireling heads home.
Three thrusts. Then back to the gate.
cmdblocks.name: Lion Ashigaru

cmdblocks.text: Lion Ashigaru follows Shizue. (In battle: Support. 3 uses, then home to Lord Hiruto's gate.)
Coin first, Akodo-sama.
cmdblocks.name: Lion Ashigaru

cmdblock.text: The ancestors won't answer here, Akodo-sama. But I can still bind a wound.
cmdblock.name: Kitsu Acolyte

cmdblocks.text: Your current hireling heads home.
Three prayers. They'll have to be enough.
cmdblocks.name: Kitsu Acolyte

cmdblocks.text: Kitsu Acolyte follows Shizue. (In battle: Support. 3 uses, then home to the silent shrine.)
Coin first, Akodo-sama.
cmdblocks.name: Kitsu Acolyte

cmdblocks.text: Everyone gathers: Akodo Hiruto, Isawa Kamasari, Shiba Ashimita, Miya Yachiko, Akodo Ijako, Akodo Hojiki under guard. The chains hang in Akodo Shizue's hands, freezing.
He's here. In this room. The dead have stopped whispering.
cmdblocks.name: Akodo Ijako

cmdblocks.text: Use me. It's my body he's been borrowing. Let him have it one last time - in chains.
cmdblocks.name: Akodo Hojiki

cmdblocks.text: ...Bring the Lion back from my guard.
cmdblocks.name: Isawa Kamasari

cmdblocks.text: A Crane duellist arrives under truce to settle the border by iaijutsu: Kakita Mizochi.
O-Tamai, whispering in Shizue's ear: "Let me lend you Hojiki's hands, Lion. You'll win. The Crane will die."
No.
cmdblocks.name: Akodo Shizue

cmdblocks.text: I'll face you clean, Kakita-san.
cmdblocks.name: Akodo Shizue

cmdblocks.text: Refused, O-Tamai lashes out.
A red shadow crawls across the courtyard wall, toward Lord Hiruto's chamber.
Tiles slide under Shizue's feet. The shadow is faster.
Screens fly open. The shadow is faster.
Shizue comes up the stair two steps at a time.
Shizue goes over the rail and lands running.
Lord Hiruto's doorway. The red shadow, and Shizue a breath ahead of it.
Uncle! Don't move!
cmdblocks.name: Akodo Shizue

cmdblocks.text: I wasn't going to.
cmdblocks.name: Akodo Hiruto

cmdblocks.text0: A - Bind him into a body.

cmdblocks.text: The air goes red. O-Tamai rises in a borrowed body; a shadow-oni crawls up behind it.
Lions! You broke my prison to burn a granary!
cmdblocks.name: O-Tamai

cmdblocks.text: I owe you a war. Let me pay my debt!
cmdblocks.name: O-Tamai

cmdblocks.text: We'll take it in jade.
cmdblocks.name: Akodo Shizue

cmdblocks.text: And a Phoenix! The Phoenix killed a child to bind me! Tell them, little Isawa!
cmdblocks.name: O-Tamai

cmdblocks.text: Yes. We did. And I know exactly what that costs.
cmdblocks.name: Isawa Haruki

cmdblocks.text: That's why I won't let you make anyone pay it again.
cmdblocks.name: Isawa Haruki

cmdblocks.text: Each time O-Tamai's guard breaks (Suki), a jade chain goes round him. Three chains hold him. (The red shadow eats MP and VP, not HP.)
The spirit-wasteland status clears. Somewhere, very faintly, a kami in the garden starts humming again.
Morning. The skull, wrapped in new jade, goes east with the Phoenix.
The Phoenix... acknowledge your diligence.
cmdblocks.name: Isawa Kamasari

cmdblocks.text: The Lion acknowledge your patience.
cmdblocks.name: Akodo Shizue

cmdblocks.text: That's the nicest thing he's ever said to anyone.
cmdblocks.name: Shiba Ashimita

cmdblocks.text: Inconclusive. Write "inconclusive".
cmdblocks.name: Miya Yachiko

cmdblocks.text: Akodo Shizue sees Miya Yachiko smile at the word.
Later. Akodo Hiruto's private garden.
My son started a war for a granary. My nephew wanted one for glory.
cmdblocks.name: Akodo Hiruto

cmdblocks.text: You stopped one for the truth.
cmdblocks.name: Akodo Hiruto

cmdblocks.text: I can't reward you for it. It would shame them.
cmdblocks.name: Akodo Hiruto

cmdblocks.text: He gives her his own go stones, worn smooth.

cmdblocks.name: Akodo Hiruto

cmdblocks.text: ...You noticed.
cmdblocks.name: Akodo Shizue

cmdblocks.text: I notice everything, Shizue. I just don't say so. It's a Lion habit. Break it, if you can.
cmdblocks.name: Akodo Hiruto

The most junior seat. The far end of the hall.

cmdblocks.text: Good. You see the whole board from the far end.

cmdblock.text: A despoiled roadside shrine: the doors torn off, the offering bowls kicked into the ditch.
A despoiled roadside shrine. Out come the Jade Chains.
Cold. Frost on the lacquer.
Cold. Frost on the lacquer.
The Magonojo ruins across the water: the burned warehouses. Smoke still rises from one.
A river-bank ledge, slippery with fog. Something lodged in the reeds below.

cmdblocks.text: Shizue goes down carefully and comes back up carefully. Akodo tacticians do not fall in rivers.
Got Rice Ball x2.

cmdblock.text: The ledge. Only reeds now.
A road-stone: "Shiro no Kamatori, two days east. Danger 4-8."

cmdblocks.text: Blackened warehouses on the Magonojo river. Isawa Kamasari's men pick through the ash.
...Crane army supply marks. Rice. Arrows.
cmdblocks.name: Isawa Haruki

cmdblocks.text: The Phoenix were supplying the Crane army. Secretly.
cmdblocks.name: Isawa Haruki

cmdblocks.text: Throw those crates in the river.
cmdblocks.name: Isawa Kamasari

cmdblocks.text: Sensei never told you.
cmdblocks.name: Shiba Ashimita

cmdblocks.text: No.
cmdblocks.name: Isawa Haruki

cmdblocks.text: Sensei was a historian. Historians know which things not to write down yet.
cmdblocks.name: Shiba Ashimita

cmdblocks.text: Got a Stamped Crate Lid.
Haruki lets the lid go into the river with the rest.
Objective: on west. The lock grows colder.
A smashed roadside shrine. The jade-chain lock is freezing here. An old shrine-keeper's ghost wanders the rubble, straightening stones that won't stay straight.
They broke it. Lions. Soldiers. They broke it and it got out. I must fix it. I must fix it.
cmdblocks.name: Shrine-keeper's Ghost

cmdblocks.text: Bless (Haruki's path action): guide someone, living or dead, to follow you.
You've kept it long enough, grandfather. Let me carry it now.
cmdblocks.name: Isawa Haruki

cmdblocks.text: ...You'll fix it?
cmdblocks.name: Shrine-keeper's Ghost

cmdblocks.text: I'll find what got out. That's the fixing.
cmdblocks.name: Isawa Haruki

cmdblocks.text: The ghost bows and fades into a calm light.
The shrine's broken guardian-stones lurch upright.
Haruki's Affinity is Water and Void. Void spells cost VP, not MP, and grow stronger the more VP he holds.
Drawing the Void gains VP at once. And Void Path to Inner Peace with 3 VP to heal the whole party.
Sensei always said Void was the element that holds the others together.
cmdblocks.name: Isawa Haruki

cmdblocks.text: And?
cmdblocks.name: Shiba Ashimita

cmdblocks.text: ...I've never been very good at holding things together.
cmdblocks.name: Isawa Haruki

cmdblocks.text: CHAPTER 1 - The Silent Kami.
Shiro no Kamatori. A Phoenix castle of five towers, where an old man is writing the history of a family that doesn't want one.
Lamplight. Scrolls everywhere. Isawa Hoju, white-bearded, ink on his nose, dictates. Isawa Haruki copies. His left hand taps his fingers one by one on the desk: fire, water, air, earth, void.
"...and in the third year, the family's shugenja bound a great evil in the west." No - "a grave evil." Grave.
cmdblocks.name: Isawa Hoju

cmdblocks.text: Grave, sensei. ...Sensei, what evil?
cmdblocks.name: Isawa Haruki

cmdblocks.text: The kind one writes about only once. You're counting on your fingers again.
cmdblocks.name: Isawa Hoju

cmdblocks.text: Sorry.
cmdblocks.name: Isawa Haruki

cmdblocks.text: Five fingers, five elements. And when you run out of fingers?
cmdblocks.name: Isawa Hoju

cmdblocks.text: Then I start again on the other hand, sensei.
cmdblocks.name: Isawa Haruki

cmdblocks.text: Ten elements! The Council will be thrilled. They'll make you a Master.
cmdblocks.name: Isawa Hoju

cmdblocks.text: Go to bed, Haruki. History has waited four hundred years. It can wait until morning.
cmdblocks.name: Isawa Hoju

cmdblocks.text: Yes, sensei. Sensei - you'll go to bed too?
cmdblocks.name: Isawa Haruki

cmdblocks.text: In a moment.
cmdblocks.name: Isawa Hoju

cmdblocks.text: Field spells: before bed, Haruki can Commune with the garden kami (the door to the inner garden), Summon a little water, and Sense what is lost. The futon is by the wall.

cmdblock.text: Hoju's reading stand.
Sense (Haruki's field spell): feel for what is lost.
Something wooden and well-loved, under the reading stand.
Hoju's brush. Haruki sets it back by the inkstone.
A futon, rolled against the wall.
Haruki lays out his futon. In the study, the lamp is still burning.

cmdblocks.text: A scream from the study. Isawa Haruki runs in. Isawa Hoju is slumped at his desk, his eyes bleeding - still holding the brush.
Sensei! Sensei!
cmdblocks.name: Isawa Haruki

cmdblocks.text: Haruki casts Path to Inner Peace with shaking hands. Nothing. Hoju is already gone.
The garden. Haruki stumbles to the shrine. Commune.
Please. Please answer. You always answer.
cmdblocks.name: Isawa Haruki

cmdblocks.text: Silence. Only wind in the pines.
...The cook. The salt. You always talk about the salt.
cmdblocks.name: Isawa Haruki

cmdblocks.text: Nothing. He counts his fingers - fire, water, air, earth, void. He counts them again.
The spirit wasteland: the kami are afraid. Haruki's spells are weaker (75%) until whatever frightened them is found.
Morning.

cmdblock.text: Hoju's desk. A chest underneath, with his tea things.
Under the tea things: a coil of jade chain, broken links, a lock. The lock is warm in his hand - and cold when he turns toward the west window.
"Kaiki. Fifteen. We had no other way." "I forged the chains. I have never forgiven myself for the boy."
cmdblock.name: Isawa Haruki

cmdblock.text: Got the Jade Chains.
The Jade Chains: the lock grows cold when it faces the spirit. Hold it up at the despoiled shrines on the road west; the coldest place is where the evil waits.
Beneath the chains: a small folded paper, in a child's handwriting.

cmdblocks.text: Haruki recognises the handwriting. He doesn't unfold it. He puts it in his sleeve.
Got a Folded Note.
He leaves it where it lies.

cmdblock.text: Objective: west along the shrine road, with the embassy, to Lord Hiruto's castle.

cmdblocks.text: (Rested. HP and MP restored.)

cmdblock.text: Hoju's desk, and the empty chest under it.

cmdblocks.text: The study is cleaned. Isawa Hoju's desk is bare. The Council has thanked Isawa Kamasari. No one mentioned Isawa Haruki.
He sits at the empty desk and takes the folded paper from his sleeve. Unfolds it.
A child's brushwork, wobbly, pressed hard into the paper:
"I'm sorry, Mieko. I didn't mean to. Please wake up."
cmdblocks.name: Note

cmdblocks.text: ...You kept this. Twelve years.
cmdblocks.name: Isawa Haruki

cmdblocks.text: You knew, sensei. You knew all along. And you never said a word.
cmdblocks.name: Isawa Haruki

cmdblocks.text: He counts on his fingers. Fire. Water. Air. Earth. He stops at five. He doesn't start again.
He sits at the empty desk. He counts on his fingers. Fire. Water. Air. Earth. He stops at five.
A knock: a messenger. The Phoenix will hold a Silent Court in Isawa Hoju's memory. Every clan will send envoys.
The ceremony masters have been named. The second is a priest from the north. Isawa Mieko.
cmdblocks.name: Messenger

cmdblocks.text: Isawa Haruki's hand closes over the note.
Got Hoju's History.
"The Silent Kami" - complete.
His teacher murdered by maho, Haruki followed the silence west and bound a Bloodspeaker in jade. Now Hoju's memorial court is coming, and the girl from the note is one of its ceremony masters.
Kamasari wants his yojimbo back. Call me if you need someone to fall off a horse for you.
cmdblocks.name: Shiba Ashimita

cmdblocks.text: Shiba Ashimita will answer the Guest call in battle from now on.
Next: the Silent Court. Zumiki, by the road east out of Kamatori. (Recommended level 20)
Shiro no Kamatori. In the sunset its copper-edged walls blaze as though the castle were built of fire.
This was my teacher's home.
cmdblocks.name: Isawa Haruki

cmdblocks.text: Then you'll know where he kept his secrets.
cmdblocks.name: Akodo Shizue

cmdblocks.text: In a chest under his desk. With his tea. He always said history and tea should be kept together.
cmdblocks.name: Isawa Haruki

cmdblocks.text: A nervous young Isawa acolyte meets them: the castle's last scholar, who reads them Hoju's history.
Isawa Hoju's study. His unfinished family history, read aloud.
"A Bloodspeaker, O-Tamai, who called himself the beloved of Iuchiban, wore the body of the young shugenja Kaiki for two years."
cmdblocks.name: Reader

cmdblocks.text: "We could not cast him out. So we killed the boy, and bound the spirit to its skull in jade."
cmdblocks.name: Reader

cmdblocks.text: "I forged the chains myself. I have never forgiven myself for the boy."
cmdblocks.name: Reader

cmdblocks.text: In the chest: the jade chains. The lock grows cold when it faces west.
Got the Jade Chains.
The Jade Chains: the lock grows cold when it faces the spirit. Walk the shrine road home and hold it up at each despoiled shrine; the coldest place is where O-Tamai waits.
(Rested. HP and MP restored.)

Got Hoju's Tea Set.
An empty shelf, and the smell of old tea.

cmdblocks.text: The story is wrong. He wept every night for thirty years.
cmdblocks.name: Akodo Kafu

cmdblocks.text: He simply did it where no one could see.
cmdblocks.name: Akodo Kafu

cmdblocks.text: Akodo Nishi sets her cup down very carefully.
(Glory +1. Toturi glances up.)
Akodo Nishi smiles.
A hush. Honest. (Honor +1)

cmdblocks.text2: "The day my cousin started a war."

cmdblocks.text: Got a Jade Flesh-cutter Arrow.

cmdblock.text: Today: the bushido debate.

cmdblocks.text: The debate. Each speaker defends a tenet.
cmdblocks.name: Hostess

cmdblocks.text: Honour is what our lord says it is. The lord defines it. We obey.
cmdblocks.name: Matsu Speaker

cmdblocks.text: The Matsu speaker smiles. Weak.
...And yet.
cmdblocks.name: Akodo Shizue

cmdblocks.text0: "Whose honour was it at Sorrow's Path, when both armies called themselves righteous?"
cmdblocks.text1: "My uncle told me to find the truth, even a Lion's truth."

cmdblocks.text: Honour isn't a banner someone can steal from a wall.
cmdblocks.name: Akodo Shizue

cmdblocks.text: Silence. Then, from the high seats, for the first time:
Who is that?
cmdblocks.name: Akodo Toturi

cmdblocks.text: Akodo Hiruto's niece, my lord. A junior strategist.
cmdblocks.name: Karo

cmdblocks.text: Got Akodo's Leadership.
Days later. Akodo Kafu no longer wears his ancestral katana.
Rewrapping. The hilt was worn.
cmdblocks.name: Akodo Kafu

cmdblocks.text: Objective: the swordsmith's shed, in the castle town.

cmdblock.text: The South Dojo was so cold last night, my lady - has anyone looked?
cmdblock.name: Hostess

cmdblock.text: The dance contest! Partners, please.
cmdblock.name: Hostess

cmdblocks.text: The dance. Who will Shizue partner?
I dance like a wall.
cmdblocks.name: Kaiu Yutaka

cmdblocks.text: Then I'll dance like a siege.
cmdblocks.name: Akodo Shizue

cmdblocks.text: A Lion asking a Crane spy to dance. They'll talk.
cmdblocks.name: Daidoji Atsuko

cmdblocks.text: Let them.
cmdblocks.name: Akodo Shizue

cmdblocks.text: No one ever asks me.
cmdblocks.name: Moto Benjiro

cmdblocks.text: He dances surprisingly well.
Got the Jade-inlaid War Fans.
Akodo Nishi dances with her betrothed, smiling the whole way through. Her smile breaks only once - when she passes Kafu.
The next morning. Akodo Toturi strides into the hall, his karo behind him, dragging Daidoji Atsuko.
My seal. My mon. Taken from my own chamber.
cmdblocks.name: Akodo Toturi

cmdblocks.text: The Crane was seen in the corridor, my lord.
cmdblocks.name: Karo

cmdblocks.text: Akodo Shizue. You have a week. Clear her or confirm her.
cmdblocks.name: Akodo Toturi

cmdblocks.text: That night Shizue lays them out in her room: a scarf, a flower, Duty, the banner, the sword, letters, the seal.
A scarf from a friend. A flower from the garden. Duty. The banner. His sword. The seal.
cmdblocks.name: Akodo Shizue

cmdblocks.text: ...They're all Kafu's. Everything Kafu loves, in order. Someone is taking his life apart one piece at a time.
cmdblocks.name: Akodo Shizue

cmdblocks.text: Objective: Daidoji Atsuko, in the cells.
(Rested. HP and MP restored.)

cmdblock.text: The wedding is in a week. Everyone keeps telling the bride.
cmdblock.name: Hostess

#5#.msg: Akodo Shizue.
#5#.name: *villager-5

#6#.msg: Sufficient.
#6#.name: *villager-6

#7#.msg: The far end of the hall, Shizue. You see the whole board from there.
#7#.name: *villager-7

cmdblocks.text: Shiro Akodo. Winter Court. Three hundred samurai, and one of them so junior the servants pour her tea last.
Ranks of kneeling samurai under ancestor portraits. Far up the hall: Akodo Toturi, quiet, watchful. Past all the great names, on the very last cushion: Akodo Shizue.
The Crab were asked for their opinion of the Akodo.
cmdblocks.name: Kaiu Gesshin

cmdblocks.text: I have looked. My verdict is... sufficient.
cmdblocks.name: Kaiu Gesshin

cmdblocks.text: A ripple through the hall. Uncle Akodo Hiruto doesn't move a muscle.
"Sufficient." From a Crab, that's a love poem.
cmdblocks.name: Akodo Shizue

cmdblocks.text: The corridor afterwards. A woman passes, stops, turns back: Akodo Nishi, bright-eyed, warm, with a strategist's ink-stained fingers.
You. The girl who sacrificed three stones on the left edge to win the centre. Shizue, wasn't it?
cmdblocks.name: Akodo Nishi

cmdblocks.text: Nishi-sama remembers a game from four summers ago?
cmdblocks.name: Akodo Shizue

cmdblocks.text: I remember the moves that surprised me. There haven't been many.
cmdblocks.name: Akodo Nishi

cmdblocks.text: Come to the North Dojo some evening. I'd like an opponent who isn't trying to flatter me.
cmdblocks.name: Akodo Nishi

cmdblocks.text: Behind Nishi, a man waits for her: Akodo Kafu, Toturi's trusted advisor. He looks at Nishi a moment too long, then away.
(Rested. HP and MP restored.)
Objective: the hostess, here in the Hall of Honors, announces the court's events.

cmdblock.name: Akodo Nishi

Four summers, and you still do that.
cmdblocks.name: Akodo Nishi

cmdblocks.text: Hm. Greedy. Kafu plays like that.
cmdblocks.name: Akodo Nishi

cmdblocks.text: ...Kafu taught me that one. Kafu taught me to play.
cmdblocks.name: Akodo Nishi

cmdblocks.text2: Play her own move back at her.

cmdblock.text: ...Black, as always.
cmdblock.name: Akodo Nishi

cmdblocks.text: The South Dojo at night. Cold. Braziers guttering. A wet trail across the floorboards that hisses where it touches the wood.
Something crawled here. Something heavy. And frightened.
cmdblocks.name: Akodo Shizue

cmdblocks.text: Terror: a Terrified traveler may lose the turn, and can't use Void. Jade gear resists it; Calming Tea cures it.
The trail goes under the floor. A loose board.

cmdblock.text: The inner screen. Behind it, silence.
Behind the dojo's inner screen: a voice, very faint - Kafu's - and another, many voices layered.
...I've given you everything. Everything. Please.
cmdblock.name: Akodo Kafu

cmdblock.text: ...Not everything. Not yet.
cmdblock.name: Other voice

cmdblocks.text: (Rested. HP and MP restored.)

cmdblock.text: The inner screen. Cold air breathes through it.

cmdblocks.text: Akodo Kafu kneels in the dark. Before him: a slug-like thing the size of a horse, a ring of teeth, dripping - Oni no Ianwa. It has his letters. It's reading them aloud in his own voice.
"My dearest Nishi. If duty were a river, I would drown in it gladly-"
cmdblocks.name: Oni no Ianwa

cmdblocks.text: Stop.
cmdblocks.name: Akodo Shizue

cmdblocks.text: I think of nothing else. That's how it eats me.
cmdblocks.name: Akodo Kafu

cmdblocks.text: My duty brought me here.
cmdblocks.name: Akodo Kafu

cmdblocks.text: ...Thirty years. No more.
cmdblocks.name: Akodo Kafu

cmdblocks.text: Akodo Kafu weeps, openly. Then he rises and draws his short sword.
What man? I don't know what you mean.
cmdblocks.name: Akodo Kafu

cmdblocks.text2: "You told the story of the man who wept. Weep now, where I can see."

cmdblocks.text: Oni no Ianwa has no attacks of its own. Each turn it charms one of you. Jade cuts the chance; Death Trance blocks it. It breaks on Jade and Fire - and it is a coward.
