cmdblocks.name: Togashi Yosai
cmdblocks.text: Company! Then I'll wait at the next inn and recount my enemies. It's a long list. I'm very popular.
(Togashi Yosai waits beside the inns. Ask him along again when no one else travels with you.)

cmdblocks.text: Akodo Kafu joins the party.
The oni squeals - "I will return! I will devour your souls!" - and is gone through the floor.
...It's lying. It won't come back. Cowards never do.
cmdblocks.name: Moto Benjiro

cmdblocks.text: Dawn.
Kafu asks Toturi's leave for seppuku. Toturi grants it. In the garden, Kafu kneels. He looks past Nishi, who stands at the edge of the snow, to the mountains.
You can see all the way to the Spine this morning. I'd forgotten.
cmdblocks.name: Akodo Kafu

cmdblocks.text: The wedding goes ahead at noon. Nishi doesn't cry until evening, alone in the North Dojo - where Shizue finds her, says nothing, and sets up the go board. They play until morning.
Kafu is taken in chains. Toturi orders his name cut from every record.
The Akodo have no son called Kafu. Not any more.
cmdblocks.name: Akodo Toturi

cmdblocks.text: The wedding goes ahead. In the North Dojo, Shizue sets up the go board. Nishi looks at it, and doesn't play.
The stolen objects are found in the oni's lair beneath the floor - all but one. The plaque "Duty" is never found.
You kept your one true thing, Lion. I'll remember.
cmdblocks.name: Daidoji Atsuko

cmdblocks.text: A corridor. Toturi passes Shizue without stopping.
Akodo Shizue. Again.
cmdblocks.name: Akodo Toturi

cmdblocks.text: "Shadow of a Doubt" - complete.
A cowardly oni ate a good man one treasure at a time. Shizue found the pattern, armed herself in jade without knowing why, and made the Lion Champion learn her name.

cmdblocks.text: CHAPTER 3 - The Deadly Message. (Recommended level 30)
Spring thaw at Shiro Akodo. The snow lets go of the roads, and the war lets go of its patience.
A small dim office. Akodo Toturi's karo, Akodo Kagehisa - precise, unreadable - holds out a lacquered tube sealed with the Champion's mon.
For the old man of Kaze-no-Tani. Speak to no one. Go now.
cmdblocks.name: Akodo Kagehisa

cmdblocks.text: Yes, Kagehisa-sama.
cmdblocks.name: Akodo Shizue

cmdblocks.text: That's the whole audience. The screen slides shut.
The corridor. Akodo Shizue looks at the tube.
A Rank 1 messenger. Nobody would miss one.
cmdblocks.name: Akodo Shizue

cmdblocks.text: ...That's why it's me.
cmdblocks.name: Akodo Shizue

cmdblocks.text: Got the Lacquered Tube.
(Rested. HP and MP restored.)
Objective: Kaze-no-Tani, west. Out through the castle town's east gate.
You read it.
cmdblocks.name: Akodo Kagehisa

cmdblocks.text: It broke. I read it.
cmdblocks.name: Akodo Shizue

cmdblocks.text: You failed the test. And you came back to ask instead of running. That's loyalty.
cmdblocks.name: Akodo Kagehisa

cmdblocks.text: The old man stays on his mountain. Fetch his answer. And take care on the pass.
cmdblocks.name: Akodo Kagehisa

cmdblocks.text: (He knows something's waiting on the pass. He's sending me anyway.)
cmdblocks.name: Akodo Shizue

cmdblocks.text: Objective: the pass again, and the old man's answer.
For once, Akodo Shizue is admitted past the karo. Akodo Toturi reads the Miya letters, the writ, the Crane general's letter. He reads them twice.
An Imperial magistrate. Feeding both armies false reports.
cmdblocks.name: Akodo Toturi

cmdblocks.text: To keep the clans bleeding, my lord. So none of us can challenge the throne.
cmdblocks.name: Akodo Shizue

cmdblocks.text: A very long silence.
Again.
cmdblocks.name: Akodo Toturi

cmdblocks.text: ...My lord?
cmdblocks.name: Akodo Shizue

cmdblocks.text: You did it again. Found the hand behind the hand.
cmdblocks.name: Akodo Toturi

cmdblocks.text: At the door, old Shogen, muddy and grinning, bows to Toturi like an uncle to a nephew.
Your strategist is rude, Toturi. I like her.
cmdblocks.name: Akodo Shogen

cmdblocks.text: Elsewhere: Miya Yachiko, recalled "for consultation", rides for the capital under Imperial protection, untouchable. She'll be at Sorrow's Path.
Got the Strategist's Eye.
"The Deadly Message" - complete.
Three words in her lord's own hand: "Kill these messengers." Shizue delivered them anyway - or asked why - and found an Imperial magistrate who pays everyone to keep the Empire at war.
Next: Sorrow's Path. The road leaves Shiro Akodo's castle town to the north. (Recommended level 41)
For once, Akodo Shizue is admitted past the karo. Akodo Toturi reads the Miya letters, the writ, the Crane general's letter. He reads them twice.
An Imperial magistrate. Feeding both armies false reports.
cmdblocks.name: Akodo Toturi

cmdblocks.text: To keep the clans bleeding, my lord. So none of us can challenge the throne.
cmdblocks.name: Akodo Shizue

cmdblocks.text: A very long silence.
Again.
cmdblocks.name: Akodo Toturi

cmdblocks.text: ...My lord?
cmdblocks.name: Akodo Shizue

cmdblocks.text: You did it again. Found the hand behind the hand.
cmdblocks.name: Akodo Toturi

cmdblocks.text: At the door, old Shogen, muddy and grinning, bows to Toturi like an uncle to a nephew.
Your strategist is rude, Toturi. I like her.
cmdblocks.name: Akodo Shogen

Shizue adds a stone. The cairn doesn't fall. A good omen, or a good cairn. (MP restored.)

cmdblock.text: The road west runs through the ford first.
A Lion village full of refugees from Crane border raids. A burned bridge; a ford; a bandit chief collecting a toll from people who have nothing.
A zeni a head to cross, or wade home.
cmdblock.name: Bandit Chief

cmdblock.text: I'll cross for free. You'll want to challenge me first.
cmdblock.name: Akodo Shizue

cmdblock.text: A Lion girl? Fine!
cmdblock.name: Bandit Chief

cmdblock.text: A Duel: first blood, no seconds.

cmdblock.code: local p = ::rpgstat.playermap["P132"]; W = !!::rpgstat.members.find( @( v) v && v == p);

cmdblocks.text: ...The toll is waived.
cmdblocks.name: Bandit Chief

cmdblocks.text: Ha! A zeni a head, Lion girl.
cmdblocks.name: Bandit Chief

cmdblock.text: The toll is waived, Lion. My lads guard the ford for the refugees now.
cmdblock.name: Bandit Chief

cmdblocks.text: Akodo Ijako, in her reed-and-mud mask, waits on the far bank as if she'd always been there.
The ancestors said you'd come this way.
cmdblocks.name: Akodo Ijako

cmdblocks.text: The ancestors say a lot of things.
cmdblocks.name: Akodo Shizue

cmdblocks.text: They said you'd say that too. I'm coming.
cmdblocks.name: Akodo Ijako

cmdblocks.text: Akodo Ijako will answer the Guest call in battle.
A neat man in Imperial Miya colours, with papers, blocks the road.
Imperial courier inspection. All sealed messages must be examined. For the Emperor's safety.
cmdblocks.name: Inspector

cmdblocks.text: Forgive me. My orders are my lord's, and my lord's are his.
cmdblocks.name: Akodo Shizue

cmdblocks.text: Get out of my way.
cmdblocks.name: Akodo Shizue

cmdblocks.text: ...Of course.
cmdblocks.name: Inspector

cmdblocks.text: (Glory -1)
He lets her pass. He watches her go for a long time.
Objective: the waystation on the road west. Sleet is coming.

#9#.msg: My husband went to Gusai-sama's war. The children ask when the bridge will be rebuilt.
#9#.name: *villager-9

#10#.msg: Inspectors on the road. Miya men. They ask everyone where Lion messengers go.
#10#.name: *villager-10

#11#.msg: The old man of Kaze-no-Tani? He splits wood barefoot in the snow. Everyone knows that.
#11#.name: *villager-11

#12#.msg: Buying? Selling? Smuggling? I mean - trading.
#12#.name: *villager-12

cmdblock.text: The bandit's toll box, heavy with the refugees' zeni.
The bandit's toll box: 1,500 zeni of the refugees' money.

cmdblocks.text: The widow cries. (Honor +2)
Got 1,500 zeni.

cmdblock.text0: Give it back to the refugees.

cmdblock.text: The empty toll box.
A roadside Hachiman shrine, hung with refugees' prayer slips.

cmdblocks.text: The offering water clouds over, then clears. The Taint is gone.
The water stays clear. There is nothing in you for it to take.
Shizue kneels among the prayer slips. Most ask for the bridge. (MP restored.)

cmdblock.text: The ronin on the pass wear good boots and bad armour, Akodo-sama. An arrow likes bad armour.
cmdblock.name: Refugee Archer

cmdblocks.text: Your current hireling heads home.
Three arrows. Then back to my family.
cmdblocks.name: Refugee Archer

cmdblocks.text: Refugee Archer follows Shizue. (In battle: Support. 3 uses, then home to the refugee tents.)
Coin first, Akodo-sama.
cmdblocks.name: Refugee Archer

cmdblock.text: I ran from Gusai-sama's war. I can still use a spear. Long blades hate a spear.
cmdblock.name: Lion Deserter

cmdblocks.text: Your current hireling heads home.
Three thrusts, Akodo-sama. Don't tell anyone where I am.
cmdblocks.name: Lion Deserter

cmdblocks.text: Lion Deserter follows Shizue. (In battle: Support. 3 uses, then home to the refugee tents.)
Coin first, Akodo-sama.
cmdblocks.name: Lion Deserter

cmdblock.text: Arrows on the pass, they say. I've pulled a lot of arrows out of a lot of Lions this winter.
cmdblock.name: Refugee Herbalist

cmdblocks.text: Your current hireling heads home.
Three poultices. Try not to need the third.
cmdblocks.name: Refugee Herbalist

cmdblocks.text: Refugee Herbalist follows Shizue. (In battle: Support. 3 uses, then home to the refugee tents.)
Coin first, Akodo-sama.
cmdblocks.name: Refugee Herbalist

cmdblock.name: Togashi Yosai

I'll be here. Probably. Statistically.
cmdblocks.name: Togashi Yosai

cmdblocks.text: You've already got company. I'll keep the bench warm. Benches love me.
cmdblocks.name: Togashi Yosai

#99#.msg: The road's closed for now. Orders. When it opens, you'll hear of it.
#99#.name: *villager-99

M267.name: The Village of the Burned Bridge

cmdblock.text: The pass road, in sleet. Not tonight.
A mat by the brazier, Akodo-sama. The sleet won't stop till morning.
cmdblock.name: Waystation keeper

cmdblocks.text: A rough waystation. Frozen rain. The lacquer tube, set too near the brazier, cracks with a sound like a twig. The seal splits. A slip of paper slides half out.
...It's broken. I didn't break it. It's already broken.
cmdblocks.name: Akodo Shizue

cmdblocks.text: She reads it. Three words in Akodo Toturi's own hand.
"Kill these messengers."
cmdblocks.name: Akodo Shizue

cmdblocks.text: Evidence is testimony. Whose hand? Whose seal? When was it sealed, and by whom?
cmdblocks.name: Kitsuki Gendo

cmdblocks.text: Burn it. Go home. Say it was lost in the river. Nobody ever checks rivers.
cmdblocks.name: Shosuro Mitsue

cmdblocks.text: Deliver it. That's the point. A messenger who reads the message isn't a messenger anymore.
cmdblocks.name: Kakita Rensei

cmdblocks.text: So someone wants you dead. Welcome to my whole life.
cmdblocks.name: Hiruma Natsuko

cmdblocks.text: Is your lord always this rude in letters?
cmdblocks.name: Sayo

cmdblocks.text: Akodo Ijako, at the waystation's roadside shrine, lifts her mask and kneels.
A message is a blade, child. Who holds the hilt?
cmdblocks.name: Ancestor

cmdblocks.text: If my lord wants me dead, I'll hear him say it to my face. Or to the old man's.
cmdblocks.name: Akodo Shizue

cmdblocks.text: I'll ask Kagehisa what this means. To his face.
cmdblocks.name: Akodo Shizue

cmdblocks.text: (Rested. HP and MP restored.)
Objective: the pass, then Kaze-no-Tani.
Objective: back to Shiro Akodo, and the karo.

cmdblock.text: Rest, Akodo-sama?
cmdblock.name: Waystation keeper

cmdblocks.text: (Rested.)

cmdblock.text: The ancestor shrine at the waystation. Sleet on the offering bowls.

cmdblocks.text: The offering water clouds over, then clears. The Taint is gone.
The water stays clear. There is nothing in you for it to take.
Shizue kneels. Somewhere behind her, Ijako's mask clicks against the stone. (MP restored.)

cmdblocks.text: A snowy pass. "Bandits" in good boots.
Hand over the tube, girl, and walk away.
cmdblocks.name: Ronin

cmdblocks.text: Bandits don't usually know about tubes.
cmdblocks.name: Akodo Shizue

cmdblocks.text: They will surrender when they're hurt badly enough.
The ronin who surrendered sit in the snow. Their packs: a Miya travel writ. And a letter to a Crane general.
(Gendo: "...in the same hand as the writ.")
"...the Lion will attack at the river by the next moon. Prepare."
cmdblocks.name: Akodo Shizue

cmdblocks.text: The Lion have no such plan. Someone is telling the Crane we do.
cmdblocks.name: Akodo Shizue

cmdblocks.text: Got the Miya Letters.
(Rested. HP and MP restored.)

cmdblock.text: A dead end, and a frozen courier, still holding his satchel.
Got a Signal Horn.
Got a Patrol Writ.
The frozen courier.
A wind-cut hollow out of the snow. A place to rest.

cmdblocks.text: (Rested. HP and MP restored.)

Our orders are simple, Akodo. The message never arrives.

cmdblocks.name: Akodo Shizue

cmdblocks.text: Then the messenger never returns.
cmdblocks.name: Seppun-trained Duelist

cmdblocks.name: Akodo Shizue

cmdblocks.name: Seppun-trained Duelist

cmdblocks.text: The letters still name her. With less weight.
Over the last ridge: the hermitage. The old man reads the karo's request and laughs.
Tell Toturi he still owes me a jar of plum wine.

cmdblocks.text: And tell him his messenger is too polite. She asked.
cmdblocks.name: Akodo Shogen

cmdblocks.text: Objective: home to Shiro Akodo, and Toturi.
The long road home, down the pass and east through the thaw.

cmdblocks.text: A hermitage clinging to the mountain. A wiry old man splitting firewood in a thin robe, despite the cold: Akodo Shogen.
A Lion girl with a broken seal. Give it here.
cmdblocks.name: Akodo Shogen

cmdblocks.text: He reads. He laughs - a great barking laugh that echoes off the peaks.
Toturi remembers! Ha!
cmdblocks.name: Akodo Shogen

cmdblocks.text: It's an old Akodo test, girl. The message says "kill these messengers."
cmdblocks.name: Akodo Shogen

cmdblocks.text: I only teach the ones who deliver it knowing what it says.
cmdblocks.name: Akodo Shogen

cmdblocks.text: But first, show me why I should bother.
cmdblocks.name: Akodo Shogen

cmdblocks.text: A Duel: first blood. Win or lose honourably.

cmdblocks.code: local p = ::rpgstat.playermap["P132"]; W = !!::rpgstat.members.find( @( v) v && v == p);

cmdblocks.text: You read it. You came anyway. Why?
cmdblocks.name: Akodo Shogen

cmdblocks.text: Because if my lord wanted me dead, I wanted to hear him say it to my face.
cmdblocks.name: Akodo Shizue

cmdblocks.text: And if he didn't, someone else did, and I wanted to know who.
cmdblocks.name: Akodo Shizue

cmdblocks.text: Ha! He's sent me a strategist. Finally.
cmdblocks.name: Akodo Shogen

cmdblocks.text: I'll come down the mountain. Don't tell anyone I enjoyed it.
cmdblocks.name: Akodo Shogen

cmdblocks.text: Shogen pours bitter tea into two chipped cups. The cold goes out of her hands.
A tall man in a Seppun-cut kimono with a long, perfect blade, and two archers on the rocks above.
Our orders are simple, Akodo. The message never arrives.
cmdblocks.name: Seppun-trained Duelist

cmdblock.text: Shogen's woodpile, and behind it a jar of plum wine.
A jar of plum wine behind the woodpile.

cmdblocks.text: Shogen notices. He laughs so hard he has to sit down. (Honor -1)
Got Shogen's Plum Wine.

cmdblock.text: A cold spring under the peaks. The water is so clear it looks like nothing.

cmdblocks.text: The offering water clouds over, then clears. The Taint is gone.
The water stays clear. There is nothing in you for it to take.
Shizue kneels. The cold is a rumour. (MP restored.)

cmdblock.text: The road home.
The road home.

cmdblocks.text: CHAPTER 4 - Sorrow's Path. (Recommended level 41)
Kanashimi no Komichi. Sorrow's Path. Centuries ago a Lion general won here, and the Crane never forgave the river.

A Lion camp on the east bank. Across the water, Crane banners. Uncle Akodo Hiruto, calm. Cousin Akodo Gusai, pacing. The Matsu vanguard under Matsu Rokuro - a huge, gentle-faced champion - sharpening a blade.
The same ground. Both armies. Again.
cmdblocks.name: Akodo Hiruto

cmdblocks.text: The same banner, too, uncle. The one the oni stole at Shiro Akodo - it was taken here, centuries ago.
cmdblocks.name: Akodo Shizue

cmdblocks.text: Then the river has a long memory.
cmdblocks.name: Akodo Hiruto

cmdblocks.text: Every Lion general who died here thought he was winning.
cmdblocks.name: Akodo Shogen

cmdblocks.text: Think the other thing, girl.
cmdblocks.name: Akodo Shogen

cmdblocks.text: Old Lion's Counsel: the party deals 10% more damage this chapter.

Akodo Shizue. We meet again. The Emperor so values peace.
cmdblocks.name: Miya Yachiko

cmdblocks.text: So I've read, magistrate. In your letters.
cmdblocks.name: Akodo Shizue

cmdblocks.text: ...How diligent of you.
cmdblocks.name: Miya Yachiko

cmdblocks.text: (Rested. HP and MP restored.)
Dusk falls over the camp.

cmdblock.name: Akodo Gusai

cmdblocks.text: I'm on my way to Kyuden Doji anyway. I'll take the scenic route. Through the enemy camp.
cmdblocks.name: Kakita Rensei

cmdblocks.text: If they shoot you-
cmdblocks.name: Akodo Shizue

cmdblocks.text: I'll bow first. Crane hate shooting someone mid-bow. It's rude.
cmdblocks.name: Kakita Rensei

cmdblocks.text: Daidoji Atsuko steps out of the reeds.
You told me one true thing in my cell, Lion. Here's mine: I'd have crossed anyway.
cmdblocks.name: Daidoji Atsuko

cmdblocks.text: But I like that you asked.
cmdblocks.name: Daidoji Atsuko

cmdblocks.text: Lord Hiruto hands her his own white truce-fan.
Then go. And Shizue - come back.

cmdblock.text: The shield-line. No one leaves it now.
The Crane bank. Not yet.

cmdblocks.text: Rokuro roars - and the Matsu vanguard charges, Crane horns answering.
Lion! Shields across the ford! No one crosses!
cmdblocks.name: Akodo Hiruto

cmdblocks.text: Lion! Lock shields across the ford! NO ONE CROSSES!
cmdblocks.name: Akodo Shizue

cmdblocks.text: Hold the ford for five waves. Matsu berserkers charging by mistake: knock them down - they yield when beaten. Don't kill your own.
Knock them down! They're ours!
cmdblocks.name: Akodo Hiruto

cmdblocks.text: Knock them down! They're ours!
cmdblocks.name: Akodo Shizue

cmdblocks.text: (Honor +1)
Hold. (Between waves: items and the guest call. No saving on the ford.)
The Crane answer: riders out of the mist, down the far bank.
Hold the line! Nobody pursues!
cmdblocks.name: Akodo Hiruto

cmdblocks.text: Hold! Don't pursue! Don't give them a reason!
cmdblocks.name: Akodo Shizue

cmdblocks.text: Arrows out of the mist from the far bank.
Shields high!
cmdblocks.name: Akodo Hiruto

cmdblocks.text: Formation! Shields high!
cmdblocks.name: Akodo Shizue

cmdblocks.text: Across the water, a white-clad figure walks through the Crane lines, bowing to every spear.
A Crane scout's whistle across the water: three notes. She's through.
On the far bank, in the mist, a white fan is raised. Shizue is through.
Upstream, the old bridge is burning. Timbers drift down onto the ford.
Back to the stones! Spears - into the river with it!
cmdblocks.name: Akodo Hiruto

cmdblocks.text: The bridge is burning - fall back to the stones! Spears: push the timbers into the river!
cmdblocks.name: Akodo Shizue

cmdblocks.text: A cold comes off the water. Shapes of dread rise out of the mist: the demon's terror wave. (Calming Tea and an Ikoma war-song cure Terror; Death Trance blocks it.)
Hold! It's only fear!
cmdblocks.name: Akodo Hiruto

cmdblocks.text: Fear is a rumour! Hold!
cmdblocks.name: Akodo Shizue

cmdblocks.text: After the fifth wave, the mist lifts.
Out of the mist, Shizue wades back across the ford, the Crane general's answer in her sleeve.
(Rested. HP and MP restored.)
Objective: Rokuro, in the middle of the ford.
Matsu Rokuro wades into the middle of the ford alone, roaring, and the thing inside him shows in his eyes - black, wide, hungry. Both armies cower.
You're afraid, little strategist. I can taste it.
cmdblocks.name: The Demon

cmdblocks.text: Of course I'm afraid. Only fools and Matsu aren't.
cmdblocks.name: Akodo Shizue

cmdblocks.text: Sorry, Rokuro-san.
cmdblocks.name: Akodo Shizue

cmdblocks.text: The possession breaks. Rokuro collapses into the shallows, himself again, weeping like a child.
...I was so frightened. All night. I was so frightened, and I couldn't stop walking.
cmdblocks.name: Matsu Rokuro

cmdblocks.text: I know. You're out of the river now.
cmdblocks.name: Akodo Shizue

cmdblocks.text: In the middle of the ford, Akodo Hiruto and the Crane general meet, holding the real letters. The armies stand down. Nobody cheers.
...This says peace.
cmdblocks.name: Crane General

cmdblocks.text: It always did.
cmdblocks.name: Akodo Hiruto

cmdblocks.text: General - the Phoenix have been supplying your army. In secret.
cmdblocks.name: Isawa Haruki

cmdblocks.text: ...That is not a matter for the Lion.
cmdblocks.name: Crane General

cmdblocks.text: It is if the Phoenix want this war to last. I don't think they do. I think they're just afraid.
cmdblocks.name: Isawa Haruki

cmdblocks.text: Then we have three clans at this table who'd rather not die here. That's a start.
cmdblocks.name: Akodo Hiruto

cmdblocks.text: Shizue's report to Toturi, by messenger.
"The Matsu vanguard charged first. Possessed, but ours. My own cousin's men were ready to follow."
cmdblocks.name: Akodo Shizue

cmdblocks.text: "The Lion started this battle. The Lion should say so."
cmdblocks.name: Akodo Shizue

cmdblocks.text: (Honor +1)
(Glory -1)
(Glory +1)
(Honor -1)

cmdblocks.text0: The truth: the Lion charged first.

cmdblocks.text: Miya Yachiko, her letters exposed, is "recalled to the capital for consultation". She passes Akodo Shizue on her way to her palanquin and smiles.
This won't be the last time, Akodo.
cmdblocks.name: Miya Yachiko

cmdblocks.text: No, magistrate. But it's the first time you lost.
cmdblocks.name: Akodo Shizue

cmdblocks.text: A tent at the edge of the Crane lines, abandoned in the night. Inside: a Crane court mask. A pot of white hair-dye. A smooth grey stone carved into the shape of a jade amulet.
...It isn't jade. It's river stone. She couldn't tell the difference.
cmdblocks.name: Akodo Shizue

cmdblocks.text: North. And east. Shinomen.
cmdblocks.name: Akodo Shizue

cmdblocks.text: Akodo Hiruto, beside her, looking at the ford.
I couldn't stop the war, uncle. Only one battle.
cmdblocks.name: Akodo Shizue

cmdblocks.text: One is enough today.
cmdblocks.name: Akodo Hiruto

cmdblocks.text: "Sorrow's Path" - complete.
The same ford, the same banner, the same blue-eyed hand pushing both armies into the river. The battle stopped. The war did not. And a river stone points north and east, to Shinomen.

cmdblock.text: The garden shrine.
Commune (Haruki's field spell): speak with the kami of a place.

cmdblock.name: Garden kami

cmdblock.text: I'll tell him.
cmdblock.name: Isawa Haruki

cmdblock.text: Salt. So much salt. Go to bed, little Isawa.
cmdblock.name: Garden kami

cmdblock.text: Haruki reaches for the kami. Nothing. Only wind in the pines.
Very faintly, a kami in the garden is humming again.
The candle hall.
A candle has toppled against a paper screen. The paper is starting to brown.
Summon (Haruki's field spell): call a little of an element. A cupful of water out of the air.
The flame hisses out.

cmdblocks.name: Isawa Haruki

cmdblocks.text: Mieko doesn't look up.
...Still not yet.

cmdblocks.text: Still more than I hoped.

cmdblocks.text: The west tower. Wind howls - and makes no sound. A samurai's ghost spins in the centre of a silent storm: Ashimoshi.
He's screaming. Can't you hear him?
cmdblocks.name: Shiba Ashimita

cmdblocks.text: No. Yes. In the wind. He's screaming in the wind.
cmdblocks.name: Isawa Haruki

cmdblocks.text: Every other turn his silent wind seals spells. Strike between, while he breathes. (Blades pass half through a ghost; Water and Void do not.)
Victory. The storm settles. Ashimoshi's ghost stands calm for the first time in years.
...Thank you.
cmdblocks.name: Ashimoshi

cmdblocks.text: The one in the sleeping man. Across the yard.
cmdblocks.name: Ashimoshi

cmdblocks.text: He has been eating us.
cmdblocks.name: Ashimoshi

cmdblocks.text: CHAPTER 2 - The Silent Court. (Recommended level 20)
A Silent Court. Grief spoken only in ritual. Every clan sends envoys - and every envoy has a second errand.

A snowbound village below an old Otomo watchtower. Three inns: the White Songbird, the Yellow Lantern, and the Hidden Poem geisha house. Asako Keiki - an idealist monk, round-faced, serene - greets arrivals.
Haruki-san. Hoju's apprentice. Thank you for coming.
cmdblocks.name: Asako Keiki

cmdblocks.text: Here, we speak with the ritual, not with our tongues.
cmdblocks.name: Asako Keiki

cmdblocks.text: Grief that shouts is only anger wearing a mourning robe.
cmdblocks.name: Asako Keiki

cmdblocks.text: Yes, Keiki-sama.
cmdblocks.name: Isawa Haruki

cmdblocks.text: Ashimita. Again. Keep the boy on his horse, and alive on the pass.
cmdblocks.name: Isawa Kamasari

cmdblocks.text: My grandfather says the boy is the only interesting thing at this funeral.
cmdblocks.name: Shiba Ashimita

cmdblock.text: Here, we speak with the ritual, not with our tongues.
cmdblock.name: Asako Keiki

cmdblock.text: In the Yellow Lantern a Matsu bushi, Matsu Hisae, sways and shouts insults at the Phoenix.
Phoenix! You hide behind prayers while the Lion bleed! You - boy! Fight me!
cmdblock.name: Matsu Hisae

cmdblocks.text: You're grieving too, Matsu-sama. Sit. Let me pour.
cmdblocks.name: Isawa Haruki

cmdblocks.text: ...Good. The last three envoys threw sake at me.
cmdblocks.name: Matsu Hisae

cmdblocks.text: He passes, Keiki-sama. Tell the Council the Phoenix boy has manners.
cmdblocks.name: Matsu Hisae

cmdblocks.text: Haruki bows, and leaves her shouting at the wall.
Ha! A shugenja who'd duel a drunk. You fail. Politely.
cmdblocks.name: Matsu Hisae

cmdblock.text0: Bless: "You're grieving too, Matsu-sama. Sit. Let me pour."

cmdblock.text: Objective: the White Songbird. The Imperial magistrates have a complaint.
Pour me another one, Phoenix. I'm only pretending to be drunk. Mostly.
cmdblock.name: Matsu Hisae

cmdblock.text: Hmph.
cmdblock.name: Matsu Hisae

cmdblock.text: The White Songbird. Raised voices inside.
Two Imperial magistrates in the White Songbird, accusing the Phoenix of harbouring road bandits.
Bandits on the pass, Isawa-sama. Phoenix bandits.
cmdblock.name: Imperial Magistrate

cmdblock.text: Absurd. We'll perform the Ritual of Forgetting tonight. Everyone sleeps; no one remembers this insult.
cmdblock.name: Isawa Kamasari

cmdblock.text: No.
cmdblock.name: Isawa Haruki

cmdblock.text: Everyone looks at him.
Forgive me. I don't think... we should make people forget things.
cmdblock.name: Isawa Haruki

cmdblock.text: I've been silent about something for twelve years, Keiki-sama. It doesn't get quieter.
cmdblock.name: Isawa Haruki

cmdblock.text: ...Then we won't make it quieter. No ritual.
cmdblock.name: Asako Keiki

cmdblocks.text: (Rested. HP and MP restored.)

cmdblock.text: Objective: the caravan leaves by the east gate, up the snowbound pass.
The White Songbird. Quiet now.

cmdblock.text: The snow shrine. The kami here are cold, but they answer.

cmdblocks.text: The offering water clouds over, then clears. The Taint is gone.
The water stays clear. There is nothing in you for it to take.
Haruki kneels in the snow. The kami answer slowly, like old men. (MP restored.)

cmdblock.text: The old Otomo watchtower. A chest under the stair: incense, a bundle of it.
Got Incense Stick x3.
The watchtower stair. Nothing left.
I carry the caravan's rice up that pass every winter. I carry a big stick too. The cultists know it.
cmdblock.name: Zumiki Porter

cmdblocks.text: Your current hireling heads home.
Three swings. Then I go back to my rice.
cmdblocks.name: Zumiki Porter

The Tattooed Prophet sees! Kokujin sees! Burn the false monks!

cmdblock.text: The mountain path. Not today.

cmdblocks.text: Honored Treaty City. Built to celebrate a peace between the Lion and the Phoenix. Most of the peace has worn off.
Objective: the second ceremony master is arranging camellias in the garden.
The memorial closes. Lanterns drift across the black lake - one for each of the dead. Isawa Haruki sets down one for Isawa Hoju.
By morning two envoys are found dead in their beds. Both were last seen walking with Isawa Mieko. The Council's investigators look at her. Mieko, bewildered, looks at Haruki.
You know her, don't you, Haruki-san.
cmdblocks.name: Asako Keiki

cmdblocks.text: I'm the reason she's two people.
cmdblocks.name: Isawa Haruki

cmdblocks.text: Got a Scroll: Courage of the Seven Thunders.
Haruki learns Courage of the Seven Thunders.
"The Silent Court" - complete.
At Hoju's memorial, Haruki refused a ritual of forgetting, defended a traitor's shrine with words, and met Mieko, who remembers a boy who counted on his fingers. At midnight, she remembers more.
Rank 2: the Council finally writes down Isawa Haruki's name.
Kamasari is leaving. So am I. My grandfather says to keep an eye on you.
cmdblocks.name: Shiba Ashimita

cmdblocks.text: Next: the Darkfever. Kyuden Isawa, by the south road out of the treaty city. (Recommended level 30)

cmdblock.text: Camellias, arranged with great care.
A gentle priest, arranging winter camellias: Isawa Mieko. The second ceremony master.
Haruki-san? What a lovely name.
cmdblock.name: Isawa Mieko

cmdblock.text: Have we met? You look at me as though we have.
cmdblock.name: Isawa Mieko

cmdblock.text: ...Once. A long time ago.
cmdblock.name: Isawa Haruki

cmdblock.text: You wouldn't remember.
cmdblock.name: Isawa Haruki

cmdblock.text: I don't remember much from when I was small. The healers say I was very ill.
cmdblock.name: Isawa Mieko

cmdblock.text: But I remember a boy who counted on his fingers. Isn't that silly?
cmdblock.name: Isawa Mieko

cmdblock.text: ...No. Not silly.
cmdblock.name: Isawa Haruki

cmdblock.text: Objective: Keiki has given the envoys rooms in the guest houses. Rest there tonight.
The camellias bloom in the snow, Haruki-san. Isn't that brave of them?
cmdblock.name: Isawa Mieko

cmdblock.text: A camellia label: "White Snow", in a careful hand.
A camellia label in the garden, in a careful, gentle hand.
...It's Mieko's handwriting.
cmdblock.name: Isawa Haruki

cmdblocks.text: (Rested. HP and MP restored.)

cmdblock.text: Objective: back to the guest houses. Haruki should sleep. He won't.
The scholars' house.
Bless (Haruki's path action): guide someone, living or dead, a little way.
A darkness that lives in the best of the Phoenix... reborn... the scroll says... the scroll says...
cmdblock.name: Historian's ghost

cmdblock.text: The ghost of Ikoma Sadahisa lets Haruki lead him to the threshold, and goes.
The scholars' house. Quiet now.
The scholars' house floor.
A loose board under the scholars' house floor. Beneath it: an old scroll, hidden in a hurry.
Haruki reads it with Speak to the Soul.
Written in fear. By a gentle hand.
cmdblock.name: Isawa Haruki

cmdblock.text: "The Consumer": an undying dark side of the Phoenix, reborn in its greatest shugenja.
Objective: that brushwork. Haruki has seen it somewhere today.
The loose board, put back.
The guest houses.
Night. A cry from the scholars' house. A Lion historian, Ikoma Sadahisa, lies dead at his desk. An old scroll is missing from his hands.
He'd found something in the archives. He wouldn't say what. He said only: "the Consumer".
cmdblock.name: Asako Keiki

cmdblock.text: Objective: the scholars' house. Bless the historian's ghost, and search the house.
Haruki can't sleep. Midnight.
Haruki rests until night. Torches are coming up the mountain path again; fewer, brighter.

cmdblocks.text: (Rested. HP and MP restored.)

cmdblock.text: Objective: the traitor's torii, up the mountain path.
A week of ritual, Haruki-san. Grief spoken properly.
cmdblock.name: Asako Keiki

cmdblock.text: He'd found something in the archives. He said only: "the Consumer".
cmdblock.name: Asako Keiki

cmdblock.text: I'm watching her. Quietly. You did right.
cmdblock.name: Asako Keiki

#16#.msg: The Council will thank me for this memorial. Try not to be noticed, boy.
#16#.name: *villager-16

cmdblock.text: The memorial-hall storeroom: tea for the mourners.
Got Rejuvenating Tea x3.
An empty storeroom shelf.
The treaty shrine: a Lion stone and a Phoenix stone, side by side.

cmdblocks.text: The offering water clouds over, then clears. The Taint is gone.
The water stays clear. There is nothing in you for it to take.
Haruki kneels between the two stones. They don't quite agree, but they're both listening. (MP restored.)

cmdblock.text: That Shiba keeps turning up at my dojo hour. Accidentally. Every day.
cmdblock.name: Hida bushi

cmdblock.text: Tell him... no. Don't tell him anything. Unless you're going that way.
cmdblock.name: Hida bushi

cmdblocks.text: Shall I carry a message? I'm very good at being overlooked.
cmdblocks.name: Isawa Haruki

cmdblocks.text: Bless: Haruki walks the Hida's message to the Shiba, and the Shiba's back. Neither says anything important. Both look much happier.
Got a Kabuto.

cmdblock.text: Kabuto fits you? Good. Crab helmets fit everyone.
cmdblock.name: Hida bushi

cmdblock.text: The Crab trains at my hour. I can't think why I keep noticing.
cmdblock.name: Shiba bushi

cmdblock.text: The archive is closed. Nothing in there but dust and very boring history.
cmdblock.name: Crane yojimbo

cmdblocks.text: Sense (Haruki's field spell): feel for what is hidden.
Someone in the dark archive, a lamp shaded with a sleeve: a young Asahina, reading a history the Council forbids.
...Thank you. He'll be a great man, if they let him read. Take this. It was going to be my excuse.
cmdblocks.name: Crane yojimbo

cmdblocks.text: Got a Scroll: Tremor.

cmdblock.text: He's still reading. Thank you.
cmdblock.name: Crane yojimbo

cmdblock.text: The procession is at dusk. I'm fine. I'm FINE.
cmdblock.name: Shiba commander

cmdblocks.text: Bless (Haruki's path action): guide someone a little way.
The procession can wait for one prayer, commander. Walk with me to the shrine.
cmdblocks.name: Isawa Haruki

cmdblocks.text: Halfway there the commander stops singing. At the shrine he washes his face in the snow, and comes back a Shiba.
Got a Shugenja's Haori.
(Honor +1)

cmdblock.text0: Bless him: lead him to the shrine.

cmdblock.text: Dusk. Procession. Sober. Don't tell anyone.
cmdblock.name: Shiba commander

cmdblocks.text: You broke my toy. I've been looking for you.

cmdblocks.text: Then I'll watch her. Quietly. You did right, Haruki-san.

cmdblocks.text: A hidden mountain torii honouring Shiba Mitsuhide, a Phoenix Champion branded a traitor centuries ago - he refused an order to burn a village. A mob of grieving envoys and townsfolk with torches.
A shrine to a traitor! At a memorial for our dead! Burn it!
cmdblocks.name: Mob Leader

cmdblocks.text: Please. Let me speak.
cmdblocks.name: Isawa Haruki

cmdblocks.text: The debate: the mob raises three claims. Two strong answers will turn them.
Claim 1: "He disobeyed his lord."
So did the boy who ran into a burning house to save his sister. Do we burn his memory too?
cmdblocks.name: Isawa Haruki

cmdblocks.text: (A strong answer. Someone in the mob looks at the ground.)
He had his reasons.
cmdblocks.name: Isawa Haruki

cmdblocks.text: (A weak answer.)

cmdblocks.text0: "So did the boy who ran into a burning house to save his sister."

cmdblocks.text: Claim 2: "Honouring a traitor insults the loyal dead."
The loyal dead would want us at peace.
cmdblocks.name: Isawa Haruki

cmdblocks.text: (A weak answer.)
My grandfather screams at me for every order I've ever obeyed.
cmdblocks.name: Shiba Ashimita

cmdblocks.text: The loyal dead died for something. Ask what.
cmdblocks.name: Shiba Ashimita

cmdblocks.text: (A strong answer. Someone in the mob looks at the ground.)
Claim 3: "There is no righteousness in disobedience."
He refused an order to burn people. You'd burn his shrine for it.
cmdblocks.name: Isawa Haruki

cmdblocks.text: Which of those is the insult to the dead?
cmdblocks.name: Isawa Haruki

cmdblocks.text: (A strong answer. Someone in the mob looks at the ground.)
Perhaps not. But he was brave.
cmdblocks.name: Isawa Haruki

cmdblocks.text: (A weak answer.)

cmdblocks.text0: "He refused an order to burn people."

cmdblocks.text: Silence. A torch lowers. Then another.
...Leave it. Leave it standing.
cmdblocks.name: Mob Leader

cmdblocks.text: (Honor +1)
The torii burns. Haruki stands in the smoke until it's gone.
Objective: back to the guest houses. Rest until night.
Night. Torches again - fewer, brighter. Hioninmaru and the last of Kokujin's cultists, and in his hands the "Consumer" scroll, stolen back.
The Consumer! Isn't it beautiful? A darkness that never dies - that lives inside the very best of you!
cmdblocks.name: Hioninmaru

cmdblocks.text: Read it to me, boy. Read me how to become it!
cmdblocks.name: Hioninmaru

cmdblocks.text: It isn't a prophecy. It's a warning.
cmdblocks.name: Isawa Haruki

cmdblocks.text: And you can't even read the difference.
cmdblocks.name: Isawa Haruki

cmdblocks.text: Hioninmaru's maho costs him his own blood, and his blood Taints. If his cultists fall, his nerve goes.
It said the best of you... the very best... why not me?
cmdblocks.name: Hioninmaru

cmdblocks.text: Because you wanted it.
cmdblocks.name: Isawa Haruki

cmdblocks.text: "The Consumer" lies in the snow where he dropped it.
Keiki locks it away. Haruki doesn't watch where.
Got "The Consumer".

cmdblock.text: The traitor's torii.
Shiba Mitsuhide's torii, still standing. Someone has left a candle.
Ash where the torii stood.

cmdblock.text: The sealed library. Bound shut; no one has opened it in a century.

cmdblocks.text: CHAPTER 3 - The Darkfever. (Recommended level 30)
Kyuden Isawa. The heart of Phoenix magic. On the first day of the Month of the Serpent, at noon, the sun went out.
A solar eclipse. The city stops. Then every kami in Kyuden Isawa shrieks at once - a sound like a thousand bells cracking.
They're screaming - they're all screaming -
cmdblocks.name: Isawa Haruki

cmdblocks.text: Silence. Light returns. Townsfolk stare at the sky.
Days later. A messenger, gasping.
Fever, in the forest villages! People burning up in a night - dark veins - dying by morning!
cmdblocks.name: Messenger

cmdblocks.text: The Council says it's peasant dirt. It isn't dirt, Isawa-sama. It's walking.
cmdblocks.name: Messenger

cmdblocks.text: Isawa Mieko has left the city. Two envoys are still dead. The Council's investigators hunt for her in the wrong places.
Ashimita goes with you. The Council will want someone to blame if you die, and I'd rather it wasn't me.
cmdblocks.name: Isawa Kamasari

cmdblocks.text: My grandfather says fevers are cowards. Fight them in the open.
cmdblocks.name: Shiba Ashimita

Objective: the fever villages, out of the south gate.
The Council of Elemental Masters. Masks of the five elements. The Master of Earth, Isawa Rujo, waves a dismissive sleeve.
Peasant uncleanliness. They'll wash, or they'll die. Either way, it ends.
cmdblocks.name: Isawa Rujo

cmdblocks.text: It spreads in a circle, Master. Dirt doesn't spread in a circle.
cmdblocks.name: Isawa Haruki

cmdblocks.text: Who is this?
cmdblocks.name: Isawa Rujo

cmdblocks.text: An acolyte, Master. Hoju's.
cmdblocks.name: Council Clerk

cmdblocks.text: Hoju's. Hoju always kept strays.
cmdblocks.name: Isawa Rujo

cmdblocks.text: Outside the hall, on the steps: a tired Crane in an Emerald Magistrate's yoriki sash, eating a rice ball: Doji Hayato.
The Masters say it's dirt.
cmdblocks.name: Doji Hayato

cmdblocks.text: Dirt doesn't spread in a circle.
cmdblocks.name: Isawa Haruki

cmdblocks.text: ...Show me the circle.
cmdblocks.name: Doji Hayato

cmdblocks.text: Objective: Doji Hayato's lodging, by the avenue.

cmdblock.text: Doji Hayato's lodging.
Doji Hayato's maps. Isawa Haruki casts Reflective Pool over a bowl of water. Village after village lights up, a ring spreading outward from one point deep in the Isawa Mori.
There. Your centre.
cmdblock.name: Doji Hayato

cmdblock.text: You know it.
cmdblock.name: Doji Hayato

cmdblock.text: ...It's a house. A family's forest house. I was there once. When I was eight.
cmdblock.name: Isawa Haruki

cmdblock.text: It's where I broke her.
cmdblock.name: Isawa Haruki

cmdblock.text: Broke whom?
cmdblock.name: Doji Hayato

cmdblock.text: Isawa Mieko.
cmdblock.name: Isawa Haruki

cmdblock.text: Flashback flicker: a child's go board; a jealous little girl knocking the stones away; a boy's scream; light like black glass tearing the room in half.
My Void lashed out. It split her soul. And it cracked something under that house. Something that was sleeping.
cmdblock.name: Isawa Haruki

cmdblock.text: The eclipse finished what I started.
cmdblock.name: Isawa Haruki

cmdblock.text: ...Then you'd better finish it properly.
cmdblock.name: Doji Hayato

cmdblock.text: Kuzushi. The unbalancing. The old records say it knocks people off their feet.
cmdblock.name: Isawa Haruki

cmdblock.text: Then stand on something heavier than your feet. The temple-smith sells mountain charms.
cmdblock.name: Doji Hayato

cmdblock.text: (The Mountain's-Feet Charm, sold by the temple-smith, keeps its wearer from being knocked Off-Balance.)

cmdblocks.text: (Rested. HP and MP restored.)

cmdblock.text: Objective: the Isawa Mori, east past the fever villages.
Hayato's maps, still spread on the floor, a ring of ink around one house.
The shrine of the five rings. Since the eclipse the kami here are hoarse.

cmdblocks.text: The offering water clouds over, then clears. The Taint is gone.
The water stays clear. There is nothing in you for it to take.
Haruki kneels. The kami answer, the way the very ill answer: slowly. (MP restored.)

cmdblock.text: (A memory, like a reflection in old water.)
Two children. A dispute over a captured stone.
(A memory, like a reflection in old water.)
A little girl laughing; a little boy, red-faced, shouting.
(A memory, like a reflection in old water.)
Light like black glass. A scream. Then two shadows where one girl stood.

cmdblocks.text: At the house's heart, sitting where the screen was broken, humming: Isawa Mieko's dark half. Black-glass eyes.
Little Void. You came back to where you broke me.
cmdblocks.name: Mieko (dark)

cmdblocks.text: Mieko-
cmdblocks.name: Isawa Haruki

cmdblocks.text: You broke more than me, you know. Can you hear it? Under the floor? It's been so grateful.
cmdblocks.name: Mieko (dark)

cmdblocks.text: She will run once she's hurt; she only came to look.
You wrote this. Your other half. A warning - about you.
cmdblocks.name: Isawa Haruki

cmdblocks.text: ...I don't remember writing this.
cmdblocks.name: Mieko (dark)

cmdblocks.text: She remembers you. She was afraid for you.
cmdblocks.name: Isawa Haruki

cmdblocks.text: Mieko hesitates, one moment too long. Then she vanishes into the trees.
She's gone before he can decide.
It's waking up, little Void! Say hello for me!
cmdblocks.name: Mieko (dark)

Objective: the cellar under the house.

cmdblocks.text: A cellar older than the house. A seal of cracked jade in the floor, broken outward. A shape fills the dark like a body falling down stairs forever: Oni no Kuzushi.
You opened my door, little Void.
cmdblocks.name: Oni no Kuzushi

cmdblocks.text: Twelve years ago. I waited so politely.
cmdblocks.name: Oni no Kuzushi

cmdblocks.text: Then I'll close it.
cmdblocks.name: Isawa Haruki

cmdblocks.text: Politely.
cmdblocks.name: Isawa Haruki

cmdblocks.text: Every second turn its breath knocks someone Off-Balance (the Mountain's-Feet Charm prevents it) and it steadies itself. The Darkfever burns everyone near it; heals undo it.
You stayed to save them. I grew while you were kind.
cmdblocks.name: Oni no Kuzushi

cmdblocks.text: You'll do this again, little Void. You'll break something else. You always will.
cmdblocks.name: Oni no Kuzushi

cmdblocks.text: Maybe. But not today.
cmdblocks.name: Isawa Haruki

cmdblocks.text: The oni collapses inward, tumbling down into nothing. The cellar seal glows, then goes dark and whole.
The fever ends in a week.

cmdblocks.text: The fever ends in a week. The Council, grudging, opens the sealed library to "the acolyte who assisted the magistrate". Isawa Haruki walks between shelves no one has touched in a century.
"On the splitting and joining of souls." "Joining requires one of the halves to want it. And a giver."
cmdblocks.name: Isawa Haruki

cmdblocks.text: ...A giver.
cmdblocks.name: Isawa Haruki

cmdblocks.text: Another scroll: the destruction of the Snake Clan, by a Shuten Doji.
"Obsidian against Fear. Jade against Regret. Crystal against Desire." "Obsidian corrupts the hand that holds it."
cmdblocks.name: Isawa Haruki

cmdblocks.text: Someone in the Ojatara valleys should read this.
cmdblocks.name: Isawa Haruki

cmdblocks.text: The Master of Air, Isawa Uona, a young woman newly raised to the Council, finds him there.
You're Hoju's boy. The one who counted the circle.
cmdblocks.name: Isawa Uona

cmdblocks.text: The Council won't thank you. So I will. Quietly.
cmdblocks.name: Isawa Uona

cmdblocks.text: Dreamwalker. A secret of Air. I think you'll need to walk in someone's dreams soon.
cmdblocks.name: Isawa Uona

cmdblocks.text: Got a Scroll: Dreamwalker.
Doji Hayato's report to the Emerald Magistrates credits "the Isawa". Isawa Haruki's name isn't in it. Haruki reads it and smiles.
Thank you for leaving me out.
cmdblocks.name: Isawa Haruki

cmdblocks.text: Most people want their names in reports.
cmdblocks.name: Doji Hayato

cmdblocks.text: I've been in one report already. It took twelve years to read.
cmdblocks.name: Isawa Haruki

cmdblocks.text: Most of the sick on the fever road lived.
Some of the sick on the fever road lived. The names of the others are read at the shrine of the five rings.
"The Darkfever" - complete.
An eclipse, a plague, and a circle drawn from a house where a boy once broke a girl. Haruki closed the door he'd opened at eight, and learned that joining a soul needs a giver.
(Rank 3 waits at level 41.)
My grandfather says you did well. He's never said that about anyone.
cmdblocks.name: Shiba Ashimita

cmdblocks.text: Next: Howl. The coast road leaves Kyuden Isawa to the north. (Recommended level 41)

cmdblocks.text: CHAPTER 4 - Howl. (Recommended level 41)
The Phoenix coast. A storm coming in off the sea. And in the temple, a book that took a hundred years to write.
A temple scriptorium. Monks copy a fat old book: Against the Bloodspeakers.
Every ward against the Bloodspeakers, in one book. The Council finally agreed to share it with every clan.
cmdblocks.name: Asako Keiki

cmdblocks.text: Last night it was stolen.
cmdblocks.name: Asako Keiki

cmdblocks.text: Mieko.
cmdblocks.name: Isawa Haruki

cmdblocks.text: Her other half. She went toward the red torii on the cliffs.
cmdblocks.name: Asako Keiki

cmdblocks.text: She'll burn it there. Or read it, and then there's no ward left that can hold her.
cmdblocks.name: Asako Keiki

cmdblocks.text: She'll do neither. She'll wait for me. She's been waiting twelve years.
cmdblocks.name: Isawa Haruki

cmdblocks.text: I watched her, as you asked. Every midnight. I'm sorry I wasn't enough.
cmdblocks.name: Asako Keiki

cmdblocks.text: You saw her at midnight, didn't you. In Treaty City. You knew before any of us.
cmdblocks.name: Asako Keiki

cmdblocks.text: The Emerald Magistrates owe you a report with your name in it. They'll settle for me instead.
cmdblocks.name: Doji Hayato

cmdblocks.text: I'll walk you up the cliffs. Try not to fall off them. I'd have to write that down.
cmdblocks.name: Doji Hayato

cmdblock.text: The sea shrine. The storm pulls at the paper prayers; they hold.

cmdblocks.text: The offering water clouds over, then clears. The Taint is gone.
The water stays clear. There is nothing in you for it to take.
Haruki kneels. Under the wind, something in the sea is listening. (MP restored.)

cmdblock.text: The jetty, slick with rain. A drowned sailor's ghost stands at the end of it, looking down.

cmdblocks.text: Bless (Haruki's path action): guide someone, living or dead, a little way.
Show me where you're going, sailor. I'll walk with you.
cmdblocks.name: Isawa Haruki

cmdblocks.text: The drowned sailor walks out along the jetty and points down into the water: a box, lashed to a pile. Then he is gone.
Got an Orochi Scale.

cmdblock.text: The jetty. Just rain now.

cmdblocks.text: Dawn. The storm gone. Isawa Mieko, wrapped in a temple blanket, gives the book back to Isawa Haruki. One page is marked with a dried camellia petal.
My other half was investigating something. Before. Read that.
cmdblocks.name: Isawa Mieko

cmdblocks.text: "On the Bride of Fu Leng, who wears the faces of the beloved..."
cmdblocks.name: Isawa Haruki

cmdblocks.text: ...You were hunting her. Even then.
cmdblocks.name: Isawa Haruki

cmdblocks.text: The gentle half was. The other half thinks she'd like to help finish it.
cmdblocks.name: Isawa Mieko

cmdblocks.text: Bring the book back afterwards. Then we'll talk.
cmdblocks.name: Isawa Mieko

cmdblocks.text: About forgiveness?
cmdblocks.name: Isawa Haruki

cmdblocks.text: About camellias. They're very difficult to grow.
cmdblocks.name: Isawa Mieko

cmdblocks.text: At the red torii, as the sun rises over the sea: two wolves on the cliff, one white and one black, howl once together. Then there is only one, the colour of dawn, and it trots away into the trees.
Got "Against the Bloodspeakers".
"Howl" - complete.

Haruki walked through the night he broke Mieko, met both halves of her, and gave up part of his own Void to make her whole. She doesn't forgive him - yet. She does want to help hunt the Bride of Fu Leng.
My report will say "the Isawa" again. You'll like it.
cmdblocks.name: Doji Hayato

cmdblocks.text: The Phoenix path is complete.

cmdblock.text: The storm has a voice tonight, Isawa-sama. I'll pray louder than it.
cmdblock.name: Sea-shrine Priestess

cmdblocks.text: Your current hireling heads home.
Three prayers. The sea is listening.
cmdblocks.name: Sea-shrine Priestess

Coin first, Isawa-sama.

cmdblocks.text: The forest estate, twelve years ago. Daylight that's too bright. The go board. Two children's voices.
That's my stone! You can't take it!
cmdblocks.name: Child-Mieko

cmdblocks.text: I captured it fairly!
cmdblocks.name: Child-Haruki

cmdblocks.text: A crack runs across the dream, splitting it: on one side, a garden in sunlight; on the other, ash.
In the garden: the gentle Isawa Mieko, arranging flowers, humming. In the ash: the dark Mieko, sitting on the broken go board.
In the sunlight, the gentle Mieko. In the ash, the dark one. Where the crack began, a frozen boy.

cmdblock.text: The camellias need covering before the rain. Do you know who I am? I don't.
cmdblock.name: Gentle Mieko

cmdblock.text: The camellias need covering before the rain.
cmdblock.name: Gentle Mieko

cmdblocks.text: You wrote this. A warning.
cmdblocks.name: Isawa Haruki

cmdblocks.text: ...I wrote this? I don't - I was afraid of her. Of me.
cmdblocks.name: Gentle Mieko

cmdblock.name: Dark Mieko

cmdblock.name: Dark Mieko

cmdblocks.text: Haruki holds out the folded note. A child's brushwork: "I'm sorry Mieko I didn't mean to please wake up."
...You wrote this.
cmdblocks.name: Dark Mieko

cmdblocks.text: ...You were eight.
cmdblocks.name: Dark Mieko

cmdblocks.text: (A dream key.)

cmdblock.text: ...Go away. I'm thinking.
cmdblock.name: Dark Mieko

cmdblock.text: Where the crack began: a frozen boy, mid-scream, Void pouring from his hands.

cmdblocks.text: I'm sorry I'm sorry I'm sorry I didn't mean to-
cmdblocks.name: Child-Haruki

cmdblocks.text: I know.
cmdblocks.name: Isawa Haruki

cmdblocks.text: You don't have to say it anymore. I'll say it for both of us.
cmdblocks.name: Isawa Haruki

cmdblocks.text: Haruki sets the child's go stone on the dream board. "I'm giving back the stone too."
The dream shudders. Haruki wakes.

cmdblock.text0: Kneel beside him. (The dream will end.)

cmdblocks.text: The red torii on the sea-cliff, in the storm. The dark Isawa Mieko stands at the edge with the book, black-glass eyes, Void crackling around her like broken lightning.
You walked in my dream. Rude.
cmdblocks.name: Mieko (dark)

cmdblocks.text: You broke me in half, little Void. Now you'll finish the job?
cmdblocks.name: Mieko (dark)

cmdblocks.text: Do it. It's what Void does.
cmdblocks.name: Mieko (dark)

cmdblocks.text: Her Void drains his. Each echo Haruki blessed stands between them once; each dream key loosened her.
Well? Finish it.
cmdblocks.name: Mieko (dark)

cmdblocks.text: Haruki raises his staff. Stops. Lowers it.
...No. Not again. I won't break you again.
cmdblocks.name: Isawa Haruki

cmdblocks.text: The library said joining needs one half to want it. And a giver.
cmdblocks.name: Isawa Haruki

cmdblocks.text: And who would give anything for me?
cmdblocks.name: Mieko (dark)

cmdblocks.text: I would. I took some of you. It's fair.
cmdblocks.name: Isawa Haruki

cmdblocks.text: Light. Not black glass - something like dawn through water. The crack between two Miekos closes, slowly, and Isawa Haruki cries out once and falls to his knees.
The library said joining needs one half to want it. And a giver.
cmdblocks.name: Isawa Haruki

cmdblocks.text: And who would give anything for me?
cmdblocks.name: Mieko (dark)

cmdblocks.text: I would. I took some of you. It's fair.
cmdblocks.name: Isawa Haruki

cmdblocks.text: Light. Not black glass - something like dawn through water. The crack between two Miekos closes, slowly, and Isawa Haruki cries out once and falls to his knees.
Haruki gives part of his Void. (Void -1, for good. Passive "Whole": his Water heals also cleanse a debuff, and he can draw the Void twice in a battle.)
One Isawa Mieko kneels in the rain. Fragile. Remembering everything. She looks at her hands as though she's never seen them.
...Who am I?
cmdblocks.name: Isawa Mieko

cmdblocks.text: I don't know. I think you get to decide.
cmdblocks.name: Isawa Haruki

cmdblocks.text: I'm sorry it took me twelve years to give it back.
cmdblocks.name: Isawa Haruki

cmdblocks.text: Someone who doesn't forgive you. Yet.
cmdblocks.name: Isawa Mieko

cmdblocks.text: "Yet" is more than I ever hoped for.
cmdblocks.name: Isawa Haruki

cmdblocks.text: Someone who remembers you were eight. And that I was cruel first. I took your stone.
cmdblocks.name: Isawa Mieko

cmdblocks.text: ...You did take my stone.
cmdblocks.name: Isawa Haruki

cmdblocks.text: CHAPTER 1 - Under the Skin.
The Mantis Isles. Where the Empire's laws arrive late, wet, and slightly bribed.
A trading ship. Kitsuki Gendo leans on the rail polishing round gaijin spectacles. Beside him, gripping the rail very hard: Kitsuki Oharu, sharp-eyed, grey-haired, kind.
Tell me what you see, Gendo.
cmdblocks.name: Kitsuki Oharu

cmdblocks.text: A trading ship. Forty crew. Silk in the manifest.
cmdblocks.name: Kitsuki Gendo

cmdblocks.text: And?
cmdblocks.name: Kitsuki Oharu

cmdblocks.text: The captain's lying about the cargo. The ship sits too low for silk. Lead, perhaps. Or rice.
cmdblocks.name: Kitsuki Gendo

cmdblocks.text: Good. And?
cmdblocks.name: Kitsuki Oharu

cmdblocks.text: And you're seasick, Oharu-sama, and pretending you're not.
cmdblocks.name: Kitsuki Gendo

cmdblocks.text: Better. Never tell anyone that second one.
cmdblocks.name: Kitsuki Oharu

cmdblocks.text: I'll file it under "classified".
cmdblocks.name: Kitsuki Gendo

cmdblocks.text: Discern: Gendo's path action. Study someone to learn what they hide. Discern the ship's captain.

cmdblock.text: Silk, magistrate-sama. Only silk. Very light, silk.
cmdblock.name: Mantis captain

cmdblocks.text: Discern: The captain is smuggling Mantis rice past a Crane tariff. Nervous. Not dangerous.
Rice is heavier than silk, captain. Your waterline says hello.
cmdblocks.name: Kitsuki Gendo

cmdblocks.text: ...Please don't tell the Yoritomo.
cmdblocks.name: Mantis captain

cmdblocks.text: I'm a junior yoriki. Nobody tells me anything, and I tell nobody anything. It's very restful.
cmdblocks.name: Kitsuki Gendo

cmdblocks.text: Docking. A drunken sailor swings a gaff at Kitsuki Gendo for "staring".
Deduce: Gendo's School technique. It reveals an enemy's weaknesses and its next action. (Battle menu: School.)
I wasn't staring. I was deducing. It looks the same from outside.
cmdblocks.name: Kitsuki Gendo

cmdblocks.text: (Rested. HP and MP restored.)

cmdblock.text: Please don't tell the Yoritomo.
cmdblock.name: Mantis captain

cmdblock.text: Tortoise Island? Nobody goes to Tortoise Island. Except a Crane gentleman, last night. In a hurry.
cmdblock.name: Ferryman

cmdblock.text: That's a Tortoise token. Tortoise Island, then. It's grey, it's wet, and the fish are rude.
cmdblock.name: Ferryman

cmdblock.text0: Take the ferry to Tortoise Island.

cmdblock.text: Yoritomo's tax shed. A bribe ledger, and a jar of good sake behind it.
Got Fine Sake.
The tax shed.
The teacher says I'm the worst at recitation and the best with a staff. He means it as an insult.
cmdblock.name: Rakusho Novice

cmdblocks.text: Your current hireling heads home.
Three blows, magistrate-sama. I'll recite them correctly.
cmdblocks.name: Rakusho Novice

Coin first, Kitsuki-sama.
cmdblocks.name: Rakusho Novice

cmdblock.text: Kama cuts and fish-hook gashes are my trade, little magistrate. You look like you'll need both.
cmdblock.name: Silk-isle Herbalist

cmdblocks.text: Your current hireling heads home.
Three poultices. Bleed slowly.
cmdblocks.name: Silk-isle Herbalist

cmdblocks.text: Kosai. Show the magistrate whatever she likes. And the boy.

cmdblocks.text: Night. The guest house. Kitsuki Oharu sips her tea. Coughs. Coughs again. Drops the cup.
Oharu-sama!
cmdblocks.name: Kitsuki Gendo

cmdblocks.text: Gendo shouts for a healer. Kosai "can't find one". Gendo's hands are steady as he sniffs the tea.
(Bitter almond... no. Mantis mushroom. She'll live if she doesn't move. If.)
cmdblocks.name: Kitsuki Gendo

cmdblocks.text: Gendo. My seal. Take my seal.
cmdblocks.name: Kitsuki Oharu

cmdblocks.text: Oharu-sama, I'm a clerk with spectacles.
cmdblocks.name: Kitsuki Gendo

cmdblocks.text: They won't respect it in your hands. Use it anyway.
cmdblocks.name: Kitsuki Oharu

cmdblocks.text: Got Oharu's Seal.
Morning. Tadayasu leans in the doorway.
Terrible luck. The magistrate is sick. The case must wait for a real magistrate.
cmdblocks.name: Tadayasu

cmdblocks.text: The case has one.
cmdblocks.name: Kitsuki Gendo

cmdblocks.text: A seal on a clerk is a hat on a fish, little Dragon. Go home.
cmdblocks.name: Tadayasu

cmdblocks.text: Fish wear hats on some islands. I've read about it.
cmdblocks.name: Kitsuki Gendo

cmdblocks.text: (Rested. HP and MP restored.)
Objective: the dump above the sea, where the body was found. (Out through the town, west.)
Kitsuki Oharu, propped on cushions, still grey, listens to everything.
You let a Crane walk free because you couldn't prove it yet.
cmdblocks.name: Kitsuki Oharu

cmdblocks.text: Yes, Oharu-sama.
cmdblocks.name: Kitsuki Gendo

cmdblocks.text: You followed a code a child remembered wrongly.
cmdblocks.name: Kitsuki Oharu

cmdblocks.text: Perfectly wrong, Oharu-sama.
cmdblocks.name: Kitsuki Gendo

cmdblocks.text: I name you to continue the case under my seal.
cmdblocks.name: Kitsuki Oharu

cmdblocks.text: They won't respect you, Gendo.
cmdblocks.name: Kitsuki Oharu

cmdblocks.text: No, Oharu-sama. But they'll remember being wrong about me.
cmdblocks.name: Kitsuki Gendo

cmdblocks.text: That will have to do.
cmdblocks.name: Kitsuki Gendo

cmdblocks.text: The next morning. Kitsuki Gendo pays a fisherman out of his own purse. Tadayasu watches from the docks, laughing.
Off to fish, clerk?
cmdblocks.name: Tadayasu

cmdblocks.text: Off to catch something.
cmdblocks.name: Kitsuki Gendo

cmdblocks.text: "Under the Skin" - complete.

A senior magistrate poisoned, a seal in a clerk's hand, three monks emptied of their ink, and a cheerful tattooed man counting the ways he might be next. Gendo goes to Tortoise Island with no authority at all.
Next: The Painting. The Tortoise ferry leaves from the Isle of Silk pier. (Recommended level 20)

cmdblocks.text: A reeking garbage heap above the sea. A cheerful little eta in a stained apron waves: Muika, the mortician.
You're the clerk! The fish-hat clerk! Everyone's talking about you.
cmdblocks.name: Muika

cmdblocks.text: Everyone is very well informed.
cmdblocks.name: Kitsuki Gendo

cmdblocks.text: The body's under the tarp. Skinned - well, not skinned. That's the strange thing.
cmdblocks.name: Muika

cmdblocks.text: ...His tattoos are gone. The skin is blank.
cmdblocks.name: Kitsuki Gendo

cmdblocks.text: Like someone poured them out of him. Thirty years I've washed the dead. Never seen that.
cmdblocks.name: Muika

cmdblocks.text: The earth under the dump trembles. Faint voices rise out of the ground.
BLOOD! FIRE! PAIN! BLOOD! FIRE! PAIN!
cmdblocks.name: Earth Kami

cmdblocks.text: ...Earth kami. Driven mad.
cmdblocks.name: Kitsuki Gendo

cmdblocks.text: On top of the heap, eating a persimmon, sits a tattooed monk with a shaved head and a cheerful face: Togashi Yosai.
That's Togashi blood in the ground. It makes the spirits hysterical. Like sugar for children.
cmdblocks.name: Togashi Yosai

cmdblocks.text: And you are?
cmdblocks.name: Kitsuki Gendo

cmdblocks.text: Yosai. Togashi. That's Nobue. He owed me three strings of coin and a poem.
cmdblocks.name: Togashi Yosai

cmdblocks.text: I suppose I'll never get the poem.
cmdblocks.name: Togashi Yosai

cmdblocks.text: You knew him.
cmdblocks.name: Kitsuki Gendo

cmdblocks.text: We were brothers in the Order. He's the third brother to die like this this year.
cmdblocks.name: Togashi Yosai

cmdblocks.text: If the pattern holds, I'm next! So I thought I'd come and see who's doing it before it's my turn.
cmdblocks.name: Togashi Yosai

cmdblocks.text: Saves time.
cmdblocks.name: Togashi Yosai

cmdblocks.text: Oh, I like him.
cmdblocks.name: Muika

cmdblocks.text: ...Would you like to help a junior yoriki with no authority?
cmdblocks.name: Kitsuki Gendo

cmdblocks.text: Would I! I've never been useful to the law before. It'll be a new way to nearly die.
cmdblocks.name: Togashi Yosai

cmdblocks.text: A temple school. Children recite Tao verses. One boy, slightly older, recites louder and wrong: Riichi.
Riichi! Again! You've said it wrong again!
cmdblocks.name: Teacher

cmdblocks.text: No, sensei. I said it exactly wrong.
cmdblocks.name: Riichi

cmdblocks.text: The teacher throws up his hands. Kitsuki Gendo kneels beside the boy.
Who taught you to say it exactly wrong, Riichi?
cmdblocks.name: Kitsuki Gendo

cmdblocks.text: The monk. Three monks. One after the other. "Say it exactly wrong, Riichi. Exactly."
cmdblocks.name: Riichi

cmdblocks.text: People laugh at me. I don't mind. I remember everything. They forget.
cmdblocks.name: Riichi

cmdblocks.text: Discern: each monk changed different words in the same verses. The changed words form directions.
Nobody ever asks slowly.
cmdblocks.name: Riichi

cmdblocks.text: I don't write. I remember.
cmdblocks.name: Riichi

cmdblocks.text: He recites it anyway, but sulks.
Riichi recites. Kitsuki Gendo's lips move along with him. His pen flies.
"The fourth step"... "three stones, thirty-three paces"... "twenty up the wall"...
cmdblocks.name: Kitsuki Gendo

cmdblocks.text: It isn't scripture. It's a map. Up the stairs of the ruin. Kyuden Gusai.
cmdblocks.name: Kitsuki Gendo

cmdblocks.text: Did I say it perfectly?
cmdblocks.name: Riichi

cmdblocks.text: You said it perfectly wrong, Riichi. That's the hardest kind.
cmdblocks.name: Kitsuki Gendo

cmdblocks.text: (Rested. HP and MP restored.)
Objective: Kyuden Gusai's ruins, up the silk hill path (east of town).

cmdblock.text: Plums! Someone took the plums. Very important. Very important plums.
cmdblock.name: Kitsuki Momo

cmdblock.text: A young woman in Kitsuki colours with farmer's hands, investigating a stolen-plum case: Kitsuki Momo.
You're the fish-hat clerk!
cmdblock.name: Kitsuki Momo

cmdblock.text: The reputation precedes me like a smell.
cmdblock.name: Kitsuki Gendo

cmdblock.text: I was a plum farmer's daughter until I saved my lord from a snake. Now I'm a magistrate who investigates plums.
cmdblock.name: Kitsuki Momo

cmdblock.text: Let me help with something that isn't plums. Please.
cmdblock.name: Kitsuki Momo

cmdblocks.name: Tadayasu's Thug

cmdblocks.text: Eighteen?
cmdblocks.name: Togashi Yosai

cmdblocks.text: Not yet. Stand behind me.
cmdblocks.name: Kitsuki Gendo

cmdblocks.text: You're a clerk.
cmdblocks.name: Togashi Yosai

cmdblocks.text: I'm a clerk with a Mirumoto sword I rarely draw. This is rarely.
cmdblocks.name: Kitsuki Gendo

cmdblock.text: (Riichi's chant: "...twenty up the wall...")

cmdblocks.text: (Said slowly, it's clear: twenty stones up)

cmdblock.text: Twenty stones up the wall. The twentieth is hollow.
The hollow. A bundle of oiled paper. Kitsuki Gendo reads by lamplight.
"Ayaru. Then Jotaro. Then Nobue. Each of us has followed the old man. Each of us will die."
cmdblock.name: Kitsuki Gendo

cmdblock.text: "Togashi Akuro. An ise zumi of our order. His last tattoo showed him a vision he could not bear."
cmdblock.name: Kitsuki Gendo

cmdblock.text: "He can change his face. Where he walks, there is no Taint. Only absence."
cmdblock.name: Kitsuki Gendo

cmdblock.text: Togashi Yosai has gone quiet. For the first time, he isn't smiling.
...Akuro taught me to sit still. When I was nine. Six hours on a cold stone. I cried the whole time.
cmdblock.name: Togashi Yosai

cmdblock.text: He brought me rice afterwards and said crying was just stillness leaking.
cmdblock.name: Togashi Yosai

cmdblock.text: Well! That's ruined that memory.
cmdblock.name: Togashi Yosai

cmdblock.text: Got the Monks' Notes.

cmdblocks.text: (Rested. HP and MP restored.)

cmdblock.text: Objective: the notes mention "the Crane who helps us". The boathouse, east of the waterfront.
The hollow behind the twentieth stone, empty.
A Gusai hostage's cell. A knife, forgotten in the straw.
Got a Kozuka.
The empty cell.

cmdblocks.text: A boathouse. A thin, elegant Crane artisan cowers among nets: Kakita Kumpei.
Don't hurt me! I only helped the monk with his paintings! I'm an artist! I'm harmless!
cmdblocks.name: Kakita Kumpei

cmdblocks.text: Of course.
cmdblocks.name: Kitsuki Gendo

cmdblocks.text: Discern: rare blue pigment under his fingernails, the same blue as the stolen tattoos' ink.
Discern, deeper: he says he left the island the night Nobue died. The tide tables say no boat could.
(Evidence: paint, tide, a lie about tide tables. Testimony against it: a Crane with beautiful manners.)
cmdblocks.name: Kitsuki Gendo

cmdblocks.text: (Every court in the Empire believes the manners.)
cmdblocks.name: Kitsuki Gendo

cmdblocks.text: You were there when Nobue died.
cmdblocks.name: Kitsuki Gendo

cmdblocks.text: How dare you! A Crane! Accused by a - a clerk!
cmdblocks.name: Kakita Kumpei

cmdblocks.text: The fish-hat accuses a Crane artist! Off the island, clerk!
cmdblocks.name: Tadayasu

cmdblocks.text: (Glory -1. Gendo was right, and nobody cares.)
Thank you, Kumpei-san. You've been very helpful. Please don't leave the island.
cmdblocks.name: Kitsuki Gendo

cmdblocks.text: He did it.
cmdblocks.name: Togashi Yosai

cmdblocks.text: Yes.
cmdblocks.name: Kitsuki Gendo

cmdblocks.text: You let him go.
cmdblocks.name: Togashi Yosai

cmdblocks.text: I let him run.
cmdblocks.name: Kitsuki Gendo

cmdblocks.text: Men who run go somewhere. I'd like to know where.
cmdblocks.name: Kitsuki Gendo

cmdblocks.text: That evening Kumpei slips away by boat toward Tortoise Island.
Objective: the departure beach, south of town.

cmdblock.text: Kumpei's paint box, left behind.
Got Rare Blue Pigment.

cmdblocks.text: The departure beach. A borrowed fishing boat. Figures waiting on the sand with dull eyes: ronin shugenja, and Mantis thugs - all murmuring the same phrase.
...you're at the end of your rope... the end of your rope...
cmdblocks.name: Hypnotised Shugenja

cmdblocks.text: Someone planted that sentence in them. They aren't choosing this.
cmdblocks.name: Kitsuki Gendo

cmdblocks.text: Akuro used to do a trick like that with a sake cup and a whisper. I thought it was a party trick.
cmdblocks.name: Togashi Yosai

cmdblocks.text: The tide: every third round it comes in while a hypnotised shugenja still calls it. Waist-deep first, then drowning. Take the callers down, or cut their sentence with Interrogate.
Victory. The tide covers the sand. The shugenja wake, shivering, remembering nothing. Togashi Yosai fetches a blanket for each one from the wrecked boat.
There. Now you're only cold and confused, like the rest of us.
cmdblocks.name: Togashi Yosai

cmdblocks.text: The boat is wrecked. Kakita Kumpei's sail is a white speck heading for Tortoise Island.
Got a Tortoise Ferry Token.

cmdblocks.text: CHAPTER 2 - The Painting. (Recommended level 20)
Tortoise Island. A fishing village, a shrine, and a new wooden house nobody remembers being built.
A grey fishing village. A villager points up the hill without being asked.
He ran exactly where I hoped. Men who run go somewhere.
cmdblocks.name: Kitsuki Gendo

cmdblocks.text: The new house? An old man and a Crane gentleman. They paid in glass. Who pays in glass?
cmdblocks.name: Villager

cmdblocks.text: Gendo's first rule as a yoriki: bring them in alive. (Gendo: Subdue, a Bo strike to the wrist.)
Objective: the new house on the hill.

cmdblock.text: The headland path. The house on the hill first.
Rubble, still settling. A grey cat sits on top of it, very pleased with itself.

cmdblocks.text: It allows this. Once.

cmdblock.text: Back to the Isle of Silk? The fish there are politer.
cmdblock.name: Ferryman

cmdblock.text: The Isle of Silk, or the mainland?
cmdblock.name: Ferryman

cmdblock.text: The new house? On the hill. Nobody remembers it being built.
cmdblock.name: Villager

cmdblocks.text: Discern: They paid the carpenters in glass. Mirrors, small ones.

cmdblock.text: Glass! Who pays in glass?
cmdblock.name: Villager

#11#.msg: My crab pinches magistrates. He's very political.
#11#.name: *villager-11

#12#.msg: The Crane gentleman cried in the night. Loud, like a gull. I told my husband it was a gull.
#12#.name: *villager-12

#13#.msg: The cove sings at low tide. I sing back. We're both terrible.
#13#.name: *villager-13

#14#.msg: On leave. A Mantis on leave fights for free. Ask me later, magistrate.
#14#.name: *villager-14

cmdblock.text: Forty years under the water, magistrate. The cove sings now. I don't like the song.
cmdblock.name: Old Diver

cmdblocks.text: Your current hireling heads home.
Three throws of the harpoon. I'll want it back.
cmdblocks.name: Old Diver

cmdblocks.text: Old Diver follows Gendo. (In battle: Support. 3 uses, then home to the diving rocks.)
Coin first, Kitsuki-sama.
cmdblocks.name: Old Diver

cmdblock.text: The Tortoise kami is slow, and so am I. But we both arrive.
cmdblock.name: Shrine-keeper

cmdblocks.text: Your current hireling heads home.
Three cups of tea. Drink them hot.
cmdblocks.name: Shrine-keeper

Coin first, Kitsuki-sama.

I'll be here. Probably. Statistically.
cmdblocks.name: Togashi Yosai

cmdblocks.text: You've already got company. I'll keep the bench warm. Benches love me.
cmdblocks.name: Togashi Yosai

#98#.msg: The road's closed for now. Orders. When it opens, you'll hear of it.
#98#.name: *villager-98

cmdblocks.text: The house: clean, empty, smelling of alchemy. Dragon instruments on the shelves: an alembic, a brass star-chart.
Dragon work. Tamori-style. Our own clan's tools, in a murderer's kitchen.
cmdblocks.name: Kitsuki Gendo

cmdblocks.text: ...Gendo.
cmdblocks.name: Togashi Yosai

cmdblocks.text: The cellar. Two shapes under cloth. Togashi Yosai lifts a corner, then lowers it again, gently.
Two more brothers. Their tattoos are gone. Not cut. Lifted.
cmdblocks.name: Togashi Yosai

cmdblocks.text: The ink lived in them, and he took it.
cmdblocks.name: Togashi Yosai

cmdblocks.text: Akuro.
cmdblocks.name: Kitsuki Gendo

cmdblocks.text: He always said ink was just patience made visible. I suppose he wanted the patience back.
cmdblocks.name: Togashi Yosai

cmdblocks.text: The floor lurches. Plaster rains down. An unnatural earthquake - the house folds like paper.
They escape through the window as the roof comes down. Below, round the headland, a white sail: Kakita Kumpei's boat entering a sea-cave.
(Rested. HP and MP restored.)
Objective: Kumpei's sail went into a sea-cave round the headland. (The east end of the shore lane.)

cmdblock.text: A one-room dojo on the ridge. An old Mirumoto in exile sharpens two blades.
A Kitsuki who carries a Mirumoto sword and never draws it. I've heard of you, fish-hat.
cmdblock.name: Mirumoto Koshi

cmdblock.text: Everyone has. It's my only fame.
cmdblock.name: Kitsuki Gendo

cmdblock.text: You hold the katana like a clerk holds a brush.
cmdblock.name: Mirumoto Koshi

cmdblock.text: I was a clerk.
cmdblock.name: Kitsuki Gendo

cmdblock.text: Good. Clerks know the second stroke corrects the first. Take the wakizashi too.
cmdblock.name: Mirumoto Koshi

cmdblock.text: Two swords. Two truths. One hand states. The other hand checks.
cmdblock.name: Mirumoto Koshi

cmdblock.text: It feels like writing with two brushes.
cmdblock.name: Kitsuki Gendo

cmdblock.text: It is. Now - write.
cmdblock.name: Mirumoto Koshi

cmdblock.text: Got Koshi's Wakizashi.
The Mirumoto secondary school opens to Gendo. Rank 1: Daisho Technique (two blades, two hits; it answers an iaijutsu draw).
An afternoon of it. Kitsuki Gendo drops the wakizashi twice. The third time, he doesn't.
Adequate.
cmdblock.name: Mirumoto Koshi

cmdblock.text: I'll file that under praise. Nobody will check.
cmdblock.name: Kitsuki Gendo

cmdblock.text: Two swords. Two truths. Write, clerk.
cmdblock.name: Mirumoto Koshi

cmdblock.text: A sparring post, notched on both sides. Gendo runs the kata until the wakizashi stops falling.

cmdblocks.text: (The second stroke corrects the first.)

M319.name: The Tortoise cove - the clay city

cmdblocks.text: The centre. A frame of two posts, silk stretched between them, painted with living ink - tattoos flowing like water. A portal. Through it: a cherry orchard in winter.

Kakita Kumpei and an old fisherman - who straightens, and is not a fisherman - step through. Togashi Akuro glances back once. He looks at Togashi Yosai. Something passes over his face. Then he's gone.
The silk's edges begin to blacken and curl.
He looked at me.
cmdblocks.name: Togashi Yosai

cmdblocks.text: Yosai-
cmdblocks.name: Kitsuki Gendo

cmdblocks.text: After them!
cmdblocks.name: Kitsuki Gendo

cmdblocks.text: Wait. Think first. A portal is evidence, and evidence -
cmdblocks.name: Kitsuki Gendo

cmdblocks.text: The portal pulls at them anyway.
Twenty!
cmdblocks.name: Togashi Yosai

cmdblocks.text: He leaps. Kitsuki Gendo leaps after him. The rest of the world stays on the sand.
I've investigated plums. I can investigate time.
cmdblocks.name: Kitsuki Momo

cmdblocks.text: Kitsuki Momo jumps too. She answers the Guest call in the past.
The silk burns away behind them.
Your hireling stays on the sand.
Only Gendo crosses. Togashi Yosai is lost in the ink.

cmdblock.text: The Ink Door: a frame of two posts, and silk that moves like water. On the other side, snow.
The Ink Door. On the other side: smoke, banners, the sea.
When this chapter ends, the door will close forever. The past's shops and chests will be gone.

cmdblock.text0: Step through (the war camp, the year 400).

cmdblock.text: Just paint now: a grey sea-cave, a tide pool, a clay city. The year 400 is sealed.

cmdblocks.text: Kakita Kumpei's painted portal: a cherry orchard dissolving into a grey sea-cave. Tortoise Island. Summer 1123.
Fish! Rain! Our century! Twenty-three - no, that was the landing. That doesn't count.
cmdblocks.name: Togashi Yosai

cmdblocks.text: Behind them, the Ink Door's painted cave goes still. Just paint now. The year 400 is sealed.

cmdblocks.text: Silence. Then - a fall. Snow. Cherry petals. A winter orchard under a pale sun.
The year 400. The reign of the sixth Hantei. Three great lords rule the Empire through a boy.
History: 100%. You are in the past. Anachronisms (words, objects, deeds that don't belong) lower History. At 0, the future you came from is lost.
Year four hundred. No Kitsuki family yet.
cmdblocks.name: Kitsuki Gendo

cmdblocks.text: No magistrates. Spectacles are probably witchcraft.
cmdblocks.name: Kitsuki Gendo

cmdblocks.text: Wonderful.
cmdblocks.name: Kitsuki Gendo

cmdblocks.text: Don't say "Kitsuki". Don't mention the Unicorn, the Kaiu Wall, or Emerald Magistrates. Keep your spectacles hidden around nobles.
(Rested. HP and MP restored.)
Objective: voices, further along the orchard path.
A boy of fourteen in Imperial white walks under the trees with two guards: Hantei Kusada. One guard - Seppun Ushimo - draws and cuts his partner down without a word, and turns toward the boy.
...Ushimo?
cmdblocks.name: Hantei Kusada

cmdblocks.text: Kitsuki Gendo is closest. He steps between them - both swords out, badly.
(Do not change history. Do not change history.) Majesty, behind me.
cmdblocks.name: Kitsuki Gendo

cmdblocks.text: Seppun Ushimo wants to die. Below a quarter of his strength he will drop his guard and ask for it. A killing blow is refused (History shudders). Break him, or Subdue him, to end it.
Ushimo collapses, sobbing. The boy-Emperor kneels beside him in the snow, puzzled and kind.
My wife. Tsuhime. She's dying. Only the gaijin medicine eases her.
cmdblocks.name: Seppun Ushimo

cmdblocks.text: Her new doctor gave me sake last night. He said I was at the end of my rope.
cmdblocks.name: Seppun Ushimo

cmdblocks.text: I've been at the end of my rope for a year. I never wanted to cut it.
cmdblocks.name: Seppun Ushimo

cmdblocks.text: The guards take him away. He doesn't resist.
Guards come running. The boy-Emperor stands, brushes snow from his sleeves, and studies Kitsuki Gendo with frank fascination.
You fought like a brush, sir. Two brushes. What are those on your face?
cmdblocks.name: Hantei Kusada

cmdblocks.text: ...An affliction, Majesty. Of the eyes.
cmdblocks.name: Kitsuki Gendo

cmdblocks.text: They're glass. How marvellous. What is your name?
cmdblocks.name: Hantei Kusada

cmdblocks.text: ...Gendo, Majesty. Just Gendo.
cmdblocks.name: Kitsuki Gendo

cmdblocks.text: A man with no family! How mysterious.
cmdblocks.name: Hantei Kusada
