cmdblocks.text: CHAPTER 3 - Past Mistakes. (Recommended level 30)
Otosan Uchi, in the year 400. The Forbidden City is younger here, and somehow more dangerous.
The boy-Emperor Hantei Kusada, fourteen, curious, polite, tugs Kitsuki Gendo's sleeve in the garden.
Can you see the future through them? The glass?
cmdblocks.name: Hantei Kusada

cmdblocks.text: Only very small print, Majesty.
cmdblocks.name: Kitsuki Gendo

cmdblocks.text: You're the only person at court who makes jokes to me. Everyone else makes requests.
cmdblocks.name: Hantei Kusada

cmdblocks.text: (He's fourteen, he suspects he's a puppet, and he's right.) Majesty, may I ask a request of my own?
cmdblocks.name: Kitsuki Gendo

cmdblocks.text: Of course!
cmdblocks.name: Hantei Kusada

cmdblocks.text: When people tell you what you want, ask them what they want first.
cmdblocks.name: Kitsuki Gendo

cmdblocks.text: ...That's a very strange request.
cmdblocks.name: Hantei Kusada

cmdblocks.text: It's a very strange court.
cmdblocks.name: Kitsuki Gendo

cmdblocks.text: In the past: don't say Kitsuki, Unicorn, Emerald Magistrate, Kaiu Wall or Asahina. Don't wear spectacles before nobles. Don't draw a katana openly: most samurai here carry straight tachi.
One hour. Three lords. If I go to one, I insult two.
cmdblocks.name: Kitsuki Gendo

cmdblocks.text: Every historian says these three ruled the Empire through a boy.
cmdblocks.name: Kitsuki Gendo

cmdblocks.text: Nobody says what they served at dinner.
cmdblocks.name: Kitsuki Gendo

cmdblocks.text: Objective: one dinner. The three mansions are in the streets, west of the palace. Entering one insults the other two.

cmdblock.text: The palace hall. The war council meets behind these doors, and nobody has called for Gendo-of-no-family.
The door of the palace hall (the war council).

cmdblocks.text: Gendo folds his spectacles away. The room will be a blur of polite shapes.
History -2%.
The World That Should Not Be: a capital with no Kitsuki courts. A Crane-blue eye in a Lion's face. A wall that was never built, and the Shadowlands walking in through the gap.
The ink pulls Gendo back, gasping, to the moment before. (History: 30%.)

cmdblock.text: His Majesty likes you. Be careful with that. The gozoku don't like what he likes.
cmdblock.name: Palace guard

cmdblock.text: Seppun Ushimo? He lives by the south gate with his wife. Small house, shutters closed. She's dying, they say.
cmdblock.name: Palace guard

cmdblock.text: Objective: Ushimo's house, by the south gate.
South gate. The house with the closed shutters.
cmdblock.name: Palace guard

#7#.msg: A court lady never runs. She hurries, beautifully.
#7#.name: *villager-7

cmdblock.text: The palace well. Someone has hidden a purse on the ledge, below the rim.
Got 1500 zeni.
The palace well.
A palace window, lit late.
A boy with ink on his fingers who wonders if cups have souls.
cmdblock.name: Kitsuki Gendo

cmdblock.text: Before he's old, they'll name a whole family after him. I told him to write it down. That's allowed. Probably.
cmdblock.name: Kitsuki Gendo

cmdblock.text: I'm allowed to bless people now. Mostly. Would you like to be blessed? Mostly?
cmdblock.name: Isawa Novice

cmdblocks.text: Your current hireling heads home.
Three blessings. I'll try to aim them.
cmdblocks.name: Isawa Novice

cmdblocks.text: Isawa Novice follows Gendo. (In battle: Support. 3 uses, then home to the palace shrine.)
Coin first, sir.
cmdblocks.name: Isawa Novice

cmdblocks.text: A small house. A woman in a sickbed, thin, grey, breathing badly: Tsuhime. Seppun Ushimo kneels beside her, unarmed.
Her "doctor" gave me the sake. A kind old man. Gaijin medicine for her pain.
cmdblocks.name: Seppun Ushimo

cmdblocks.text: He said one sentence to me as he left. I've heard it ever since.
cmdblocks.name: Seppun Ushimo

cmdblocks.text: ...Real gaijin medicine. Real comfort. Wrapped around one poisoned suggestion.
cmdblocks.name: Kitsuki Gendo

cmdblocks.text: (Akuro. The Chameleon tattoo. He wore a doctor's face.)
cmdblocks.name: Kitsuki Gendo

cmdblocks.text: Gendo turns the medicine jar in his hands, sniffs it, counts the doses. Real gaijin medicine, and nothing else in it. He shows Ushimo how much, and how often, and how to make her sleep.
...She's asleep. She hasn't slept in a month.
cmdblocks.name: Seppun Ushimo

cmdblocks.text: History +10%.
The World That Should Not Be: a capital with no Kitsuki courts. A Crane-blue eye in a Lion's face. A wall that was never built, and the Shadowlands walking in through the gap.
The ink pulls Gendo back, gasping, to the moment before. (History: 30%.)
I was at the end of my rope. You cut a different sentence. Let me carry a sword beside you, Gendo-of-no-family.
cmdblocks.name: Seppun Ushimo

Objective: the duplicate portal painting by the south entrance was painted by someone. There's a painter's studio next door. Then: rumours of a massacre at Shiro Izumida, down the south road (west).

cmdblocks.text: A war council. Bayushi Atsuki and Shiba Katsutoshi argue for closing the gates. Doji Tomeko tries to speak and is drowned out.
We hold the city. Let the gaijin break on the walls.
cmdblocks.name: Shiba Katsutoshi

cmdblocks.text: Where is Seikidera? Has anyone seen my Champion?
cmdblocks.name: Doji Tomeko

cmdblocks.text: Silence. A messenger, breathless.
The Crane Champion rode to the Mantis shipyard at dawn, my lady. Alone. To talk peace - with the gaijin.
cmdblocks.name: Messenger

cmdblocks.text: ...He went to stop it himself.
cmdblocks.name: Doji Tomeko

cmdblocks.text: Then someone has to reach him first.
cmdblocks.name: Kitsuki Gendo

cmdblocks.text: (Rested. HP and MP restored.)
Gendo races to the Mantis shipyard.
Doji Seikidera lies in state. The merchant fleets will follow only the Crane Champion. Doji Tomeko stares at nothing.
They'll follow only him. Only Seikidera.
cmdblocks.name: Doji Tomeko

cmdblocks.text: Kitsuki Gendo stands. Takes off his spectacles. Folds them. Puts them away.
Then they'll follow him, my lady.
cmdblocks.name: Kitsuki Gendo

cmdblocks.text: I've studied every recorded habit of the Crane Champion. I filed them.
cmdblocks.name: Kitsuki Gendo

cmdblocks.text: ...You'd wear his face.
cmdblocks.name: Doji Tomeko

cmdblocks.text: For one battle. Then I'll give it back. History can have it.
cmdblocks.name: Kitsuki Gendo

cmdblocks.text: Got Shukujo (it does not ring for Gendo).
"Past Mistakes" - complete.
Three dinners, a sick woman's sleep, mirrors bought back from a painter, and a map of an invasion burned into a floor. Gendo was one breath too late for the Crane Champion. Now he must become him.

IT WROTE US! IT WROTE US! MAKE IT UN-BE! MAKE IT UN-BE!

cmdblocks.text: A trading ship at anchor. Doji Seikidera on deck with the Mantis trader Gusai Iami and gaijin envoys. A stableboy holds the horses at the rail.
Kitsuki Gendo's boat bumps alongside. He climbs the rail just as the stableboy straightens, raises a gaijin pistol, and shoots Seikidera in the back of the head.
NO-
cmdblocks.name: Kitsuki Gendo

cmdblocks.text: The "stableboy's" face ripples. Togashi Akuro, old and calm and unhurried, lowers the pistol.
Little clerk. You're late. History usually is.
cmdblocks.name: Togashi Akuro

cmdblocks.text: Gaijin and pirates swarm the deck.
Akuro can't be beaten: his tattoos make him untouchable. Fell the vanguard captain to win.
When the smoke clears, Gendo kneels on the wet deck beside the Crane Champion.

cmdblocks.text: CHAPTER 4 - The Battle of the White Stag. (Recommended level 41)
The year 400. A gaijin army marches on the capital. The Crane Champion is dead. And a clerk from 1122 is about to become him.
A tent. Doji Seikidera's armour on a stand. Doji Tomeko holds out the sword Shukujo. It does not ring when Kitsuki Gendo takes it.
It only rings for its true wielder.
cmdblocks.name: Doji Tomeko

cmdblocks.text: Then we'll hope nobody listens closely.
cmdblocks.name: Kitsuki Gendo

cmdblocks.text: A Crane make-up artist, terrified, works by lamplight.
(He tilted his head left when he lied.)
cmdblocks.name: Kitsuki Gendo

cmdblocks.text: (I'll keep mine very straight.)
cmdblocks.name: Kitsuki Gendo

cmdblocks.text: The tent flap bursts open. A shaved head, singed eyebrows, a grin.
Twenty-one!
cmdblocks.name: Togashi Yosai

cmdblocks.text: Yosai!
cmdblocks.name: Kitsuki Gendo

cmdblocks.text: The ink tried to eat me. It didn't like the taste. It spat me out three days ago, in a fish market. I've been looking for you ever since.
cmdblocks.name: Togashi Yosai

cmdblocks.text: ...Gendo. Why are you a dead Crane?
cmdblocks.name: Togashi Yosai

cmdblocks.text: It's a long story.
cmdblocks.name: Kitsuki Gendo

cmdblocks.text: Good. I love long stories. They're the ones you survive.
cmdblocks.name: Togashi Yosai

cmdblocks.text: I was going to save the Empire. Nobody ever asked me to paint anything else.
cmdblocks.name: Kakita Kumpei

cmdblocks.text: Then paint me the year 1122, Kumpei. Exactly as it is.

cmdblocks.text: Nobody else can.
cmdblocks.name: Kitsuki Gendo

cmdblocks.text: The cannons fire on a timer. Break Kumpei before the 8th round, or he hurls the vial overboard.

cmdblocks.text: ...I'll get the light right. I promise. I'll get the light exactly right.
cmdblocks.name: Kakita Kumpei

cmdblocks.name: Hantei Kusada

cmdblocks.text: ...Yes, Majesty.
cmdblocks.name: Kitsuki Gendo

cmdblocks.text: You saved my city wearing a dead man's face. I could give you a clan. Lands. A name in every history.
cmdblocks.name: Hantei Kusada

cmdblocks.text: "Gendo the Saviour." They'd paint your glass eyes on temple walls.
cmdblocks.name: Hantei Kusada

cmdblocks.text: ...I accept, Majesty.
cmdblocks.name: Kitsuki Gendo

cmdblocks.text: The room shimmers. Somewhere in the future, something shifts.
History -50%.
The World That Should Not Be: a capital with no Kitsuki courts. A Crane-blue eye in a Lion's face. A wall that was never built, and the Shadowlands walking in through the gap.
The ink pulls Gendo back, gasping, to the moment before. (History: 30%.)
You'd give up being remembered?
cmdblocks.name: Hantei Kusada

cmdblocks.text: Majesty, I was an archive clerk for nine years.
cmdblocks.name: Kitsuki Gendo

cmdblocks.text: I know exactly how little being remembered is worth. It's the remembering that matters.
cmdblocks.name: Kitsuki Gendo

cmdblocks.text: Let them remember him. Seikidera. He earned it. He rode out alone to stop a war.
cmdblocks.name: Kitsuki Gendo

cmdblocks.text: ...I'll burn the records myself.
cmdblocks.name: Hantei Kusada

cmdblocks.text: But I'll remember. Is that allowed?
cmdblocks.name: Hantei Kusada

cmdblocks.text: That's the only kind that matters, Majesty.
cmdblocks.name: Kitsuki Gendo

cmdblocks.text: (Honor +5, told to no one.)
Kumpei paints the way home: the orchard dissolving into a grey sea-cave, the light exactly right.

cmdblocks.text: CHAPTER 1 - Blood and Iron.
Kyuden Bayushi. Its gardens are beautiful. Its walls hide three times as many passages as rooms.

A memorial for the Imperial Chancellor, Bayushi Kaukatsu. Courtiers in red and black, each wearing a little white for mourning. A lady's maid with downcast eyes carries a tray: Shosuro Mitsue, in her first face.
An older woman in Emerald Magistrate's green passes, murmuring without moving her lips: Shosuro Norie.
Three true rumours before the incense burns down, Mitsue. Begin.
cmdblocks.name: Shosuro Norie

cmdblocks.text: Yes, my lady. More tea?
cmdblocks.name: Shosuro Mitsue

cmdblocks.text: Eavesdrop: Mitsue's path action. Listen in on a private conversation; the chance depends on her Stealth. Each target can be tried once. Failing in town costs Honor: it is a dishonourable act if you're caught.
Objective: three marked conversations. The courtiers by the koi pond, the Mantis envoy at the dinner pavilion, the pale courtier who won't eat.

cmdblock.text: Two Soshi courtiers by the koi pond, fans up, whispering a little too loudly.

cmdblocks.text: Eavesdrop: They want to be overheard: they are practising. "The Crab were scandalous." And, carelessly: "A Miya caravan of relics from the ruins of the old capital stopped here. Two nights. It went south." (Rumour 1)
The talk stops. Eyes turn to the servant who is standing much too close.
...Do you mind? Go and pour tea somewhere else.
cmdblocks.name: Soshi courtier

cmdblocks.text: (Honor -1)

cmdblock.text: She was listening. Good. Now it will travel.
cmdblock.name: Soshi courtier

cmdblock.text: A Mantis envoy at the dinner pavilion, explaining to a Yogo why he missed the caravan.

cmdblocks.text: Eavesdrop: "Bandits on the River of Gold, worse every month. And another band, fighting them. Nobody knows whose." (Rumour 2)
The talk stops. Eyes turn to the servant who is standing much too close.
...Do you mind? Go and pour tea somewhere else.
cmdblocks.name: Mantis envoy

cmdblocks.text: (Honor -1)

cmdblock.text: More tea. And less of the girl who brings it.
cmdblock.name: Mantis envoy

cmdblock.text: A pale Bayushi courtier who hasn't touched her food, talking low to her cousin.

cmdblocks.text: Eavesdrop: "Two nights I dreamed of blood. A heart beating. Both nights the caravan stayed here." Her cousin goes still: "...So did I. The same two nights." (Rumour 3)
The talk stops. Eyes turn to the servant who is standing much too close.
Some of us are in mourning, girl.
cmdblocks.name: Bayushi courtier

cmdblocks.text: (Honor -1)

cmdblock.text: I'm not hungry. I haven't been hungry since the caravan.
cmdblock.name: Bayushi courtier

cmdblock.text: The incense sticks before the Shrine of Fukurokujin, Fortune of Wisdom. Half burned.

#8#.msg: (a Crane, to a Phoenix) I'm certain the Champion dyes his hair.
#8#.name: *villager-8

cmdblocks.text: The incense burns down. Mitsue, now a minor cousin in a different silk, kneels beside Norie.
Three. And you were a maid for two of them. Who were you for the third?
cmdblocks.name: Shosuro Norie

cmdblocks.text: Nobody, sensei. Nobody is very easy to be.
cmdblocks.name: Shosuro Mitsue

cmdblocks.text: Fewer than three. Still: you were a maid, and nobody looked twice.
cmdblocks.name: Shosuro Norie

cmdblocks.text: None. The garden heard you before you heard it. Never mind. Nobody is very easy to be, and you'll learn it.
cmdblocks.name: Shosuro Norie

cmdblocks.text: Nobody is very easy to be, sensei.
cmdblocks.name: Shosuro Mitsue

cmdblocks.text: Be careful. Some of us forget how to stop.
cmdblocks.name: Shosuro Norie

cmdblocks.text: (Rested. HP and MP restored.)

cmdblocks.text: A teahouse among weeping willows, on a peninsula in a still pond. One way in.
Orders. From the Champion. Who does not know your name, which is why you are useful.
cmdblocks.name: Shosuro Norie

cmdblocks.text: Kudo. A farm town on the River of Gold, near the Shinomen. Once Hare land, now no one's.
cmdblocks.name: Shosuro Norie

cmdblocks.text: The Fox and the Sparrow govern it together and hate it together.
cmdblocks.name: Shosuro Norie

cmdblocks.text: Someone wants it to be the seat of a new Minor Clans Court. Someone else wants it to burn.
cmdblocks.name: Shosuro Norie

cmdblocks.text: You'll be a temporary yoriki to the Mantis magistrate there. Find out which someone is winning.
cmdblocks.name: Shosuro Norie

cmdblocks.text: (Papers sealed with a Mantis chop: one month, five miles around Kudo. Enter, question, arrest. No torture. Travelling papers to the border at Shutai.)
And the caravan? The dreams?
cmdblocks.name: Shosuro Mitsue

cmdblocks.text: Find out those too. Quietly. Leave by the servants' gate.
cmdblocks.name: Shosuro Norie

cmdblocks.text: For your trouble.
cmdblocks.name: Shosuro Norie

cmdblocks.text: Got Antidote x2.
Got Smoke Pellet x2.
And this. You'll need a smaller knife than you think.
cmdblocks.name: Shosuro Norie

cmdblocks.text: Got Norie's Kozuka.
Many Faces: Mitsue's School technique. In towns she takes a stranger's appearance to pass where Mitsue can't. In battle: Steal an item, or Copy the last skill an enemy used and turn it back on it.
Mitsue becomes a teahouse servant and walks out past the guards, carrying a tray.
Evening, girl.
cmdblocks.name: Guard

cmdblocks.text: Evening, sir. Mind the step.
cmdblocks.name: Shosuro Mitsue

cmdblocks.text: She is gone.
Objective: south to Kudo, by Traitor's Grove and the border town of Shutai. The castle town has an outfitter, an apothecary and an inn.

cmdblocks.text: The road south. Blighted rice in thin paddies. And a grove where the Scorpion leave their traitors for the crows.
Old posts among the trees. Rusting chains. Helmets and masks hang on strings, turning in air that doesn't move. Shosuro Mitsue walks through without slowing, eyes ahead.
Eyes ahead. Never count the posts.
cmdblocks.name: Shosuro Mitsue

cmdblocks.text: ...Nineteen.
cmdblocks.name: Shosuro Mitsue

cmdblocks.text: Bandits block the road at the edge of the grove.
Hand over the purse, pretty!
cmdblocks.name: Bandit

cmdblocks.text: Many Faces: Steal. In battle, School > Many Faces: Steal takes what an enemy carries. These bandits are weak to the tanto and the bow.
This one?
cmdblocks.name: Shosuro Mitsue

cmdblocks.text: Objective: Shutai, the border town, south down the road.

cmdblock.text: A chained traitor's purse, still on his belt. Still full.

cmdblocks.text: 80 zeni. A hiss from the nearest tree. And now that she looks: every mask and helmet in the grove has turned to face south.
Mitsue leaves it. The grove keeps what it keeps.

cmdblock.text: The empty chain. Every mask faces south.

cmdblock.text: Two murders this month. Both travellers from Kudo.
cmdblock.name: Innkeeper

cmdblocks.text: Eavesdrop: Later, to his wife, low: "Both of them bloodless. Not a drop left in them. Like the woman at Megu's."
The talk stops. Eyes turn to the stranger who is standing much too close.
...Do you mind? This is a private conversation.
cmdblocks.name: Innkeeper

cmdblocks.text: (Honor -1)

cmdblock.text: Bloodless. I said nothing. Rooms are thirty.
cmdblock.name: Innkeeper

cmdblock.text: A nondescript man in grey has been three steps behind her since the gate. She steps into a doorway; he walks straight into her.
...Ah. A Shosuro. Of course you're a Shosuro. Shosuro Noburo. I watch the interesting newcomers.
cmdblock.name: Shosuro Noburo

cmdblock.text: Fourteen days ago: ghastly murders at Megu's sake house. The same days the Miya caravan came through. A man cut a woman's throat, drew in her blood, and died beside it without a mark.
cmdblock.name: Shosuro Noburo

cmdblock.text: And the magistrates?
cmdblock.name: Shosuro Mitsue

cmdblock.text: Called it a bad night in Shutai. It's a town of bad nights. Megu will show you the room for two bu.
cmdblock.name: Shosuro Noburo

cmdblock.text: I'm not here. You never saw me. Neither did anyone else, which is the job.
cmdblock.name: Shosuro Noburo

cmdblock.text: A room is two bu, with or without a geisha. Talking is five.
cmdblock.name: Megu

cmdblocks.text: A dingy room upstairs. Cleaned, after a fashion. Old blood in a spatter, and more of it gathered on one patch of floor, in a pattern.
Lines. Circles. A summoning. Half-finished. Somebody tried to call something through this floor, and paid with two lives, and failed.
cmdblocks.name: Shosuro Mitsue

cmdblocks.text: ...So it tried again further south.
cmdblocks.name: Shosuro Mitsue

cmdblocks.text: No coin, no room. No room, no ghosts.
cmdblocks.name: Megu

cmdblock.text: You didn't see anything up there. Nobody does. It's a very clean room.
cmdblock.name: Megu

cmdblock.text: The river's gone a strange colour upstream. Toward Kudo. Brown, then red at dusk.
cmdblock.name: Priest

#9#.msg: Kudo pays well for swords. Too well. That's how you know.

cmdblock.text: The docks, and the dark far bank. No reason to cross. Yet.

cmdblocks.text: Kudo. Sparrow ribbons on plain, swept streets by the river; Fox lanterns among the trees to the east; and a little bridge between them that nobody likes to cross.
A Suzume samurai is sweeping his own courtyard. A Kitsune child throws a stone into it, and runs.
Objective: the Mantis magistrate's guest house (the yellow quarantine banner hangs on the magistrate's own house beside it).
Night. Rui's runner finds Mitsue at a run.
The Mantis guest house, a council of war. The sick are gone: the magistrate, his seniors, the quarantined river-men. Beds empty, still warm.
A drunk dock-worker broke quarantine to collect a debt. He says something flew over him, west, and blotted out the moon. I'd arrest the moon if I could.
cmdblocks.name: Yoritomo Rui

cmdblocks.text: Running feet. Kitsune Hana, robes torn, no shoes.
The governor - he's gone! He walked into the river! He didn't sink!
cmdblocks.name: Kitsune Hana

cmdblocks.text: Which way?
cmdblocks.name: Shosuro Mitsue

cmdblocks.text: West! Into the woods - the woods are changing!
cmdblocks.name: Kitsune Hana

cmdblocks.text: I'm coming. The Mantis are coming. That's me. I'm the Mantis.
cmdblocks.name: Yoritomo Rui

cmdblocks.text: Then the Mantis can hold a lantern.
cmdblocks.name: Shosuro Mitsue

#10#.msg: Quarantine. Imperial decree. A Champion couldn't get in. The guest house is next door; the acting magistrate is there.
#10#.name: *villager-10

cmdblock.text: Lord Soseki barely survived the assassin. The Kitsune have hired professionals.
cmdblock.name: Suzume Rika

cmdblocks.text: Eavesdrop: Later, to a retainer at the Suzume hall gate: "There was no man. A cloud. A yellow-green cloud, and fear like drowning. He woke screaming for a day. We say 'assassin' because who would believe a cloud?"
The talk stops. Eyes turn to the stranger who is standing much too close.
...Do you mind? This is a private conversation.
cmdblocks.name: Suzume Rika

cmdblocks.text: (Honor -1)

cmdblock.text: Lord Soseki is resting. Lord Soseki will see you never.
cmdblock.name: Suzume Rika

cmdblock.text: Just trading. Rice. Ordinary rice.
cmdblock.name: Kasuga Yodo

cmdblocks.text: Eavesdrop: To his boatman: "Smuggle the rice, yes, that's nothing. But Hyobe! A week ago he wanted a Minor Clans Court here. Now he wants a war. Men don't turn like that."
The talk stops. Eyes turn to the stranger who is standing much too close.
...Do you mind? This is a private conversation.
cmdblocks.name: Kasuga Yodo

cmdblocks.text: (Honor -1)

cmdblock.text: I go between. Lately there's nothing between to go.
cmdblock.name: Kasuga Yodo

cmdblock.text: The caravan was robbed right here! Everything got dumped in the reeds next morning. A Crane banner, a broken sword, two little stone Fortunes.
cmdblock.name: Dock-hand

cmdblock.text: Everything except a little iron box. Nobody found that.
cmdblock.name: Dock-hand

cmdblock.text: The reeds on the far bank are full of the Miya's rubbish. Nobody goes over there now.
cmdblock.name: Dock-hand

cmdblock.text: The kami of the river are sick. Something old and spoiled is pulling at them. Steel won't touch a thing like that.
cmdblock.name: Inari priestess

cmdblock.text: Crystal will. Magic will. Clean water from this spring will, a little. Take some. Pay what you can.
cmdblock.name: Inari priestess

#17#.msg: My neighbours left in the night. All of them. Their rice is still in the pot.
#17#.name: *villager-17

#18#.msg: Fox street or Sparrow street. Pick one. Everybody else has.
#18#.name: *villager-18

cmdblock.text: Six young Suzume, drunk, beating a Kitsune man in the street while a crowd watches.

cmdblocks.text: "Mantis yoriki!" It's mostly the papers; a little of it is the way Mitsue holds the knife. They scatter.
(Honor +1)
Mitsue walks past. A yoriki who walks past is no yoriki.
(Honor -1)

cmdblock.text0: Step in, with the yoriki papers held high.
cmdblock.text1: Walk past. Not your face today.

cmdblock.text: The cobbles where it happened, swept already. Suzume sweep everything.
Yoriki! That Fox woman spilled her slops on my step. Forty years she's been spilling slops on my step!
cmdblock.name: Suzume grandmother

cmdblock.text: Forty years she's been putting her step under my slops!
cmdblock.name: Kitsune grandmother

cmdblock.text: The Mantis will consider the matter of the step.
cmdblock.name: Shosuro Mitsue

cmdblock.text: They both look deeply satisfied, and go back to shouting.
The Mantis are considering it. Ha!
cmdblock.name: Suzume grandmother

cmdblock.text: An arrow whips past Mitsue's ear from the bushes. A boy, not yet gempukku, with a bow too big for him.
Go away! My father's in the militia! We'll fight all of you!
cmdblock.name: Kitsune boy

cmdblock.text: That was a good shot. You missed on purpose. Go home, and tell your father the Mantis are here.
cmdblock.name: Shosuro Mitsue

cmdblock.text: ...Are they really? The Mantis?
cmdblock.name: Kitsune boy

cmdblock.text: We Suzume sweep our own courtyards. Noble poverty. I'll sweep a road for you, for a little less poverty.
cmdblock.name: Suzume Sweeper

cmdblocks.text: Your current hireling heads home.
Three good sweeps. I keep the rake.
cmdblocks.name: Suzume Sweeper

cmdblocks.text: Suzume Sweeper follows Mitsue. (In battle: Support. 3 uses, then home to Sparrow street.)
Coin first, Shosuro-sama.
cmdblocks.name: Suzume Sweeper

cmdblock.text: Fox herbs for fox troubles. These are fox troubles, aren't they? Everyone's frightened.
cmdblock.name: Kitsune Herb-woman

cmdblocks.text: Your current hireling heads home.
Three pots of herbs. Drink them before they go cold.
cmdblocks.name: Kitsune Herb-woman

cmdblocks.text: Kitsune Herb-woman follows Mitsue. (In battle: Support. 3 uses, then home to Fox street.)
Coin first, Shosuro-sama.

cmdblock.text: Yoriki! Sake? Good Kudo sake. Kudo is calm. Kudo is very calm. The Suzume will be compensated when they leave, very fairly.
cmdblock.name: Kitsune Hyobe

cmdblocks.text: Eavesdrop: After dark, from the shadow of a column: he eats raw river fish alone, and whispers to it. "Soon. The box is near. The blood is near."
The talk stops. Eyes turn to the stranger who is standing much too close.
Who's there? A servant. Out.
cmdblocks.name: Kitsune Hyobe

cmdblocks.text: (Honor -1)

cmdblock.text: Kudo is very calm.
cmdblock.name: Kitsune Hyobe

cmdblock.text: A Fox lady in dark green with gold leaves: Kitsune Hana. She bows, and makes to leave, the way she leaves every room the governor is in.
The governor hasn't been himself since spring.
cmdblock.name: Kitsune Hana

cmdblock.text: ...Forgive me. I have business. On his behalf.
cmdblock.name: Kitsune Hana

cmdblock.text: He laughed differently, before. Please don't tell him I said so.
cmdblock.name: Kitsune Hana

cmdblock.text: A Fox servant with a covered plate, being shouted at by the cook.

cmdblocks.text: A Fox household servant is scolded at the kitchen door and sent up with a covered plate. Halfway up the stair, she is Mitsue in her third face.
The governor's rooms. Kitsune Hyobe eats alone, hood up, his back to the door.
Your fish, my lord.
cmdblocks.name: Shosuro Mitsue

cmdblocks.text: ...Leave it.
cmdblocks.name: "Governor"

cmdblocks.text: My lord, it's raw-
cmdblocks.name: Shosuro Mitsue

cmdblocks.text: Leave the plate. Leave.
cmdblocks.name: "Governor"

cmdblocks.text: He turns. For one moment, too many teeth. Under the hood, on the back of his head, another face is looking at the wall.
Of course, my lord.
cmdblocks.name: Shosuro Mitsue

cmdblocks.text: The corridor. Her hands shake once, then stop.
...That isn't a governor. That isn't a person.
cmdblocks.name: Shosuro Mitsue

cmdblocks.text: (Rested. HP and MP restored.)

cmdblock.text: Who took the governor's fish up? Nobody did. Then who brought the plate back?

cmdblocks.text: A small house set up like a war room. Scrolls on every table. A map of Kudo on the wall, stuck with little paper flags.
Whoever you are, we're closed! Quarantine! Pneumonia! Come back next season!
cmdblocks.name: Yoritomo Rui

cmdblocks.text: Mitsue holds out her yoriki papers. The young Mantis reads the chop, and all at once looks very tired and very young.
Okame's yoriki. Then you outrank me, and I'm still in charge. Yoritomo Rui. Junior yoriki to the town magistrate, who is sick. So is everyone above me. So I'm the magistracy.
cmdblocks.name: Yoritomo Rui

cmdblocks.text: Eleven days ago: the magistrate and three seniors, and the river-men at the port. Ten days ago: the Miya caravan robbed in the middle of town. A Crane banner, a broken sword, two stone Fortunes, an iron box. All of it back on the riverbank next morning. All but the box.
cmdblocks.name: Yoritomo Rui

cmdblocks.text: The Kitsune governor changed a week ago. And the Suzume 'assassin'... nobody in Kudo's underworld heard a whisper of him. Nobody.
cmdblocks.name: Yoritomo Rui

cmdblocks.text: A boy, barely past gempukku, whispers to her and pins another flag. Its first word is "murder".
Look at the map if you like. I have to go and be the magistracy.
cmdblocks.name: Yoritomo Rui

cmdblocks.text: Objective: learn what the suspects hide (Eavesdrop; the docks; the Kitsune Hall), and find out what the governor is.

cmdblock.text: The map of Kudo. Two dozen flags. And now that Mitsue looks: nearly everyone who 'fled' lived in the Suzume district by the river. Nobody at the Mantis had noticed.
If you're going to ask me something, ask it fast. I'm the magistracy.
cmdblock.name: Yoritomo Rui

cmdblocks.text: Dawn at the Dreaming Carp. The box sits on the table. Iron. Plain. A finger long. It hums, very faintly, like a heartbeat heard through a wall.
Thank you. I don't know your name.
cmdblocks.name: Kitsune Hana

cmdblocks.text: Neither does anyone. It's restful.
cmdblocks.name: Shosuro Mitsue

cmdblocks.text: I'll write the report. Meiji-sama. The governor. Twenty-six others. I'll write it all.
cmdblocks.name: Yoritomo Rui

cmdblocks.text: That night Mitsue dreams of a heart beating inside iron. She wakes. The lid is open on her pillow. She closes it.
A letter from Norie arrives at dawn.
That box once held the heart of Iuchiban. No tool we own can break it.
cmdblocks.name: Shosuro Norie (letter)

cmdblocks.text: Keep it. Tell no one. Do not open it again.
cmdblocks.name: Shosuro Norie (letter)

cmdblocks.text: ...Again?
cmdblocks.name: Shosuro Mitsue

cmdblocks.text: Got The Iron Box.
(The Iron Box is cursed: while Mitsue carries it she starts every battle with no Void.)
Got Scorpion "Favor".
The Fox will remember you. Even if you're nobody.
cmdblocks.name: Kitsune Hana

cmdblocks.text: ...Especially if I'm nobody.
cmdblocks.name: Shosuro Mitsue

cmdblocks.text: Yoritomo Rui stays in Kudo. She is the magistracy.
"Blood and Iron" - complete.
Three rumours, three faces, and a town ruled by something wearing a dead governor. Mitsue saved a frightened Fox, and now carries an iron box that once held a sorcerer's heart.
Next: City of Masks. The north road leaves the Kyuden Bayushi castle town by the west gate. (Recommended level 20)

Something is calling. I can hear it. It's calling me.
cmdblocks.name: Kitsune Hana

cmdblocks.text: A drifting barge, tangled in the reeds. Gulls and ravens on it together, the way they only share after a battle.
Under a cloth: the Mantis magistrate, Yoritomo Meiji, and his seniors. And the real Kitsune governor, dead for weeks. All of them bloodless.
Meiji-sama. You were sick. You were only sick.
cmdblocks.name: Yoritomo Rui

cmdblocks.text: ...My lord. It was never you. All spring, it was never you.
cmdblocks.name: Kitsune Hana

cmdblocks.text: Then he didn't fail you. Something wore him.
cmdblocks.name: Shosuro Mitsue

cmdblocks.text: Rui strikes a light. The barge burns on the water, slowly, with every honour the marsh allows.
(Honor +1)
They leave it in the reeds. The ravens come back before they've gone ten steps.

cmdblocks.text0: Burn the barge. The dead shouldn't drift.
cmdblocks.text1: Leave it for the eta. There's no time.

cmdblocks.text: A clearing that rises and falls like breathing. A pit of blood in the centre, slopping in time with a beat that shakes the air. Kitsune Hana walks to its edge as if in a dream, and lifts a small iron box out of the mud.
A yellow-green cloud pours into her.
Take it... take it away from me... Give it to ME.
cmdblocks.name: Kansen-Hana

cmdblocks.text: Hana. Look at me. Not at the box.
cmdblocks.name: Shosuro Mitsue

cmdblocks.text: The Oracle comes. The blood rises. Iuchiban's heart will beat again.
cmdblocks.name: Kansen-Hana

cmdblocks.text: The ritual counter rises every round. At 10 the Oracle of Blood rises. Break her (Suki) and she drops the Iron Box: the counter stops. Then Steal it. Steel only annoys a Kansen: crystal, Water, Air and magic hurt it.
The cloud tears out of Hana and dissolves in the air. She collapses, alive.
Mine.
cmdblocks.name: Shosuro Mitsue

cmdblocks.text: CHAPTER 2 - City of Masks.
The plains north of Shiro no Soshi. A day's ride from Seikitsu Pass. Last week, there was nothing here.
Now there is a city on the horizon that no map shows, with the Scorpion mon on its walls. The Lion and the Unicorn both call it a Scorpion plot, and both are moving soldiers.
A letter from Norie in Mitsue's sleeve: "Find out what it is. Nobody is to know we don't know."
Objective: east along the plains road. Hisatu Kensu, the hot-spring village, is the last stop before the city.

cmdblock.text: A track up into the Spine: the Ojatara Valleys. Nothing up there for Mitsue yet.
The valley road into the Spine: the Ojatara Valleys, where Norie's tribunal sits.

cmdblock.text: What city? Have another bath, lady!
cmdblock.name: Innkeeper

cmdblocks.text: A soft bed, a hot bath, an extravagant supper. Mitsue sleeps.
Fog. A faceless monk sits before a wall of masks, every one of them looking at her.
Heat. A smith at an anvil hammers something out of hot metal, quenches it, and holds it up in his tongs: her face.
A puppet show. The puppets wear her face, and sand blows across them until the faces are smooth.
...Still mine.
cmdblocks.name: Shosuro Mitsue

cmdblocks.text: Probably.
cmdblocks.name: Shosuro Mitsue

cmdblocks.text: Morning. The innkeeper is horrified that she slept badly, and brings three breakfasts.
(Rested. HP and MP restored.)
Objective: the last leg to the city, east across the plain.

cmdblock.text: Another bath? Another breakfast? Don't go east, lady. Have another bath.
cmdblock.name: Innkeeper

cmdblock.text: Hot water, clean towels. Don't ask about the city. Nobody asks.
cmdblock.name: Bath attendant

cmdblocks.text: Eavesdrop: Later, to the laundry girl: "My cousin went to sell eels there. She came back wearing a mask. She won't take it off. She doesn't eat. At night I hear the masks talking."
The talk stops. Eyes turn to the stranger who is standing much too close.
...Do you mind? This is a private conversation.
cmdblocks.name: Bath attendant

cmdblocks.text: (Honor -1)

cmdblock.text: More towels? Please take more towels.
cmdblock.name: Bath attendant

cmdblock.name: Ide Xue

cmdblock.text: The city to the east, Ide-sama?
cmdblock.name: Shosuro Mitsue

cmdblock.text: East? Oh, the baths are lovely in the east wing. Have you tried the east wing?
cmdblock.name: Ide Xue

cmdblock.text: She smiles and nods at everything. Her two Shinjo yoriki, behind her, do not smile at all.
Everything is very calm in Hisatu Kensu!

cmdblock.text: A spring shrine. The water is warm even here.

cmdblocks.text: The offering water clouds over, then clears. The Taint is gone.
The water stays clear. There is nothing in you for it to take.

cmdblocks.name: Togashi Yosai

cmdblocks.text: You've already got company. I'll keep the bench warm. Benches love me.
cmdblocks.name: Togashi Yosai

cmdblock.text: The city is right there. Mitsue doesn't hurry.

cmdblocks.text: Mid-morning, on the last leg. A Lion scout staggers out of the grass into the road, his armour battered, a deep cut down his face. Ikoma Yoshi.
Scorpion... I must reach the Scorpion, to deliver-
cmdblocks.name: Ikoma Yoshi

cmdblocks.text: He coughs blood. Then he looks at Mitsue, and grips her wrist with surprising strength.
You. You. I saw you in my dream. It's meant for you.
cmdblocks.name: Ikoma Yoshi

cmdblocks.text: He shakes a red-and-black mask out of a cloth bag and presses it into her hands, with folded papers under the chop of a lord three hundred years dead.
It said - give it to the woman with many faces.
cmdblocks.name: Ikoma Yoshi

cmdblocks.text: Who said?
cmdblocks.name: Shosuro Mitsue

cmdblocks.text: ...He did.
cmdblocks.name: Ikoma Yoshi

cmdblocks.text: He dies. The mask is warm in her hands, like skin.
...Thank you for coming. I've waited a long time.
cmdblocks.name: Soshi Giseiki (the mask)

cmdblocks.text: Masks don't usually say thank you.
cmdblocks.name: Shosuro Mitsue

cmdblocks.text: Masks don't usually have anyone inside.
cmdblocks.name: Soshi Giseiki (the mask)

cmdblocks.text: Got Giseiki's Mask.
Got Antique Travel Papers.
Mitsue lays Ikoma Yoshi's swords across his chest. She will tell the Lion where he lies.
Objective: the city.
Dawn. The city is a mist, then a field, then nothing. Motes of light rise from where the walls stood, one for every mask.
Thank you, many-faced girl. I'd almost forgotten mine.
cmdblocks.name: Shosuro Osuko

cmdblocks.text: The city folds back into fog, a dream with the lid on. Somewhere inside it, Osuko keeps hunting.
Thirty years they laughed.
cmdblocks.name: Miya Hatomu

cmdblocks.text: I'll never prove it now. I don't care. I saw it.
cmdblocks.name: Miya Hatomu

cmdblocks.text: Mitsue takes off her last mask and checks her reflection in a puddle.
...Still mine.
cmdblocks.name: Shosuro Mitsue

cmdblocks.text: Her reflection, for one moment, is someone older. Then it's her again.
The red-and-black mask in her sleeve is only lacquer now. Giseiki left when he said he would.
I'll write to the Emerald Champion's office. Somebody should know what happened to my team, even if nobody believes it.
cmdblocks.name: Isawa Kasiko

cmdblocks.text: Isawa Kasiko takes the road west, toward the capital.
"City of Masks" - complete.

A city that wasn't on any map, people who wouldn't speak to the faceless, and masks that ate souls. Mitsue wore other faces to save the souls inside them, and checked afterwards that hers was still there.
Next: Fortunes Lost, the Ojatara tribunal. (Recommended level 30)

cmdblocks.text: A city that isn't on any map. Its gates are open. Its people wear masks, and clothes three hundred years out of date.
Masked citizens in antique silk. A sake-seller pours cups that no one drinks.
Good morning.
cmdblocks.name: Shosuro Mitsue

cmdblocks.text: I have nothing to say to the faceless.
cmdblocks.name: Masked sake-seller

cmdblocks.text: The city's people ignore the unmasked. Masks: the Merchant District, north. Worn in the city, a mask drinks a little of you (MP) each time you enter a district. A district shrine takes it off.

Each mask has a material, and the citizens care: wood fears metal, metal fears fire, fire fears water, water fears earth, earth fears wood, stone fears silk. They welcome the mask they fear, and scorn the one they overcome.
A shout behind her: a Crane woman with a drawn sword, limping, two monks at her back. An Emerald Magistrate's badge hangs from her obi.
You've seen too much of the market, Scorpion. Give us your face.
cmdblocks.name: Doji Siko

cmdblocks.text: She is no longer a magistrate of the Empire. Don't hesitate. She won't.
cmdblocks.name: Soshi Giseiki (the mask)

cmdblocks.text: Doji Siko throws herself onto Mitsue's blade rather than be taken. The monks' masks are already gone.
Black-clad figures on the roof. One drops to the street: a woman in black, masked in cloth.
You fight well, and now you've seen what we're against. The Sweet Cup. The back room. Osuko-sama is waiting.
cmdblocks.name: Shadow hunter

cmdblocks.text: The back room of the Sweet Cup. Black-clad figures, very still. A woman in a white porcelain mask pours tea she doesn't drink: Shosuro Osuko, owner of the Sweet Cup, governor of a city that doesn't exist.
You're a Shosuro. No. You're several. Good.
cmdblocks.name: Shosuro Osuko

cmdblocks.text: Three hundred years ago the masks began to eat us. Not a curse: a hunger, a living thing in the lacquer. Soshi Giseiki bound every soul in the city into a mask so the masks would have nowhere to spread, and hid the whole city in the Realm of Dreams.
cmdblocks.name: Shosuro Osuko

cmdblocks.text: Then the dreams broke, and here we are, on the plain, with the Lion counting our walls.
cmdblocks.name: Shosuro Osuko

cmdblocks.text: The monks of the Silent Self pray to the hunger, under the Temple District. Their abbot, Munashii, wants it out in the Empire. We've hunted his monks for three hundred years of dream-time.
cmdblocks.name: Shosuro Osuko

cmdblocks.text: A small Phoenix woman in torn Emerald Magistrate's green rises from the corner: Isawa Kasiko.
My team came to find out why the city was here. Siko killed the others. I was at the Miya archives, or I'd be dead too. The hunters hid me.
cmdblocks.name: Isawa Kasiko

cmdblocks.text: Giseiki can end it. The counter-ritual. But he needs a body to work through.
cmdblocks.name: Shosuro Osuko

cmdblocks.text: And take some of these. Crystal is the only thing the abbot fears. We'll sell you what we have.
cmdblocks.name: Shosuro Osuko

cmdblocks.text: Hers, or yours, Osuko. I'm not choosy. I'm only a mask.
cmdblocks.name: Soshi Giseiki (the mask)

cmdblocks.text: Brave and sensible. A rare Shosuro.
cmdblocks.name: Shosuro Osuko

cmdblocks.text: ...Oh. He's very polite in here.
cmdblocks.name: Shosuro Mitsue

cmdblocks.text: Forgive the intrusion. I'll be brief.
cmdblocks.name: Soshi Giseiki (through Mitsue)

cmdblocks.text: (Giseiki rides with Mitsue: a stronger ritual, and he will speak in the fight. Until the chapter ends her Void is 1 less.)
I'm coming. I'm the last of my team, and I'd like to arrest somebody before I die.
cmdblocks.name: Isawa Kasiko

M363.name: Kamen no Toshi - the Sweet Cup's back room

cmdblocks.text: In the market a masked citizen stops mid-step and collapses. The crowd steps around him without looking down.
Mitsue kneels, and lifts his mask a little.
...There's no one behind it. Just a body, breathing.
cmdblocks.name: Shosuro Mitsue

cmdblocks.text: She sets the mask back. He gets up, brushes his sleeves, and walks on, a little more slowly.
The masks are hungry, Shosuro. Some of them are fuller than others.
cmdblocks.name: Soshi Giseiki (the mask)

cmdblock.text: The forge. A hulking Crab in a scorched steel mask sets down a blade and lets it cool.
I forged the first masks. I'd rather not forge more.
cmdblock.name: Kaiu Naname

cmdblock.text: He puts a sheet of iron in the fire anyway, without asking.
Here. Please don't keep it on long.
cmdblock.name: Kaiu Naname

cmdblock.text: Got Iron Mask.

cmdblocks.text: Mitsue puts on the iron mask. Her own face goes away.

cmdblock.code: W = ::Rokugan.wearsMask( "P105", null);

cmdblocks.text: Giseiki and I made the first ones together. He'd want you to know that the masks were never meant to be kept.
cmdblocks.name: Kaiu Naname

cmdblocks.text: Put it back on, or take it off for good. Halfway is worst.
cmdblocks.name: Kaiu Naname

cmdblock.text: The Badger carver, Ichiro Itami, a stone mask worn smooth. He pulls a box of carved masks from under the table and refuses money with one raised hand.

cmdblocks.text: You surround yourself with questionable company, sama. You are welcome to my wares. Please don't trouble me again.
cmdblocks.name: Ichiro Itami

cmdblocks.text: Wood is light in the heat. Take it.
cmdblocks.name: Ichiro Itami

cmdblock.text: Got Cedar Mask.

cmdblocks.text: Mitsue puts on the cedar mask. Her own face goes away.

cmdblock.text: I know nothing, sama.
cmdblock.name: Ichiro Itami

cmdblock.text: A Dragon monk with no mask: his face is a tattoo of a stone wall. Jars of ink all round him.
You seek Master Giseiki?
cmdblock.name: Togashi Sumi

cmdblock.text: ...I'm not wearing him.
cmdblock.name: Shosuro Mitsue

cmdblock.text: He's on the face of the one who wears him. Yet.
cmdblock.name: Togashi Sumi

cmdblock.text: A mask that washes off. Mostly. Sit still.
cmdblock.name: Togashi Sumi

cmdblock.text: Got Ink Mask.

cmdblocks.text: Mitsue puts on the ink mask. Her own face goes away.

cmdblock.text: Ink is water. Water is patient. Be patient, Shosuro.
cmdblock.name: Togashi Sumi

cmdblock.text: Silks, dyes, perfumes. And faces, for those who've mislaid theirs.
cmdblock.name: Bayushi Shiruko

cmdblock.text: A Crane magistrate bought a kimono from me three days ago. Alone. It brought out her eyes.
cmdblock.name: Bayushi Shiruko

cmdblock.text: Silk. Soft. Fears nothing but stone, and stone fears it.
cmdblock.name: Bayushi Shiruko

cmdblock.text: Got Silk Mask.

cmdblocks.text: Mitsue puts on the silk mask. Her own face goes away.

cmdblock.text: The temple gatekeeper is stone. He'll bow to silk. They always do.
cmdblock.name: Bayushi Shiruko

cmdblock.text: Jade! Genuine jade! Except mine. Mine's real. That's why I still remember my name.
cmdblock.name: Yasuki Kasamashi

cmdblocks.text: You'll forget your name, then.
cmdblocks.name: Yasuki Kasamashi

cmdblocks.text: I have several.
cmdblocks.name: Shosuro Mitsue

cmdblocks.text: Scorpion!
cmdblocks.name: Yasuki Kasamashi

cmdblocks.text: Got Jade Mask.
Real jade costs real money, sama.
cmdblocks.name: Yasuki Kasamashi

cmdblock.text0: Buy his real jade mask. (2500 zeni)

cmdblock.text: Glass! Genuine glass! ...What? It's honest glass.
cmdblock.name: Yasuki Kasamashi

#8#.msg: Fine art by the finest Crane artisans. Not trinkets, like that Yasuki fishmonger over there.
#8#.name: *villager-8

cmdblock.code: W = ::Rokugan.wearsMask( "P105", null);

cmdblocks.text: (looking straight through her)
I have nothing to say to the faceless.
cmdblocks.name: Kakita Yuko

cmdblocks.text: Ink! Ink puts fires out. I'm a fire, so I have to be nice to you.
cmdblocks.name: Kakita Yuko

cmdblocks.text: I made these before you came. The masks told me what you'd look like.
cmdblocks.name: Kakita Yuko

cmdblocks.text: Her puppets: a woman with a red half-mask, and other faces Mitsue doesn't know yet.
The abbot's frightened of crystal. And of choosing. He's frightened of choosing most of all.
cmdblocks.name: Kakita Yuko

cmdblocks.text: Iron melts. You'll melt. Go away!
cmdblocks.name: Kakita Yuko

cmdblocks.text: My puppets are busy. Come back as something else.
cmdblocks.name: Kakita Yuko

cmdblock.text: The puppets miss you. They don't have faces anymore. The sand took them.
cmdblock.name: Kakita Yuko

cmdblock.code: W = ::Rokugan.wearsMask( "P105", null);

cmdblocks.text: (looking straight through her)
I have nothing to say to the faceless.
cmdblocks.name: Miya Hatomu

cmdblocks.text: Thirty years they called me mad. I mapped this city from a dream, and when the Miya surveyors came there was only a field.
cmdblocks.name: Miya Hatomu

cmdblocks.text: Look. Every street. Every one. Take a copy. Somebody should have one who believes it.
cmdblocks.name: Miya Hatomu

cmdblocks.text: Got Hatomu's Map.
Water. Water washes maps away. Please.
cmdblocks.name: Miya Hatomu

cmdblocks.text: Wood roots in clay. Clay keeps maps. Come back with roots.
cmdblocks.name: Miya Hatomu

cmdblock.text: Every street. Every one.
cmdblock.name: Miya Hatomu

cmdblock.code: W = ::Rokugan.wearsMask( "P105", null);

cmdblocks.text: Remedies! Spices! I made a poultice for an Emerald Magistrate two days ago. My friend Kusuri helped. She has a lighter hand.
cmdblocks.name: Soshi Onaka

cmdblocks.text: (looking straight through her)
I have nothing to say to the faceless.
cmdblocks.name: Soshi Onaka

cmdblock.code: W = ::Rokugan.wearsMask( "P105", null);

cmdblocks.text: I have nothing to say to the faceless.
cmdblocks.name: Agasha Kusuri

cmdblocks.text: I help Onaka with his herbs. Only herbs.
cmdblocks.name: Agasha Kusuri

cmdblocks.text: Eavesdrop: Later, to a monk at the brewery door: "She slept like the dead. The abbot has her now."
The talk stops. Eyes turn to the stranger who is standing much too close.
...Do you mind? This is a private conversation.
cmdblocks.name: Agasha Kusuri

cmdblocks.text: (Honor -1)

cmdblock.text: Only herbs.
cmdblock.name: Agasha Kusuri

#13#.msg: (a barrel of a mask) A drink and a punch! A drink and a punch! The Crab magistrate lasted nine rounds.
#13#.name: *villager-13

cmdblock.text: Masked courtiers, gossiping in voices from three hundred years ago.

cmdblocks.text: Eavesdrop: "The masks began to eat us. Old Soshi Giseiki found out first."
The talk stops. Eyes turn to the stranger who is standing much too close.
...Do you mind? This is a private conversation.
cmdblocks.name: Masked citizen

cmdblock.text: ...Three hundred years. At least.
cmdblock.name: Masked citizen

cmdblock.text: Two masked merchants over a ledger nobody has opened in centuries.

cmdblocks.text: Eavesdrop: "He bound every soul into a mask, so the masks couldn't spread beyond our walls."
The talk stops. Eyes turn to the stranger who is standing much too close.
...Do you mind? This is a private conversation.
cmdblocks.name: Masked citizen

cmdblock.text: ...Three hundred years. At least.
cmdblock.name: Masked citizen

cmdblock.text: A masked couple on a bench, holding hands they can't feel.

cmdblocks.text: Eavesdrop: "And then he hid the whole city in the Realm of Dreams. Until the dreams broke."
The talk stops. Eyes turn to the stranger who is standing much too close.
...Do you mind? This is a private conversation.
cmdblocks.name: Masked citizen

cmdblock.text: ...Three hundred years. At least.
cmdblock.name: Masked citizen

cmdblocks.text: ...I did. And I'd do it again. The masks are hungry, Shosuro. They want the Empire.
cmdblocks.name: Soshi Giseiki (the mask)

cmdblock.text: A district shrine. Masked citizens bow to it on the way past, and never stop.

cmdblocks.text: (Masks off. Mitsue's own face, cold in the air. HP and MP restored.)
(Rested.)

cmdblocks.text: Monks with cloth faces sewn over their own guard the temple path. They reach for the masks.
Give us your face. Give us your face. Give us your face.
cmdblocks.name: Stitched-face monk

cmdblocks.text: Break a stitched-face monk and its sewn face tears free: the soul inside escapes, and it falls, at peace.
A monk falls. For a second, under the cloth, a young man's face, relieved.
...thank you...
cmdblocks.name: Stitched-face monk (freed)

cmdblock.text: A cracked wall behind the temple of the sun: Lady Sun's statue split down the middle, and behind the crack, a hidden reliquary.

Got Jade Pouch.
The cracked statue of Amaterasu.

cmdblocks.text: The Monastery of the Silent Self. Plain, almost bare. A vast shadow shaped like a mask fills the far wall. Before it kneels the abbot, an old Akodo in a plain wooden mask: Munashii.
A mask is a mercy, child.
cmdblocks.name: Abbot Munashii

cmdblocks.text: No more being anyone. No more having to choose who.
cmdblocks.name: Abbot Munashii

cmdblocks.text: Mitsue takes off the market's mask. Her own face, for once.
Choosing is the only part that's mine.
cmdblocks.name: Shosuro Mitsue

cmdblocks.text: Only crystal hurts Munashii fully; everything else does half. Halfway down he puts on his true mask, and it copies your buffs.
...I only wanted to stop being frightened...
cmdblocks.name: Abbot Munashii

cmdblocks.text: Now the counter-ritual. Hold still, Shosuro. This will feel like remembering.
cmdblocks.name: Soshi Giseiki (through Mitsue)

cmdblocks.text: Osuko, in Giseiki's mask, comes in out of the dark with her hunters, chanting.
Every soul in every mask. Choose, Mitsue. Quickly.
cmdblocks.name: Isawa Kasiko

cmdblocks.text: Every mask in the city goes light at once. The souls go free; the city has nothing left to hold it.
The city slips back toward the dream, every soul still in its mask. Safer. Sadder.

cmdblocks.text0: Free it. Let every soul go.
cmdblocks.text1: Seal it again. Back into the dream.

cmdblocks.text: CHAPTER 3 - Fortunes Lost.
The Ojatara Valleys, in the Spine of the World. The Iuchi and the Soshi fought a war here that the Emperor allowed and nobody wanted. Both sides did things.
Now the Emerald Champion has sent three magistrate teams to judge it. Shosuro Norie leads the Scorpion's. She has sent for a servant who is nobody in particular.
Objective: the Town of Buried Leaves, east, where the tribunal sits.

#4#.msg: A thin fire. Bark smoke.
#4#.name: *villager-4

cmdblocks.text: The Iuchi post. Their sergeant knows the purple of an Ide emissary, and the rice cakes that come with it.
The tribunal has a grievance about Shioden. Soshi Katsu's funeral. Who broke the mourning peace?
cmdblocks.name: Ide Tamotsu

cmdblocks.text: They did. Mourning banners up on the manor, white everywhere. We stood off, like you do. Then they came out of the banners at us.
cmdblocks.name: Iuchi sergeant

cmdblocks.text: A boy led it. In his dead father's armour, much too big. Fourteen, if he was a day.
cmdblocks.name: Iuchi sergeant

cmdblocks.text: And the manor? With his father inside?
cmdblocks.name: Ide Tamotsu

cmdblocks.text: ...Write that we were provoked, emissary.
cmdblocks.name: Iuchi sergeant

cmdblocks.text: I'll write what happened. All of it.
cmdblocks.name: Ide Tamotsu

cmdblocks.text: Objective: three grievances proven. Back to Buried Leaves: General Soshi Furayaru is to testify tomorrow, and the tribunal will want to hear what you have first.
Objective: three grievances proven. The Soshi camp: General Furayaru is to testify tomorrow.
More rice cakes, emissary? We were provoked. Write that.
cmdblocks.name: Iuchi soldier

cmdblocks.text: Ide-sama. The tribunal's in town, they say. Ask us when it sits.
cmdblocks.name: Iuchi soldier

cmdblocks.text: Move on, Scorpion. The Emperor's people say we can't kill you this month.
cmdblocks.name: Iuchi soldier

cmdblocks.text: Mitsue takes an Iuchi soldier's spare helmet from a cart and his accent from his own mouth, and sits down at the fire as a latecomer from the night watch.
...the actors? We were ordered to. They were spies, Shosuro spies with paint on.
cmdblocks.name: Iuchi soldier

cmdblocks.text: Who gave the order?
cmdblocks.name: Shosuro Mitsue

cmdblocks.text: Came down from the old master. Same as everything this year. Don't ask.
cmdblocks.name: Iuchi soldier

cmdblocks.text: The old master: not the daimyo. Iuchi Daiyu talks to woodchucks. Someone older.
Objective: three grievances proven. Back to Buried Leaves: General Soshi Furayaru is to testify tomorrow, and the tribunal will want to hear what you have first.
Objective: three grievances proven. The Soshi camp: General Furayaru is to testify tomorrow.

cmdblocks.text0: Many Faces: sit down at their fire as one of them.

cmdblock.text: Who was that? Who was who?
cmdblock.name: Iuchi soldier

cmdblock.text: A Unicorn emissary fed the whole camp at Buried Leaves. Round man. Rice cakes. Gone north to the Ide now, they say.
cmdblock.name: Refugee

cmdblock.text: You're the round man. From the inn fire. Four times, they say. For a cat.
cmdblock.name: Refugee

cmdblock.text: You're the round man! You fed the camp in autumn. You fed my sister.

cmdblock.text: The mountain path east, toward Yotomo and the flower villages. The tribunal comes first.

cmdblocks.text: Back in Buried Leaves. Akodo Rin has been quiet since the Soshi camp.
Someone's following me. Every time I'm alone. A man at the edge of the crowd, then not there.
cmdblocks.name: Akodo Rin

cmdblocks.text: And twice now, a miner from Yotomo has been watching me with something in his hand. Like a little bell.
cmdblocks.name: Akodo Rin

cmdblocks.text: Then let's go and ask him what it rings for.
cmdblocks.name: Shosuro Mitsue

cmdblocks.text: Objective: Yotomo, the pigeon breeders' village, up the mountain path east.
Morning. News runs through the tribunal town faster than the carpenters can hammer: a Soshi general opened his belly in the night, before he could testify.
General Furayaru. One less witness. Somebody wanted it that way.
cmdblocks.name: Shinjo Tsune

cmdblocks.text: Somebody always wants it that way, Tsune-sama. That's why we write things down.
cmdblocks.name: Ide Tamotsu

cmdblocks.text: Later. Akodo Rin has been quiet all morning.
Someone's following me. Every time I'm alone, a bell on the hill moves.
cmdblocks.name: Akodo Rin

cmdblocks.text: It doesn't ring. It has no clapper. It just... swings.
cmdblocks.name: Akodo Rin

cmdblocks.text: Then I'll stop leaving you alone.
cmdblocks.name: Shinjo Ryuko

cmdblocks.text: A bell that doesn't ring is a bell somebody's paying for. Let's go and find out who.
cmdblocks.name: Ide Tamotsu

cmdblocks.text: Objective: Yotomo, the pigeon breeders' village, up the mountain path east.

cmdblock.text: Shosuro Mayumi. The troupe was coming from Dragon lands to perform at Shiro Soshi. Iuchi riders came out of the dusk. I was under the costume cart.
cmdblock.name: Shosuro Mayumi

cmdblock.text: They had no reason. We had no swords. We had masks and a play about a fox.
cmdblock.name: Shosuro Mayumi

cmdblocks.text: Then somebody owes you the second performance. I'll find out who.
cmdblocks.name: Ide Tamotsu

cmdblocks.text: I'll find out who gave the order.
cmdblocks.name: Shosuro Mitsue

cmdblock.text: A play about a fox. We were going to do it twice.
cmdblock.name: Shosuro Mayumi

cmdblock.text: Masks! Fans! A trunk! All very theatrical, all very cheap!
cmdblock.name: Rag-peddler

cmdblocks.text: A rag-peddler's barrow: a fox mask, a painted fan, a costume trunk with a split lid. The Shosuro troupe's props, picked off the road where they fell.
For a Unicorn, two hundred. It's heavy, mind. Full of sticks.
cmdblocks.name: Rag-peddler

cmdblocks.text: Not sticks. Arrows, snapped off in the lacquer: grey goose fletching, the Iuchi's own, with an Iuchi fletcher's mark on every shaft.
They had masks and a play about a fox. And somebody shot the trunk.
cmdblocks.name: Ide Tamotsu

cmdblocks.text: Objective: three grievances proven. Back to Buried Leaves: General Soshi Furayaru is to testify tomorrow, and the tribunal will want to hear what you have first.
Objective: three grievances proven. The Soshi camp: General Furayaru is to testify tomorrow.
Two hundred, Unicorn. Fox masks don't grow on trees.
cmdblocks.name: Rag-peddler

cmdblocks.text0: Barter for the costume trunk. (200 zeni)

cmdblock.text: Sold you the heavy one, didn't I. No refunds on sticks.
cmdblock.name: Rag-peddler

#14#.msg: Fourteen hundred Dragon between two families. Neither of them likes us. That's how you know it's working.
#14#.name: *villager-14

#15#.msg: There was a bomb. Gaijin pepper. A round Unicorn went back into the fire four times. The last time was for a cat.
#15#.name: *villager-15

#16#.msg: Are you a magistrate? Whose side are you on? A man in the crowd gave me two bu to ask everybody that.
#16#.name: *villager-16

CHAPTER 2 - The Bell Without a Clapper.

Winter, 1122. The tribunal sits again, in the old Imperial tax office, its burned wall patched with planks. Three benches: Unicorn, Scorpion, and one neutral swing vote. Five grievances left. Every judge has a price.
The swing judge likes horses, poetry and cheap scandal.
cmdblocks.name: Shinjo Tsune

cmdblocks.text: I have a pony, a terrible haiku, and a very expensive scandal. I'll bring all three.
cmdblocks.name: Ide Tamotsu

cmdblocks.text: The Unicorn have sent their dangerous man again.
cmdblocks.name: Shosuro Norie

cmdblocks.text: I should like testimony. And a horse. Mostly testimony.
cmdblocks.name: Doji Himeko

cmdblocks.text: The case board. Four grievances can be proven now; the jade mines are sealed until spring:

The Jiochi well (a water-carrier who lived through it, in the Soshi camp south of town). The Shosuro troupe (a rag-peddler in town is selling what's left of their props). Soshi Katsu's broken funeral peace (the Iuchi post on the Ojatara road, west). The padded armies (the Soshi quartermaster's trade ledgers, in the camp).
I'm still the tribunal's escort. These days that seems to mean you.
cmdblocks.name: Akodo Rin

cmdblocks.text: It always meant him.
cmdblocks.name: Shinjo Ryuko

cmdblocks.text: Objective: prove three of the four grievances.
The tribunal. Evidence on every table. A clapperless bell, a trunk of Iuchi arrows, a sergeant's confession over rice cakes, two sets of ledgers that both lie the same way.
The evidence names crimes on both sides.
cmdblocks.name: Doji Himeko

cmdblocks.text: ...Both. You named both.
cmdblocks.name: Shinjo Tsune

cmdblocks.text: You've made enemies in two clans today, emissary.
cmdblocks.name: Shosuro Norie

cmdblocks.text: Then I'll need twice the rice cakes.
cmdblocks.name: Ide Tamotsu

cmdblocks.text: (Honor +1)
Shiro Iuchi will remember a loyal emissary.
cmdblocks.name: Shinjo Tsune

cmdblocks.text: And the Scorpion will remember a trunk full of Iuchi arrows.
cmdblocks.name: Shosuro Norie

cmdblocks.text: (Honor -1)
Afterwards. A balcony over the refugee camp. Tamotsu offers Shosuro Norie a rice cake.
You wrote half of that verdict.
cmdblocks.name: Ide Tamotsu

cmdblocks.text: I wrote all of it. You read it beautifully.
cmdblocks.name: Shosuro Norie

cmdblocks.text: Don't tell anyone I was kind.
cmdblocks.name: Shosuro Norie

cmdblocks.text: I'd never. Nobody would believe me.
cmdblocks.name: Ide Tamotsu

cmdblocks.name: Akodo Rin

Under the mat: his last letter, unsent.

cmdblocks.text: I am Soshi Ichihito. My father's lands are mine.
cmdblocks.name: Soshi Ichihito

cmdblocks.text: The Iuchi say the mourning peace for your father was broken. By whom?
cmdblocks.name: Shosuro Mitsue

cmdblocks.text: By me. I put up the banners of mourning. Then I attacked. They killed my father in front of me!
cmdblocks.name: Soshi Ichihito

cmdblocks.text: ...They burned the manor. With him inside. Unsanctified.

cmdblocks.text: By law he is wrong. He is also fourteen.
I'll write it as it happened. Nothing more.

cmdblocks.text: Under a bell frame on the hill above Yotomo, a starving miner, very still. In his hand: a ceramic bell the size of a baby's fist. It has no clapper.
Five koku, lady. Five koku to swing it when you're alone.
cmdblocks.name: Gochu

cmdblocks.text: It doesn't even ring. I thought it was a joke.
cmdblocks.name: Gochu

cmdblocks.text: Then let's tell the joke back to whoever's laughing.
cmdblocks.name: Akodo Rin

cmdblocks.text: Your family's in the camp? Here. Now tell me who paid.
cmdblocks.name: Ide Tamotsu

cmdblocks.text: ...You're the one who fed the camp. In autumn. My daughter ate your rice.
cmdblocks.name: Gochu

cmdblocks.text: It was an Iuchi. Rich. Silk and good boots, and a meishodo amulet on his wrist. There's four more of us with bells. The signal's for men on the ridge.
cmdblocks.name: Gochu

cmdblocks.text: Your family's in the camp? Here. Now tell me who paid.
cmdblocks.name: Ide Tamotsu

cmdblocks.text: ...My daughter will eat tonight.
cmdblocks.name: Gochu

cmdblocks.text: It was an Iuchi. Rich. Silk and good boots, and a meishodo amulet on his wrist. There's four more of us with bells. The signal's for men on the ridge.
cmdblocks.name: Gochu

cmdblocks.text: Please, lord. I've nothing to sell you but the bell.
cmdblocks.name: Gochu

cmdblocks.text: That evening, from the dovecotes: Gochu's friends, whispering. "An Iuchi. Rich. Amulets. The men on the ridge watch for the bells."

cmdblocks.text0: Barter: rice for his family in the camp, for the payer's name. (300 zeni)
cmdblocks.text1: Leave him the bell and watch the ridge.

cmdblocks.text: They want her. Something about her blood.
cmdblocks.name: Gochu

cmdblocks.text: ...My grandmother was Seppun.
cmdblocks.name: Akodo Rin

cmdblocks.text: Imperial blood.
cmdblocks.name: Ide Tamotsu

cmdblocks.text: A drop. Enough to be useful to someone, apparently.
cmdblocks.name: Akodo Rin

cmdblocks.text: Got The Clapperless Bell.
Objective: the hunters' trail runs east, to Perfume Petal Blossom, the flower village.

cmdblocks.text: A flower village. Every house freshly swept. Every path lined with blossom. No refugees, though thousands are camped one valley away.

cmdblocks.text: Because somebody's paying for it to be. Nothing's this clean for free.
cmdblocks.name: Ide Tamotsu

cmdblocks.text: The most beautiful house. An old courtesan serving tea with perfect hands: 'Waruko'.
You're the Ide boy. My son wrote about you.
cmdblocks.name: Soshi Nihime

cmdblocks.text: "He smiles while he disagrees."
cmdblocks.name: Soshi Nihime

cmdblocks.text: He told you about me?
cmdblocks.name: Ide Tamotsu

cmdblocks.text: He tells me everything. He thinks I'm the only person in these valleys who never lied to him.
cmdblocks.name: Soshi Nihime

cmdblocks.text: I was a Soshi daimyo's daughter, once. I loved an Iuchi. They sold me to a geisha house and told my family I'd died.
cmdblocks.name: Soshi Nihime

cmdblocks.text: My son is the child of that war. Naohida.
cmdblocks.name: Soshi Nihime

cmdblocks.text: Tamotsu's hand finds the grey pebble in his sleeve.
Tamotsu tells her: the barrels, the kitchen, the dead. The pigeon. The vats of powder in the cave.
I gave the tribunal his name.
cmdblocks.name: Ide Tamotsu

cmdblocks.text: Then you were honest with them. You're being honest with me.
cmdblocks.name: Soshi Nihime

cmdblocks.text: ...Then he's become his father after all.
cmdblocks.name: Soshi Nihime

cmdblocks.text: I'll help you. Not for the Iuchi. For him.
cmdblocks.name: Soshi Nihime

cmdblocks.text: The Iuchi you're hunting serve his father. Iuchi Kurosho, the old master. Go before dusk, by the mountain road.
cmdblocks.name: Soshi Nihime

cmdblocks.text: He's well. He's angry. He's well.
cmdblocks.name: Ide Tamotsu

cmdblocks.text: You're hiding something from me. He said you would. Keep it; I don't want it.
cmdblocks.name: Soshi Nihime

cmdblocks.text: Go before dusk, by the mountain road. Something's waiting on it.
cmdblocks.name: Soshi Nihime

cmdblocks.text: Objective: the mountain road out of the village, east. (The village shrine is a place to rest first.)
The most beautiful house. An old courtesan serving tea with perfect hands: 'Waruko'.
A Shosuro. In my house. You walk like a Scorpion pretending to be a servant. I walked like that once, the other way round.
cmdblocks.name: Soshi Nihime

cmdblocks.text: I was Soshi Nihime, a daimyo's daughter. I loved an Iuchi. They sold me to a geisha house and told my family I had drowned.
cmdblocks.name: Soshi Nihime

cmdblocks.text: A Scorpion lady sold and declared dead. The family files say 'drowned'. I've read them.
cmdblocks.name: Shosuro Mitsue

cmdblocks.text: My son is the child of that war. Naohida. He thinks I'm the only person in these valleys who never lied to him.
cmdblocks.name: Soshi Nihime

cmdblocks.text: Naohida: the peasant who bombed the Welcome Road inn, and ran into the smoke.

cmdblocks.text: Dusk on the mountain road out of the village. The ground ripples.
Iuchi shugenja rise out of the earth around them, basket hats and masks, amulets twisting in their fingers. One makes an adjustment, and the world goes utterly silent.
The silence bubble: every other round, spells and spell-like skills (anything that costs MP) make no sound. The round before, the air goes still. Break the amulet-bearer to pop it for good.
The old master needs her! He needs royal blood! You don't understand what's coming!
cmdblocks.name: Amulet-bearer

cmdblocks.text: Under the masks: Iuchi officers who 'disappeared' in the war.

cmdblocks.text: CHAPTER 4 - The Eve.
A pilgrims' inn in a Dragon mountain town, below the High House of Light. Night. Summer, the Month of the Horse.
The iron box sits on the floor beside Mitsue's futon. The lid is closed. It speaks, in her own voice.
Open me. You're so tired of being nobody.
cmdblocks.name: Iron Box (in Mitsue's voice)

cmdblocks.text: I could make you everyone.
cmdblocks.name: Iron Box (in Mitsue's voice)

cmdblocks.text: Everyone is exactly the problem.
cmdblocks.name: Shosuro Mitsue

cmdblocks.text: A letter from Norie lies by the lamp.
The only fire hot enough is Tamori's Furnace, in Dragon lands. Destroy it there.
cmdblocks.name: Shosuro Norie (letter)

cmdblocks.text: And Mitsue - whatever you hear on the road, keep walking.
cmdblocks.name: Shosuro Norie (letter)

cmdblocks.text: ...That's an odd thing to write, sensei.
cmdblocks.name: Shosuro Mitsue

cmdblocks.text: (Rested. HP and MP restored.)
Morning. Mitsue walks out into the town at the head of a 'pilgrim troupe': Many Faces, a grey pilgrim's face, a staff, a straw hat.
Objective: the pilgrims gather at the mountain shrine, at the east end of town.
The mountain shrine. A cold wind off the peaks, incense, the troupe's straw hats.

cmdblocks.name: Kitsuki Gendo

cmdblocks.text: You won't like it.
cmdblocks.name: Shosuro Mitsue

cmdblocks.text: I'll settle for knowing what it does.
cmdblocks.name: Kitsuki Gendo

A cursed box of a Bloodspeaker's heart! In my mountains!
cmdblocks.name: Togashi Yosai

cmdblocks.text: Wonderful. That's nineteen.
cmdblocks.name: Togashi Yosai

cmdblocks.text: Nineteen what?
cmdblocks.name: Shosuro Mitsue

The Furnace-keepers sent me down to escort pilgrims. You don't smell like pilgrims.

cmdblocks.text: You smell like something that wants to be burned. Come on, then. It's a long climb.

cmdblock.text: Going up to the Furnace? Then listen. The rock up there is hot enough to cook you through your sandals.
cmdblock.name: Tamori apprentice

cmdblock.text: The red stone near the lava burns anyone without a Tamori heat-ward. The outfitter sells them. Wear one, pilgrim.
cmdblock.name: Tamori apprentice

cmdblock.text: And the fire spirits hate water and a good staff. The ash-dead hate jade. That's all the Furnace teaches, really.
cmdblock.name: Tamori apprentice

cmdblock.text: A Kitsuki clerk, muttering to a colleague over a ledger of road tolls.

cmdblocks.text: Eavesdrop: "...the Scorpion Champion's procession passes the Togashi road tomorrow. All of it. Banners, bearers, him. Going up to the High House."
My Champion. Here. Keep walking, she said.
cmdblocks.name: Shosuro Mitsue (thinking)

cmdblocks.text: The talk stops. Eyes turn to the stranger who is standing much too close.
Evidence, pilgrim, is not for sale. Nor for listening to.
cmdblocks.name: Kitsuki clerk

cmdblocks.text: (Honor -1)

cmdblock.text: Tolls, tolls. Everybody wants to climb a mountain this summer.
cmdblock.name: Kitsuki clerk

#13#.name: *villager-13

#14#.name: *villager-14

#15#.msg: My grandmother says the Furnace takes anything. I asked if it takes homework.
#15#.name: *villager-15

cmdblock.text: The Furnace's spirits are fire. Fire hates rain. I call rain. You see where this is going, pilgrim.
cmdblock.name: Tamori Rain-caller

cmdblocks.text: Your current hireling heads home.

cmdblocks.name: Tamori Rain-caller

cmdblock.text: I know every switchback to the Furnace. Two swords, one guide. Bloodspeakers hate a good blade. So do bandits.

Hana? Hana, is that you? Tell them - tell the garrisons -

...muster at the Month of the Rooster... every garrison toward the capital... the Champion's orders... sealed...

cmdblocks.text: ...the Emperor's guard won't know... until it's done...
cmdblocks.name: Bayushi courier

cmdblocks.text: Every garrison. Toward Otosan Uchi.

cmdblocks.text0: Eavesdrop: sit by him, and be Hana.

cmdblocks.text: Rest now. I'll tell them.
cmdblocks.name: Shosuro Mitsue

cmdblocks.text: He dies before dawn, smiling, believing he delivered his message.

cmdblocks.text: A garden of raked sand and old pines at the top of the world. The procession kneels along the walls. A servant with a tray stands where servants stand.
Bayushi Shoju kneels before a tall tattooed figure who seems less a man than the mountain itself: the Kami Togashi.
I've found a prophecy, my lord. That the last of the Hantei will bring ruin. I would ask your guidance.
cmdblocks.name: Bayushi Shoju

cmdblocks.text: Togashi is silent a long time.
Then he answers. As Mitsue will remember it, ever after: if Shoju does this, a family's line will end; and if he succeeds, the Empire will be saved.
Shoju bows low. He hears only the second half. He rises with something like peace on his face.
Mitsue, at the edge of the garden with a tray, does not drop it. Her hands don't shake.
She waits until the procession has passed. Until she is alone, behind a wall. And then they do.
...A family's line will end.
cmdblocks.name: Shosuro Mitsue

cmdblocks.text: The lip of the crater. Heat like a wall. Far below, the Furnace breathes.
At the edge a figure waits, in Mitsue's own face, smiling her smile: a Bloodspeaker who has hunted the Box since Kudo.
You and I are the same, Shosuro.
cmdblocks.name: Bloodspeaker

cmdblocks.text: We wear what we need.
cmdblocks.name: Bloodspeaker

cmdblocks.text: The Stolen Face: at two-thirds and at one-third of its blood it steals a traveler's face. It mirrors their last skill, and takes on their weaknesses - their weapon. Use them, or take the face back with Mitsue's Steal.
(Giseiki's echo, pale and very quiet: "A borrowed face, Shosuro. You know how to take it back.")
Many Faces: Steal. Mitsue takes her face back.
We're not the same.
cmdblocks.name: Shosuro Mitsue

cmdblocks.text: I always give mine back.
cmdblocks.name: Shosuro Mitsue

cmdblocks.text: Mitsue stands at the crater's edge. The box in her hands is red-hot, screaming in her voice.
She lets it fall. It screams in her voice - and then in nobody's voice at all. The Furnace swallows it.
(The Iron Box is gone. Mitsue's Void is her own again.)
Mitsue sits down on a warm rock and doesn't move for a while.
The road home. A fork in the mountain road: one way down to the Dragon lowlands, the other toward the long road south, to Otosan Uchi.
Mitsue presses something into each companion's hand: a small blood-red jasper scorpion. A Favor.
One favour each. From a nobody. They're good for exactly one impossible thing.
cmdblocks.name: Shosuro Mitsue

cmdblocks.text: Don't waste them on dinner.
cmdblocks.name: Shosuro Mitsue

cmdblocks.text: My mother will want to know who gave me this. I'll say a pilgrim.
cmdblocks.name: Tamori Haku

cmdblocks.text: I'm not putting this on either list. It gets a list of its own.
cmdblocks.name: Togashi Yosai

cmdblocks.text: Got Jasper Scorpions.
Gendo walks with her as far as the fork. Neither speaks. At the fork he bows - lower than his rank requires, lower than hers, the bow of a man to a friend he won't see again for a long time.
...Be careful in the capital, Shosuro.
cmdblocks.name: Kitsuki Gendo

cmdblocks.text: I'm always careful. Thank you for burning the page.
cmdblocks.name: Shosuro Mitsue

cmdblocks.text: She takes the south road. Behind her, Shoju's procession is disappearing over a ridge. One servant turns her head and looks back.
Her eyes are very blue. She smiles. Then she's gone.
...You're in his procession.
cmdblocks.name: Shosuro Mitsue

cmdblocks.text: Of course you are.
cmdblocks.name: Shosuro Mitsue

cmdblocks.text: "The Eve" - complete.
Mitsue carried a sorcerer's heart into a volcano and heard the Dragon Kami answer her Champion's question. She knows what is coming in the Month of the Rooster. She can tell no one. She kept walking.
Shosuro Mitsue reaches Rank 3: The Shadow Has No Form.
Tamori Haku climbs back up to the Furnace.

cmdblocks.text: CHAPTER 1 - Fault Lines.
The Ojatara Valleys, in the Spine of the World. Two shugenja families fought a war here that nobody gave them permission to fight.
Now the Emerald Champion has sent judges. And one round, bearded Unicorn who likes everybody.
The Welcome Road inn, the Town of Buried Leaves. Silk and tension. Ide Tamotsu, round and bright-robed and laughing, hands out rice cakes to strangers.
You'll take the refugees, Tamotsu.
cmdblocks.name: Shinjo Tsune

cmdblocks.text: The refugees, Tsune-sama?
cmdblocks.name: Ide Tamotsu

cmdblocks.text: They like you. Everybody likes you. It's unbearable.
cmdblocks.name: Shinjo Tsune

cmdblocks.text: I'm Ide, Tsune-sama. Being liked is our only weapon. I keep it sharp.
cmdblocks.name: Ide Tamotsu

cmdblocks.text: Across the room, the Scorpion magistrate's party: Shosuro Norie, cool and courteous, and a Scorpion yojimbo who went to look at the stable - and was promptly bitten by Persimmon.
Agh! Your horse -
cmdblocks.name: Scorpion yojimbo

cmdblocks.text: Pony. Persimmon. She bites everyone she loves. And everyone she doesn't. Please, a small apology.
cmdblocks.name: Ide Tamotsu

cmdblocks.text: A lacquered sweet box changes hands.
...Thank you.
cmdblocks.name: Scorpion yojimbo

cmdblocks.text: The Unicorn have sent a dangerous man.
cmdblocks.name: Shosuro Norie

cmdblocks.text: And you'll take Ryuko. Someone in these valleys will try to kill you, Tamotsu. Not because you deserve it. Because you're easy.
cmdblocks.name: Shinjo Tsune

cmdblocks.text: Shinjo Ryuko. I stand in front of things.
cmdblocks.name: Shinjo Ryuko

cmdblocks.text: Then stand in front of the rice cakes. People keep taking them.
cmdblocks.name: Ide Tamotsu

cmdblocks.text: ...That's your job.
cmdblocks.name: Shinjo Ryuko

cmdblocks.text: Shinjo Ryuko joins the party.
(Shinjo Ryuko, Tamotsu's guardian: Guardian's Vow draws every enemy blow to her for two turns; Shinjo Sweep cuts every enemy.)
And this. The tribunal's purse, for the camps. Don't spend it on rice cakes.
cmdblocks.name: Shinjo Tsune

cmdblocks.text: Got 500 zeni.
Rice cakes are for the camps, Tsune-sama.
cmdblocks.name: Ide Tamotsu

cmdblocks.text: Status: an accredited emissary, Tamotsu can ask for audiences with daimyo and karo where others would be turned away.
(Rested. HP and MP restored.)
Objective: the refugee camps, east of town.
Night. The tribunal's welcome dinner. Toasts. Lanterns. Tsune almost smiles.
Then a thunderclap tears the east wall open.
Fire. Beams falling. Tamotsu drags a Scorpion judge out by the collar. Goes back for a Crane clerk. Then for a child. Then for a cat. In the stable, Persimmon kicks down a burning door.
Is that everyone?
cmdblocks.name: Ide Tamotsu

cmdblocks.text: ...You went back four times.
cmdblocks.name: Shinjo Tsune

cmdblocks.text: The cat was important.
cmdblocks.name: Ide Tamotsu

cmdblocks.text: A pigeon lands on a broken beam with a message tube. Tsune reads it, white-faced.
"Stop judging the dead. Judge the living."
cmdblocks.name: Shinjo Tsune

cmdblocks.text: A Lion samurai in Seppun-trimmed armour pushes through the smoke: Akodo Rin, the tribunal's escort.
That was gaijin pepper. Gunpowder. Illegal. Unthinkable.
cmdblocks.name: Akodo Rin

cmdblocks.text: And made fresh. Saltpeter. From bird droppings.
cmdblocks.name: Akodo Rin

cmdblocks.text: Pigeons. Yotomo - the pigeon breeders' village. North.
cmdblocks.name: Iuchi Hiroichi

cmdblocks.text: Then I'm coming with you, emissary. I'm meant to protect the tribunal. I'd like to protect it from that.
cmdblocks.name: Akodo Rin
