(Akodo Rin: Cover draws every enemy blow to her for two turns; The Clouds Part, an Akodo war-shout.)
(Rested. HP and MP restored.)
Objective: Yotomo, the pigeon breeders' village. North off the valley road.
Morning. The tribunal reconvenes in the inn's one standing room. Three grievances' worth of testimony on the table.
The bomber. Do you have his name?
cmdblocks.name: Shinjo Tsune

cmdblocks.text: ...His name is Naohida. A peasant. Trained by Shinjo Miyahana. My classmate.
cmdblocks.name: Ide Tamotsu

cmdblocks.text: (Honor +1)
He escaped, Tsune-sama. Into the smoke. Unidentified.
cmdblocks.name: Ide Tamotsu

cmdblocks.text: ...Unidentified.
cmdblocks.name: Shinjo Tsune

cmdblocks.text: (Honor -1)
You knew him.
cmdblocks.name: Shinjo Tsune

cmdblocks.text: I sold him rice cakes for a copper when we were nine.
cmdblocks.name: Ide Tamotsu

cmdblocks.text: He paid in pebbles. I took them.
cmdblocks.name: Ide Tamotsu

cmdblocks.text: He opens his hand: a small grey pebble, smooth from twenty years in a pocket.
Got A Grey Pebble.
A servant from Shiro Iuchi brings a long lacquered box: Iuchi Hiroichi's gaijin telescope, and a note. "For the emissary who brought my lord a carrot."
(Tamotsu learns Gaijin Spyglass: every enemy's weaknesses at once.)
"Fault Lines" - complete.
A tribunal of grief between two castles. Tamotsu fed the camps, opened three cases, pulled four people and a cat from a bombed inn - and met the bomber, who once paid him in pebbles.
Next: The Bell Without a Clapper. The tribunal sits again in winter; Tsune waits at the inn's table. (Recommended level 22)

cmdblock.text: The case board. Eight grievances; three are open to the tribunal now:
1. Assassins at Shiro Iuchi killed the captain of the guard and the daimyo's wife. (Shiro Iuchi, north off the valley road.)
2. The fields at Hafuna were salted. (South off the valley road.)
3. The Temple of Jizo at Motobu was destroyed by spellcraft. (The valley road's far west end.)
Shiro no Soshi's court is open to the tribunal too, south-west off the valley road.
Testimony, Tamotsu. Scorpion testimony, if you can find any that isn't lying.
cmdblock.name: Shinjo Tsune

cmdblock.text: Four times. For a cat.
cmdblock.name: Shinjo Tsune

cmdblock.text: The carpenters say the old tax office will be fit for a tribunal by midwinter. Five grievances left. Every one of them worse.
cmdblock.name: Shinjo Tsune

cmdblocks.text: The leaves come down. The snow comes after them. The camps get colder, and Tamotsu's rice-cake box gets lighter.

cmdblocks.text: The camps. Mud. Smoke. Thousands of farmers between two castles, belonging to neither.
A merchant has the only rice in the camp, and sells it at triple prices.
Barter: Tamotsu's path action. Buy what someone owns; his Commerce brings the price down. Money can also feed people.
...A hundred? For all of it? An Ide. I should have known.
cmdblocks.name: Rice merchant

cmdblocks.text: Got Rice Ball x10.
No coin, no rice, emissary.
cmdblocks.name: Rice merchant

cmdblocks.text0: Barter for the merchant's rice. (100 zeni)

cmdblocks.text: The Iuchi burned our village. The Soshi burned the next one.
cmdblocks.name: Refugee grandmother

cmdblocks.text: Which one shall I hate, my lord?
cmdblocks.name: Refugee grandmother

cmdblocks.text: Tamotsu kneels in the mud - a samurai shouldn't - beside her.
Hate me, grandmother. I'm the one who's late.
cmdblocks.name: Ide Tamotsu

cmdblocks.text: Ten sacks' worth of rice cakes go round the camp.
(Honor +1)
The grandmother says nothing.

cmdblocks.text0: Give all the rice to the camp.

cmdblocks.text: Thugs come for the rice the moment Tamotsu stands up.
Barter Coin: Tamotsu's School technique. Spend coin in battle: hire a strike, or bribe someone. A person for hire takes the money and goes home; anyone else loses a move counting it.
Go with the Fortunes, my friend. Buy your mother something.
cmdblocks.name: Ide Tamotsu

cmdblock.text: Shiro Iuchi: a triangular castle built into a wind tunnel. A harsh wind howls through the pass. The daimyo, Iuchi Daiyu, sits in his garden talking to a woodchuck.
He's a nice one. He brought you a carrot.
cmdblock.name: Iuchi Daiyu

cmdblock.text: I brought you one too, my lord.
cmdblock.name: Ide Tamotsu

cmdblock.text: Nobody brings me carrots. They bring me reports.
cmdblock.name: Iuchi Daiyu

cmdblock.text: ...The reports are lies, aren't they?
cmdblock.name: Iuchi Daiyu

cmdblock.text: Behind them, a man in a white porcelain mask with faintly glowing eyes: Iuchi Karasu.
Mostly. The carrots are real.
cmdblock.name: Iuchi Karasu

cmdblock.text: You're the nephew who came back from the Shadowlands.
cmdblock.name: Ide Tamotsu

cmdblock.text: I'm the nephew who came back. The Shadowlands were very rude about it.
cmdblock.name: Iuchi Karasu

cmdblock.text: Karasu-sama. I'm asking as the tribunal's emissary. What did the assassins carry?
cmdblock.name: Ide Tamotsu

cmdblock.text: A pause. Then he lays a scorched cloth on the stone: Soshi shadow-brands, cut from every one of them.
The case of the assassins is open for the tribunal.
The karo, Iuchi Hiroichi, a Shinjo-trained bushi with a gaijin telescope, watches them both with worry.
My lord doesn't need to hear about the war, Ide-san.
cmdblock.name: Iuchi Hiroichi

cmdblock.text: My lord is talking to woodchucks so he won't have to, Hiroichi-sama. That's hearing.
cmdblock.name: Ide Tamotsu

cmdblocks.text: Objective: two cases. Old Miyahana-sensei's cottage is in the hills south of town.
Objective: three cases. Back to the Welcome Road inn: the tribunal's welcome dinner.

cmdblock.text: The woodchuck says you smell of rice cakes. He approves.
cmdblock.name: Iuchi Daiyu

#4#.msg: I have seen worse than this war. (pause) Not much worse.
#4#.name: *villager-4

cmdblock.text: The tribunal's emissary. Welcome to Shiro Iuchi. My lord is... occupied.
cmdblock.name: Iuchi Hiroichi

cmdblock.text: My telescope? Gaijin glass, from the Burning Sands. You can see a man's buttons from a mile off.
cmdblock.name: Iuchi Hiroichi

cmdblocks.text: Ide. Take it. Watch the war with it, since my lord won't.
cmdblocks.name: Iuchi Hiroichi

cmdblocks.text: (Tamotsu learns Gaijin Spyglass: every enemy's weaknesses at once.)
Two thousand, Ide-san. Even for a friend of the woodchucks.
cmdblocks.name: Iuchi Hiroichi

cmdblock.text: Look after the glass. Look after him, if you can.
cmdblock.name: Iuchi Hiroichi

cmdblock.text: White-crusted earth. A general inspects it without regret: Iuchi Takanobu, a Shinjo by birth, a gruff man in furs.
Wars are for winning, emissary.
cmdblock.name: Iuchi Takanobu

cmdblock.text: And when the war is over, general, what grows here?
cmdblock.name: Ide Tamotsu

cmdblock.text: ...Nothing. That was the point.
cmdblock.name: Iuchi Takanobu

cmdblock.text: His supply ledger lies on a camp table: salt, by the cartload, and the order that sent it.

cmdblocks.text: Take it. It says what happened. I'm not ashamed of what happened.
cmdblocks.name: Iuchi Takanobu

cmdblocks.text: The order came from the top: from Shiro Iuchi itself.
Objective: two cases. Old Miyahana-sensei's cottage is in the hills south of town.
Objective: three cases. Back to the Welcome Road inn: the tribunal's welcome dinner.
Everything costs something in a war, Ide. Come back with coin.
cmdblocks.name: Iuchi Takanobu

cmdblock.text0: Barter for his supply ledger. (200 zeni)

cmdblock.text: Only fools and children play at war and stop short of winning it.
cmdblock.name: Iuchi Takanobu

cmdblock.text: Motobu is on the old maps. It won't be on any new ones. Where the Temple of Jizo stood: a smoking crater.
The Soshi hid soldiers in the temple. The Iuchi used the Fist of Osano-Wo.
cmdblock.name: Ide Tamotsu

cmdblock.text: Both sides made a temple a weapon. Jizo protects children. There were children in the village below.
cmdblock.name: Ide Tamotsu

cmdblock.text: The head monk, Hitoro, a retired Ikoma, sits at the crater's edge. He forgets to eat unless someone tells him to.

cmdblocks.text: Hitoro-sama. Nobody will make you fight for this. I only need you to say what you saw.
cmdblocks.name: Ide Tamotsu

cmdblocks.text: ...The Soshi ordered us out of our own temple. Soldiers in the hall of Jizo.
cmdblocks.name: Hitoro

cmdblocks.text: Then the Iuchi brought the mountain down on it. Nobody asked us to leave first.
cmdblocks.name: Hitoro

cmdblocks.text: I want both of them to answer for it. Both.
cmdblocks.name: Hitoro

cmdblocks.text: Objective: two cases. Old Miyahana-sensei's cottage is in the hills south of town.
Objective: three cases. Back to the Welcome Road inn: the tribunal's welcome dinner.

cmdblock.text0: Etiquette: kneel, bow, promise he won't have to duel for speaking.

cmdblock.text: Both of them. Tell the judges both.
cmdblock.name: Hitoro

cmdblocks.text: Shiro no Soshi: grey walls rising out of a sea of refugees. In the hall, the Soshi daimyo, Soshi Bantaro - buffoonish, loud, red and black face-paint - and his wife Shinobu, quiet: the real power.
The Unicorn are liars! The Iuchi are murderers! More sake!
cmdblocks.name: Soshi Bantaro

cmdblocks.text: My husband means that the Soshi welcome the tribunal's wisdom.
cmdblocks.name: Soshi Shinobu

cmdblocks.text: I'm sure he does, my lady.
cmdblocks.name: Ide Tamotsu

cmdblocks.text: A small mountain cottage. Plum trees. An old woman pouring tea: Shinjo Miyahana, Tamotsu's teacher.
Little Tamotsu. Rounder than ever.
cmdblocks.name: Shinjo Miyahana

cmdblocks.text: Sensei. Wiser than ever.
cmdblocks.name: Ide Tamotsu

cmdblocks.text: You were always a flatterer. Have you heard from Naohida?
cmdblocks.name: Shinjo Miyahana

cmdblocks.text: Not in a year.
cmdblocks.name: Ide Tamotsu

cmdblocks.text: Nor I. He always asked why. Why must the farmer bow? Why does the lord eat first?
cmdblocks.name: Shinjo Miyahana

cmdblocks.text: I told him the answers. He didn't like them.
cmdblocks.name: Shinjo Miyahana

cmdblocks.text: I didn't like them either, sensei.
cmdblocks.name: Ide Tamotsu

cmdblocks.text: No. But you smiled while you disliked them. He never learned to smile.
cmdblocks.name: Shinjo Miyahana

cmdblocks.text: She looks out at the hills a long time.
If you find him, bring him to tea. Tell him I've stopped giving answers.
cmdblocks.name: Shinjo Miyahana

cmdblock.text: Little Tamotsu! Come and have tea when the tribunal lets you breathe.
cmdblock.name: Shinjo Miyahana

cmdblock.text: Bring him to tea. I'll make the good kind.
cmdblock.name: Shinjo Miyahana

cmdblocks.text: Then I'll pay you in rice to tell me how many.
cmdblocks.name: Ide Tamotsu

cmdblocks.text: ...Twenty. And the angry one.
cmdblocks.name: Sabu

cmdblocks.text: Vats. Pigeons. Barrels. A young man in peasant clothes over silk, a curved gaijin blade at his hip: Naohida. He stops dead.
...Tamotsu.
cmdblocks.name: Naohida

cmdblocks.text: Naohida. You owe me a copper.
cmdblocks.name: Ide Tamotsu

cmdblocks.text: What?
cmdblocks.name: Naohida

cmdblocks.text: The rice cakes. When we were nine. You paid in pebbles. I took them. I still have one.
cmdblocks.name: Ide Tamotsu

cmdblocks.text: Look at you. Silk and a pony.
cmdblocks.name: Naohida

cmdblocks.text: They gave you a seat at the table, Tamotsu. They gave me a grave to dig.
cmdblocks.name: Naohida

cmdblocks.text: Then come and sit in my seat. I'll stand. I've got good legs.
cmdblocks.name: Ide Tamotsu

cmdblocks.text: You always talk. Talk to this.
cmdblocks.name: Naohida

cmdblocks.text: Powder kegs stand between them. Any Fire hit sets one off - on both sides. Naohida's weak to Yari, Yumi and Water: water spoils the powder.
The cave mouth burns. He's gone.

cmdblocks.text: CHAPTER 3 - The Noblest Blood.
A field outside Shiro Iuchi. An eight-pointed star burned into the frost. And at its centre, a messenger in Seppun colours who will never deliver his message.
Akodo Rin stands at the edge of the burned star, very pale.
A Seppun courier. Royal blood. It was meant to be me.
cmdblocks.name: Akodo Rin

cmdblocks.text: It wasn't you. Because of you. Because you were careful.
cmdblocks.name: Ide Tamotsu

cmdblocks.text: Because you were careful.
cmdblocks.name: Akodo Rin

cmdblocks.text: A man in a white porcelain mask kneels by the body, sniffing the air. His eyes glow faintly behind it: Iuchi Karasu, the daimyo's nephew.
The characters at the points. Noble. Blood. Teacher. And 'Fortunes', upside down.
cmdblocks.name: Iuchi Karasu

cmdblocks.text: Regret. My great-uncle Kurosho has summoned the Shuten Doji of Regret.
cmdblocks.name: Iuchi Karasu

cmdblocks.text: Its servants sing. If you hear them, you belong to it. And then you sing too.
cmdblocks.name: Iuchi Karasu

cmdblocks.text: I was a prisoner in the Shadowlands for six months. I never once regretted anything.
cmdblocks.name: Iuchi Karasu

cmdblocks.text: Except leaving. And now, coming back.
cmdblocks.name: Iuchi Karasu

cmdblocks.text: Then we'd better not listen. The Iuchi agent's satchel. I kept it.
cmdblocks.name: Ide Tamotsu

cmdblocks.text: ...An emissary who carries earplugs. My uncle's luck is improving.
cmdblocks.name: Iuchi Karasu

cmdblocks.text: Jade hurts it. Nothing else does much. And Shahai - my cousin, nine - is in the castle with every servant in it singing.
cmdblocks.name: Iuchi Karasu

cmdblocks.text: Then we go and get her.
cmdblocks.name: Shinjo Ryuko

cmdblocks.text: Iuchi Karasu will answer the Guest call in battle. (One guest at a time.)
(Iuchi Karasu: Jade Strike, called in twice a battle. Jade burns the dead and the Tainted.)

Covered Ears: at the castle gate the Wax Earplugs go in. Possession by hearing can't touch you - but nobody can hear you either. Spoken path actions are out and the party talks in written notes. In battle, a voice skill (Words of Peace, Song of the Ki-Rin, The Clouds Part) means pulling your wax out first - and then you can hear them. The wax comes out at safe places.

cmdblocks.text: The top of the tower. A barricaded door: chests, a screen, a futon, all pushed against it from inside.
A small hand pushes a note out underneath, in a child's writing.
ARE YOU REAL OR ARE YOU SINGING
cmdblocks.name: Iuchi Shahai (note)

cmdblocks.text: Tamotsu writes on the back of it, and pushes it under, with a rice cake on top.
REAL. I BROUGHT RICE CAKES.
cmdblocks.name: Ide Tamotsu (note)

cmdblocks.text: A pause. The door opens a crack. A small hand takes the rice cake.
Then the door opens wider: Iuchi Shahai, nine, wax in her own ears, a kitchen knife in her other hand.
YOU'RE THE FAT EMISSARY. FATHER SAYS YOU'RE NICE.
cmdblocks.name: Iuchi Shahai (note)

cmdblocks.text: YOUR FATHER IS VERY WISE. ALSO I'M ROUND, NOT FAT.
cmdblocks.name: Ide Tamotsu (note)

cmdblocks.text: A small smile, the first in days.
OK.
cmdblocks.name: Iuchi Shahai (note)

cmdblocks.text: As they lead her down the stair, Shahai hums, very softly, without noticing. The same tune as the servants.
SHE'S HUMMING IT.
cmdblocks.name: Iuchi Karasu (note)

cmdblocks.text: I KNOW. NOT NOW.
cmdblocks.name: Ide Tamotsu (note)

cmdblocks.text: A sunlit clearing by a brook, strangely untouched. Woodchucks everywhere. Sparrows on a man's shoulders. Iuchi Daiyu sits among them with his eyes shut, listening to the water.
Ah. That is far better. The water's music has improved.
cmdblocks.name: Iuchi Daiyu

cmdblocks.text: Tamotsu. The woodchucks told me everything. Everything my karo wouldn't.
cmdblocks.name: Iuchi Daiyu

cmdblocks.text: The war. The camps. The salted fields. My father.
cmdblocks.name: Iuchi Daiyu

cmdblocks.text: Twenty years I listened to animals so I wouldn't have to listen to men.
cmdblocks.name: Iuchi Daiyu

cmdblocks.text: You're listening now, my lord. That's what counts. Animals tell the truth. So will you.
cmdblocks.name: Ide Tamotsu

cmdblocks.text: ...I'll tell the truth. Gods help me. I'll tell all of it.
cmdblocks.name: Iuchi Daiyu

cmdblocks.text: Your father summoned a demon, my lord. With a Seppun boy's blood. He's in your castle now.
cmdblocks.name: Ide Tamotsu

cmdblocks.text: Daiyu goes very still. A woodchuck climbs into his lap.
...Then I am the son of a monster.
cmdblocks.name: Iuchi Daiyu

cmdblocks.text: You're the son who'll stop him.
cmdblocks.name: Ide Tamotsu

cmdblocks.text: (Honor +1)

cmdblocks.text1: Tell him the whole truth about Kurosho.

cmdblocks.text: Shahai runs into the clearing and throws herself at her father. He holds her. The animals scatter.
...The animals. Who protects the animals, Tamotsu, if the song reaches them?
cmdblocks.name: Iuchi Daiyu

cmdblocks.text: Animals can't be possessed, uncle. Only people. It's one of the very few nice things about it.
cmdblocks.name: Iuchi Karasu

cmdblocks.text: I'll take them both west, out of the wind. You need an army. The Mirumoto only left the valley a few days ago. Armies walk slowly.
cmdblocks.name: Iuchi Karasu

cmdblocks.text: Then I'll go and talk one round.
cmdblocks.name: Ide Tamotsu

cmdblocks.text: Objective: the Mirumoto war-camp at the valley mouth, south of the star field.

cmdblock.text: The valley path east, to the jade mines. Not without an army.

cmdblocks.text: A Dragon war-camp at the valley mouth: green banners, cold cook-fires, three thousand men packing to leave. In the command tent, two blunt, resentful generals.
A Unicorn family feud. Shugenja against shugenja. Why should three thousand Dragons bleed for it?
cmdblocks.name: Mirumoto Tsukaru

cmdblocks.text: And you want us to ride in with wax in our ears.
cmdblocks.name: Mirumoto Tabezu

cmdblocks.text: I want three thousand Dragons to ride out again, general. The wax is the cheap part.
cmdblocks.name: Ide Tamotsu

cmdblocks.code: local p = ::rpgstat.playermap["P102"]; W = !!(p && ::rpgstat.members.find( @( v) v && v == p));

cmdblocks.text: General. It's not a feud. It's a Shuten Doji. Regret. It'll be in your camp by the next moon.
cmdblocks.name: Kitsuki Gendo

cmdblocks.text: ...A Kitsuki. With gaijin glass on his face.
cmdblocks.name: Mirumoto Tsukaru

cmdblocks.text: And excellent hearing, general. For now.
cmdblocks.name: Kitsuki Gendo

cmdblocks.text: Barter: Tamotsu lays it out the way he'd lay out a trade. Supplies for the Dragon from Ide warehouses. A trade road through the valleys when this is over. Every courtesy, every title in its place.
And the price of our dead, emissary? What do you pay for those?
cmdblocks.name: Mirumoto Tsukaru

cmdblocks.text: The jade mines are just over the hill. Every lump we pull out of them, the Dragon gets a share. Forever.
cmdblocks.name: Ide Tamotsu

cmdblocks.text: Jade, you said? ...I like jade.
cmdblocks.name: Mirumoto Tabezu

cmdblocks.text: There are children in that castle with wax in their ears, general. That's all I have to offer.
cmdblocks.name: Ide Tamotsu

cmdblocks.text: A long silence. Then Tsukaru holds out his hand for the wax.
...Saddle up.
cmdblocks.name: Mirumoto Tsukaru

cmdblocks.text: (Honor 3 or more would let him appeal to their honour alone. Not today.)
The jade mines are just over the hill. Every lump we pull out of them, the Dragon gets a share. Forever.
cmdblocks.name: Ide Tamotsu

cmdblocks.text: Jade, you said? ...I like jade.
cmdblocks.name: Mirumoto Tabezu

cmdblocks.text: The demonstration: Tamotsu has the Dragon officers put the wax in, then claps, very loudly, behind their heads. Nobody turns.
...What?
cmdblocks.name: Mirumoto Tsukaru

cmdblocks.text: Exactly.
cmdblocks.name: Ide Tamotsu

cmdblocks.text: We'll cut the road so nothing walks out of this valley. You take a hundred men to the mines. Fighting a Shuten Doji without jade is a way of killing yourself slowly.
cmdblocks.name: Mirumoto Tsukaru

cmdblocks.text: (Rested. HP and MP restored.)
Objective: the jade mines, east up the valley path.
Dusk. Carts of jade rolling into camp, green-glowing in the half-light. A Dragon army stuffing wax into its ears. Shahai holding her father's hand.
Ahead, in the gathering storm: Shiro Iuchi, howling in its wind tunnel.
Do you regret it? The six months?
cmdblocks.name: Ide Tamotsu

cmdblocks.text: I regret that I came back to this.
cmdblocks.name: Iuchi Karasu

cmdblocks.text: No. I don't. Pass me another stone.
cmdblocks.name: Iuchi Karasu

cmdblocks.text: A runner from Perfume Petal Blossom, with a note in a courtesan's perfect hand.
"My son goes to the castle. Bring him home, if there is a home."
cmdblocks.name: Soshi Nihime

cmdblocks.text: Got Nihime's Note.
...I'll try, my lady.
cmdblocks.name: Ide Tamotsu

cmdblocks.text: "The Noblest Blood" - complete.

A star burned in the frost, a little girl who wrote 'are you real or are you singing', a lord who listened to animals for twenty years, and a mine full of the quiet dead. Tamotsu has jade, a deaf army, and a castle ahead that howls.
(The Dragon army will answer in the last battle. At Rank 3, at level 41: When the Veil Moves.)
Next: Regret. (Recommended level 41)

cmdblock.text: Dragon drums at dusk. The army moves on Shiro Iuchi at first light.
Two swords, emissary. One to say a thing, one to make sure. (He looks you up and down.) You carry neither.
cmdblock.name: Mirumoto duellist

cmdblock.text: I watch the castle. Professionally. For a fee I'll even tell you what I saw.
cmdblock.name: Kitsuki scout

cmdblocks.text: Old Kurosho. At the tower window, every dusk, looking down at the courtyard like a man watching rice grow.
cmdblocks.name: Kitsuki scout

cmdblocks.text: And the generals hate the wax. Tabezu says it makes his teeth itch.
cmdblocks.name: Kitsuki scout

cmdblocks.text: Fifty. Sake is dear in a war-camp.
cmdblocks.name: Kitsuki scout

cmdblock.text0: Barter: buy him a cup of sake. (50 zeni)

cmdblock.text: Calming tea, for the ones who heard the screaming. Three cups for sixty.
cmdblock.name: Camp follower

Sixty, round one.

cmdblocks.text: The jade mines. Silent for months. The miners didn't leave.
Low mounds by the entrance. Prayer strips. Flowers someone has planted, and kept watering. Karasu stops in front of them and says nothing at all for a long time.
Karasu-san?
cmdblocks.name: Ide Tamotsu

cmdblocks.text: ...My great-uncle ordered this. I was in the Shadowlands while he did it.
cmdblocks.name: Iuchi Karasu

cmdblocks.text: I was a prisoner in hell, and I came home to find my family had built one for the neighbours.
cmdblocks.name: Iuchi Karasu

cmdblocks.text: Behind the Dragon column, a crowd of thin people with carrying-poles: refugees from the camps Tamotsu fed in autumn.
We'll carry the carts, Ide-sama. You carry the fight.
cmdblocks.name: Gochu

cmdblocks.text: (The porters carry the carts: every raw-jade node is yours.)
(The Dragon porters will load some of the raw jade straight onto the carts.)
Raw jade lies everywhere in the galleries. Thrown, it burns the dead. The risen dead feel no fear; they're weak to Jade, Fire and Bo.
Shapes ahead in the torchlight, like short trees, moving slowly. The dead of the mine, standing in rows in front of the gallery mouth.

cmdblocks.text: CHAPTER 4 - Regret.
Shiro Iuchi. A triangular castle built into a wind tunnel. Today the wind is screaming, and so is something inside.

The Mirumoto army, wax in its ears, surrounds the castle. Iuchi survivors with them: Hiroichi, Daiyu, Shahai holding her father's sleeve. A young man walks into camp under a white flag, a gaijin blade on his back: Naohida.
The bomber! Arrest him!
cmdblocks.name: Iuchi soldier

cmdblocks.text: One day, Hiroichi-sama. Give me one day's truce. I'll pay for it.
cmdblocks.name: Ide Tamotsu

cmdblocks.text: Barter: Tamotsu empties the purse onto the karo's camp table, and keeps talking.
...Keep your money, Ide. One day.
cmdblocks.name: Iuchi Hiroichi

cmdblocks.text: You didn't name me. At the tribunal.
cmdblocks.name: Naohida

cmdblocks.text: You still owe me a copper.
cmdblocks.name: Ide Tamotsu

cmdblocks.text: ...I'll pay you in pebbles.
cmdblocks.name: Naohida

cmdblocks.text: He's my father. Kurosho. I made gunpowder to hurt him.
cmdblocks.name: Naohida

cmdblocks.text: I'll walk in there to save him. I don't understand myself either.
cmdblocks.name: Naohida

cmdblocks.text: Good. Understanding yourself is overrated. Here. It's jade. Bring it.
cmdblocks.name: Ide Tamotsu

cmdblocks.text: Naohida will answer the Guest call in battle. (One guest at a time.)
(Naohida: Powder Charge, once a battle - Fire across the whole enemy line. Iuchi Karasu walks with you too, but writes rather than fights: Naohida answers the Guest call now.)
Soshi Nihime arrives on a borrowed horse, veiled, determined.
I'm coming in. He'll listen to me, once. For one breath.
cmdblocks.name: Soshi Nihime

cmdblocks.text: The tunnel, then. It sings louder than the castle. Bring spare wax. Bring a great deal of spare wax.
cmdblocks.name: Iuchi Karasu

cmdblocks.text: (Rested. HP and MP restored.)

cmdblock.text: My father taught himself to hate the son he had. I taught myself to hate the father I didn't. We're very alike.
cmdblock.name: Naohida

cmdblock.text: My Yotomo birds. One came in from the flower village this morning, with a letter for the old lord. She sends one every spring. I never deliver them.
cmdblock.name: Pigeon-keeper

cmdblocks.text: Three words. I've never read the others. I read this one.
cmdblocks.name: Pigeon-keeper

cmdblocks.text: 'Look at me.'
cmdblocks.name: Pigeon-keeper

cmdblocks.text: Got The Pigeon's Letter.
...My mother's hand.
cmdblocks.name: Naohida

cmdblocks.text: Three hundred. Birds eat, emissary.
cmdblocks.name: Pigeon-keeper

cmdblock.text: She'll send another next spring. She always does.
cmdblock.name: Pigeon-keeper

cmdblock.name: Old woman

cmdblock.text: My husband's saddle. The pony will hate it less than the others. Here.
cmdblock.name: Old woman

cmdblock.text: Got Persimmon's Saddle.

cmdblock.name: Old woman

cmdblock.text: The Soshi are here to observe, Ide-sama. Only to observe.
cmdblock.name: Soshi envoy

cmdblocks.text: My lord wants a treaty, not an heir. They fear a peasant lord more than they fear demons.
cmdblocks.name: Soshi envoy

cmdblocks.text: Tea is dear in a siege.
cmdblocks.name: Soshi envoy

cmdblock.text0: Barter: a cup of good tea, and an hour. (100 zeni)

cmdblocks.text: My telescope. Take it, Ide. I'd rather not see what's up there.

Kurosho taught me my first water prayer. Now I'd like to drown the thing he called up. They say Regret hates water. Everything sad does.

cmdblocks.text: The top of the castle. A room where the wind never stops; the windows have long since gone. In its centre, Iuchi Kurosho: eighty, a monk's robe, the kanji for Void burned into his skull.
Behind him, filling the wind: the Shuten Doji of Regret, a shape made of every apology no one ever made.
The party speaks in notes. Then Tamotsu pulls out one plug. He needs his voice.
Kurosho-sama!
cmdblocks.name: Ide Tamotsu

cmdblocks.text: ...The Ide boy. Come to haggle?
cmdblocks.name: Iuchi Kurosho

cmdblocks.text: Come to buy you back, my lord.
cmdblocks.name: Ide Tamotsu

cmdblocks.text: The Wail: every third round the Doji wails. Anyone with open ears may be possessed - Tamotsu's are open now. Spare Wax puts it back in; When the Veil Moves guards the party from it. The Doji is weak to Jade, Water and Void; Kurosho to Air and Bo.
The wind stops, all at once. The silence is enormous.
On the stair below, the servants wake, dazed, freed. Kurosho lies in the centre of the still room.
Nihime kneels and takes his head in her lap.
...Twenty years. I should have come for you.
cmdblocks.name: Iuchi Kurosho

cmdblocks.text: Yes. You should have. Hush now. Your son is here.
cmdblocks.name: Soshi Nihime

cmdblocks.text: ...Mine?
cmdblocks.name: Iuchi Kurosho

cmdblocks.text: ...Yours.
cmdblocks.name: Naohida

cmdblocks.text: Iuchi Kurosho dies, at peace.
Iuchi Kurosho dies alone in the still room, murmuring a name nobody there knows.
...I wanted to hate you properly. You didn't even let me do that.
cmdblocks.name: Naohida

cmdblocks.text: Daiyu comes up the stair with the Soshi envoy behind him, a woodchuck at his heel.
My father did this. The Iuchi will say so, in court.
cmdblocks.name: Iuchi Daiyu

cmdblocks.text: (Honor +1)
I'll speak for the boy. I've listened long enough.
cmdblocks.name: Iuchi Daiyu

cmdblocks.text: He's Iuchi by his father. Soshi by his mother. Peasant by upbringing.
cmdblocks.name: Ide Tamotsu

cmdblocks.text: If you want a bridge between your houses, my lords - here he is. Already built.
cmdblocks.name: Ide Tamotsu

cmdblocks.text: Tamotsu -
cmdblocks.name: Naohida

cmdblocks.text: You always asked why the lord eats first. Now you'll find out. It's mostly indigestion.
cmdblocks.name: Ide Tamotsu

cmdblocks.text: A treaty, my lords. Borders, rice, the mines shared. Nobody's name on it but yours.
cmdblocks.name: Ide Tamotsu

cmdblocks.text: ...Nameless suits me. I'm used to it.
cmdblocks.name: Naohida

cmdblocks.text0: Acknowledge Naohida as heir of both houses.

cmdblocks.text: The valley road. Tamotsu walks a refugee caravan home through the Ojatara valleys, leading Persimmon, who bites every person who tries to help carry anything.
He fixed it. The fat merchant fixed it.
cmdblocks.name: Iuchi Daiyu

cmdblocks.text: Emissary.
cmdblocks.name: Iuchi Karasu

cmdblocks.text: The fat emissary fixed it.
cmdblocks.name: Iuchi Daiyu

cmdblocks.text: Round, my lord!
cmdblocks.name: Ide Tamotsu

cmdblocks.text: The jade, Ide.
cmdblocks.name: Mirumoto Tabezu

cmdblocks.text: (The Jade Toll: jade goods cost a quarter more at the Mirumoto quartermaster from now on.)
A small hand tugs Tamotsu's sleeve. Shahai, holding out her palm.
You promised a rice cake.
cmdblocks.name: Iuchi Shahai

cmdblocks.text: I always keep rice-cake promises.
cmdblocks.name: Ide Tamotsu

cmdblocks.text: She hums as she eats it. A different tune now: her own.
"Regret" - complete.

In a castle where the wind never stopped, Tamotsu paid a demon to leave, and it went. An old man died saying sorry at last. A nameless peasant became the bridge between two broken houses - whether he likes it or not.
Karasu presses an iron tuning fork into Tamotsu's hand. "For the next song nobody should hear."
Got Karasu's Tuning Fork.
(Ide Tamotsu's road is walked. Naohida will answer the Guest call when the roads meet. And one day, at Rank 5: the Immovable Hand of Peace.)

cmdblocks.text: CHAPTER 1 - What's Eating the Eta.
Cakon, a Crane river city. Very clean on top. Very busy underneath.
Sayo - eighteen, straw hat, a basket of herbs, a plain katana - jumps from the barge onto the docks before it's tied up.
Oi! Wait till we dock!
cmdblocks.name: Bargeman

cmdblocks.text: I did. It just wasn't your dock yet.
cmdblocks.name: Sayo

cmdblocks.text: Who taught you to fight?
(The Wolf's Technique: Sayo hits harder against whoever targeted her this round.)
(The Wind Technique: Sayo is faster in every battle.)
(The Way of Sacrifice: when Sayo Defends, the ally with the least HP shares her guard.)

cmdblocks.text0: "My mother. She never let anyone hit first." (Ronin Warrior: The Wolf's Technique)
cmdblocks.text1: "The river. You learn to be faster than the current." (Ronin Duelist: The Wind Technique)
cmdblocks.text2: "Nobody. I just stood in front of people who needed it." (Ronin Yojimbo: The Way of Sacrifice)

cmdblocks.text: Dockside: two thugs shove a fish-seller into the water.
Remedy: Sayo's School technique. Mix a base herb with a catalyst. Ginseng and Rice Wine make a strong heal; Ume-baa's Poultice needs nothing at all. (Battle menu: School.)
Katana: her attacks hit harder for every VP spent on Void.
The fish-seller climbs out, dripping.
Thank you, miss! Who are you?
cmdblocks.name: Fish-seller

cmdblocks.text: Nobody in particular. Chew this. You swallowed half the river.
cmdblocks.name: Sayo

cmdblocks.text: Got Ginseng Root x2.
Got Rice Wine x2.
(Rested. HP and MP restored.)
Objective: the market, east. Somebody is throwing silver.

cmdblock.text: You! The river girl! Have a fish. No, have two.
cmdblock.name: Fish-seller

cmdblock.text: Wait till we dock, I said!
cmdblock.name: Bargeman

cmdblocks.text: A brush of sleeves. Nobody notices a ronin girl.
Got 40 zeni.
And a scrap of paper: "Sono barge, upriver, every night. Empty."
Oi! Hands off, river-rat!
cmdblocks.name: Bargeman

cmdblock.text: My purse feels light. Must be the river air.

cmdblocks.text: Togashi Yosai joins the party. (Dragon's Breath, Arrowroot; his tattoos heal him a little every turn.)
I'll be here. Probably. Statistically.
cmdblocks.name: Togashi Yosai

cmdblocks.text: You've already got company. I'll keep the bench warm. Benches love me.
cmdblocks.name: Togashi Yosai

cmdblocks.text: Street musicians. A young noble with a fresh black eye throws a fistful of silver at them - too much - then steps behind a stall, embarrassed: Mibu Kagemaro.
I seek bold and honourable citizens! For a... delicate task!
cmdblocks.name: Mibu Kagemaro

cmdblocks.text: Nobody moves. Sayo walks up, chewing a rice ball.
I'm a citizen. Mostly bold.
cmdblocks.name: Sayo

cmdblocks.text: You are... a ronin?
cmdblocks.name: Mibu Kagemaro

cmdblocks.text: Ronin's daughter. Even worse, my lord. I don't even have a lord to have lost.
cmdblocks.name: Sayo

cmdblocks.text: A mercenary named Daigoro killed my brother, Mibu Ieko, in a brawl.
cmdblocks.name: Mibu Kagemaro

cmdblocks.text: Over a poet. O-Sode, of the House of Tranquillity. It was a very stupid brawl.
cmdblocks.name: Mibu Kagemaro

cmdblocks.text: The judge, Sono Kentanaga - of a rival family - added a clause.
cmdblocks.name: Mibu Kagemaro

cmdblocks.text: If Daigoro isn't executed in three days, he walks free.
cmdblocks.name: Mibu Kagemaro

cmdblocks.text: So execute him.
cmdblocks.name: Sayo

cmdblocks.text: No eta will do it. Something has been eating them. In their village. At night.
cmdblocks.name: Mibu Kagemaro

cmdblocks.text: They believe it's a punishment for their unclean souls. They won't work until it stops.
cmdblocks.name: Mibu Kagemaro

cmdblocks.text: Couldn't you do the execution yourself?
cmdblocks.name: Sayo

cmdblocks.text: I would become eta!
cmdblocks.name: Mibu Kagemaro

cmdblocks.text: There. Now you know what you're paying me for.
cmdblocks.name: Sayo

cmdblocks.text: ...Yes. I suppose I do.
cmdblocks.name: Mibu Kagemaro

cmdblocks.text: I can't be seen to be involved. If anyone asks, you've never met me.
cmdblocks.name: Mibu Kagemaro

cmdblocks.text: My lord, nobody ever asks a ronin girl anything.
cmdblocks.name: Sayo

cmdblocks.text: Got 300 zeni (a string of silver, discreetly).
Pilfer: Sayo's path action. Take what someone carries. It's a Low Skill: get caught in town and your Honor suffers. (Sayo has very little to lose.)
Objective: the eta village, outside the walls. The river gate is east, through the alleys.
The eta go back to work.
On the third day, at the very edge of the judge's clause, Hiro walks to the execution ground. His no-dachi has been cleaned and sharpened all night. Sayo watches from the crowd, hat down.
A single sound. The crowd breathes out. The law is satisfied.
The market. Kagemaro, at a careful distance, does not quite look at her.
I can't thank you in public.
cmdblocks.name: Mibu Kagemaro

cmdblocks.text: I know.
cmdblocks.name: Sayo

cmdblocks.text: I owe you giri. A debt. I'll never be able to be seen paying it.
cmdblocks.name: Mibu Kagemaro

cmdblocks.text: Throw some silver to the musicians. I'll know what it means.
cmdblocks.name: Sayo

cmdblocks.text: One more thing. Your judge's family paid Daigoro's friends to slow the hunt.
cmdblocks.name: Sayo

cmdblocks.text: ...The Sono. Thank you. That debt I can repay. Quietly.
cmdblocks.name: Mibu Kagemaro

cmdblocks.text: Kagemaro walks away and throws a fistful of silver at the musicians. They play a very cheerful song.
(That night, in the eta village, Hiro sits by the shrine, rubbing the three claw marks on his arm when he thinks no one is watching. They are a little redder than they were.)
"What's Eating the Eta" - complete.
A noble with a black eye, a clause, and a village that believed it deserved to be eaten. Sayo walked where no samurai would, and an old tiger went hungry at last.

cmdblock.text: The river gate. Somebody in the alley wants a word first.

cmdblocks.text: A narrow alley. A ronin with a scarred lip - Tetsuo - and a 'merchant' with a Lion's posture block both ends.
You're the girl Mibu's paying. Go home, ronin. This isn't your fight.
cmdblocks.name: Tetsuo

cmdblocks.text: It's nobody's fight. That's why I'm here.
cmdblocks.name: Sayo

cmdblocks.text: Tetsuo runs. The 'merchant' drops his disguise - a Lion samurai, Ogura Tokinari - bows very stiffly, and is gone too.
"Payment, Daigoro's band." From the Sono house.
cmdblocks.name: Sayo

cmdblocks.text: The judge's family is paying the murderer's friends. Interesting.
cmdblocks.name: Sayo

cmdblocks.text: Objective: the river gate, and the eta village beyond it.

cmdblock.text: At the river gate a stray dog snaps at an old beggar-monk. The gate guards laugh.

cmdblocks.text: Here, here. Go eat this instead.
cmdblocks.name: Sayo

cmdblocks.text: The dog takes it and trots off, delighted.
Kind child. A riddle for you, in thanks.
cmdblocks.name: Beggar-monk

cmdblocks.text: "Under the right arm of the strong is the gift. Between two red stones, under the old cedar."
cmdblocks.name: Beggar-monk

cmdblocks.text: Strong what?
cmdblocks.name: Sayo

cmdblocks.text: Strong cedar, child. What else is strong?
cmdblocks.name: Beggar-monk

cmdblocks.text: (A riddle: a cedar between two red stones, somewhere on the trail.)
The dog tugs a few more times at his rags, and the old man wanders away, muttering.

cmdblock.text0: Shoo the dog with a rice ball.

cmdblock.text: Strong cedar. What else is strong?

M417.name: Cakon: the alley and the river gate

cmdblocks.text: The village outside the walls: wicker and thatch huts on a barren plain, an all-faiths shrine of salvaged lumber and carved cork, frightened faces in doorways. About a hundred and twenty people, sitting idle.
Sayo? Little Sayo? Ume-baa's girl?
cmdblocks.name: Auntie Fumi

cmdblocks.text: Auntie Fumi! You're thinner.
cmdblocks.name: Sayo

cmdblocks.text: We're all thinner. It comes at night. Took the Koyama boy last week. Took the old ferryman.
cmdblocks.name: Auntie Fumi

cmdblocks.text: A huge, toothless man with a rusty no-dachi sits by the shrine, grinding the blade on a stone: Hiro the undertaker.
Ume's girl. You came.
cmdblocks.name: Hiro

cmdblocks.text: Hiro! You're still alive!
cmdblocks.name: Sayo

cmdblocks.text: It took my brother from his bed. I fought it. It went away. It'll come back.
cmdblocks.name: Hiro

cmdblocks.text: He didn't scream, my brother. Good men don't scream when they're being punished.
cmdblocks.name: Hiro

cmdblocks.text: Then it's not punishment. It's dinner.
cmdblocks.name: Sayo

cmdblocks.text: And I'm going to spoil its appetite.
cmdblocks.name: Sayo

cmdblocks.text: A long look. Then Hiro stands, and he is enormous.
...I'll carry the sword.
cmdblocks.name: Hiro

cmdblocks.text: Hiro will answer the Guest call in battle. (One guest at a time.)
(Hiro: No-dachi Sweep, twice a battle - every enemy in reach.)
The eta show her the trail it drags its prey along: across the rice paddies, toward the big canal. Dried blood on the grass.
(Rested. HP and MP restored.)
Objective: follow the blood trail, east, out across the paddies.

#4#.msg: A thin fire. Bark smoke.
#4#.name: *villager-4

cmdblock.text: Ume-baa will be proud when she hears. She'll also tell you to eat something.
cmdblock.name: Auntie Fumi

cmdblock.text: A thin girl sits by the shrine fire, wrapped in a quilt: Akari.
Akari? You're better!
cmdblock.name: Sayo

cmdblock.text: The fire talks when it's quiet. Don't tell anyone.
cmdblock.name: Akari

cmdblock.text: Akari watches the shrine fire. She doesn't blink.

cmdblocks.text: The trail joins a farmer's path and crosses the big irrigation canal on an ancient maple log, worn smooth and flat. Spots of dried blood on it.
On the log, two crow-headed tengu in red silk kimonos fence with katana, cawing with laughter.
Cross, wave-girl! Cross with dignity!
cmdblocks.name: Crow-Tengu

cmdblocks.text: And be laughed at! Caw!
cmdblocks.name: Crow-Tengu

cmdblocks.text: I've been laughed at by better birds.
cmdblocks.name: Sayo

cmdblocks.text: She's crawling!
cmdblocks.name: Crow-Tengu

cmdblocks.text: That's cheating!
cmdblocks.name: Crow-Tengu

cmdblocks.text: (On the log, a heavy hit - a quarter of the target's health - knocks a fighter into the canal for two turns. Either side. Crow-tengu are weak to Yumi and Air, and very vain: Compliment makes one lose its turn preening.)
The tengu flap off, sulking. One drops a long black feather.
Got Tengu Feather.

cmdblock.text: Goblins on the trail. Not past them.

cmdblocks.text: A copse of dwarf pines by the trail. Small misshapen figures crouch in the shade - blue ones, horned ones, tusked ones - with four wicker baskets of stolen pilgrim offerings.
Shinies! Ours! Go away, meat!
cmdblocks.name: Goblin

cmdblocks.text: (Bakemono: weak to Katana, Fire and Jade. Pilfer works on their baskets.)
The baskets: offering coins, paper prayers, a bronze bell, a biwa, a folding fan, a bamboo umbrella, two large radishes.
Sayo carries the baskets back to the eta village shrine. There are new charms on it by evening.
(Honor +1)
Got 200 zeni (and two large radishes).
(Honor -1)
Objective: the trail runs on, toward a column of smoke.

cmdblock.text: A single majestic cedar in a meadow, two red granite stones at its feet.

cmdblocks.text: Under the right arm of the strong: the ground under the cedar's right-hand bough has been dug, once, long ago.
Sayo digs. Wrapped in oil-soaked cotton: a jade-handled knife.
Got Jade-handled Knife.
Beautiful. Impossible to paint. Nothing else.

cmdblock.text: The cedar. The dug earth.
A small stone shrine to the Fortunes, half buried in the rock. Someone left it a rice ball.

cmdblocks.text: The trail ends in a small gravel hollow. A dome of clay on a bamboo frame, painted with warnings. A smouldering fire pit before it, with bones in the ash.
An old woman at the door, smiling, a teapot in her hands: Tomie Cho.
Visitors! Come in, come in. You smell of herbs, child.
cmdblocks.name: Tomie Cho

cmdblocks.text: Ume's girl, aren't you? She always smelled of herbs too.
cmdblocks.name: Tomie Cho

cmdblocks.text: You knew Ume-baa.
cmdblocks.name: Sayo

cmdblocks.text: I knew everyone in that village. I've been visiting them.
cmdblocks.name: Tomie Cho

cmdblocks.text: Her smile widens. And widens. Her teeth are not an old woman's teeth.
...It's her.
cmdblocks.name: Hiro

cmdblocks.text: My family drank from the wrong well, child. Three hundred years ago.
cmdblocks.name: Tomie Cho

cmdblocks.text: And now I'm too old to catch rabbits. The eta don't run very fast. They think they deserve it.
cmdblocks.name: Tomie Cho

cmdblocks.text: They don't. Nobody does. Least of all from you.
cmdblocks.name: Sayo

cmdblocks.text: Tomie Cho goes back inside the hut. Hiro pulls a burning stick out of her own fire pit and hands it to Sayo.
Got Firebrand.
(Inside her hut the walls take most of every blow. Fire will flush her out: the firebrand, or a Hanabi remedy.)
The hut goes up like paper. Something tears out of the flames on four legs.
The wall of the hut bursts outward. Something comes through it on four legs.
RUN, wave-girl! Run like the eta run!
cmdblocks.name: Tomie Cho

cmdblocks.text: (Tomie Cho: weak to Fire, Yari and Yumi. Hiro's No-dachi Sweep hits her twice as hard.)
The tiger falls. For a moment it is an old woman again, very small in the ash.
...It was such a long time to be hungry.
cmdblocks.name: Tomie Cho

cmdblocks.text: I know. It still wasn't theirs to pay for.
cmdblocks.name: Sayo

cmdblock.text: Back up the river road to Cakon?

cmdblocks.text: CHAPTER 2 - The Noble and the Ronin.
Winter on the river road. Lords ride in the middle. Everyone else walks in the ditch.
A pilgrim in grey steps aside a heartbeat too slowly for a mounted young lord: Ikoma Sadanobu. The lord's retainers knock the pilgrim into the snow and beat him.
You! Peasant! Hold that man!
cmdblocks.name: Ikoma Sadanobu

cmdblocks.text: Which one of you is the criminal again? I'm new.
cmdblocks.name: Sayo

cmdblocks.text: How dare -! Seize her too!
cmdblocks.name: Ikoma Sadanobu

cmdblocks.text: (Sadanobu's retainers: weak to Katana and Yumi. They won't stay past half.)
You'll hang, wave-girl! I'll have your face on every post from here to the sea!
cmdblocks.name: Ikoma Sadanobu

cmdblocks.text: Make sure they get my good side!
cmdblocks.name: Sayo

cmdblocks.text: Something flutters off his saddle as he gallops away: an Ikoma travel writ, sealed in gold wax.
On a branch above the road, a crow watches her.
Sayo pockets it. The crow caws once, very loudly, like a magistrate.
Got Sadanobu's Travel Writ.
(Honor -1)
Sayo leaves it. The crow looks almost disappointed.
The pilgrim is still on his knees, bleeding into the snow. Downriver, a rice barge is pulling away from the bank.
Up, up. We're leaving by water. Lords hate getting their horses wet.
cmdblocks.name: Sayo

cmdblocks.text: The river road out of Cakon, heading downriver. Snow on the reeds.

cmdblock.text: Small tracks in the snow, very neat, one paw in front of the other. A fox. They lead off the road, toward the trees.
A Fox shrine no taller than a child, half under the snow. A cracked offering dish.

cmdblocks.text: Something red slips away between the trees. Where the rice ball was: a charm on a red cord.
Got Fox Charm.
The dish is empty. Sayo has nothing to put in it. (A rice ball, maybe.)

cmdblock.text: The Fox shrine. The dish is clean.

cmdblocks.text: A rice barge in the dark, drifting downriver. Sayo binds the pilgrim's ribs by lantern light. He is calm, wry, and in more pain than he admits.
You'll be hunted for this.
cmdblocks.name: Jinnai

cmdblocks.text: I was born on a barge, monk. I've been "hunted" by every toll-keeper on three rivers.
cmdblocks.name: Sayo

cmdblocks.text: They never catch me at low tide.
cmdblocks.name: Sayo

cmdblocks.text: ...I'm not a monk. Not exactly. A lay brother. The Order of Osano-Wo.
cmdblocks.name: Jinnai

cmdblocks.text: Osano-Wo? The thunder fortune? Your order hits people.
cmdblocks.name: Sayo

cmdblocks.text: Only when they insist.
cmdblocks.name: Jinnai

cmdblocks.text: The bargewoman's wife sells Sayo a dried snow-lotus for a story about the lord in the ditch.
Got Snow-Lotus x2.
Got Willow Bark.

Remedy, two catalysts: Ume-baa's story brew. Ginseng, willow bark and snow-lotus - a heal, a guard (DEF up), and healing that keeps on going (Regen). Ginseng and snow-lotus alone make the slow brew. (Battle menu: School. Snow-lotus is sold by Yasuki merchants.)
Jinnai's prayer beads click as he settles. On one bead: a tiny carved snake.
Pretty snake.
cmdblocks.name: Sayo

cmdblocks.text: A family thing.
cmdblocks.name: Jinnai

cmdblocks.text: Jinnai will answer the Guest call in battle. (One guest at a time.)
(Jinnai: Freezing the Lifeblood, twice a battle - one enemy can't move. And once a battle, when Sayo is badly hurt, his Chi Protection catches her.)
By dawn the barge ties up at a village of jetties and paper lanterns.

cmdblocks.text: The Village of Floating Flowers. A river stop between Crab, Scorpion and Sparrow lands, where everyone knows everyone's business and nobody admits it.
A wanted poster on the dock post: a badly drawn girl with an enormous nose.
No, no. That girl has a nose like a radish. You're much prettier.
cmdblocks.name: Village grandmother

cmdblocks.text: Go away before they notice.
cmdblocks.name: Village grandmother

cmdblocks.text: I love this village already.
cmdblocks.name: Sayo

cmdblocks.text: I'll be at the inn. Pretending my ribs belong to somebody else.
cmdblocks.name: Jinnai

cmdblocks.text: (Rested. HP and MP restored.)
Objective: Floating Flowers. The inn is in the middle of the street, when Sayo wants to sleep.
Dawn on the jetty. Jinnai sits heavily on a mooring post, his old wound opened again.
My family guarded a secret on the Mountain of the White Snow. For three hundred years.
cmdblocks.name: Jinnai

cmdblocks.text: I'm the last of them. And this wound won't let me climb.
cmdblocks.name: Jinnai

cmdblocks.text: The Order isn't mine to give you. The mountain is.
cmdblocks.name: Jinnai

cmdblocks.text: Got Snake Beads.
Climb it for me, wave-girl. Find out what my family was guarding. Then decide whether it should stay guarded.
cmdblocks.name: Jinnai

cmdblocks.text: And you?
cmdblocks.name: Sayo

cmdblocks.text: I'll go back to my shrine. The Osano-Wo monks will want to know why I'm late.
cmdblocks.name: Jinnai

cmdblocks.text: Will you be all right?
cmdblocks.name: Sayo

cmdblocks.text: I'm a lay brother of the thunder fortune. We're very hard to kill. It's mostly stubbornness.
cmdblocks.name: Jinnai

cmdblocks.text: Jinnai walks up the river road with a limp, and doesn't look back. Then he does, once, and lifts a hand.
Rank 2. A ronin may take her next technique from any ronin school.

cmdblocks.text0: Punish the Arrogant (Ronin Warrior, Rank 2): her next blow on whoever wounds her hits harder.
cmdblocks.text1: The Wind Technique (Ronin Duelist): faster in every battle.
cmdblocks.text2: The Way of Sacrifice (Ronin Yojimbo): when she Defends, the weakest ally shares her guard.

cmdblocks.text0: Taking the Measure (Ronin Duelist, Rank 2): every blow on the same foe studies it - the next one hits harder.
cmdblocks.text1: The Wolf's Technique (Ronin Warrior): she hits harder against whoever targeted her.
cmdblocks.text2: The Way of Sacrifice (Ronin Yojimbo): when she Defends, the weakest ally shares her guard.

cmdblocks.text0: Will Not Flesh (Ronin Yojimbo, Rank 2): once a round she takes a blow meant for an ally.
cmdblocks.text1: The Wolf's Technique (Ronin Warrior): she hits harder against whoever targeted her.
cmdblocks.text2: The Wind Technique (Ronin Duelist): faster in every battle.

cmdblocks.text: "The Noble and the Ronin" - complete.
Branded a bandit for helping a stranger, Sayo crawled through a snake-cult's sand on her belly and was told she belongs to no one - which, it turns out, is exactly why the mountain needs her.
Next: The Village of the Wounded Lion. (Recommended level 30)

cmdblock.text: WANTED: A BANDIT GIRL, FOR ASSAULT ON THE PERSON OF LORD IKOMA SADANOBU. The drawing has a nose like a radish.
Go away before they notice. Shoo. Come back for tea.
cmdblock.name: Village grandmother

cmdblock.text: Pretty and kind. That's a bad combination for business, girl. Have a persimmon.
cmdblock.name: Village grandmother

cmdblock.text: The grandmother closes her shutter, very politely, as Sayo passes.
A room, miss? Storm's coming tonight. Lords' men ride in storms. They think it's dramatic.
cmdblock.name: Innkeeper

cmdblocks.text: (Rested.)
Night. A winter storm comes up the river, and with it torches: Sadanobu's retainers, down the jetties in force.
Give up the wave-girl and the beggar, villagers!
cmdblocks.name: Retainer Captain

cmdblocks.text: What wave-girl? We only have pretty girls here!
cmdblocks.name: Village grandmother

cmdblocks.text: No red lantern waves from the jetty to guide them. One squad wanders the wrong jetty in the rain and is never heard from again. Well - until morning.
(Retainers: weak to Katana and Yumi. They'll give up when it goes badly.)
The retainers kneel on the wet planks. The captain is the last one up.
Go home. Tell your lord the radish-nosed girl wasn't here.
cmdblocks.name: Sayo

cmdblocks.text: ...She wasn't.
cmdblocks.name: Retainer Captain

cmdblocks.text: The village pulls its shutters back open. Somebody brings Sayo a bowl of soup she didn't ask for.
(Honor +1)
Sayo sends them off the end of the jetty, one splash at a time. It's quick. Behind every shutter, the village watches her very quietly.
Morning. The storm has blown downriver.
You didn't wake me.
cmdblocks.name: Jinnai

cmdblocks.text: You'd have helped. Your ribs wouldn't have.
cmdblocks.name: Sayo

cmdblocks.text: Objective: rest at the inn again tonight, when Floating Flowers has nothing more to say.

cmdblock.text: Another night, miss? Your friend the monk went to bed early. He's very quiet for a man who snores.
cmdblock.name: Innkeeper

cmdblocks.text: The second night. Sayo wakes in the dark. Jinnai's bed is empty - still warm.
Wet footprints lead out of the inn and across the street to the harbourmaster's house. Its door is not locked.
Inside, a low table has been pushed aside. Under it, the floor mats are newer than the house - and one of them is a trapdoor.

cmdblock.text: Rest, miss? Nothing exciting tonight. I checked.
cmdblock.name: Innkeeper

cmdblocks.text: (Rested.)

cmdblock.text: Beloved by all! Ask anyone! Fair prices, fair weights, fair weather!
cmdblock.name: Harbourmaster Tokubei

cmdblock.text: Beloved by all! Midnight? I sleep at midnight. Like everyone.
cmdblock.name: Harbourmaster Tokubei

cmdblock.text: The harbourmaster's office, under the stair: river charts, letters in a fine hand, signed only with a little drawing of a snake. One letter is sealed with a ring - the wax shows a snake eating its tail.
And the floor mats under the table are newer than the house.
Not now. Not in daylight, with Tokubei waving at everyone from the doorway.
The loose mat. The trapdoor under it.
Everyone has a secret, sweetling. Mine are expensive.
cmdblock.name: Madame Hagi

cmdblocks.text: The harbourmaster has visitors at midnight. Men with snake rings. They never stay for the girls. That's the suspicious part.
cmdblocks.name: Madame Hagi

cmdblocks.text: Come back with coin, sweetling. Secrets don't eat rice.
cmdblocks.name: Madame Hagi

cmdblock.text: One secret per customer, sweetling. House rule.
cmdblock.name: Madame Hagi

cmdblock.text: I'm a respectable man! Mostly.
cmdblock.name: Yasuki Kanemori

cmdblock.text: I'm a respectable man! Mostly.
cmdblock.name: Yasuki Kanemori

cmdblocks.text: A brush of sleeves. Nobody notices a ronin girl.
A letter, unsent, written and rewritten until the paper is soft: "To Oyuki, whom I am ashamed of being ashamed of. Marry me, in front of all of them."
Oh, you poor fool.
cmdblocks.name: Sayo

cmdblocks.text: My sleeve! ...Oh. It's only the ronin girl.
cmdblocks.name: Yasuki Kanemori

cmdblocks.text: (Honor -1)

cmdblock.text0: Pilfer: the folded paper in his sleeve.

cmdblock.text: You dropped this. It's a good letter. Terrible handwriting.
cmdblock.name: Sayo

cmdblock.text: You - that - she'd never - in front of the whole village -
cmdblock.name: Yasuki Kanemori

cmdblocks.text: Kanemori drinks it in one swallow, straightens his collar, and walks to the jetty where Oyuki is mending a net.
The whole village finds something to do near the jetty. Nobody is watching. Everybody is watching.
Oyuki! Will you - would you - in front of everyone - marry a respectable man? Mostly?
cmdblocks.name: Yasuki Kanemori

cmdblocks.text: Oyuki takes off the wide hat. In the daylight. She looks at him for a long time.
...Mostly will do.
cmdblocks.name: Oyuki

cmdblocks.text: The village pretends not to cheer.
For the matchmaker! Ten off, everything, forever! Well. While I live.
cmdblocks.name: Yasuki Kanemori

cmdblocks.text: Got Kanemori's Discount.
Got Herbal Salve x5.

cmdblocks.text0: Pour him a cup of rice wine. (One cup for courage. Ume-baa said two is for fools.)

cmdblocks.text: He needs a cup of something first. Rice wine. One cup.
cmdblocks.name: Sayo

cmdblock.text: A respectable man! Entirely! Ask my wife!
cmdblock.name: Yasuki Kanemori

cmdblock.text: Sayo? Ume-baa's girl? You set my arm when I was nine!
cmdblock.name: Oyuki

cmdblocks.text: Sayo steeps the bark, stirs in the honey, and makes her drink it hot.
Ume-baa's cough tea. It still tastes like a boot.
cmdblocks.name: Oyuki

cmdblocks.text: Kanemori brings me honey too. At night. He won't look at me in the daylight. Nobody does.
cmdblocks.name: Oyuki

cmdblocks.text0: Remedy: willow bark and wild honey, for the cough.

cmdblocks.text: That cough wants willow bark and honey. Ume-baa's tea.
cmdblocks.name: Sayo

cmdblocks.text: The Yasuki sells both. He sells everything. Except courage.
cmdblocks.name: Oyuki

cmdblock.text: The cough's gone. The rest stays.
cmdblock.name: Oyuki

cmdblock.text: Mostly will do. Don't tell him I said it like that.
cmdblock.name: Oyuki

cmdblock.text: The riverside hut outside the village. The one house in Floating Flowers with no secrets in it. Sayo checks anyway. Nothing. She's almost disappointed.
Lord Sadanobu's men will come. They always do.

cmdblocks.text: A brush of sleeves. Nobody notices a ronin girl.

Oi! I counted those!
cmdblocks.name: Fisherman

cmdblocks.text: (Honor -1)

cmdblock.text0: Pilfer: a fish or two from the basket.

cmdblock.text: ...The river takes.
cmdblock.name: Fisherman

cmdblock.text: Storm's coming.
cmdblock.name: Boatman

cmdblock.text: And Lord Sadanobu pays the storm-riders double. I'd sleep with my sandals on, if I were a radish-nosed girl.
cmdblock.name: Boatman

cmdblock.text: Ribbons! Combs! Very cheap!
cmdblock.name: "Pedlar"

cmdblock.text: His hands are very clean for a pedlar. His sandals are new. There is a shuttered lantern in his basket under the ribbons.

cmdblocks.text: A brush of sleeves. Nobody notices a ronin girl.
A lantern with a red lens. The kind you wave from a jetty, in a storm, to tell boats where to land. Or retainers.
Oops.
cmdblocks.name: Sayo

cmdblocks.text: Hands off the stock, girl!
cmdblocks.name: "Pedlar"

cmdblocks.text: (Honor -1)

cmdblock.text: Ribbons... combs...
cmdblock.name: "Pedlar"

#20#.name: *villager-20

cmdblock.text: The river shrine. Paper fish hang from the eaves, turning in the wind.

cmdblocks.text: The offering water clouds over, then clears. The Taint is gone.
The water stays clear. There is nothing in you for it to take.
Sayo sits with the river for a while. (MP restored.)

cmdblock.text: The road north, toward the Lion hills and a mountain still white to the shoulders.

cmdblock.text0: Take it. (Chapter 3: The Village of the Wounded Lion - Recommended level 30)

cmdblocks.text: Your current hireling heads home.
Three cuts. Then I go back to sitting on this barrel.

Coin first, Sayo. Ronin pay up front.

M425.name: The snake den - under the floor mats

cmdblocks.text: A long room of white sand under carved serpents. In the middle, kanji in black sand. The walls are full of small holes, two hands apart, from the floor to head height.
Carved inscription: "Only snakes may pass."
Shadows of snakes slide across the walls, above the height of a crawling man.
Come on. The sand's warm.
cmdblocks.name: Sayo

cmdblocks.text: Hm. Let's see what they do.
cmdblocks.name: Sayo

cmdblocks.text: The shadows pour out of the holes - a cloud of flying black snakes from the waist up.
OW. Fine! Belly! Belly is good!
cmdblocks.name: Sayo

cmdblocks.text: (Sayo is poisoned. It will matter in the next fight. Rhubarb, or an Antidote.)

cmdblocks.text0: Crawl on your belly. (Safe. A samurai would lose face. Sayo has none to lose.)
cmdblocks.text1: Walk upright. (The shadow-snakes bite: damage and Poison.)

cmdblocks.text: Togashi Yosai walks straight down the middle, upright, hands folded in his sleeves. The shadow-snakes bite him all over.
They're testing my humility. I have so much of it. It's my best quality.
cmdblocks.name: Togashi Yosai

cmdblocks.text: By the far wall, the bites have already closed.
The far door opens onto a greenish light.

cmdblocks.text: Beyond the serpent's throat, a passage climbs toward the river. Men and women with snake tattoos on their wrists block the way out. Shadows crawl off the walls and become snakes.
A spy! The Voice spoke to a SPY!
cmdblocks.name: Snake Enforcer

cmdblocks.text: I'm not a spy. Spies are better dressed.
cmdblocks.name: Sayo

cmdblocks.text: Jinnai is there, at the edge of the circle, the snake on his wrist bare. He won't strike his brothers. But his hands can still keep them from killing her.
(Snake enforcers: weak to Katana, Fire and Jade. Their shadow-snakes: weak to Fire and Air; they rise again every second round while an enforcer stands. Break an enforcer.)
The enforcers lower their blades. The shadow-snakes sink back into the stone.
She isn't a spy. Look at her clothes.
cmdblocks.name: Jinnai

cmdblocks.text: One by one, the Order goes back into the dark, until only an enforcer's pack is left on the floor.
Got Snake Ring.
They'll want to know you can keep a secret.
cmdblocks.name: Jinnai

cmdblocks.text: I'll keep it. I'm very good at secrets. I just tell people they're recipes.
cmdblocks.name: Sayo

cmdblocks.text: That will do.
cmdblocks.name: Jinnai

cmdblocks.text: I won't promise anything. I don't know what your Order is for yet.
cmdblocks.name: Sayo

cmdblocks.text: ...Good. Neither do half of them. I trust you anyway.
cmdblocks.name: Jinnai

cmdblocks.text: Somewhere in the dark, someone writes her name down.

cmdblocks.text: CHAPTER 3 - The Village of the Wounded Lion.
Early spring. The road runs north into the Lion hills. Sayo turns the snake beads over in her fingers as she walks.
A Lion checkpoint across the north road: a bar of lacquered timber, a hut, three spears.
Papers. Wave-folk go round by the goat track.

M429.name: The road north to the Wounded Lion

cmdblocks.text: The Village of the Wounded Lion, at the foot of the Mountain of the White Snow. Every fifty years, the grandchildren of heroes come here to climb it.
Five young samurai in brilliant clan colours stand in the street: the descendants of the five legendary champions. Matsu, Hida, Bayushi, Doji, Mirumoto. Their leader, sharp and proud: Matsu Hanae.
You. Ronin. You'll carry the ropes.
cmdblocks.name: Matsu Hanae

cmdblocks.text: Of course, my lady.
cmdblocks.name: Sayo

cmdblocks.text: And I'll be the only one who knows how to tie them.
cmdblocks.name: Sayo

cmdblocks.text: Our grandfathers' grandfathers climbed this mountain to save a stolen prince from an oni.
cmdblocks.name: Hida Ren

cmdblocks.text: Five champions. Four died gloriously. Bayushi carried the baby down and died telling the tale.
cmdblocks.name: Doji Aoi

cmdblocks.text: The Bayushi always get the best lines.
cmdblocks.name: Bayushi Kei

cmdblocks.text: The Mirumoto ancestor died first. Bravely. It's in every history.
cmdblocks.name: Mirumoto Sen

cmdblocks.text: At the village gate: a row of low, snow-covered mounds. An old man leaves a rice cake on each.
What are these, grandfather?
cmdblocks.name: Sayo

cmdblocks.text: My family's. Always have been.
cmdblocks.name: Old Mosuke

cmdblocks.text: My grandfather's grandfather said the real prince never came down the mountain.
cmdblocks.name: Old Mosuke

cmdblocks.text: He was a silly old man. Everybody said so.
cmdblocks.name: Old Mosuke

cmdblocks.text: (Rested. HP and MP restored.)
Objective: the trailhead, east of the village. The climbers leave when Sayo does.
The trailhead. The five grandchildren are waiting, very well dressed for a mountain.
We go up today. You go in front, ronin. If the snow gives way, it gives way under you.
cmdblocks.name: Matsu Hanae

cmdblocks.text: Very sensible, my lady.
cmdblocks.name: Sayo

cmdblocks.text: The others climb in a line behind. Matsu Hanae walks beside Sayo, sword loose in its scabbard.

cmdblocks.text: Matsu Hanae joins the party.
(Matsu Hanae: Matsu Fury, one great cut; Lion's Charge, through the whole line. The others fight their own battles on the slopes.)
The village gate, at dusk. Old Mosuke at the snow mounds, the same as every evening.
Your grandfather's grandfather wasn't silly. The real prince never came down.
cmdblocks.name: Sayo

cmdblocks.text: And the one who did - the one who became Emperor - was a baby from this village.
cmdblocks.name: Sayo

cmdblocks.text: ...All these years. All these years we left rice for them and didn't know why.
cmdblocks.name: Old Mosuke

cmdblocks.text: The champions climbed. The prince came down. It's a good story, grandfather.
cmdblocks.name: Sayo

cmdblocks.text: He nods, satisfied, and puts down another rice cake.
You weren't punished for anything. You were just in the way.
cmdblocks.name: Sayo

cmdblocks.text: I know what that's like.
cmdblocks.name: Sayo

cmdblocks.text: Night. Sayo sits alone by the village fire, turning the snake beads in her fingers.
Every emperor for three hundred years. A peasant's grandson's grandson's grandson.
cmdblocks.name: Sayo

cmdblocks.text: Blood means nothing. Funny.
cmdblocks.name: Sayo

cmdblocks.text: That's the one thing samurai would kill to stop anyone saying.
cmdblocks.name: Sayo

cmdblocks.text: Far away, in the dark beyond the firelight, someone with a snake ring on their wrist watches her.
The watcher bows toward her - a deep, odd, respectful bow - and slips away.
The watcher writes something on a slip of paper, folds it, and slips away.
"The Village of the Wounded Lion" - complete.

A legend climbed by grandchildren in their best colours, a hermit who kept a promise for three hundred years, and a basin of red stones. Sayo carried the truth down the mountain - and it is heavy enough to topple a dynasty.
Next: The Oracle's Choice. (Recommended level 40)

#6#.name: *villager-6

cmdblock.text: Behind the outfitter's counter: a crate of climbing gear at double the lowland price.

cmdblocks.text: A brush of sleeves. Nobody notices a ronin girl.
Got Climbing Spikes.
Hands off! Those are for paying pilgrims!
cmdblocks.name: Outfitter

cmdblocks.text: (Honor -1)

cmdblock.text0: Pilfer: a pair of climbing spikes.

cmdblock.text: The crate. One pair fewer.
The hero shrine: five champions' names in gold, and a great many rice cakes.

cmdblocks.text: The offering water clouds over, then clears. The Taint is gone.
The water stays clear. There is nothing in you for it to take.
Sayo sits under the five names for a while. (MP restored.)

cmdblock.text: The hero shrine's storeroom: five memorial tablets, older than the shrine, wrapped in silk.

The dates are wrong. Four of the champions died on the mountain the night the prince was stolen. The fifth tablet - the Bayushi's - is dated three days later. And the tablet beside it, for the village itself, says only: "Burned. All. The same night."
Got Ginseng Tonic x2.
The five tablets. The dates still don't match.

#14#.msg: My ancestor charged the oni's castle first. First! (beat) It's in the song, anyway.
#14#.name: *villager-14

#15#.msg: The Crane histories say the champions argued on the mountain. Nobody reads that part aloud.
#15#.name: *villager-15

#16#.msg: Everyone says my ancestor was a hero. I'd like to know what he was before that.
#16#.name: *villager-16

#17#.msg: We don't talk about our ancestor much. He died first. That's all anyone knows.
#17#.name: *villager-17

cmdblock.text: My family's mounds. We feed them. They never say thank you.
cmdblock.name: Old Mosuke

cmdblock.text: I told them. All of them. They'd have laughed.
cmdblock.name: Old Mosuke

cmdblock.text: Back down to the village?
A steep pitch, iced over. A good rock for a rope.

cmdblocks.text: Sayo loops the rope twice round the rock and pulls a barge-knot tight with her teeth.
Above, Matsu Hanae's foot goes out from under her. She swings from the line over a long drop.
Ronin! Ronin!
cmdblocks.name: Matsu Hanae

cmdblocks.text: Sayo. My name's Sayo, my lady. It's quicker to shout.
cmdblocks.name: Sayo

cmdblock.text: Sayo's knot. It will still be holding when the rock isn't.
Too steep to climb untied. (A rope point, just back there.)
An old rock shelter in the pass. A yari sticks out of the ice at its mouth, frozen solid. On it, the rags of a banner: the green and white of the Imperial Guard.
The legend doesn't have the Imperial Guard in it.
cmdblock.name: Bayushi Kei

cmdblock.text: It does now.
cmdblock.name: Sayo

cmdblock.text: The frozen yari. The banner.

cmdblocks.text: A grave under the cedars, half under the snow. A Crane's grave - and a Lion arrow still in the headstone.
...A Crane grave. With a Lion arrow in it.
cmdblocks.name: Doji Aoi

cmdblocks.text: Bandits. Obviously.
cmdblocks.name: Matsu Hanae

cmdblocks.text: Something huge and white heaves up out of the drift behind the grave. Then another.
(Snow beasts: weak to Fire and Yumi. The others take the third; these two are Sayo's.)
Further up, a tall man stands in the snow, barefoot, a Crane tattoo winding over his face and neck. He looks at Sayo. Then he walks on up the mountain without a word.
Who is that?
cmdblocks.name: Sayo

cmdblocks.text: A hermit. They say he's been on this mountain forever. He never speaks.
cmdblocks.name: Matsu Hanae

cmdblocks.text: Objective: on up the mountain, to the ice ledges.

The wind on the bridge would take a man off it. Rope first.

cmdblocks.text: On the bridge of stone over the clouds, a suit of ancient Mirumoto armour, half buried in ice. It is facing away from the castle - down the mountain.
...That's facing the wrong way. Our ancestor died charging the castle.
cmdblocks.name: Mirumoto Sen

cmdblocks.text: Armour doesn't lie, my lord. People do.
cmdblocks.name: Sayo

cmdblocks.text: The Castle of the White Snow: black stone under three hundred years of ice. The gate hangs open, blown in. Old banners move in the wind, a thread at a time.
The hermit stands in the snow beside the gate. He doesn't go in. He waits.
(Rested. HP and MP restored.)
Objective: into the castle.

encount.name: Fortress: a ghost and the frost
Fortress: a ghost and the frost (Lv 40)

cmdblocks.text: The Castle of the White Snow. A winter palace. Three hundred years of frost, and a night that never ended.
The courtyard is a cemetery: fifty or sixty samurai, frozen where they fell, mostly Lion and Crab, in the green and white of the Imperial Guard. Every one of them died defending this place.
The legend says there was an oni here. It doesn't say anything about a battle.
cmdblocks.name: Matsu Hanae

cmdblocks.text: And the guard still walks the walls: pale shapes replaying the night, over and over, like a play with no audience.

cmdblock.text: The Crab lord says take the prince. He'll marry the other heir. Consort to an empty cradle.
cmdblock.name: Ghost-Guard

cmdblock.text: There was no oni. A Crab lord had rebel guards kidnap the prince.
The ghost-guard turns, and says it again, and again.
You shot him!
cmdblock.name: Ghost-Guard

cmdblock.text: He was a guard!
cmdblock.name: Ghost-Guard

cmdblock.text: He was Crane!
cmdblock.name: Ghost-Guard

cmdblock.text: The champions fought each other. The Lion killed the Crane.
...The grave under the cedars.
cmdblock.name: Doji Aoi

cmdblock.text: The two ghosts struggle, and part, and struggle.

encount.name: Pagoda: a ghost and the frost
Pagoda: a ghost and the frost (Lv 40)

cmdblock.text: Stand back. This will be loud.
cmdblock.name: Ghost-Guard

cmdblock.text: The Bayushi champion blew the gate with gunpowder.
The fuse burns, and burns, and never reaches the powder.
Togashi said - when you hear the cry - run. Run.
cmdblock.name: Ghost-Guard

cmdblock.text: The Mirumoto champion fled on Togashi's prophetic order.
...The armour on the bridge.
cmdblock.name: Mirumoto Sen

cmdblock.text: He runs. He comes back. He runs.
In an alcove, a Lion samurai kneels, frozen solid, his short sword in his belly. Before him, written in his own blood on the floor, a single line.
"I have failed."
...The Matsu champion. My grandfather's grandfather's grandfather.
cmdblock.name: Matsu Hanae

cmdblock.text: The Kitsu say his spirit won't speak to us. Out of shame. I thought they were lying.
cmdblock.name: Matsu Hanae

cmdblock.text: He stayed. Whatever else he did, he stayed with it to the end.
cmdblock.name: Sayo

cmdblock.text: "I have failed."
A small room, a lacquered cradle, a brazier gone cold three hundred years ago. In the cradle, nothing. Beside it, a silver rattle.
Got Silver Rattle.
The empty cradle.
A ghost-guard bars the door to the inner hall, and looks through her as if she were not there yet. (The other ghosts in the fortress have more to show first.)
The basin hall door. Through it: a stone basin on a pedestal, heaped with red stones. Empty. Very still.
The ghost-guard at the door turns away from it, and will not look.
The child died here.
Matsu Hanae stands in the doorway, white-faced. The others behind her, silent.
...The legend is a lie. All of it. Our families' glory is built on -
cmdblock.name: Matsu Hanae

cmdblock.text: - a dead baby and a lot of brave men who did terrible things. Yes.
cmdblock.name: Sayo

cmdblock.text: Inside, the ghost-guard turns toward them. All of them. At once.

cmdblocks.text: (Rested. HP and MP restored.)

cmdblock.text: Objective: the basin hall.
The ghost at the door looks away from the basin.

M435.name: The Castle of the White Snow - the pagoda

cmdblocks.text: The ghosts draw ghost-swords. Behind them, the stone basin glows red, and something huge and green screams out of the dark above it: the shade of the Crab lord who stole the prince.
Mirumoto Hikaru steps in out of the snow and stands beside Sayo, drawing two swords.
(Mirumoto Hikaru answers the Guest call: Endless Strike, two to four cuts.)
(The basin raises the fallen every second round. Break it - it is weak to Jade, Water and Bo - or bring it down, and it ends. The guards: weak to Fire and Katana; other blades pass half through.)
The red stones go grey, one by one. The ghost-guards lower their swords and fade, bowing to the empty basin.
...Thank you, hermit.
cmdblocks.name: Sayo

cmdblocks.text: Hikaru kneels by the empty basin. For the first time in three hundred years, he speaks - a voice like a door that hasn't been opened since the world was young.
I ran.
cmdblocks.name: Mirumoto Hikaru

cmdblocks.text: Togashi told me to run, and I ran, and I have remembered it every day since.
cmdblocks.name: Mirumoto Hikaru

cmdblocks.text: He put this tattoo on me so I would live to remember. A living book.
cmdblocks.name: Mirumoto Hikaru

cmdblocks.text: I was forbidden to speak until I saw the child in its bed of stone.
cmdblocks.name: Mirumoto Hikaru

cmdblocks.text: Someone must carry it down now. Not me. I've carried it long enough.
cmdblocks.name: Mirumoto Hikaru

cmdblocks.text: Sayo tells them. All of it. The guards, the grave, the gunpowder, the run, the basin.
...If this is ever told, the Empire burns. Every clan's legend. Every throne.
cmdblocks.name: Matsu Hanae

cmdblocks.text: I'll keep the silence. On my family's name. Thank you for telling us the truth, Sayo.
cmdblocks.name: Matsu Hanae

cmdblocks.text: The ghosts were very confused. Old ghosts. Let's go down.
cmdblocks.name: Sayo

cmdblocks.text: Sayo carries it alone.
A blizzard comes down on the mountain. The legend says only one champion came down. Sayo ties every rope herself, checks every knot twice, and makes sure everyone comes down.
Why are you doing this? We treated you like a porter!
cmdblocks.name: Hida Ren

cmdblocks.text: You paid me like a porter! Porters get everyone home. That's the job.
cmdblocks.name: Sayo

cmdblocks.text: At the castle gate, Hikaru stands in the snow and does not follow.
You're not coming?
cmdblocks.name: Sayo

cmdblocks.text: I'll stay with the child. It's the first time I've chosen to.
cmdblocks.name: Mirumoto Hikaru

cmdblocks.text: He leaves something in the snow at her feet before he turns away.
Got Hikaru's Kata Scroll.
Five grandchildren of five legends walk into the Village of the Wounded Lion behind a ronin girl. All five.
Sayo. Thank you for the ropes.
cmdblocks.name: Matsu Hanae

cmdblocks.text: Matsu Hanae leaves the party.

cmdblocks.text: CHAPTER 4 - The Oracle's Choice.
Summer. The pilgrim road climbs the flank of a living volcano: the mountain of the Oracle of Fire. Pilgrims in their thousands, prayer flags, heat-shimmer on the black stone.
A letter in Sayo's sleeve, in a hand she taught to write: "Sayo. The fire says my name. Please come. - Akari."
Rank 3. A ronin may take her next technique from any ronin school whose earlier ones she holds.

cmdblocks.text: The shrine town of the Oracle of Fire, on the flank of a living volcano. The old Oracle is leaving his body. The whole Empire is watching to see who he chooses.
Thousands of pilgrims. Prayer flags. Heat-shimmer. A young eta woman in grey, hiding in a doorway, sees Sayo and runs to her: Akari.
Sayo! You came!
cmdblocks.name: Akari

cmdblocks.text: You sent for me. I came. That's how it works.
cmdblocks.name: Sayo

cmdblocks.text: The fire talks to me, Sayo. Since the spring. It says my name.
cmdblocks.name: Akari

cmdblocks.text: It says it like a lord would. I'm scared.
cmdblocks.name: Akari

cmdblocks.text: Fire's like that. Loud and full of itself. Let's find out what it wants.
cmdblocks.name: Sayo

cmdblocks.text: (Rested. HP and MP restored.)
Three kinds of people in this town are watching Akari. Sayo means to know who they are before they know her.
Objective: the shrine town. Find out who wants what - then hide Akari in the eta quarter, east.

#4#.msg: Akari keeps her hood up and her eyes on the mountain.
#4#.name: *villager-4

cmdblock.text: The Oracle will choose properly. A samurai. We'll help him choose.
cmdblock.name: Pilgrim

cmdblocks.text: A brush of sleeves. Nobody notices a ronin girl.
Got The Cipher Letter.
A cipher, and under it a careless line in plain kana: "Poison the eta well before the ascension."
...Oh, you didn't.
cmdblocks.name: Sayo

cmdblocks.text: Objective: tell Ume-baa, in the eta quarter. Then watch the well tonight.
A thief! In a holy town! A ronin thief!
cmdblocks.name: Pilgrim
