cmdblock.text: Ronin girl. You carry something from the White Snow. Give it to us, and the Order will topple a usurper.
cmdblock.name: Snake scout

cmdblock.text: Which usurper?
cmdblock.name: Sayo

cmdblock.text: The biggest one there is.
cmdblock.name: Snake scout

cmdblock.text: They don't care about Akari. They want the mountain's secret.
cmdblock.name: Sayo

cmdblock.text: The Order is patient, ronin girl.
cmdblock.name: Snake scout

cmdblock.text: An eta? Choosing an eta would be an obscenity.
cmdblock.name: Temple priest

cmdblock.text: She should go away. Quietly. Tonight.
cmdblock.name: Temple priest

cmdblock.text: Of course, holy one. Quietly. Tonight. Right.
cmdblock.name: Sayo

#12#.msg: (muttering) An eta at the crater. The ancestors would weep.
#12#.name: *villager-12

cmdblock.text: A knot of frightened pilgrims in the heat. An old woman has fainted on the stones; her daughter is crying, and the crowd is starting to push.

cmdblocks.text: Remedy-girl! Mother's walking! Everyone's calm!
cmdblocks.name: Pilgrim girl

cmdblocks.text: Sayo kneels in the dust, loosens the old woman's collar, and tucks a sliver of ginseng under her tongue. In a while the old woman sits up and asks for tea.
The ronin girl! A healer! Make way, make way for her!
cmdblocks.name: Old pilgrim

cmdblocks.text: The crowd settles. It will remember her. (The pilgrim road will make way.)

cmdblocks.text0: Remedy: ginseng under her tongue, and shade.

cmdblocks.text: (A sliver of ginseng root would do it. The herb stall sells them.)

cmdblock.text: An old priest sweeps the lower shrine. The roof above him is mostly sky.
Forty years I've swept here. The new Oracle will never come down to this shrine. Nobody fixes a roof for a broom.
cmdblock.name: Old priest

cmdblocks.text: ...Dry. You know, I'd forgotten what dry sounds like.
cmdblocks.name: Old priest

cmdblocks.text: For the roof. And a broom with all its bristles.
cmdblocks.name: Sayo

cmdblocks.text: ...Up on the switchback, above the last bend, there's a back gate into the crater shrine. Nobody uses it but me.
cmdblocks.name: Old priest

cmdblocks.text: If anyone needs to get up that mountain in a hurry, it won't be a priest.
cmdblocks.name: Old priest

cmdblocks.text: Got Back-gate Key.
Nobody fixes a roof for a broom. I did say.
cmdblocks.name: Old priest

cmdblocks.text: A quiet teahouse above the street. A snake-ringed elder pours tea for Sayo with exquisite courtesy.
A name. A house. A place. Lands, if you want them. A family.
cmdblocks.name: Snake elder

cmdblocks.text: All for one secret from the White Snow. You'll be somebody, Sayo.
cmdblocks.name: Snake elder

cmdblocks.text: Sayo opens her mouth to accept - and laughs.
A name? I've had lots of names. "Wave-girl." "Ronin's brat." "You there."
cmdblocks.name: Sayo

cmdblocks.text: Sayo's the only one I picked. I'll keep it.
cmdblocks.name: Sayo

cmdblocks.text: ...The Voice said you'd say that.
cmdblocks.name: Snake elder

cmdblocks.text: And that you'd keep the secret even from us. The Voice was pleased.
cmdblocks.name: Snake elder

cmdblocks.text: Midnight. The old Oracle ascends at dawn. Two dozen Scorpion knives are on the rooftops.
Objective: Akari, in the eta quarter. Get her to the crater shrine before dawn.

#18#.msg: The mountain's been grumbling since the spring. Mother says it's clearing its throat.

cmdblock.text: The temple has twenty archers on the crater wall and nothing to shoot. Pilgrims, mostly. Hire me and I'll find something that deserves an arrow.
cmdblock.name: Crater-shrine Archer

cmdblocks.text: Your current hireling heads home.
Three arrows. Then I go back to the wall and pretend I never left.
cmdblocks.name: Crater-shrine Archer

cmdblocks.text: Crater-shrine Archer follows Sayo. (In battle: Support. 3 uses, then home to the lower shrine.)
Coin first, Sayo. Ronin pay up front.
cmdblocks.name: Crater-shrine Archer

cmdblock.text: I came to watch an Oracle die. It's taking him an age. Fire always dawdles. Wind doesn't. Hire me, and I'll show you.
cmdblock.name: Isawa Wind-Priest

cmdblocks.text: Your current hireling heads home.
Three winds. Then I go back to waiting for the old man.
cmdblocks.name: Isawa Wind-Priest

cmdblocks.text: The eta quarter, under the shrine town: mud walls, thatch, and the smell of tanning vats. The pilgrims stop at the edge of it as if at a cliff.
Hiro stands at the gate, enormous and toothless, his rusty no-dachi over his shoulder. And on a stool in a doorway, a tiny old woman in grey smoking a long pipe: Ume-baa.
There's my girl. Thinner. Taller. Same stupid hat.
cmdblocks.name: Ume-baa

cmdblocks.text: Ume-baa!
cmdblocks.name: Sayo

cmdblocks.text: You're the one the fire's shouting at. Come in, child. Fire can't shout through mud walls.
cmdblocks.name: Ume-baa

cmdblocks.text: Inside, by the hearth, Ume-baa takes Sayo's hands in her own.
Samurai doctors heal from across the room so they don't have to touch you.
cmdblocks.name: Ume-baa

cmdblocks.text: We heal from here. Let me teach you the bit they won't.
cmdblocks.name: Ume-baa

cmdblocks.text: Sayo learns Anatomy, the low knowledge. (Diagnosis, in her Remedy list: hands on one ally - the next Remedy on them is one tier stronger.)
Hiro sits down by the fire and holds out his arm. Three claw marks, red and swollen.
Hold still, Hiro.
cmdblocks.name: Sayo

cmdblocks.text: ...It's quieter. The tiger. It's quieter.
cmdblocks.name: Hiro

cmdblocks.text: For now.
cmdblocks.name: Sayo

cmdblocks.text: (Hiro's side story "The Tiger in the Blood" will open after this chapter.)
Rhubarb. Moxa. You'll want them. Things are going to go wrong in this town; they always do when lords come to watch.
cmdblocks.name: Ume-baa

cmdblocks.text: Got Rhubarb x2.
Got Moxa x2.
Hiro will answer the Guest call in battle. (One guest at a time.)
Objective: the cipher said the well. Wait for night at the lane, east.
Objective: the pilgrims in good sandals are up to something. (Pilfer the one in the street.) Then the well, at night.

cmdblock.text: Fire's just an old man shouting. You've dealt with those.
cmdblock.name: Ume-baa

cmdblock.text: It's still saying my name. Louder at night.
cmdblock.name: Akari

cmdblock.text: Sayo. It's time. I can feel it. Dawn.
cmdblock.name: Akari

cmdblock.text: Two dozen of them on the roofs. I counted. I can count past two dozen.
cmdblock.name: Hiro

cmdblock.text: Get Akari to the crater shrine before dawn. Three battles in a row, no rest between them - items and Remedy only.

cmdblock.text0: The pilgrim road: crowded; fewer fights.
cmdblock.text1: The cliff path: faster; two more fights.

cmdblock.text: Up we go. Don't let go of me, and don't drop the ginseng.
cmdblock.name: Sayo

cmdblocks.text: Night. The eta quarter's well. Figures in pilgrim robes are pouring something into it.
Poison the well, and the priests say the eta are unclean, and the fire's choice is "a curse".
cmdblocks.name: Sayo

cmdblocks.text: (Scorpion agents: weak to Yumi and Katana. They run when it hurts.)
The well water is already darkening.
Sayo's basket is empty. Ume-baa hobbles up out of the dark with her own.
Rhubarb and Moxa: a purge that spreads. Sayo grinds them together on the well's lip.
Rhubarb. Moxa. And a pinch of spite.
cmdblocks.name: Sayo

cmdblocks.text: The dark goes out of the water like a held breath let go.

In the crowd that gathers at the well's edge: a lovely woman in Scorpion grey, whispering to an agent. Later, in a priest's robe, whispering to a priest. Later still, a snake ring on her wrist, whispering to a scout. The same smile each time.
...Same smile. Three faces.
cmdblocks.name: Sayo

cmdblocks.text: Nobody hides from a ronin girl. We're not worth hiding from.
cmdblocks.name: Sayo

cmdblocks.text: (Rested. HP and MP restored.)

cmdblocks.text: The crowd on the pilgrim road parts for them. Someone presses water and rice balls into Sayo's hands as she passes.
On the switchback, five young samurai in bright clan colours push through the pilgrims.
Ronin! Sayo! Go - we'll hold this one!
cmdblocks.name: Matsu Hanae

cmdblocks.text: My lady! Thank you for the ropes!
cmdblocks.name: Sayo

cmdblocks.text: Go!
cmdblocks.name: Matsu Hanae

cmdblocks.text: Above the last bend: the crater shrine's back gate, iron-bound, nobody's road but a priest's.
Sayo turns the old priest's key in the lock. The gate swings, and the last switchback goes by underneath them.
The first switchback. The stair is narrow, and the drop is long. They are waiting.
The cliff path: a ledge of black stone over nothing, the town's lanterns far below.
Above the last bend: the crater shrine's back gate, iron-bound, nobody's road but a priest's.
Sayo turns the old priest's key in the lock. The gate swings, and the last switchback goes by underneath them.
The last of them, on the last ledge before the crater.

cmdblock.text: The path on is narrow. (They are still behind you.)

cmdblocks.text: A stone lantern at the top of the stair, its flame lit from the crater itself.
Sayo - I can't - the fire's so loud -
cmdblocks.name: Akari

cmdblocks.text: Then shout back! Tell it to wait for us!
cmdblocks.name: Sayo

cmdblocks.text: WAIT FOR US!
cmdblocks.name: Akari

cmdblocks.text: The mountain rumbles. It sounds, almost, like it's laughing.
(Rested. HP and MP restored.)
Objective: the crater, at the top.
At the top of the stair, blocking the way: a great serpent-bodied warrior in a pearl-white robe, spear lowered. The Great Naga's champion - the Order's guardian.
The Order guards the true lines. The choice must be the right one.
cmdblocks.name: Naga champion

cmdblocks.text: It is. (pointing at Akari) There's a true line. It goes from her to the fire.
cmdblocks.name: Sayo

cmdblocks.text: Guard that.
cmdblocks.name: Sayo

cmdblocks.text: (The Naga's champion: weak to Air, Yari and Fire; resists Water. He is not evil. Break him, and he may listen.)
The champion lowers his spear and coils aside.
(Honor +1)
The champion sinks onto his coils, breathing like the sea, and lets them pass.
Something round and cool lies on the stair where he coiled. A pearl.
Got the Naga Pearl.
Dawn is a red line on the crater's rim.

cmdblocks.text: The crater shrine, at the lip of the fire. The old Oracle of Fire stands at the edge, ancient, half-made of flame. Dawn breaks.
You brought her. Good. I was getting impatient. Fire always is.
cmdblocks.name: Oracle of Fire

cmdblocks.text: He holds out a burning hand. Akari, shaking, takes it.
The old Oracle becomes light and rises into the dawn like a spark from a bonfire, and is gone.
Akari stands at the crater's edge. The flames in the pit bow toward her. The priests who climbed behind them fall to their knees. Some weep. Some look furious.
Sayo.
cmdblocks.name: Akari

cmdblocks.text: ...It still says my name like a lord.
cmdblocks.name: Akari

cmdblocks.text: But it says yours like a friend.
cmdblocks.name: Akari

cmdblocks.text: She holds out something small and warm: an ember, caught in a twist of iron.
For you. It won't make you anything. It'll just keep you warm. And light, if you need it.
cmdblocks.name: Akari

cmdblocks.text: Got the Ember Charm.
(Ember Charm: once a battle, its wearer can Spark - a small Fire hit - or Rekindle a fallen ally.)
...That's all I ever wanted from fire, honestly.
cmdblocks.name: Sayo

cmdblocks.text: The descent. Sayo turns the snake beads in one hand and the ember in the other.
Three hundred years of emperors, descended from a peasant.
cmdblocks.name: Sayo

cmdblocks.text: I could start a war with one sentence. I'll keep it. For the villagers who'd die in it.
cmdblocks.name: Sayo

cmdblocks.text: For Old Mosuke's rice cakes.
cmdblocks.name: Sayo

cmdblocks.text: ...And for my family.
cmdblocks.name: Sayo

cmdblocks.text: "The Oracle's Choice" - complete.

An eta woman the fire called by name, a poisoned well, a race up a burning mountain, and a serpent that lowered its spear. Sayo didn't become the Oracle. She got her friend there alive - and finally chose a family.
(Sayo's road is walked. Hiro's "The Tiger in the Blood" waits for her in Cakon. And at Rank 4, Lv 51: her fourth ronin technique.)

cmdblock.text: The smoke over Osano-Wo is east. Everyone you'd go back for is here now.

cmdblocks.text: The Plains of Thunder, at the end of the Month of the Monkey, 1123.
A Shadowlands host marches out of the Shinomen Mori toward a shrine full of monks, peasants, and jade.
And eight people, on eight roads, who were not sent by anyone.
Where the roads cross the plain, eight figures arrive from eight directions. They stop, and look at each other.
Nobody sent me. I followed smoke.
cmdblocks.name: Hiruma Natsuko

cmdblocks.text: Nobody sent me either. Lady Sanae suggested it. Strongly.
cmdblocks.name: Kakita Rensei

cmdblocks.text: I followed a map of everywhere she's been. It points here.
cmdblocks.name: Kitsuki Gendo

cmdblocks.text: And here.
cmdblocks.name: Akodo Shizue

cmdblocks.text: Mieko's book said she'd come from the forest.
cmdblocks.name: Isawa Haruki

cmdblocks.text: I was in the area.
cmdblocks.name: Shosuro Mitsue

cmdblocks.text: I was delivering. Somebody has to bring the jade.
cmdblocks.name: Ide Tamotsu

cmdblocks.text: I came because you'd all be here. Obviously.
cmdblocks.name: Sayo

cmdblocks.text: Travel Banter: "Eight Roads"
Eight of us.
cmdblocks.name: Hiruma Natsuko

cmdblocks.text: "Seven mortals will rise." That's what the prophecy said.
cmdblocks.name: Kitsuki Gendo

cmdblocks.text: Then one of us is extra. Hope it's me. I've never been extra before.
cmdblocks.name: Sayo

cmdblocks.text: Eight! I'll wait at the shrine and count the ninth. There's always a ninth. It's usually me.
cmdblocks.name: Togashi Yosai

cmdblocks.text: The eight travel together now: two parties of four. Party A walks and fights; Party B keeps pace and waits its turn. (Swap them at an inn or a save shrine, and at the shrine's stockade gate between waves. Whoever steps in has kept up: they share the party's level.)
${::Rokugan.fSummary()}
Objective: the Shrine of Osano-Wo, east across the plain.

cmdblock.text: A burned village: black posts, a well, a cat that won't come out.
They came out of the forest a week ago. Goblins first. Then ogres with a tree for a ram. Then things I don't have names for.
cmdblock.name: Shrine peasant

cmdblock.text: Everyone who could walk went to the shrine. The monks have jade. The monks have jade, and walls, and they laugh at everything. I hope it helps.
cmdblock.name: Shrine peasant

#5#.msg: (running west with a jade pouch for the villages) The abbot says hurry and don't die. In that order.
#5#.name: *villager-5

cmdblock.text: A small stone shrine to the Fortunes, half buried in the rock. Someone left it a rice ball.

cmdblocks.text: (Rested. HP and MP restored.)

cmdblock.text: A boulder the lightning split clean in two. Something pale is wedged deep in the crack. (Athletics)

cmdblocks.text: Someone braces their back against one half and their feet against the other, and inches down into the dark. It smells of burned air.
Wedged in the stone: a bow of pale wood, unwarped, faintly shining.
Got the Moonlit Yumi.

cmdblock.text: The split rock. Empty now.
A Unicorn rider sits his horse at the side of the road, in white death-paint, watching the plain. Moto Benjiro.
The Moto rode into the Shadowlands once, long ago, and came back wrong. Our undead reflection.
cmdblock.name: Moto Benjiro

cmdblock.text: Every Moto who dies there risks becoming one of them. So we ride in, in white death-paint, to die well before it can take us.
cmdblock.name: Moto Benjiro

cmdblock.text: A pause.
I've ridden in four times. I keep coming back. I don't know why the Fortunes won't let me die.
cmdblock.name: Moto Benjiro

cmdblock.text: Out on the plain, something white is riding. Not toward the shrine. Toward Benjiro.
...That's my father's saddle.
cmdblock.name: Moto Benjiro

cmdblocks.text: (Moto Benjiro answers the Guest call.)
The dead rider comes apart in the grass like smoke from a snuffed lamp. Benjiro kneels beside what's left.
...I think the Fortunes kept me alive to do that. To bring him home.
cmdblocks.name: Moto Benjiro

cmdblocks.text: Then maybe stop riding in to die. Ride in to bring people home.
cmdblocks.name: Hiruma Natsuko

cmdblocks.text: A slow smile. The death-paint cracks.
...That's a much better reason.
cmdblocks.name: Moto Benjiro

cmdblocks.text: He wipes the paint off his face with his sleeve, and doesn't put it back.
(Moto Benjiro's Death Trance: 3 uses a battle now.)
He always was the better rider. Again.
cmdblocks.name: Moto Benjiro

cmdblocks.text: He's not going anywhere. Neither am I.
cmdblocks.name: Moto Benjiro

cmdblocks.text: The Shrine of Osano-Wo: a stockade of black timber on the open plain, a hundred monks, the villages' peasants, and storehouses of powdered jade.
The monk-abbot opens the gate. Behind him, in a lay brother's grey, his ribs still bandaged: Jinnai.
Wave-girl. You brought friends.
cmdblocks.name: Jinnai

cmdblocks.text: You said the thunder monks were hard to kill.
cmdblocks.name: Sayo

cmdblocks.text: We're about to find out.
cmdblocks.name: Jinnai

cmdblocks.text: Seven travelers and a ronin. Eight. Good. Osano-Wo laughed at death, and death got bored first. Shop. Eat. Sleep a little. They come at dusk.
cmdblocks.name: Abbot of Osano-Wo

cmdblocks.text: Jinnai will answer the Guest call in battle. (One guest at a time.)
Objective: the stockade gate, east, when everyone is ready. (Seven waves; the parties change places at the gate after each. The pilgrim hall is full of the wounded once the fighting starts.)

#6#.name: *villager-6

cmdblock.text: Osano-Wo was the son of Thunder. He laughed at death. We practise.
cmdblock.name: Abbot of Osano-Wo

cmdblock.text: Hold the gate, and I'll hold the abbey. I'm old. I'm very hard to move.
cmdblock.name: Abbot of Osano-Wo

cmdblock.text: Four days. Go and come back. We'll keep the jade warm.
cmdblock.name: Abbot of Osano-Wo

cmdblock.text: The mountain's secret, the Order, the Voice. Tonight it's goblins. Goblins I understand.
cmdblock.name: Jinnai

cmdblock.text: The forest is worse than the plain. I'll be behind you. Call, and I'll come.
cmdblock.name: Jinnai

#11#.msg: (guarding the jade stores with a bo and a grin) Every goblin wants jade. None of them want it the way we give it.

Goblins! The first wave's always goblins. It's tradition.

cmdblocks.text: You took a good man's name.

Scout! You'll walk beside me - so I came to walk beside you!

(The many-legged horror: weak to Fire, Jade and Yumi.)
Smoke. Silence. The horde breaks and flees into the forest.
Out of the smoke walks a lovely herald in red silk, untouched by soot. Her eyes are very blue.
The Empress congratulates you.

cmdblocks.text: She awaits you in Shinomen. Four days.

cmdblocks.text: Or this shrine burns, and everyone in it.

cmdblocks.text: You're not even bothering to change the smile anymore.

cmdblocks.text: The Shrine of Osano-Wo. The day before the finale.
(The finale is cleared. It can be played again from the Shinomen, for the other ally shots and codas. Two more roads open from the shrine gate: the deep Shadowlands, and a storm off the Crane coast.)

cmdblock.text: A Crab rider at the shrine gate, mud to the knees: the Kaiu Wall has opened its Shinomen gate. The Hida are sending scouts into the deep Shadowlands, past anywhere on the maps.
(The post-game: the deep Shadowlands, Lv 61+. Recommended level 61.)

cmdblock.text0: Ride south to the Wall. (Three days)

cmdblock.text: A Crane ship's master, ashore at the shrine for jade, with a sailor who won't stop talking.
I saw it. In the storm off the coast. It had eyes. Waves don't have eyes!
cmdblock.name: Sailor

cmdblock.text: He's been saying that for a year. ...I've started to believe him. I'll take you out there, if you want to look. I'm not staying to watch.
cmdblock.name: Ship's master

cmdblock.text: (A superboss: the Orochi. Recommended level 95+.)

cmdblock.text0: Sail out to the storm. (Two days)

cmdblock.text: Osano-Wo was the son of the Thunder and he laughed at death. We try to keep up. Hire me, and I'll laugh for you.
cmdblock.name: Osano-Wo Thunder Monk

cmdblocks.text: Your current hireling heads home.
Three claps of thunder. Then I go back and laugh at the abbot's cooking.
cmdblocks.name: Osano-Wo Thunder Monk

cmdblocks.text: Osano-Wo Thunder Monk follows the travelers. (In battle: Support. 3 uses, then home to the thunder shrine.)
Coin first. Even heroes pay up front.
cmdblocks.name: Osano-Wo Thunder Monk

cmdblock.text: I walked the jade carts up from the Wall. Then the goblins came, so I stayed. Jade-tipped arrows. They don't like it. Hire me.
cmdblock.name: Hida Jade Archer

cmdblocks.text: Your current hireling heads home.
Three jade arrows. They're expensive. Make them count.
cmdblocks.name: Hida Jade Archer

cmdblocks.text: Hida Jade Archer follows the travelers. (In battle: Support. 3 uses, then home to the jade stores.)
Coin first. Even heroes pay up front.
cmdblocks.name: Hida Jade Archer

cmdblock.text: Two letters, two insults, two armies. Somebody is very good at arithmetic.
cmdblock.name: Togashi Yosai

cmdblocks.text: Excellent. If I die, tell them I was taller.
cmdblocks.name: Togashi Yosai

cmdblocks.text: Togashi Yosai joins the party. (Dragon's Breath, Arrowroot; his tattoos heal him a little every turn.)
I'll be here. Probably. Statistically.
cmdblocks.name: Togashi Yosai

cmdblocks.text: You've already got company. I'll keep the bench warm. Benches love me.
cmdblocks.name: Togashi Yosai

cmdblock.text: Back to the Shrine of Osano-Wo.

cmdblocks.text: The next morning. The edge of the Shinomen Mori: a wall of green older than the Empire, and no birds in it.
At the treeline, tied to a stake: a one-handed nezumi, scarred, trembling.
Guide! Stich'Kik good-good guide! Knows forest!
cmdblocks.name: Stich'Kik

cmdblocks.text: Take you to the glade.
cmdblocks.name: Stich'Kik

cmdblocks.text: A beat. Very small:
Then kill. After. Yes? Kill-kill after.
cmdblocks.name: Stich'Kik

cmdblocks.text: Why?
cmdblocks.name: Hiruma Natsuko

cmdblocks.text: Because she find me again. If you don't.
cmdblocks.name: Stich'Kik

cmdblocks.text: A small furred shape pushes past Natsuko's legs: Squeak, who has followed her all the way from the Wall.
No-kill! Come-come live in dry-cave! Is nice! Has eggs!
cmdblocks.name: Squeak

cmdblocks.text: ...Eggs?
cmdblocks.name: Stich'Kik

cmdblocks.text: Scout-who-fights-at-night bring eggs. Every week.
cmdblocks.name: Squeak

cmdblocks.text: ...No. I'm not doing it. You're coming home with the rats.
cmdblocks.name: Hiruma Natsuko

cmdblocks.text: Natsuko cuts the rope.
(After the forest, Stich'Kik will go home with Squeak, to the nezumi of the Egg Caves.)
There's a dry cave near my Wall post. Nobody uses it. You can have it.
cmdblocks.name: Hiruma Natsuko

cmdblocks.text: ...Dry. Dry cave.
cmdblocks.name: Stich'Kik

cmdblocks.text: Glade is there. Four days. Three, if nobody eats us.
cmdblocks.name: Stich'Kik

cmdblocks.text: Objective: through the Shinomen Mori to the glade. Stich'Kik leads.

cmdblocks.text: Across the path, through the moss and the ferns: a furrow as wide as a cart, pressed smooth, and another beside it. Scales the size of hands, shed in the mud.
The Naga are waking.
cmdblocks.name: Sayo

cmdblocks.text: I met one. On a mountain. It lowered its spear for me.
cmdblocks.name: Sayo

cmdblocks.text: From the trees, a pearl-and-bronze shape watches. It inclines its head, and is gone.
Snake-folk. Old-old. Not hers. Not anybody's.
cmdblocks.name: Stich'Kik

cmdblocks.text: A clearing. In the middle, carved out of a living tree: a kneeling samurai, a knife in his belly, his face a sneer. The sap has run down the cut like blood.
The inscription, in a lovely court hand: "Here is your bushido. Honestly."
Somebody's very proud of their carving.
cmdblocks.name: Hiruma Natsuko

cmdblocks.text: It's badly proportioned.
cmdblocks.name: Kakita Rensei

cmdblocks.text: Evidence of an extremely insecure author.
cmdblocks.name: Kitsuki Gendo

cmdblocks.text: Trying to make us doubt before we arrive. An old move.
cmdblocks.name: Akodo Shizue

cmdblocks.text: It's sad. Someone carved all this, all alone, out of anger.
cmdblocks.name: Isawa Haruki

cmdblocks.text: I've seen better propaganda in the Scorpion nursery.
cmdblocks.name: Shosuro Mitsue

cmdblocks.text: Shall we leave a rice cake? It looks hungry.
cmdblocks.name: Ide Tamotsu

cmdblocks.text: Nobody made me swear to it. So it can't mock me.
cmdblocks.name: Sayo

cmdblocks.text: She walks past. One by one, so do the others.

cmdblock.text: "Here is your bushido. Honestly." The sap has dried.

cmdblocks.text: (Kumo brood: weak to Fire. The oni spawn: weak to Jade.)

cmdblock.text: A wall of roots, too regular to have grown that way, over an opening in the hillside. Behind it, a cold breath of the sea. (Tremor: an Earth spell can shake it loose.)

cmdblocks.text: The ground hums. The roots shiver, loosen, and fall away like a curtain.
Behind them: a little shrine of green stone, carved with coils. A Naga shrine, older than the forest. Two pearls in the offering bowl.

Got the Spawn Pearl.
...Thank you.

cmdblocks.text: A campfire in the forest, where there should be no one. An old hermit sits by it, roasting something on a stick.
His shadow on the trees behind him has far too many legs.
...Kumo. Old-old Kumo.
cmdblocks.name: Stich'Kik

cmdblocks.text: Visitors. In my forest.
cmdblocks.name: Mamoru

cmdblocks.text: He looks up.
Sit, or don't.
cmdblocks.name: Mamoru

cmdblocks.text: We are eight, grandfather, and we apologise for it.
cmdblocks.name: Kakita Rensei

cmdblocks.text: Jasmine. From the Unicorn trade. The good kind.
cmdblocks.name: Ide Tamotsu

cmdblocks.text: ...Polite. Very rare, in this forest.
cmdblocks.name: Mamoru

cmdblocks.text: You go to the glade. To her.
cmdblocks.name: Mamoru

cmdblocks.text: A word, for the tea.
cmdblocks.name: Mamoru

cmdblocks.text: He leans close. His eyes are many.
She can only hold one mind at a time.
cmdblocks.name: Mamoru

cmdblocks.text: Speak with two voices, and she hears neither.
cmdblocks.name: Mamoru

cmdblocks.text: That's all. Mind the roots. They bite.
cmdblocks.name: Mamoru

cmdblocks.text: (Mamoru's word: "Two Voices". Remember it when you face her.)
Hm.
cmdblocks.name: Mamoru

cmdblocks.text: The shadow on the trees stands up. The shadows on the other trees stand up too.
(Kumo: weak to Fire.)
When the last spider falls, the fire is out and the hermit is gone. Somewhere in the trees, someone sighs, unimpressed.

cmdblocks.text0: "May we share your fire, grandfather? We brought tea."

cmdblocks.text: Objective: the glade. Stich'Kik says it is close now. He has stopped talking.

cmdblock.text: Tea was good. Go on. She's waiting, and she hates waiting.
cmdblock.name: Mamoru

cmdblocks.text: A glade of terrible beauty: flowers made of something that isn't petal, a pool that reflects the sky wrong.
Nailed to the largest tree: a plaque. Old, Lion-made. "DUTY."
...The plaque from Shiro Akodo. The one that was never found.
cmdblocks.name: Akodo Shizue

cmdblocks.text: She takes it down, very carefully, and holds it.
I'll carry it the rest of the way.
cmdblocks.name: Akodo Shizue

cmdblocks.text: Got the "Duty" Plaque.
Here. Glade. Stich'Kik not go further. Not ever.
cmdblocks.name: Stich'Kik

cmdblocks.text: You don't have to. Wait for us at the shrine.
cmdblocks.name: Hiruma Natsuko

cmdblocks.text: ...And then dry-cave. With eggs.
cmdblocks.name: Stich'Kik

cmdblocks.text: ...And then dry cave.
cmdblocks.name: Stich'Kik

cmdblocks.text: He goes back the way they came, fast, and doesn't look back.
Objective: the Empress waits beyond the flowers.

cmdblocks.text: The heart of the glade. On a mat of something leathery, in the loveliest form any of them has seen, a woman receives them as if at court.
Doji Nashiko.
My guests. At last.
cmdblocks.name: Doji Nashiko

cmdblocks.text: You've been chasing me through eight little stories. Aren't you tired?
cmdblocks.name: Doji Nashiko

cmdblocks.text: Sit. Let's talk about your code.
cmdblocks.name: Doji Nashiko

cmdblocks.text: The debate: she will strike each of you through your clan's weakest virtue, then attack its strongest. Answer from your own story. Each strong answer breaks one of her eight shields for the battle to come.
Courage - Hiruma Natsuko.
You've never once been courteous, scout. You blunder through every court.
cmdblocks.name: Doji Nashiko

cmdblocks.text: ...No. I haven't.
cmdblocks.name: Hiruma Natsuko

cmdblocks.text: And your courage? Following the path every Crab follows - onto the Wall to die - that's not courage. That's habit.
cmdblocks.name: Doji Nashiko

cmdblocks.text: Courage isn't following the path everyone walks.
cmdblocks.name: Hiruma Natsuko

cmdblocks.text: It's walking back into the dark every morning because someone has to.
cmdblocks.name: Hiruma Natsuko

cmdblocks.text: Something in the glade cracks like glaze. (One of her eight shields breaks.)
The Crab are brave.
cmdblocks.name: Hiruma Natsuko

cmdblocks.text: The Crab are stubborn. It isn't the same.
cmdblocks.name: Doji Nashiko

cmdblocks.text: (A weak answer. Her shield holds.)

cmdblocks.text0: Her father's road. Kage. The nezumi.

cmdblocks.text: Courtesy - Kakita Rensei.
A Crane boy who shook at his father's voice. Brave?
cmdblocks.name: Doji Nashiko

cmdblocks.text: ...I shook.
cmdblocks.name: Kakita Rensei

cmdblocks.text: And courtesy - a mask for knives. Ask me. I was the most courteous woman at Komatsu's court.
cmdblocks.name: Doji Nashiko

cmdblocks.text: Courtesy is beautiful.
cmdblocks.name: Kakita Rensei

cmdblocks.text: So am I, little Crane. Look where it got me.
cmdblocks.name: Doji Nashiko

cmdblocks.text: (A weak answer. Her shield holds.)
Etiquette can be a mask for knives.
cmdblocks.name: Kakita Rensei

cmdblocks.text: It's also the only thing that keeps two enemies at one table long enough to stop a war.
cmdblocks.name: Kakita Rensei

cmdblocks.text: And I've read your play, my lady. Every scene.
cmdblocks.name: Kakita Rensei

cmdblocks.text: She flinches.
My what?
cmdblocks.name: Doji Nashiko

cmdblocks.text: Something in the glade cracks like glaze. (One of her eight shields breaks.)

cmdblocks.text1: Two enemies at one table: the war that didn't start.

cmdblocks.text: Sincerity - Kitsuki Gendo.
A clerk who abandoned his post to play in the past.
cmdblocks.name: Doji Nashiko

cmdblocks.text: I filed for leave.
cmdblocks.name: Kitsuki Gendo

cmdblocks.text: Every clan asks its samurai to lie. Sincerity is just lying well.
cmdblocks.name: Doji Nashiko

cmdblocks.text: Every clan asks its samurai to lie. I've lied too - to protect a truth bigger than me.
cmdblocks.name: Kitsuki Gendo

cmdblocks.text: Sincerity isn't never lying. It's knowing exactly what the lie costs, and paying it yourself.
cmdblocks.name: Kitsuki Gendo

cmdblocks.text: I gave up being remembered rather than lie about who saved that city.
cmdblocks.name: Kitsuki Gendo

cmdblocks.text: Something in the glade cracks like glaze. (One of her eight shields breaks.)
The Kitsuki never lie.
cmdblocks.name: Kitsuki Gendo

cmdblocks.text: That's a lie, magistrate. A small one. Well done.
cmdblocks.name: Doji Nashiko

cmdblocks.text: (A weak answer. Her shield holds.)

cmdblocks.text0: The lie he told to protect a truth bigger than himself.

cmdblocks.text: Honor - Akodo Shizue.
Cold little strategist. Do you feel anything, or only count?
cmdblocks.name: Doji Nashiko

cmdblocks.text: ...Sometimes I only count.
cmdblocks.name: Akodo Shizue

cmdblocks.text: Honour is a word lords use to keep you in line. Your cousin started a war in its name.
cmdblocks.name: Doji Nashiko

cmdblocks.text: Shizue sets the "Duty" plaque on the mat between them.
I've seen my cousin start a war in its name. Honour isn't what my lord calls it.
cmdblocks.name: Akodo Shizue

cmdblocks.text: It's what I answer for when no one is watching.
cmdblocks.name: Akodo Shizue

cmdblocks.text: I told my Champion the Lion charged first. Nobody would ever have known.
cmdblocks.name: Akodo Shizue

cmdblocks.text: Something in the glade cracks like glaze. (One of her eight shields breaks.)
The Lion have never lost their honour.
cmdblocks.name: Akodo Shizue

cmdblocks.text: Sorrow's Path, little Akodo. Count the bodies.
cmdblocks.name: Doji Nashiko

cmdblocks.text: (A weak answer. Her shield holds.)

cmdblocks.text0: Set the "Duty" plaque on the mat between them.
cmdblocks.text1: "The Lion have never lost their honour."

cmdblocks.text: Righteousness - Isawa Haruki.
You hid your crime for twelve years, little Void. Sincere?
cmdblocks.name: Doji Nashiko

cmdblocks.text: ...No. I wasn't.
cmdblocks.name: Isawa Haruki

cmdblocks.text: And where is justice? The guilty walk free while their retainers die for them.
cmdblocks.name: Doji Nashiko

cmdblocks.text: The Elemental Masters will judge you.
cmdblocks.name: Isawa Haruki

cmdblocks.text: They never judged you. Why would they start with me?
cmdblocks.name: Doji Nashiko

cmdblocks.text: (A weak answer. Her shield holds.)
No court ever judged me for what I did at eight. So I judged myself.
cmdblocks.name: Isawa Haruki

cmdblocks.text: And I spent my life setting it right. That is righteousness: not waiting for someone else to do what's just.
cmdblocks.name: Isawa Haruki

cmdblocks.text: I gave her back what I took. It cost me. It was supposed to.
cmdblocks.name: Isawa Haruki

cmdblocks.text: Something in the glade cracks like glaze. (One of her eight shields breaks.)

cmdblocks.text1: What he did at eight, and the life he spent setting it right.

cmdblocks.text: Duty and Loyalty - Shosuro Mitsue.
A Scorpion with no honour at all. Nobody knows your name.
cmdblocks.name: Doji Nashiko

cmdblocks.text: That's rather the point.
cmdblocks.name: Shosuro Mitsue

cmdblocks.text: Lords never pay for their failures. You pay. And your Champion - oh, I know what he's planning. Do you?
cmdblocks.name: Doji Nashiko

cmdblocks.text: Mitsue's smile stays. Her eyes don't.
(Every garrison. Toward the capital. The Month of the Rooster.)
I'm sure I've no idea, my lady.
cmdblocks.name: Shosuro Mitsue

cmdblocks.text: Lords never pay for their failures? Mine will. And I'll be there.
cmdblocks.name: Shosuro Mitsue

cmdblocks.text: Because duty isn't a leash. It's the promise I keep even when I know exactly what it will cost - and I know better than anyone here.
cmdblocks.name: Shosuro Mitsue

cmdblocks.text: You threw the Iron Box into a volcano? It would have made you anyone.
cmdblocks.name: Doji Nashiko

cmdblocks.text: I'd rather be someone.
cmdblocks.name: Shosuro Mitsue

cmdblocks.text: Something in the glade cracks like glaze. (One of her eight shields breaks.)
A Scorpion serves. That's all.
cmdblocks.name: Shosuro Mitsue

cmdblocks.text: A dog serves, Mitsue. Even a dog bites, sometimes.
cmdblocks.name: Doji Nashiko

cmdblocks.text: (A weak answer. Her shield holds.)

cmdblocks.text0: The promise she keeps, knowing exactly what it will cost.

cmdblocks.text: Compassion - Ide Tamotsu.
The Ide's famous manners. Bought, like everything Unicorn.
cmdblocks.name: Doji Nashiko

cmdblocks.text: Some of them were on sale.
cmdblocks.name: Ide Tamotsu

cmdblocks.text: Lords starve villages and sell daughters and call it order.
cmdblocks.name: Doji Nashiko

cmdblocks.text: The Unicorn are generous traders.
cmdblocks.name: Ide Tamotsu

cmdblocks.text: Generous at a price. Everything has one. Name mine.
cmdblocks.name: Doji Nashiko

cmdblocks.text: (A weak answer. Her shield holds.)
Lords sell daughters and starve villages, and call it order. I've stood in the camps, lady.
cmdblocks.name: Ide Tamotsu

cmdblocks.text: Compassion isn't pretending the world is kind. It's the rice you hand over anyway, even when there's no profit in it - especially then.
cmdblocks.name: Ide Tamotsu

cmdblocks.text: I made a nameless boy a bridge between two houses that tried to kill each other. Profit: zero.
cmdblocks.name: Ide Tamotsu

cmdblocks.text: Something in the glade cracks like glaze. (One of her eight shields breaks.)

cmdblocks.text1: The camps, and the rice handed over anyway.

cmdblocks.text: The last word - Sayo.
And you. No lord. No clan. No virtue to defend.
cmdblocks.name: Doji Nashiko

cmdblocks.text: Bushido is a child's dream. You of all people know it.
cmdblocks.name: Doji Nashiko

cmdblocks.text: Maybe.
cmdblocks.name: Sayo

cmdblocks.text: Nobody ever made me swear to it. No lord. No clan.
cmdblocks.name: Sayo

cmdblocks.text: I picked it up anyway.
cmdblocks.name: Sayo

cmdblocks.text: A pause.
That's what makes it real.
cmdblocks.name: Sayo

cmdblocks.text: Something in the glade cracks like glaze. (One of her eight shields breaks.)
Bushido is real. The clans say so.
cmdblocks.name: Sayo

cmdblocks.text: The clans say a great many things, child. They said your father was nobody.
cmdblocks.name: Doji Nashiko

cmdblocks.text: (A weak answer. Her shield holds.)

cmdblocks.text1: "Bushido is real. The clans say so."

cmdblocks.text: ...A peasant's daughter. Lecturing an Empress.
cmdblocks.name: Doji Nashiko

cmdblocks.text: Ronin's daughter.
cmdblocks.name: Sayo

cmdblocks.text: A pause.
And you're not an Empress. You never were.
cmdblocks.name: Sayo

cmdblocks.text: That's the whole play.
cmdblocks.name: Sayo

cmdblocks.text: Act three. Scene two.
cmdblocks.name: Kakita Rensei

cmdblocks.text: She rises. Her beauty cracks like glaze.
WHAT PLAY?
cmdblocks.name: Doji Nashiko

cmdblocks.text: She rises. Her beauty cracks like glaze.
(Her shields broken: ${::rpgvar["G1189"]} of eight.)
The Empress rises.
Act 4 - "The Empress of Nothing".
(Party A fights the first phase. Party B fights the second. Choose your best four, of all eight, for the third. Shields broken in the debate are already gone.)
${::Rokugan.fFight()}
She rises into the air on wings of smoke.
You'll be my court. All of you. On your knees, forever.
cmdblocks.name: Doji Nashiko

cmdblocks.text: Two samurai step out of the trees behind her, swords drawn, eyes on her and nowhere else: her seduced champions. Her wounds will open on them. (Blood Shouting)
(She turns invisible. Crystal or jade finds her.)
The Bride rises out of reach, laughing. Her champions sit down in the poppies, blinking, freed.
Party B steps in.
${::Rokugan.fFight()}
The glade dissolves into an inky starfield. Each traveler sees, for a moment, their own death - and their hair begins to whiten.
Look. Look how you end. All of you, old and alone, in the dark.
cmdblocks.name: Doji Nashiko

cmdblocks.text: (Body of Damned Time: every round, the party ages. End it quickly.)
The stars go out one by one, and the glade comes back: poppies, the leathery mat, the eight of you.
Her loveliness peels away. A black-edged wound in her throat pulses with Fu Leng's glowing blood. Her eye-sockets are empty, and glow blue.
(The last phase: choose your best four, of all eight.)
${::Rokugan.fFight()}
Who steps out of the fight?
Who steps in, from those waiting?
${::Rokugan.fFight()}
Who steps out of the fight?
Who steps in, from those waiting?
${::Rokugan.fFight()}
Who steps out of the fight?
Who steps in, from those waiting?
${::Rokugan.fFight()}
Who steps out of the fight?
Who steps in, from those waiting?
${::Rokugan.fFight()}
Who steps out of the fight?
Who steps in, from those waiting?
${::Rokugan.fFight()}
Who steps out of the fight?
Who steps in, from those waiting?
I was going to be EMPRESS!
cmdblocks.name: Doji Nashiko

cmdblocks.text: (Weak to jade, crystal and obsidian - obsidian Taints its user. Everything the eight learned of her in eight stories is a weapon now.)
At the last she breaks, and flees into the forest.
She runs into the Shinomen, down every path at once.
Every path is blocked.
Hiruma Kage's scouts, torches high.
Squeak, on a sergeant's shoulder.
Gonta and the Hidden Ones, with a landslide of boulders.
The old guard from the Wall, off watch, holding up a lantern.
Moto Benjiro, face unpainted, at the head of the Crab.
Lady Sanae, on a palanquin. A blank scroll burns in a brazier beside her.
Lady Sanae and Kakita Masanori, side by side.
Brave. Foolish. Correct.
cmdblocks.name: Doji Sanae

cmdblocks.text: A pause.
Again.
cmdblocks.name: Doji Sanae

cmdblocks.text: For the House, then. It's the same road tonight.
cmdblocks.name: Doji Sanae

cmdblocks.text: Imuro and the forest "bandits", with paper lanterns.
A cloaked Scorpion merchant slips away from the scene. Nobody notices but Rensei.
The Mirumoto army, wax in its ears, swords out.
Togashi Yosai at the front.
Twenty-four!
cmdblocks.name: Togashi Yosai

cmdblocks.text: Kitsuki Momo, with her plum-farm cousins and their pitchforks.
Toturi's Lion, who know Shizue's name now.
Atsuko's Crane scouts, beside them.
Old Shogen, barefoot, grinning.
Isawa Mieko - one person - raising a ward.
Keiki's monks, with temple bells.
Isawa Michio's Inquisitors - all six of them - blocking a path.
Kitsune Hana, and the Fox of Kudo.
A drift of light shaped like a city wall bars one path: Osuko's freed souls.
Naohida's guerrillas, under two family banners.
Karasu's glowing eyes, in the dark between the trees.
The refugees of the Ojatara, carrying rice-sack shields.
The eta of Cakon, and Hiro with his no-dachi.
A Naga in pearl and bronze lowers its spear across the path.
And Akari's fire, in the trees.
Cornered, her face flickers through every disguise from eight stories.
I was going to be Empress...
cmdblocks.name: Doji Nashiko

cmdblocks.text: You were going to be a footnote.
cmdblocks.name: Kitsuki Gendo

cmdblocks.text: A pause.
I've filed a thousand of those.
cmdblocks.name: Kitsuki Gendo

cmdblocks.text: Her body becomes an inky void. A white porcelain mask, jewelled, falls out of it and cracks.
It breaks into a thousand motes of light: the souls she drank, rising free.
The glade is just a glade.
Far away, deep under the Shadowlands, something bellows in grief.
The eight stand in an ordinary forest, in ordinary morning light.
A long silence.
...Is anyone hungry?
cmdblocks.name: Sayo

cmdblocks.text: Hiruma Natsuko sits down on a root.
Starving.
cmdblocks.name: Hiruma Natsuko

cmdblocks.text: Rain. A war drum, slow.
The Kaiu Wall. Three hundred miles of stone between the Emerald Empire and the Shadowlands.
Every night, something tries to climb it. Every night, the Crab push it back down.
Torches hissing on the battlements. Hiruma Natsuko leans on her yari, a rolled map case strapped to her back.
Hiruma! Your little friends are back!
cmdblocks.name: Hida Sachiko

cmdblocks.text: How many?
cmdblocks.name: Hiruma Natsuko

cmdblocks.text: Twelve. Thirteen. One of them has a hat.
cmdblocks.name: Hida Sachiko

cmdblocks.text: A hat.
cmdblocks.name: Hiruma Natsuko

cmdblocks.text: A straw one. Very fetching.
cmdblocks.name: Hida Sachiko

cmdblocks.text: Then I'll take the one with the hat. Fashion should be punished.
cmdblocks.name: Hiruma Natsuko

cmdblocks.text: Grappling hooks clatter onto the stone. Goblins pour over the crenellations.
Natsuko! Left side!
cmdblocks.name: Hiruma Ryoichi

cmdblocks.text: I see them. Stay behind me, Ryoichi.
cmdblocks.name: Hiruma Natsuko

cmdblocks.text: I always do. It's the safest place on the Wall.
cmdblocks.name: Hiruma Ryoichi

cmdblocks.text: The last goblin topples off the Wall. Its straw hat drifts down after it.
You hit it so hard it lost its fashion sense.
cmdblocks.name: Hida Sachiko

cmdblocks.text: It never had any.
cmdblocks.name: Hiruma Natsuko

cmdblocks.text: You're bleeding.
cmdblocks.name: Hiruma Ryoichi

cmdblocks.text: The goblin started it.
cmdblocks.name: Hiruma Natsuko

cmdblocks.text: Hiruma Ryoichi wraps her arm. He glances at the map case.
Your father's map got wet.
cmdblocks.name: Hiruma Ryoichi

cmdblocks.text: It's oiled. It's fine.
cmdblocks.name: Hiruma Natsuko

cmdblocks.text: It's been through worse than rain.
cmdblocks.name: Hiruma Natsuko

cmdblocks.text: You still look at it every night.
cmdblocks.name: Hiruma Ryoichi

cmdblocks.text: Thirty years of Hiruma died looking for that road home, Natsuko.
cmdblocks.name: Hiruma Ryoichi

cmdblocks.text: Then the thirty-first should at least look at the map first.
cmdblocks.name: Hiruma Natsuko

cmdblocks.text: The rain eases.
Go to sleep, Ryoichi. I've got the watch.
cmdblocks.name: Hiruma Natsuko

cmdblocks.text: You always have the watch.
cmdblocks.name: Hiruma Ryoichi

cmdblocks.text: Someone has to.
cmdblocks.name: Hiruma Natsuko

cmdblocks.text: Dawn.

cmdblock.text: Hiruma. Not today. The Wall will still be here when you get back.
cmdblock.name: Hida Sachiko

cmdblocks.text: CHAPTER 3 - Beyond the Wall. (Recommended level 25)
Grey dawn at the Wall gate. Hida Sachiko waits, for once not smiling.
Hiruma. The Phoenix girl. Mutsuye.
cmdblocks.name: Hida Sachiko

cmdblocks.text: She went up to the women's shrine last night. She didn't come down.
cmdblocks.name: Hida Sachiko

cmdblocks.text: ...She was Tainted. She couldn't bear it.
cmdblocks.name: Hiruma Natsuko

cmdblocks.text: And Kage-sama - he walked out through the Wall at first light. Alone. No armour.
cmdblocks.name: Hida Sachiko

cmdblocks.text: The sentries let him. He's their daimyo. What could they do?
cmdblocks.name: Hida Sachiko

cmdblocks.text: Kaiu Takakana arrives at a run, naginata over his shoulder.
He's a daimyo, Hiruma. If he dies out there, the Hiruma line dies with him.
cmdblocks.name: Kaiu Takakana

cmdblocks.text: Then I'll bring him back.
cmdblocks.name: Hiruma Natsuko

cmdblocks.text: I didn't hear you volunteer.
cmdblocks.name: Kaiu Takakana

cmdblocks.text: Because I didn't order it. Because nobody would be fool enough.
cmdblocks.name: Kaiu Takakana

cmdblocks.text: He presses a pouch of jade into her hands.
Go.
cmdblocks.name: Kaiu Takakana

cmdblocks.text: Got Jade Pouch x5.
And buy a jade finger from the quartermaster if you have the zeni. Wear it out there. The Taint can't take hold of anyone who wears jade.
cmdblocks.name: Kaiu Takakana

cmdblocks.text: (Taint: Shadowlands ground can Taint you, lowering max HP. A Jade Pouch or a Hiruma waystone cleanses it. A Jade Finger accessory stops it entirely. The quartermaster by the gate sells both.)

cmdblock.text: Bring him back, Hiruma. Bring yourself back, too.
cmdblock.name: Hida Sachiko

cmdblock.text: Bring me a Kaiu blueprint some day and I'll forge it for nothing. Honour of the family.
cmdblock.name: Kaiu smith

cmdblock.text: That's my great-uncle's hand on that blueprint! Leave it with me.
cmdblock.name: Kaiu smith

cmdblocks.text: An hour of hammering. The smith hands back a club still warm from the forge.
Got a Kaiu Tetsubo.

cmdblock.text: The gate stands open for the first time in forty years. Beyond it: the trap tunnels.

cmdblocks.text: Dusk. The Wall gate. Sentries cheer when they see Hiruma Kage. Kaiu Takakana stands at the top of the steps and says nothing, which from Takakana is a parade.
Behind them, the broken guard steps through the gate, wrapped in Natsuko's cloak. A sentry looks at him, and drops his spear.
...Uncle?
cmdblocks.name: Sentry

cmdblocks.text: Inside the gate, Kage holds the map case out to Natsuko. Then he draws it back.
Keep it.
cmdblocks.name: Hiruma Kage

cmdblocks.text: No. I'll keep it. Someone of rank should carry it.
cmdblocks.name: Hiruma Kage

cmdblocks.text: You'll walk beside me when we use it.
cmdblocks.name: Hiruma Kage

cmdblocks.text: Yes, my lord.
cmdblocks.name: Hiruma Natsuko

cmdblocks.text: A messenger meets them inside: the court has already arranged Hiruma Kage's next marriage. To the late bride's dearest friend. Asako Kuhime.
...The one with grey mud on her hem.
cmdblocks.name: Hiruma Natsuko

cmdblocks.text: "Beyond the Wall" - complete.
Natsuko followed her grieving lord into the Shadowlands and found her father's road was real. She brought Kage home - and learned that a name left in the dark doesn't stay lost.
(Kage keeps the Map of the Road Home.)

cmdblock.text: Still in one piece, Natsuko? Mostly? Good. Keep it that way.
cmdblock.name: Hiruma Ryoichi

cmdblocks.text: CHAPTER 4 - The Fairest One of All. (Recommended level 34)
Hiruma-sama! The Champion's orders: Hiruma Kage is to be married at Kyuden Hida. Every Hiruma at court. You leave today.
cmdblocks.name: Hiruma messenger

cmdblocks.text: Married? To whom?
cmdblocks.name: Hiruma Natsuko

cmdblocks.text: Asako Kuhime. Lady Mutsuye's dearest friend.
cmdblocks.name: Hiruma messenger

cmdblocks.text: Natsuko thinks about grey mud on a hem, and says nothing.

cmdblock.text: A wedding. At least nobody's trying to eat you at a wedding.
cmdblock.name: Hiruma Ryoichi

cmdblock.text: The Hiruma barracks at the foot of the Wall. Hiruma Goro sits on the step, turning his bent katana over in his hands. His elder brother, Hiruma Kenzo, wears their father's sword: a perfect blade.
My brother got Father's sword. I got the one that bent on a troll's skull.
cmdblock.name: Hiruma Goro

cmdblock.text: ...Once, on the Wall, I felt an ancestor proud of me. Just once. Holding this.
cmdblock.name: Hiruma Goro

cmdblock.text: Then my brother laughed, and it went away.
cmdblock.name: Hiruma Goro

cmdblock.text: A horn from the watchtower above the barracks. A scream. Then a roar that shakes dust off the Wall.
Troll on the tower! Goro, stay down here with your bent stick.
cmdblock.name: Hiruma Kenzo

cmdblocks.text: Hiruma Goro joins the party.
The tower top. Kenzo meets the troll head-on, and Father's perfect sword rings off its skull and shatters.
Father's sword...!
cmdblocks.name: Hiruma Kenzo

cmdblocks.text: Goro. Now.
cmdblocks.name: Hiruma Natsuko

cmdblocks.text: Goro finishes the troll with the bent sword. It goes over the parapet and doesn't get up.
...How did that thing survive?
cmdblocks.name: Hiruma Kenzo

cmdblocks.text: It's bent. Bent things know how to take a hit.
cmdblocks.name: Hiruma Goro

cmdblocks.text: There. Just now. Did you feel it? Somebody old, and proud.
cmdblocks.name: Hiruma Goro

cmdblocks.text: I felt the Wall stop shaking. Same thing, on the Wall.
cmdblocks.name: Hiruma Natsuko

cmdblocks.text: Courage isn't having the best sword. It's using the one you've got.
cmdblocks.name: Hiruma Goro

cmdblocks.text: Hiruma Goro's Troll-Breaker is now swung with the bent katana: 3 uses, and it ignores armour.
It's still up there. So are we. Again, Hiruma?
cmdblocks.name: Hiruma Goro

cmdblocks.text: Go on, then. I'll stay down here. I'm good at that.
cmdblocks.name: Hiruma Goro

cmdblock.text: The garrison yard. Isawa Michio has a table out in the cold, covered in papers, and six people around it who have never all stood in one place before.
A year. A year we've hunted "the Kyuden Hida poisoner". Look.
cmdblock.name: Isawa Michio

cmdblock.text: Ide Fujio's forged letters. Yogo Mai's sabotaged traps, and the goblin who wouldn't talk about them. A bride at Kage's wedding, with very blue eyes.
The woman who forged Fujio's letters. Who paid for the traps. Who sat at Kage's wedding.
cmdblock.name: Isawa Michio

cmdblock.text: Doji Nashiko.
cmdblock.name: Hiruma Natsuko

cmdblock.text: Then the Inquisitors would like to be present when you find her.
cmdblock.name: Isawa Michio

cmdblock.text: We start with what she left behind. A nest, under the Wall, where the old trap tunnels go deep. Mai's goblin finally drew us a map.
cmdblock.name: Isawa Michio

cmdblocks.text: Hiruma Goro joins the party.
Under the Wall. Takeo and Sakura hold the tunnel mouth; Fujio and Mai hold the lanterns. The nest is a cave of bones and silk, and it is not empty.
Smells like somebody's been feeding it.
cmdblocks.name: Hiruma Goro

cmdblocks.text: Somebody has. Kill it, Hiruma. I'll write the report.
cmdblocks.name: Isawa Michio

cmdblocks.text: The nest burns. Michio stands over it until the last of the silk is ash.
One thing she made, unmade. Write that down, somebody. I want it in the record.
cmdblocks.name: Isawa Michio

cmdblocks.text: "One thing unmade."
cmdblocks.name: Yogo Mai

cmdblocks.text: When you find her, Hiruma - send word. The Inquisitors will come.
cmdblocks.name: Isawa Michio

cmdblocks.text: (The Inquisitors' Last Hunt - complete. Michio's team will be there at the end.)
Got Jade Pouch x3.
Retreat is a tactic. So is coming back. Again?
cmdblocks.name: Isawa Michio

cmdblocks.text: We'll wait. We've waited a year. I'm told I'm very bad at it.
cmdblocks.name: Isawa Michio

cmdblock.text0: Go down with Michio and Goro.

#22#.msg: The nest is ash. I'm keeping the report. It's the first one I've enjoyed writing.
#22#.name: *villager-22

cmdblock.text: The Wall shrine to the Kaiu ancestors. A jade bowl of water stands on the offering step.

cmdblocks.text: The offering water clouds over, then clears. The Taint is gone.
The water stays clear. There is nothing in you for it to take.
Natsuko kneels and empties her mind of everything but the sound of the sea against the Wall. (MP restored.)
The Hida road. Tomoe-sama said rest, not wander.
cmdblocks.name: Hiruma Natsuko

cmdblocks.text: Hiruma Natsuko returns: bruised, the map case intact. At a distance behind her, a nezumi pretends very hard not to be following.
You're back early!
cmdblocks.name: Hida Sachiko

cmdblocks.text: I rested.
cmdblocks.name: Hiruma Natsuko

cmdblocks.text: You've got a black eye.
cmdblocks.name: Hida Sachiko

cmdblocks.text: I rested hard.
cmdblocks.name: Hiruma Natsuko

cmdblocks.text: A Runner in Kaiu colours waits at the gate, a sealed letter in his hand.
Hiruma Natsuko? The karo of Kyuden Hida, Kaiu Takakana, summons you.
cmdblocks.name: Runner

cmdblocks.text: Kyuden Hida! The Champion's castle! What did you do?
cmdblocks.name: Hida Sachiko

cmdblocks.text: I went on leave.
cmdblocks.name: Hiruma Natsuko

cmdblocks.text: Fortunes help us. Never let her rest again.
cmdblocks.name: Hida Sachiko

cmdblocks.text: He wants a Hiruma nobody at court would notice.
cmdblocks.name: Hiruma Natsuko

cmdblocks.text: Well. That's me.
cmdblocks.name: Hiruma Natsuko

cmdblocks.text: "Eggs and Shadows" - complete.
Sent on leave against her will, Natsuko found a town's missing eggs, a guardsman's broken dream, and a tribe of nezumi who chose her. Now Kyuden Hida calls for a scout nobody will notice.

#35#.name: *villager-35

#36#.name: *villager-36

#37#.msg: Rice, salt fish and one barrel of pickled radish.
#37#.name: *villager-37

cmdblock.text: Wall's quiet today. Me and my bow are for hire, Hiruma-sama, if you're walking somewhere loud.
cmdblock.name: Ashigaru Archer

cmdblocks.text: Your current hireling heads home.
Point me at it. Three volleys, then I'm back to my post.
cmdblocks.name: Ashigaru Archer

cmdblock.text: "Coast Road. Hoshi-no-Ichi, a day east." Someone has scratched underneath: GOBLINS. (Danger 1-8)
A ledge below the rocks, just out of reach. Something lashed to a driftwood post down there.

cmdblocks.text: Natsuko swings over the edge, finds a toehold, and drops onto the ledge. A fisherman's bow, wrapped in oilcloth, never collected.
Got a Bamboo Yumi.

cmdblock.text: The ledge below the rocks. Nothing left on the post.
Hoof-prints in the grass, deep and split. Boar - two of them, heavy. The tracks run up into a hollow under the cliff.

cmdblocks.text: Natsuko follows the trail into the hollow. The boars were waiting for her.
In the back of the hollow, under a fallen pine: a traveller's pack the boars have been rooting through.
Got 150 zeni.
Got Herbal Salve x2.
Natsuko backs out of the hollow, bruised. The boars don't follow. Yet.

cmdblock.text: Old boar tracks. The hollow under the cliff is quiet now.

#9#.msg: Keep the goblins off the rice, Hiruma-sama, and I'll keep the radish off you.
#9#.name: *villager-9

#10#.msg: Rice, salt fish and one barrel of pickled radish.
#10#.name: *villager-10

cmdblock.text: A cave mouth in the cliff. It stinks of rotten eggs.
Not my business. I'm on leave.
cmdblock.name: Hiruma Natsuko

cmdblocks.text: Dawn. Hiruma Natsuko walks Seppun Ryozo out of the cave mouth, wrapped in her cloak.
Outside the cave: the young nezumi huddle at the entrance. Squeak looks up at Hiruma Natsuko.
Tribe have no cave now. Roof go crack. Shaman gone.
cmdblocks.name: Squeak

cmdblocks.text: Every Crab instinct I have says walk away.
cmdblocks.name: Hiruma Natsuko

cmdblocks.text: ...There's a dry cave three ri from my Wall post. Nobody uses it. The goblins hate the smell.
cmdblocks.name: Hiruma Natsuko

cmdblocks.text: Smell like what?
cmdblocks.name: Squeak

cmdblocks.text: Crab.
cmdblocks.name: Hiruma Natsuko

cmdblocks.text: Good-good smell!
cmdblocks.name: Squeak

cmdblocks.text: Got Squeak's Charm.

cmdblock.text: Drop soup! I'm putting it on the menu.
cmdblock.name: Kiyo

cmdblocks.text: Objective: the Hidden Ones' camp at the old quarry, up the north trail.

cmdblock.text: Natsuko sets the pearl hairpin on the counter.
My hairpin! I thought I'd dropped it in the soup!
cmdblock.name: Kiyo

cmdblock.text: Something with whiskers borrowed it.
cmdblock.name: Hiruma Natsuko

cmdblock.text: Here - drop soup. On the house. Forever.
cmdblock.name: Kiyo

cmdblock.text: Got Drop Soup.
Drop soup! The whole coast wants it now. I put the egg back in for the Yasuki.
cmdblock.name: Kiyo

cmdblock.text: Ruined! Forty hens and not one egg to sell!
cmdblock.name: Gonbei

cmdblocks.text: Objective: the Hidden Ones' camp at the old quarry, up the north trail.

cmdblock.text: Salt herring! Two zeni, or one if you smile.
cmdblock.name: Fishwife

cmdblocks.text: Objective: the Hidden Ones' camp at the old quarry, up the north trail.

cmdblock.text: My mirror's gone! I used it to signal my friend!
cmdblock.name: Child

cmdblocks.text: Objective: the Hidden Ones' camp at the old quarry, up the north trail.

cmdblock.text: Natsuko hands over the little mirror.
My mirror! You found it! ...Was it the rat-people? Were they nice?
cmdblock.name: Child

cmdblock.text: Nicer than me.
cmdblock.name: Hiruma Natsuko

cmdblock.text: Got a Crow Feather.
For luck. It's my best one.
cmdblock.name: Child

cmdblock.text: I can signal my friend again! Flash, flash!
cmdblock.name: Child

cmdblocks.text: I was on the Wall forty years. Now I'm on the sake.
cmdblocks.name: Wall veteran

cmdblocks.text: Objective: the Hidden Ones' camp at the old quarry, up the north trail.
You again? Half the town has your footprints on it. Go away, Crab.
cmdblocks.name: Wall veteran

cmdblocks.text: Wrestle me.
cmdblocks.name: Hiruma Natsuko

cmdblocks.text: Natsuko takes the belt, drops her hips, and throws.
Hah! Hah-hah! Forty years and a little Hiruma puts me on my back.
cmdblocks.name: Wall veteran

cmdblocks.text: Here. My old jade. It kept the Taint off me on the Wall. Might as well keep it off you.
cmdblocks.name: Wall veteran

cmdblocks.text: Got the Old Jade Bead.
Natsuko goes for the belt and ends up in the dust.
Ha! Forty years on the Wall, girl. I'm made of stone and sake.
cmdblocks.name: Wall veteran

cmdblock.text: Drop soup. Ha!
cmdblock.name: Hida Taneo

cmdblocks.text: Objective: the Hidden Ones' camp at the old quarry, up the north trail.

cmdblock.text: A lacquer box on the storehouse step, tied shut with the magistrate's seal.
The magistrate's seal has been cut. A note, in a careful hand: "Goods seized for the inquiry. There was no inquiry. Returned. - Kanbe"
Inside: a string of coins and a painted egg, wrapped in silk.
Got 200 zeni.
Got a Painted Egg.
An empty lacquer box. The magistrate's note is still in it.

cmdblocks.text: Hoshi-no-Ichi. A Yasuki market town where salt, fish and gossip change hands every hour.
The cart pulls in. Merchants mob it.
Rice! Is there rice?
cmdblocks.name: Cart Driver

cmdblocks.text: Is there any egg?
cmdblocks.name: Merchant

cmdblocks.text: Eggs? I brought pickled radish.
cmdblocks.name: Cart Driver

cmdblocks.text: Radish!
cmdblocks.name: Merchant

cmdblocks.text: ...Rest. Right.
cmdblocks.name: Hiruma Natsuko

cmdblocks.text: Objective: rest. ...Or at least find something to eat.

#22#.msg: Radish. They wanted eggs and I brought radish. I'll never sell this load.
#22#.name: *villager-22

cmdblocks.text: Inside the noodle stall: a big Crab bushi, red-faced, glares at his bowl.
Egg-drop soup!
cmdblocks.name: Crab bushi

cmdblocks.text: Y-yes, my lord!
cmdblocks.name: Kiyo

cmdblocks.text: Where. Is. The. EGG.
cmdblocks.name: Crab bushi

cmdblocks.text: There isn't an egg in the whole town, my lord! I swear it!
cmdblocks.name: Kiyo

cmdblocks.text: Then what am I drinking?!
cmdblocks.name: Crab bushi

cmdblocks.text: Hiruma Natsuko sits down beside him on the bench.
Drop soup.
cmdblocks.name: Hiruma Natsuko

cmdblocks.text: ...What?
cmdblocks.name: Crab bushi

cmdblocks.text: No egg. Just the drop. Very pure. Very Crab.
cmdblocks.name: Hiruma Natsuko

cmdblocks.text: Drink it and let the girl go.
cmdblocks.name: Hiruma Natsuko

cmdblocks.text: Long pause. He drinks. He starts to laugh, a big helpless laugh.
Drop soup! Ha! You're from the Wall.
cmdblocks.name: Crab bushi

cmdblocks.text: Is it that obvious?
cmdblocks.name: Hiruma Natsuko

cmdblocks.text: Nobody else would talk to me like that.
cmdblocks.name: Crab bushi

cmdblocks.text: He leaves coins for the whole table and stomps out, still laughing.
Thank you, my lady! He's been shouting for three days!
cmdblocks.name: Kiyo

cmdblocks.text: I'm not a lady. I'm a scout. Why are there no eggs?
cmdblocks.name: Hiruma Natsuko

cmdblocks.text: Nobody knows! The hens lay, and by morning the eggs are gone.
cmdblocks.name: Kiyo

cmdblocks.text: And it isn't just eggs. Fans. Mirrors. Hairpins. Little pretty things.
cmdblocks.name: Kiyo

cmdblocks.text: Everyone says it's the Hidden Ones.
cmdblocks.name: Kiyo

cmdblocks.text: The who?
cmdblocks.name: Hiruma Natsuko

cmdblocks.text: Ronin! A gang camped at the old quarry. Thieves, all of them, the magistrate says.
cmdblocks.name: Kiyo

cmdblocks.text: A gang that steals eggs and hairpins. Terrifying.
cmdblocks.name: Hiruma Natsuko

cmdblocks.text: Objective: look around Hoshi-no-Ichi.
The old quarry trail. Kiyo said the Hidden Ones camp up there.
cmdblocks.name: Hiruma Natsuko

cmdblocks.text: ...Better ask around town first. Walking into a camp blind is how scouts become stories.
cmdblocks.name: Hiruma Natsuko

cmdblock.text: Ginseng, willow bark, a little sake for the nerves. You look like you'll need all three.
cmdblock.name: Village Herbalist

cmdblocks.text: Your current hireling heads home.
I've brewed three pots. Shout when you're bleeding, dear.
cmdblocks.name: Village Herbalist

cmdblocks.text: Village Herbalist follows Natsuko. (In battle: Support. 3 uses, then home to Hoshi-no-Ichi.)
Coin first, Hiruma-sama.
cmdblocks.name: Village Herbalist

cmdblocks.text: Wrestle me.
cmdblocks.name: Hiruma Natsuko

cmdblocks.text: Wrestle an old woman? On the Wall they'd laugh you off it.
cmdblocks.name: Village Herbalist

cmdblock.text: Nets don't care what's in them. Fish, goblins. I'll come along for the right coin.
cmdblock.name: Hoshi Fisherman

cmdblocks.text: Your current hireling heads home.
Two good nets. After that I'm back on the quay.
cmdblocks.name: Hoshi Fisherman

cmdblocks.text: Hoshi Fisherman follows Natsuko. (In battle: Support. 2 uses, then home to Hoshi-no-Ichi.)
Coin first, Hiruma-sama.
cmdblocks.name: Hoshi Fisherman

cmdblocks.text: Wrestle me. If I win, you come for nothing.
cmdblocks.name: Hiruma Natsuko

cmdblocks.text: Natsuko takes the belt, drops her hips, and throws.
...Fair's fair. I'll come.
cmdblocks.name: Hoshi Fisherman

cmdblocks.text: Your current hireling heads home.
Two good nets. After that I'm back on the quay.
cmdblocks.name: Hoshi Fisherman

cmdblocks.text: Hoshi Fisherman follows Natsuko. (In battle: Support. 2 uses, then home to Hoshi-no-Ichi.)
Natsuko goes for the belt and ends up in the dust.
You throw like a wave! Pay me, then.

cmdblocks.text: Gonta lands flat on his back. The camp goes silent. Then he roars with laughter.
All right, scout! All right! You throw like a landslide!
cmdblocks.name: Gonta

cmdblocks.text: Now talk.
cmdblocks.name: Hiruma Natsuko

cmdblocks.text: Look around you. Do we look like we're eating anyone's eggs?
cmdblocks.name: Gonta

cmdblocks.text: We're eating bark. Someone's robbing the whole coast - us too. My boy's carving got stolen. A wooden fish.
cmdblocks.name: Gonta

cmdblocks.text: ...Who steals a wooden fish?
cmdblocks.name: Hiruma Natsuko

cmdblocks.text: Something small. Comes at night. Smells like a rotten egg.
cmdblocks.name: Gonta

cmdblocks.text: Hiruma Natsuko walks back up to the ridge.
Sergeant. They don't have anything. Not even soup.
cmdblocks.name: Hiruma Natsuko

cmdblocks.text: ...The magistrate won't like it.
cmdblocks.name: Guard Sergeant

cmdblocks.text: The magistrate doesn't like anything. Go home.
cmdblocks.name: Hiruma Natsuko

cmdblocks.text: Crab! If you ever need a landslide, ask for Gonta!
cmdblocks.name: Gonta

cmdblocks.text: Objective: rest at the inn tonight. Rest. Apparently.

#6#.name: *villager-6

cmdblock.name: Gonta's boy

cmdblock.text: Took it from right under your nose?
cmdblock.name: Hiruma Natsuko

cmdblock.text: At night. And after, everything smelled like bad eggs.
cmdblock.name: Gonta's boy

cmdblock.text: Natsuko holds out the wooden fish.
My fish! Father! FATHER! The Crab found my fish!
cmdblock.name: Gonta's boy

cmdblock.text: ...Crab. We owe you. The Hidden Ones pay their debts.
cmdblock.name: Gonta

cmdblock.text: Got the Hidden Ones' Thanks.
I'm carving you one too. It's a crab. It has eleven legs.
cmdblock.name: Gonta's boy

#8#.msg: Noon, scout. Then we burn the nest out.
#8#.name: *villager-8

#9#.msg: Ronin. Always ronin. Nobody ever blames the weather.
#9#.name: *villager-9

#10#.msg: ...I don't want to burn anybody's tent. Don't tell the sergeant.
#10#.name: *villager-10

cmdblock.text: Cook pots, scraped clean. Bark shavings in the bottom.
Nobody in this camp has eaten an egg in a long time.
cmdblock.name: Hiruma Natsuko

cmdblock.text: Small clawed prints in the dust. They circle the hovels, then head off toward the sea cliffs.
Too small for a man. Too many claws for a dog. And that smell... rotten eggs.
cmdblock.name: Hiruma Natsuko

cmdblocks.text: Ragged tents. Thin ronin around a thin fire. Town guards gather on the ridge behind Hiruma Natsuko.
Stand aside, scout. We're clearing this nest at noon.
cmdblocks.name: Guard Sergeant

cmdblocks.text: Give me until noon, then.
cmdblocks.name: Hiruma Natsuko

cmdblocks.text: Your funeral.
cmdblocks.name: Guard Sergeant

cmdblocks.text: A mountain of a man rises from the fire: Gonta.
Crab dog. Come to watch the Yasuki burn us out?
cmdblocks.name: Gonta

cmdblocks.text: Came to see if you're worth burning.
cmdblocks.name: Hiruma Natsuko

cmdblocks.text: I don't talk to Crab dogs.
cmdblocks.name: Gonta

cmdblocks.text: Then don't talk. Wrestle.
cmdblocks.name: Hiruma Natsuko

cmdblocks.text: ...Now you're speaking a language I like.
cmdblocks.name: Gonta

cmdblocks.text: Gonta lands flat on his back. The camp goes silent. Then he roars with laughter.
All right, scout! All right! You throw like a landslide!
cmdblocks.name: Gonta

cmdblocks.text: Now talk.
cmdblocks.name: Hiruma Natsuko

cmdblocks.text: Look around you. Do we look like we're eating anyone's eggs?
cmdblocks.name: Gonta

cmdblocks.text: We're eating bark. Someone's robbing the whole coast - us too. My boy's carving got stolen. A wooden fish.
cmdblocks.name: Gonta

cmdblocks.text: ...Who steals a wooden fish?
cmdblocks.name: Hiruma Natsuko

cmdblocks.text: Something small. Comes at night. Smells like a rotten egg.
cmdblocks.name: Gonta

cmdblocks.text: Hiruma Natsuko walks back up to the ridge.
Sergeant. They don't have anything. Not even soup.
cmdblocks.name: Hiruma Natsuko

cmdblocks.text: ...The magistrate won't like it.
cmdblocks.name: Guard Sergeant

cmdblocks.text: The magistrate doesn't like anything. Go home.
cmdblocks.name: Hiruma Natsuko

cmdblocks.text: Crab! If you ever need a landslide, ask for Gonta!
cmdblocks.name: Gonta

cmdblocks.text: Objective: rest at the inn tonight. Rest. Apparently.

...You let me do that.
cmdblocks.name: Hiruma Natsuko

cmdblocks.text: Prove it.
cmdblocks.name: Gonta

cmdblocks.text: A great heap of eggs. Candles. Young nezumi kneel around a thin man in a guard's undershirt, painting an egg with enormous care: Seppun Ryozo.
Another one, Squeak? Did you bring me the fresh ones?
cmdblocks.name: Seppun Ryozo

cmdblocks.text: Brought scout.
cmdblocks.name: Squeak

cmdblocks.text: A Crab! Wonderful! Come, come - you'll understand. Your people fight darkness!
cmdblocks.name: Seppun Ryozo

cmdblocks.text: My people fight goblins. What are you doing, Ryozo?
cmdblocks.name: Hiruma Natsuko

cmdblocks.text: You know my name! Then you know I was a guardsman of the Emperor himself.
cmdblocks.name: Seppun Ryozo

cmdblocks.text: And I learned the secret the shugenja hide. Magic without blood.
cmdblocks.name: Seppun Ryozo

cmdblocks.text: The life inside the shell is the offering. No blood. No sin. A clean sorcery!
cmdblocks.name: Seppun Ryozo

cmdblocks.text: They laughed at me in the capital. They threw me out.
cmdblocks.name: Seppun Ryozo

cmdblocks.text: Does it work?
cmdblocks.name: Hiruma Natsuko

cmdblocks.text: Of course it works!
cmdblocks.name: Seppun Ryozo

cmdblocks.text: What happened when you tried it?
cmdblocks.name: Hiruma Natsuko

cmdblocks.text: ...The eggs must be fresher.
cmdblocks.name: Seppun Ryozo

cmdblocks.text: Your aunt Satomi is in Hoshi-no-Ichi. She's frightened for you.
cmdblocks.name: Hiruma Natsuko

cmdblocks.text: Aunt Satomi? She... she's here? She came?
cmdblocks.name: Seppun Ryozo

cmdblocks.text: These nezumi will die for you. Is that clean?
cmdblocks.name: Hiruma Natsuko

cmdblocks.text: The young nezumi look up at him. He looks at them. For a moment, he sees them.
I... I only wanted to give them something. Something that would protect them.
cmdblocks.name: Seppun Ryozo

cmdblocks.text: You've been stealing from starving people.
cmdblocks.name: Hiruma Natsuko

cmdblocks.name: Seppun Ryozo

cmdblocks.text: I just couldn't stop painting. If I stopped, I'd have to go home a failure.
cmdblocks.name: Seppun Ryozo

cmdblocks.text: My whole family's failed to go home for fifteen generations, Ryozo.
cmdblocks.name: Hiruma Natsuko

cmdblocks.text: You get up and try again. That's all there is.

cmdblocks.text: ...Will you take me to her?
cmdblocks.name: Seppun Ryozo

cmdblocks.text: Yes.
cmdblocks.name: Hiruma Natsuko

cmdblocks.text: The candles gutter. An old nezumi in bone charms steps out of the shadows: the Tribe Shaman.
Shiny-man ours. Eggs ours. Young ones OURS.
cmdblocks.name: Nezumi Shaman

cmdblocks.text: Crab take nothing. Crab go in the dark-hole forever.
cmdblocks.name: Nezumi Shaman

cmdblocks.text: Shaman wrong! Squeak fight with scout!

cmdblocks.name: Togashi Yosai
cmdblocks.text: Company! Then I'll wait at the next inn and recount my enemies. It's a long list. I'm very popular.
(Togashi Yosai waits beside the inns. Ask him along again when no one else travels with you.)
You'll not take my children! The eggs will protect us!
cmdblocks.name: Seppun Ryozo

cmdblocks.text: ...Young ones... choose scout...?
cmdblocks.name: Nezumi Shaman

cmdblocks.text: Natsuko turns to leave. Seppun Ryozo, bleeding, crawls into a side tunnel, and nobody sees him go.
Darkness. Dripping. Something large and wet shifts.
...a name...
...give me... a name...
...Seppun... Ryozo... of the Emperor's... guard...
cmdblocks.name: Seppun Ryozo

cmdblocks.text: ...Ryozo. ...Yes.
Black.
Behind them the altar cave groans, and the roof comes down.

cmdblocks.text: A cramped garrison office. A grizzled commander, Hida Tomoe, reading a report without looking up.
Three months on the Wall without a day's leave.
cmdblocks.name: Hida Tomoe

cmdblocks.text: [neutral] Yes, Tomoe-sama.
cmdblocks.name: Hiruma Natsuko

cmdblocks.text: Two broken ribs you didn't report.
cmdblocks.name: Hida Tomoe

cmdblocks.text: [determined] One and a half, Tomoe-sama.
cmdblocks.name: Hiruma Natsuko

cmdblocks.text: You're going on leave.
cmdblocks.name: Hida Tomoe

cmdblocks.text: [determined] I'd rather not.
cmdblocks.name: Hiruma Natsuko

cmdblocks.text: I'd rather you didn't die of being stubborn on my section of Wall.
cmdblocks.name: Hida Tomoe

cmdblocks.text: There's a supply cart going up the coast to Hoshi-no-Ichi. You'll escort it.
cmdblocks.name: Hida Tomoe

cmdblocks.text: Then you'll rest. A week. Eat food a goblin hasn't touched.
cmdblocks.name: Hida Tomoe

cmdblocks.text: [determined] And if I refuse?
cmdblocks.name: Hiruma Natsuko

cmdblocks.text: Then you'll guard the latrines until the Shadowlands fall into the sea.
cmdblocks.name: Hida Tomoe

cmdblocks.text: [determined] ...I'll take the cart.
cmdblocks.name: Hiruma Natsuko

cmdblocks.text: Good. And Hiruma - try to enjoy yourself.
cmdblocks.name: Hida Tomoe

cmdblocks.text: [determined] I'll try, Tomoe-sama. I don't know how.
cmdblocks.name: Hiruma Natsuko

cmdblocks.text: Nobody does, on the Wall. Go and find out.
cmdblocks.name: Hida Tomoe

cmdblocks.text: Objective: escort the supply cart up the Coast Road to Hoshi-no-Ichi.

cmdblock.text: A traveler! Togashi Yosai. I hunt men who skin monks, and the Fortunes hunt me. We're all very busy.
cmdblock.name: Togashi Yosai

cmdblock.text: I've got tattoos that breathe fire and tattoos that steal wounds, and none of them do my taxes.
cmdblock.name: Togashi Yosai

cmdblock.text: Somewhere a woman is writing two letters at once. Nobody ever reads the second one. Strange times.
cmdblock.name: Togashi Yosai

cmdblock.text: You're the one wrestling half the town. People talk, you know.
cmdblock.name: Innkeeper

cmdblocks.text: I'll stand a round for the ones you threw, and say you're sorry. Are you?
cmdblocks.name: Innkeeper

cmdblocks.text: ...Mostly.
cmdblocks.name: Hiruma Natsuko

cmdblocks.text: (Hoshi-no-Ichi will hear you out again.)
A round for half the town costs more than you've got, Crab.
cmdblocks.name: Innkeeper

cmdblock.text: Back again? A room's ten zeni. Quiet tonight, at least.
cmdblock.name: Innkeeper

cmdblocks.text: Dark room. Snoring through the wall. A tiny scratching. A small furred shape rummaging in Hiruma Natsuko's pack.
Natsuko's eyes open.
...You picked the wrong pack, friend.
cmdblocks.name: Hiruma Natsuko

cmdblocks.text: The shape freezes: a young Nezumi with huge ears. It grabs the map case and bolts out the window.
NOT. THE. MAP!
cmdblocks.name: Hiruma Natsuko

cmdblocks.text: Natsuko vaults the window, half-dressed, yari in hand, across rooftops, slides down a drainpipe, crashes through a laundry line. The nezumi is always one roof ahead. At the edge of town it stops, looks back - and waits for her.
...You're waiting for me.
cmdblocks.name: Hiruma Natsuko

cmdblocks.text: It runs again, slower now.
Objective: follow the nezumi.

cmdblock.text: You're Crab? Have you seen... no. Never mind.
cmdblock.name: Seppun Satomi

cmdblocks.text: Objective: the Hidden Ones' camp at the old quarry, up the north trail.

cmdblock.text: You're a scout. You notice things?
cmdblock.name: Seppun Satomi

cmdblock.text: It's mostly what I do. That, and stab things.
cmdblock.name: Hiruma Natsuko

cmdblock.text: My nephew came to this coast a month ago. Seppun Ryozo.
cmdblock.name: Seppun Satomi

cmdblock.text: An Imperial guardsman. He... had troubles in the capital. Strange ideas.
cmdblock.name: Seppun Satomi

cmdblock.text: His letters stopped. If you hear of him, come to me. Only me.
cmdblock.name: Seppun Satomi

cmdblock.text: Strange ideas like what?
cmdblock.name: Hiruma Natsuko

cmdblock.text: Ideas a Seppun should not have. Please. Only me.
cmdblock.name: Seppun Satomi

cmdblock.text: If you hear of him, come to me. Only me.
cmdblock.name: Seppun Satomi

cmdblocks.text: Hoshi-no-Ichi, the tea house. Seppun Satomi rushes to him and stops herself - then holds him anyway.
You foolish, foolish boy.
cmdblocks.name: Seppun Satomi

cmdblocks.text: I'm sorry, Aunt. The eggs didn't work.
cmdblocks.name: Seppun Ryozo

cmdblocks.text: No. No, they wouldn't.
cmdblocks.name: Seppun Satomi

cmdblocks.text: The town will be paid for every egg. Every fan. Every hairpin.
cmdblocks.name: Seppun Satomi

cmdblocks.text: And this will never have happened. You understand.
cmdblocks.name: Seppun Satomi

cmdblocks.text: I understand you're asking. I don't gossip. Ask anyone on the Wall.
cmdblocks.name: Hiruma Natsuko

cmdblocks.text: A Seppun blade. A small thank-you.
cmdblocks.name: Seppun Satomi

cmdblocks.text: Got the Seppun Tanto.
It's beautiful. I'll get goblin on it within the week.
cmdblocks.name: Hiruma Natsuko

cmdblocks.text: Keep it. Buy Kiyo some hens.
cmdblocks.name: Hiruma Natsuko

cmdblocks.text: (Honor +1)
Hoshi-no-Ichi, the tea house. Seppun Satomi is packing.
You found him.
cmdblocks.name: Seppun Satomi

cmdblocks.text: I found where he was. He ran into the deep tunnels. I couldn't follow.
cmdblocks.name: Hiruma Natsuko

cmdblocks.text: ...Then I'll tell the family he died bravely. It's what Seppun do.
cmdblocks.name: Seppun Satomi

cmdblocks.text: She leaves the coast that evening. No gift.
Objective: back to the Wall.

cmdblock.text: The Hida dojo. Come back when the court is done with you, Hiruma. I'll show you something the Hida don't teach to scouts.
cmdblock.name: Hiruma Goro

cmdblock.text: The court let you go? Good. Stand there. Feet wide. You're a mountain - things hit you and slide off. Again. Again.
cmdblock.name: Hiruma Goro

cmdblock.text: Natsuko learns the Crab kata Striking as Earth. (Battle: School. Strike, and settle like the mountain for 3 turns: +evasion, -accuracy.)
Now go home. Back to the Wall - the gate garrison. Kage will want you beyond it.
cmdblock.name: Hiruma Goro

cmdblock.text: Practising? Good. Now the Wall, Hiruma - the gate garrison. Kage is waiting.
cmdblock.name: Hiruma Goro

cmdblock.text: An iron-bound door down to the cells. Locked.
Hida Sachiko and three Wall veterans, bored, wrestling for sake.
Hiruma! Court got you yet?
cmdblock.name: Hida Sachiko

cmdblock.text: Court's trying. It hasn't found anything to grip.
cmdblock.name: Hiruma Natsuko

cmdblocks.text: Natsuko takes the veteran's belt and puts him in the sawdust.
Fine! You want a secret? The troll in the basement - its chains were filed.
cmdblocks.name: Wall Veteran

cmdblocks.text: Not broken. Filed. Somebody's been visiting it with a rasp.
cmdblocks.name: Wall Veteran

cmdblocks.text: Objective: the dance contest tonight, in the great hall (4F).
Filed chains, and a Hiruma on the hunt. Court just got interesting.
cmdblocks.name: Hida Sachiko

cmdblocks.text: I'm coming with you. Don't argue. I'm bigger.
cmdblocks.name: Hida Sachiko
