cmdblock.text: The court gathers to shoot at painted targets - "dogs" in the old days, the hostess says, flustered; "now we use straw goblins, much nicer."
Hiruma-san! You'll shoot, of course. All the Crab shoot.
cmdblock.name: Yasuki Kurako

cmdblocks.text: Natsuko's arrow splits the straw goblin's nose. The court applauds. Asako Kuhime claps a beat too late.
The arrow lands politely in the straw.
You're kind.
cmdblocks.name: Isawa Mutsuye

cmdblocks.text: The straw hat spins away. The court gasps. On his balcony, the Champion almost smiles.

cmdblock.text2: Shoot the straw goblin's hat off.

cmdblocks.text: Objective: the dance contest tonight, in the great hall (4F).

cmdblock.text: A Lion cavalryman in Akodo gold walks a horse round and round the outer yard. Kitsu Takeo.
Every Kitsu hears the ancestors. My cousins, my sisters. Children of six.
cmdblock.name: Kitsu Takeo

cmdblock.text: I've never heard a word. They're silent for me. So I ride very fast, and nobody notices.
cmdblock.name: Kitsu Takeo

cmdblock.text: Those two Matsu say a Kitsu who can't hear his grandfathers can't ride either. Three laps of the yard, for my saddle. I need a second rider.
cmdblock.name: Kitsu Takeo

cmdblocks.text: Three laps on the Champion's own horses. On the second lap the Matsu stop racing and start swinging.
We won. I won! ...Nobody heard the ancestors cheering.
cmdblocks.name: Kitsu Takeo

cmdblocks.text: Nobody heard them booing, either.
cmdblocks.name: Hiruma Natsuko

cmdblocks.text: Ha! Call me, Hiruma, whenever something needs charging at.
cmdblocks.name: Kitsu Takeo

cmdblocks.text: Kitsu Takeo will answer the Guest call in battle. (One guest at a time.)
The horses liked you, at least. Again, when you're ready.
cmdblocks.name: Kitsu Takeo

cmdblocks.text: The horses will wait. The Matsu won't.
cmdblocks.name: Kitsu Takeo

cmdblock.text: The horses are saddled, Hiruma. Ride with me?
cmdblock.name: Kitsu Takeo

cmdblocks.text: Kitsu Takeo will answer the Guest call.

cmdblock.text0: Ask Kitsu Takeo to come along.

cmdblock.text: I'm with you. Charge first, think later.
cmdblock.name: Kitsu Takeo

cmdblock.text: A gentle Scorpion shugenja pours tea at the foot of the cellar stair: Yogo Mai. A goblin in Kuni chains sulks across the cup from her.
The Kuni caught this one in the old trap tunnels. It won't say who moved the traps.
cmdblock.name: Yogo Mai

cmdblock.text: I just ask nicely. People like to tell me things. Would you sit in? Goblins talk more with a Crab in the room.
cmdblock.name: Yogo Mai

cmdblocks.text: Tell me about the traps, little one.
cmdblocks.name: Yogo Mai

cmdblocks.text: The goblin lasts four breaths. Then it sobs out everything.
Sky-eyes lady pay goblin! Goblin move roller-stone! Third stone safe, all others squish! Goblin make dust-line, lady not touch jade!
cmdblocks.name: Goblin prisoner

cmdblocks.text: Sky-eyes?
cmdblocks.name: Hiruma Natsuko

cmdblocks.text: Blue-blue eyes! Pretty! Scary!
cmdblocks.name: Goblin prisoner

cmdblocks.text: ...I'm very good at this.
cmdblocks.name: Yogo Mai

cmdblocks.text: I noticed.
cmdblocks.name: Hiruma Natsuko

cmdblocks.text: Call me if you need someone to talk to. Or someone to talk.
cmdblocks.name: Yogo Mai

cmdblocks.text: Yogo Mai will answer the Guest call in battle. (One guest at a time.)
It will still be here. It has nowhere to go, poor thing.
cmdblocks.name: Yogo Mai

cmdblock.text: More tea, Hiruma? Or more confessions?
cmdblock.name: Yogo Mai

cmdblocks.text: Yogo Mai will answer the Guest call.

cmdblock.text0: Ask Yogo Mai to come along.

cmdblock.text: Ready when you are. I'll ask nicely.
cmdblock.name: Yogo Mai

cmdblock.text: The troll's regeneration is remarkable. We'd need another week.
cmdblock.name: Yogo Shigeru

cmdblock.text: Another troll, you mean. That one's nearly worn out.
cmdblock.name: Kuni Taira

cmdblock.text: Another week. Just one more week.
cmdblock.name: Yogo Shigeru

cmdblocks.text: Togashi Yosai joins the party. (Dragon's Breath, Arrowroot; his tattoos heal him a little every turn.)
I'll be here. Probably. Statistically.
cmdblocks.name: Togashi Yosai

cmdblocks.text: You've already got company. I'll keep the bench warm. Benches love me.
cmdblocks.name: Togashi Yosai

cmdblock.text: Oh! Are you - you're Hiruma! You're from his family!
cmdblock.name: Isawa Mutsuye

cmdblock.text: From his family's ruins, my lady. We're mostly ruins.
cmdblock.name: Hiruma Natsuko

cmdblock.text: He says that too. Exactly that. Is he always so sad?
cmdblock.name: Isawa Mutsuye

cmdblock.text: He wasn't, this week.
cmdblock.name: Hiruma Natsuko

cmdblocks.text: Objective: the dance contest tonight, in the great hall (4F).

cmdblock.text: "He wasn't, this week." I keep thinking about that, Hiruma-san. It's a nice thing to be told.
cmdblock.name: Isawa Mutsuye

cmdblock.text: ...I didn't do this, Hiruma-san. I don't even know what it is on my skin.
cmdblock.name: Isawa Mutsuye

cmdblock.text: I know. Somebody threw it at you. I mean to find out who.
cmdblock.name: Hiruma Natsuko

cmdblock.text: You're the scout Takakana sent. Don't worry. She's exactly what she seems. I've known her for years.
cmdblock.name: Asako Kuhime

cmdblock.text: How many years?
cmdblock.name: Hiruma Natsuko

cmdblock.text: Long enough to know everything about her.
cmdblock.name: Asako Kuhime

cmdblocks.text: Objective: the dance contest tonight, in the great hall (4F).

cmdblock.text: She's exactly what she seems. I'd know.
cmdblock.name: Asako Kuhime

cmdblock.text: It's called the Tunnel of Quiescent Flame. My grandmother learned it in the Burning Sands.
cmdblock.name: Ide Keiyomi

cmdblock.text: Everyone here thinks it's barbaric. I think it's the only honest thing at court.
cmdblock.name: Ide Keiyomi

cmdblocks.text: Objective: the dance contest tonight, in the great hall (4F).

cmdblock.text: Keiyomi spins on the frozen stones, alone.
You watched the whole thing. Nobody watches. They wait for me to fall over.
cmdblock.name: Ide Keiyomi

cmdblock.text: On the Wall we watch anything that moves that fast.
cmdblock.name: Hiruma Natsuko

cmdblock.text: Ha! Then take this. It's from the Tunnel of Quiescent Flame - my grandmother's ribbon, from the Burning Sands.
cmdblock.name: Ide Keiyomi

cmdblock.text: Wear it somewhere they hate.
cmdblock.name: Ide Keiyomi

cmdblock.text: Got the Unicorn Dance Ribbon.
Are you a real Hiruma? From the Wall? Have you killed an oni? I almost drowned in a carp pond. Twice.
cmdblock.name: Isawa Akiko

cmdblock.text: Except the second time was on purpose. Don't ask about the exploding Togashi. Nobody's allowed to ask about the exploding Togashi.
cmdblock.name: Isawa Akiko

cmdblock.text: ...I wasn't going to.
cmdblock.name: Hiruma Natsuko

cmdblock.text: Don't ask about the exploding Togashi!
cmdblock.name: Isawa Akiko

cmdblock.text: Mother of six. I've seen worse than court. Not much worse.
cmdblock.name: Shinjo O-Shito

cmdblock.text: Hiruma Natsuko holds out Ide Keiyomi's ribbon.
...That's Ide Keiyomi's. The Burning Sands dance.
cmdblock.name: Shinjo O-Shito

cmdblock.text: Her grandmother will want it back. I'll carry it to the Ide myself, and they'll know a Crab brought it out of this castle.
cmdblock.name: Shinjo O-Shito

cmdblock.text: (Honor +1)
Six children, and not one of them dances like that. She'd have laughed at me for saying so.
cmdblock.name: Shinjo O-Shito

cmdblock.text: A Crane yojimbo in Phoenix colours stands alone by the garden wall, and the court whispers "deserter" as it passes. Daidoji Sakura.
They tell you I ran. They don't tell you where from.
cmdblock.name: Daidoji Sakura

cmdblock.text: A gorge, filled with pitch. My general wanted to set it alight with three hundred peasants inside. "A trap for the Crab."
cmdblock.name: Daidoji Sakura

cmdblock.text: I refused. I left. The Shiba took me in.
cmdblock.name: Daidoji Sakura

cmdblock.text: Now the Daidoji have sent two men to take me home in disgrace. They're waiting in the hall.
cmdblock.name: Daidoji Sakura

cmdblocks.text: The Daidoji agents don't bother with words.
Tell the Daidoji I'm not coming home. Tell them politely.
cmdblocks.name: Daidoji Sakura

cmdblocks.text: Three hundred peasants still alive. On the Wall we'd call that a good day.
cmdblocks.name: Hiruma Natsuko

cmdblocks.text: Then call me, Hiruma, on a bad one.
cmdblocks.name: Daidoji Sakura

cmdblocks.text: Daidoji Sakura will answer the Guest call in battle. (One guest at a time.)
They're good. So are we. Again?
cmdblocks.name: Daidoji Sakura

cmdblocks.text: They'll wait. Patience is the Daidoji's only virtue.
cmdblocks.name: Daidoji Sakura

cmdblock.text: Need a spear that knows when to say no, Hiruma?
cmdblock.name: Daidoji Sakura

cmdblocks.text: Daidoji Sakura will answer the Guest call.

cmdblock.text0: Ask Daidoji Sakura to come along.

cmdblock.text: I'm here, Hiruma.
cmdblock.name: Daidoji Sakura

cmdblock.text: Yogo Shigeru's room. Scrolls in a bad hand: love letters, forged, to three different ladies.
Under the love letters, newer scrolls in a far better hand, pointing straight at Yogo Shigeru. Too neat. Planted.
A Hiruma at court! How refreshing. You look at the exits like they owe you money.
cmdblock.name: Shosuro Shiko

cmdblock.text: They do. Nobody here knows where they are.
cmdblock.name: Hiruma Natsuko

cmdblock.text: Oh, I like you. A free rumour: the Phoenix bride's friend never sleeps. I've watched.
cmdblock.name: Shosuro Shiko

cmdblock.text: The bride's friend never sleeps. Try the barracks, Hiruma. Crabs hear things.
cmdblock.name: Shosuro Shiko

cmdblock.text: Court is a map with no roads, Natsuko.
cmdblock.name: Hiruma Kage

cmdblock.text: ...She danced. And now she's a body on the shrine steps. And they look at Mutsuye.
cmdblock.name: Hiruma Kage

cmdblock.text: Leave me the map, Natsuko. I can't read it tonight.
cmdblock.name: Hiruma Kage

cmdblock.text: Asako Kuhime's room. The bedding hasn't been slept in.
A dashing Ide in Unicorn purple writes furiously in a corner while ladies read over his shoulder and gasp. Ide Fujio.
Letters! Romantic, scandalous, anonymous. The whole court reads them. Nobody knows they're mine.
cmdblock.name: Ide Fujio

cmdblock.text: Except someone's started forging them. Nasty ones. Ruining people.
cmdblock.name: Ide Fujio

cmdblock.text: Three people here could copy my hand: a Doji poet, a Kakita calligrapher and a Yogo scribe.
cmdblock.name: Ide Fujio

cmdblock.text: Tell me about the forgeries. Not the words. The paper.
cmdblock.name: Hiruma Natsuko

cmdblock.text: ...The paper? Cheap. Grey ink - slate ground in water, not good pine soot. And the brush drags left, like a man writing with his wrong hand.
cmdblock.name: Ide Fujio

cmdblock.text: The Doji poet writes only on gold-flecked paper. The Kakita calligrapher would sooner die than touch slate ink.
cmdblock.name: Ide Fujio

cmdblock.text: And the Yogo scribe is left-handed, and copies tax rolls all day for the Crab, on whatever they give him.
cmdblock.name: Ide Fujio

cmdblocks.text: On cheap paper? She'd faint. Think again, Hiruma.
cmdblocks.name: Ide Fujio

cmdblocks.text: Slate ink? He'd commit seppuku first. Think again.
cmdblocks.name: Ide Fujio

cmdblocks.text: The Yogo scribe has grey ink under his fingernails. He folds at once.
A woman paid me! Lovely, she was. Blue eyes. I never saw her face again.
cmdblocks.name: Yogo scribe

cmdblocks.text: Blue eyes. I never write about blue eyes.
cmdblocks.name: Ide Fujio

cmdblocks.text: Hiruma, you've saved my career and several marriages. If you ever need a distraction in a fight, call me. I'll write something.
cmdblocks.name: Ide Fujio

cmdblocks.text: Ide Fujio will answer the Guest call in battle. (One guest at a time.)

cmdblock.text: Need a scandal, Hiruma? I have several drafted.
cmdblock.name: Ide Fujio

cmdblocks.text: Ide Fujio will answer the Guest call.

cmdblock.text0: Ask Ide Fujio to come along.

cmdblock.text: My brush is wet and my reputation is terrible. Ready.
cmdblock.name: Ide Fujio

cmdblock.name: Yasuki Kurako

cmdblock.text: Sake for the 6th floor, sake for the 6th floor...
cmdblock.name: Kitchen servant

cmdblocks.text: The dance contest. Courtiers in pairs, careful as chess. Then Ide Keiyomi steps out alone and dances the Tunnel of Quiescent Flame: fast, fierce, barefoot. The court titters behind its fans.
(They're laughing at her. She knows. She doesn't stop.)
cmdblocks.name: Hiruma Natsuko

cmdblocks.text: Across the hall, Asako Kuhime watches the girl's face the whole time, and never once blinks.
Natsuko sleeps in the barracks. Badly.
Dawn.

cmdblock.text: The window over the Wall. Grey stone to the edge of sight, and beyond it, the dark.

#5#.msg: The Champion is listening, Hiruma. He is always listening.
#5#.name: *villager-5

#6#.msg: Such a long court. Such pretty dancers.
#6#.name: *villager-6

cmdblocks.text: Kyuden Hida. Seven floors of black stone. The Great Bear lives at the top, and nobody climbs there twice by choice.

The audience hall. Hida Kisada in the Armor of the Shadow Warrior, unmoving as the castle. Hiruma Natsuko kneels far below. The karo, Kaiu Takakana - scarred, broad, a naginata over his shoulder even here - presents her.
Hiruma Natsuko, my lord. Scout of the Wall.
cmdblocks.name: Kaiu Takakana

cmdblocks.text: Kisada looks at her. One glance. Then at the next petitioner.
That is all.
The corridor outside. Takakana walks fast. Natsuko keeps up.
Your daimyo, Hiruma Kage, is going to marry.
cmdblocks.name: Kaiu Takakana

cmdblocks.text: My lord Kage? Marry? He's never looked at anyone but a map.
cmdblocks.name: Hiruma Natsuko

cmdblocks.text: He's looked now. A Phoenix girl. Isawa Mutsuye.
cmdblocks.name: Kaiu Takakana

cmdblocks.text: The betrothal is announced at the end of court. Before that, I want her vetted.
cmdblocks.name: Kaiu Takakana

cmdblocks.text: If she's Tainted, a Scorpion, or a fool, I want to know before the Champion does.
cmdblocks.name: Kaiu Takakana

cmdblocks.text: Why me? I'm a scout. I can't tell a fan from a fork.
cmdblocks.name: Hiruma Natsuko

cmdblocks.text: Exactly. Nobody at this court will notice a junior Hiruma. You'll see everything.
cmdblocks.name: Kaiu Takakana

cmdblocks.text: And if she's none of those things?
cmdblocks.name: Hiruma Natsuko

cmdblocks.text: Then you've wasted my time. And I'll thank you for it.
cmdblocks.name: Kaiu Takakana

cmdblocks.text: He stops at a window overlooking the Wall and hands her three small cylinders.
Red flare, we attack. Green, we fall back.
cmdblocks.name: Kaiu Takakana

cmdblocks.text: Blue. Nobody has fired a blue in my lifetime.
cmdblocks.name: Kaiu Takakana

cmdblocks.text: What does blue mean?
cmdblocks.name: Hiruma Natsuko

cmdblocks.text: Something none of us has seen before. Keep it.
cmdblocks.name: Kaiu Takakana

cmdblocks.text: Got the Blue Flare.
Hiruma Natsuko? Goro. Kage-sama's shadow at court.
cmdblocks.name: Hiruma Goro

cmdblocks.text: He says you'll go poking at the Phoenix girl, and court bites. I'm to stand behind you and look large.
cmdblocks.name: Hiruma Goro

cmdblocks.text: Do you also look at exits?
cmdblocks.name: Hiruma Natsuko

cmdblocks.text: Constantly.
cmdblocks.name: Hiruma Goro

cmdblocks.text: Hiruma Goro joins the party.
Objective: vet Isawa Mutsuye. The court is on floors 1-4: talk to the bride, her friend, the Unicorn girl, and shoot at the archery contest (1F yard).
The audience hall. The court lines the walls. Hida Kisada waits.
The scout's findings, my lord.
cmdblocks.name: Kaiu Takakana

cmdblocks.text: Then I demand the right to defend my lady's name.
cmdblocks.name: Shiba Noboru

cmdblocks.text: A duel. Natsuko steps out alone.
Win or lose, Isawa Mutsuye is confined to her rooms.
Yogo Shigeru is dragged out protesting. He is executed before morning.
(He was a creep. He wasn't a killer. I just killed a creep.)
cmdblocks.name: Hiruma Natsuko

cmdblocks.text: My lord. I don't have a culprit. I have mud.
cmdblocks.name: Hiruma Natsuko

cmdblocks.text: A ripple through the court. Kaiu Takakana goes very still.
Give me one night, and I'll give you the hand that held the knife.
cmdblocks.name: Hiruma Natsuko

cmdblocks.text: One night. Then I choose for you.
cmdblocks.name: Hida Kisada

cmdblocks.text2: No one yet. One more night.

cmdblocks.text: Then I demand the right to defend my lady's name.
cmdblocks.name: Shiba Noboru

cmdblocks.text: A duel. Natsuko steps out alone.
Win or lose, Isawa Mutsuye is confined to her rooms.
Yogo Shigeru is dragged out protesting. He is executed before morning.
(He was a creep. He wasn't a killer. I just killed a creep.)
cmdblocks.name: Hiruma Natsuko

cmdblocks.text: Night. Objective: follow the grey mud. The cellar door on 1F is open.
The puppet's "confession" - magically extracted, word-perfect - is read to the court. Hida Kisada accepts it with a nod. The case is closed.
But Isawa Mutsuye stands at the edge of the hall in plain robes, the Taint dark at her collar. It can't be undone in time. She bows to Hiruma Kage, who can't look at her, and leaves the court.
The window above the Wall. Hiruma Natsuko and Kaiu Takakana.
The puppet didn't do it alone. Someone held its strings.
cmdblocks.name: Hiruma Natsuko

cmdblocks.text: I know.
cmdblocks.name: Kaiu Takakana

cmdblocks.text: Then why-
cmdblocks.name: Hiruma Natsuko

cmdblocks.text: So does the Champion. A culprit is not the same as the truth, Hiruma.
cmdblocks.name: Kaiu Takakana

cmdblocks.text: The Wall only needs a culprit. You and I need the truth. Keep looking.
cmdblocks.name: Kaiu Takakana

cmdblocks.text: The court below. Asako Kuhime comforting a weeping Kage, her hand on his shoulder. She looks up at the window, straight at Natsuko, and smiles. Her eyes are very blue in the lantern light.
"Winter Court at Kyuden Hida" - complete.

A dancer without a face, a bride with a stain thrown on her, and a puppet's word-perfect confession. The Champion has his culprit. Natsuko has grey mud, and a friend of the bride's who never seems to sleep.
Objective: back to the Kaiu Wall - the gate garrison. (Before you go: Hiruma Goro will teach you a Crab kata at the Hida dojo here.)
Goro goes back to standing behind Kage. Sachiko goes back to the Wall, complaining. Isawa Michio leaves for the Phoenix lands with a list of names.
Summer at Kyuden Hida. The court needs a Hiruma heir. So the court has arranged a wedding - quickly.
A hasty, grand ceremony. Hiruma Kage, numb, in borrowed finery. Beside him, radiant: Asako Kuhime. Hiruma Natsuko stands at the very back.
You brought him home from the Shadowlands. I'll never forget it.
cmdblocks.name: Asako Kuhime

cmdblocks.text: I never forget anything.
cmdblocks.name: Asako Kuhime

cmdblocks.text: My lady.
cmdblocks.name: Hiruma Natsuko

cmdblocks.text: Kuhime glides away. Natsuko watches her lift a cup of scalding sake for a toast, and drink it without a flicker.
...I've seen someone drink sake like that before.
cmdblocks.name: Hiruma Natsuko

cmdblocks.text: (Free roam in the castle town: the stalls sell Kaiu-forged gear. Night will fall when you return to the castle.)

cmdblock.text: A road-stone: "Kyuden Hida, two days. Danger 18-25."
A waystation shrine on the Hida road. Travellers leave rice balls and chips of jade.

cmdblocks.text: The offering water clouds over, then clears. The Taint is gone.
The water stays clear. There is nothing in you for it to take.
Natsuko kneels in the snow and listens to the Wall creak in the cold. (MP restored.)
The Hida road, the morning after. Hiruma Natsuko walks beside Hiruma Kage on the first mile of her father's road.
At the first marker, she stops.
You told me the truth about the wedding. Nobody else would have.
cmdblocks.name: Hiruma Kage

cmdblocks.text: I never thanked you properly. For the Shadowlands.
cmdblocks.name: Hiruma Kage

cmdblocks.text: Someday.
cmdblocks.name: Hiruma Natsuko

cmdblocks.text: A pause.
Not by dying.
cmdblocks.name: Hiruma Natsuko

cmdblocks.text: She turns back toward the Wall.
Squeak and Stich'Kik trot behind her, arguing about eggs.

cmdblocks.text: A scream from the women's shrine. Hiruma Natsuko runs. Courtiers in a frozen ring around a veiled shape on the shrine steps. Ide Keiyomi. Her face hidden under a cloth someone laid over it.
Don't lift it. Don't anyone lift it. Her face - it's gone.
cmdblocks.name: Shinjo O-Shito

cmdblocks.text: Natsuko kneels. She doesn't lift the cloth.
Tunnel of Quiescent Flame. You were the only honest thing here.
cmdblocks.name: Hiruma Natsuko

cmdblocks.text: Isawa Mutsuye stands at the edge of the ring. There is a dark stain at her collar: fresh Taint.
Someone finds scrolls in Yogo Shigeru's room. They name him. Neatly.
Asako Kuhime, who found the body, has wet mud on her hem.
Shrine-path mud is red clay. That's grey. That's Wall mud.
cmdblocks.name: Hiruma Natsuko

cmdblocks.text: (Why would a Phoenix lady walk the Wall path at dawn?)
cmdblocks.name: Hiruma Natsuko

cmdblocks.text: A runner: the Champion demands a culprit by nightfall.
By nightfall, Hiruma. He won't wait. He never waits.
cmdblocks.name: Kaiu Takakana

cmdblocks.text: A young shugenja in Phoenix brown kneels by the body, then stands, brushing his knees.
Isawa Michio. The Phoenix sent me to keep an eye on the bride. Inquisitor.
cmdblocks.name: Isawa Michio

cmdblocks.text: That Taint at her collar was thrown, not grown. Whoever threw it, I want them.
cmdblocks.name: Isawa Michio

cmdblocks.text: Then walk with me. I have mud.
cmdblocks.name: Hiruma Natsuko

cmdblocks.text: ...I have no idea what that means. Lead on.
cmdblocks.name: Isawa Michio

Such a pretty dancer. Such a pretty face. I only borrowed it.

cmdblocks.text: Who's holding your strings?
cmdblocks.name: Hiruma Natsuko

cmdblocks.text: Someone beautiful.
cmdblocks.name: Maho Puppet

cmdblocks.text: The troll isn't your target. Each turn it smashes whoever draws the most attention. Razor's Edge draws it to Natsuko. Break the puppet, and the troll turns on it.
Victory. The troll, sated and confused, lets Hiruma Natsuko re-chain it. The puppet lies in the straw, himself again - dying, and frightened.
I don't remember... I don't remember anything...
cmdblocks.name: Servant

cmdblocks.text: (Honor +1)
Natsuko does it quickly. It is the kindest thing she has.

cmdblocks.text0: Spare him. Tell his family he was innocent.

cmdblocks.text: The Lava Trees: a forest growing roots-up, its branches buried, dripping fire.
"Tar chasm. Rope bridge. The forest that hangs." ...It's here.
cmdblocks.name: Hiruma Natsuko

cmdblocks.text: It's all here. Every mark.
cmdblocks.name: Hiruma Natsuko

cmdblocks.text: Goblin warmongers, four of them, painted for war.

cmdblock.text: A root as thick as a man hangs down from the buried canopy. Something glints in its fork.

cmdblocks.text: Hiruma scouts climb before they can walk. Natsuko goes up the root hand over hand.
Got a Fine Katana.

cmdblock.text: The root sways, empty now.
A dead end. A Hiruma scout's bones, curled around his pack. His last note is in a careful hand: "The road goes on past the poppies. Tell my daughter I found it."
I'll tell her, brother.
cmdblock.name: Hiruma Natsuko

cmdblock.text: Got a Hiruma Scout's Jingasa.
Natsuko has laid his bones straight and covered his face.
Another Hiruma, this far out? I've a quiver of jade-tipped arrows and nobody to watch my back.
cmdblock.name: Hiruma Scout

cmdblocks.text: Your current hireling heads home.
Three volleys of jade. Then I go back to my tree and wait for the next fool.
cmdblocks.name: Hiruma Scout

cmdblocks.text: Hiruma Scout follows Natsuko. (In battle: Support. 3 uses, then home to the lava trees.)

cmdblocks.name: Hiruma Scout

cmdblocks.text: Wrestle me. If I win, you come for nothing.
cmdblocks.name: Hiruma Natsuko

cmdblocks.text: Natsuko takes the belt, drops her hips, and throws.

cmdblocks.text: A troll-ruin coliseum. Broken pottery everywhere. Hiruma Kage - a warrior-poet, haggard, armourless - hurls a jar against a pillar.
Go home, scout.
cmdblocks.name: Hiruma Kage

cmdblocks.text: You first, my lord.
cmdblocks.name: Hiruma Natsuko

cmdblocks.text: Fifteen generations of Hiruma without a home. One woman made me forget it for a month.
cmdblocks.name: Hiruma Kage

cmdblocks.text: Another jar, shattering.
I'm done remembering.
cmdblocks.name: Hiruma Kage

cmdblocks.text: Then remember this.
cmdblocks.name: Hiruma Natsuko

cmdblocks.text: There's a road back, my lord. My father found it. I walked the first leg this morning. It's real.
cmdblocks.name: Hiruma Natsuko

cmdblocks.text: A road. To a castle full of oni.
cmdblocks.name: Hiruma Kage

cmdblocks.text: A road. To home. If you die here, who walks it?
cmdblocks.name: Hiruma Natsuko

cmdblocks.text: Long silence. Kage takes the map. He unrolls it in the dust and looks at it for a long time. Then he sits down, and for the first time since the court, he weeps.
...I'll keep watch.
cmdblocks.name: Hiruma Natsuko

cmdblocks.text: You always keep watch.
cmdblocks.name: Hiruma Kage

cmdblocks.text: Someone has to.
cmdblocks.name: Hiruma Natsuko

cmdblocks.text: Winged undead riders sweep the plain - Moto akutsukai, skeletal wings over rotting horses.
Down. Flat. Don't breathe.
cmdblocks.name: Hiruma Natsuko

cmdblocks.text: The riders sweep overhead, wings creaking. They pass.
A skull turns. A wing tilts. They've been seen.
One rider lingers. It wears polished Imperial armour - Seppun colours - over something that isn't a man. It turns its head toward their hiding place.
...I have a name now, scout.
cmdblocks.name: "Ryozo"

cmdblocks.text: A good one. Imperial. Thank you for leaving it for me.
cmdblocks.name: "Ryozo"

cmdblocks.text: ...Ryozo.
cmdblocks.name: Hiruma Natsuko

cmdblocks.text: Ryozo.
cmdblocks.name: "Ryozo"

cmdblocks.text: It rides off into the dark, laughing.
I left him in that tunnel. I left a name in the dark, and something picked it up.
cmdblocks.name: Hiruma Natsuko

Nothing happens. She stares at her sleeve, and starts to cry.
Natsuko seizes them. It's just a frightened servant of the Hida - wrong.

Laughter behind them. When Natsuko turns, Hida Sachiko is down, breathing, out cold.
A cold hand in the dark. Hiruma Goro falls like a tree.
Something brushes Natsuko's cheek in the dark. She keeps walking.
Natsuko-san! Lady Kuhime said to come to the roof! She said it was safe!
cmdblocks.name: Isawa Akiko

cmdblocks.text: Akiko. Go to the cellars.
cmdblocks.name: Hiruma Natsuko

cmdblocks.text: Two bright eyes in a vent.

cmdblocks.text: Akiko vanishes into the wall with a squeak.

cmdblocks.text: Like a goblin. Goats are smarter.
cmdblocks.name: Hiruma Natsuko

cmdblocks.text: The tunnel's exit. Hiruma Natsuko stops at the mouth, the blue flare in her hand.
"Something none of us has seen before."
cmdblocks.name: Hiruma Natsuko

cmdblocks.text: A blue star climbs over the Wall. Every Crab on the Wall turns and stares. Then, everywhere, horns.
BLUE! BLUE! Every man to the east tunnel!
cmdblocks.name: Kaiu Takakana

cmdblocks.text: The blue flare stays in her sleeve. Not yet.
The tunnel mouth opens onto the top of the Wall.

cmdblocks.text: Hiruma Goro joins the party.
The top of the Wall at the tunnel's mouth. Nashiko floats above the battlements, smoke streaming from her burned wrist, and calls up a bone-cage that bounces like a monstrous ball: Oni no Tsukakoro.
Play with my pet, Crab. I'm late for a carriage.
cmdblocks.name: Nashiko

cmdblocks.text: A bone-cage. Steel won't more than scratch it. Jade, though... jade cracks it open.
cmdblocks.name: Hiruma Natsuko

cmdblocks.text: (Oni no Tsukakoro is warded: every hit does 1 damage until a Jade hit lands. Then, for the rest of that round, everything hurts it. Jade Dust, jade weapons.)
Along the parapet, Crab archers nock arrows. Every one of them saw the blue.
The cage collapses into bones that roll off the Wall into the dark.
The whole Crab army has the Wall. Nashiko hangs in the air above them, untouchable, laughing.
Tell Kage I enjoyed the wedding! Such a sad little man.
cmdblocks.name: Nashiko

cmdblocks.text: I'll wear someone he loves next time. Maybe you.
cmdblocks.name: Nashiko

cmdblocks.text: Try it. My face doesn't fit anyone else.
cmdblocks.name: Hiruma Natsuko

cmdblocks.text: Nashiko becomes smoke, and the smoke flies north on the wind.
Dawn. The castle quiet. Hiruma Kage sits alone on the Wall steps, looking at the smoke still drifting north.
My lord. The woman you married wasn't Kuhime. Kuhime died two weeks ago. You married a demon.
cmdblocks.name: Hiruma Natsuko

cmdblocks.text: ...Twice now. Twice I've loved someone in this castle and lost her to the dark.
cmdblocks.name: Hiruma Kage

cmdblocks.text: I'll keep the Hiruma alive, Natsuko. I swear it. Not by marrying. Not by dying.
cmdblocks.name: Hiruma Kage

cmdblocks.text: She fled with the Shadowlands, my lord. She was... never what she seemed.
cmdblocks.name: Hiruma Natsuko

cmdblocks.text: ...I'll keep the Hiruma alive. I swear it.
cmdblocks.name: Hiruma Kage

cmdblocks.text: (Honor -1)
Hiruma Kage presses his father's tanto into her hands.
Someday we'll walk your father's road.
cmdblocks.name: Hiruma Kage

cmdblocks.text: Not by dying.
cmdblocks.name: Hiruma Kage

cmdblocks.text: Not by dying, my lord.
cmdblocks.name: Hiruma Natsuko

cmdblocks.text: She looks north, where the smoke went.
...North. You keep running north.
cmdblocks.name: Hiruma Natsuko

cmdblocks.text: Got Kage's Father's Tanto.
"The Fairest One of All" - complete.

A wedding at speed, a barrel in the cellar, and a demon in a bride's face. Natsuko hunted her through a dark castle using pebbles and jade dust, and herded her out onto the Wall. She escaped north on smoke - and Natsuko is following.

cmdblocks.text: Shiro Kitsuki. Kitsuki Gendo sits at his desk, over his evidence case, and murmurs.
The son will become the dark brother... the jade clan goes black... seven mortals will rise.
cmdblocks.name: Kitsuki Gendo

cmdblocks.text: He counts on his fingers, like Haruki.
...Seven. Plus one.
cmdblocks.name: Kitsuki Gendo

cmdblocks.text: He frowns. Then he smiles.
Akuro never could count.
cmdblocks.name: Kitsuki Gendo

cmdblocks.text: On the wall, a temple painting that wasn't there before: "Gendo the Saviour", glass eyes and all.
For a moment the painted city behind him is burning. He blinks, and it isn't.
He turns the painting to the wall.
He opens his notebook to the page he burned at the Furnace. It's blank.
He leaves it blank, and looks toward the capital for a long time.
On the wall above his desk: a small painting of the year 1122, with the light exactly right.

She looked right at me in the shrine town. A ronin girl.

cmdblocks.text: A pause.
Biggest mistake she ever made.
cmdblocks.name: Sayo

cmdblocks.text: A letter on the table, from old Mosuke at the Village of the Wounded Lion: "The rice cakes are for us now. Thank you."

encount.name: Hiruma: an ogre in the stables
Hiruma: the troll in the well

cmdblocks.text: Shiro Hiruma. The Hiruma's castle, lost fifteen generations ago to the Shadowlands, and never retaken.
The outer walls still stand. The gate is a hole. Everything inside is black.
Hiruma Natsuko takes the oiled case from her pack, and unrolls her father's map on a fallen stone.
Thirty years of work.
cmdblocks.name: Hiruma Natsuko

cmdblocks.text: Every landmark they passed is on it, in his careful hand: the tar, the poppies, the bone fields. The last line stops a day short of the castle. Where he died.
...He was right. All of it. It leads here.
cmdblocks.name: Hiruma Natsuko

cmdblocks.text: Then let's finish it for him.
cmdblocks.name: Sayo

cmdblock.text: The keep's gate, a black mouth.

encount.name: Keep: a rider and the dead

cmdblock.text: The keep's shrine. The kami-shelf is broken, the tablets scattered. Hiruma names, hundreds of them, under the soot.
Natsuko sets the tablets back up, one by one. It takes a long time. Nobody hurries her.
We're back. Not for good. Not yet. But we came.
cmdblock.name: Hiruma Natsuko

cmdblock.text: For a moment, the cold in the keep is a little less cold.
The Hiruma tablets stand in their rows again.
A Hiruma waystone, the crab mon worn almost smooth. Jade grit is packed into the cracks.

cmdblocks.text: (Rested. HP and MP restored. Taint cleansed.)

cmdblock.text: The lord's hall. Something on the throne is waiting.

cmdblocks.text: The lord's hall of Shiro Hiruma. On the dais, in the lord's own armour, something with horns and a blue face sits the Hiruma throne as if it were born there.
Little Hiruma. You brought a map. How sweet. Your father brought one too.
cmdblocks.name: Oni no Okura

cmdblocks.text: ...You met him.
cmdblocks.name: Hiruma Natsuko

cmdblocks.text: My father took a Jade Champion's name. I took a castle. He took a road a day too far.
cmdblocks.name: Oni no Okura

cmdblocks.text: Then this is the last day of the road.
cmdblocks.name: Hiruma Natsuko

cmdblocks.text: Okura falls back across the dais, and comes apart like a burned scroll. The armour stays behind, empty, as it was always supposed to be.
On the throne, under fifteen generations of dust: a katana with a running hare on the tsuba. Not a Crab blade at all.
A Usagi sword. In the Hiruma's castle. Somebody carried this a long way, a long time ago.
cmdblocks.name: Hiruma Natsuko

cmdblocks.text: I'd like to know who. I'd also like to know why. I'll file it.
cmdblocks.name: Kitsuki Gendo

cmdblocks.text: Got the Hare Sword.
Natsuko takes out her father's map, and a stick of charcoal, and draws the last line: from the bone fields, up the hill, to the gate.
There, Father. It leads home.
cmdblocks.name: Hiruma Natsuko

cmdblocks.text: (Shiro Hiruma - cleared. The Hiruma have a road home, and a map that proves it.)
Run home, little Hiruma. Oh - you can't. You haven't got one.

cmdblocks.text: Night, and the storm. The ship heels over in water the colour of ink.
Then the sea stands up. A head the size of a gatehouse rises out of it, green as deep water, and looks down at the deck with eyes gold in the lightning.
Mortals. On my water. Again.
cmdblocks.name: The Orochi

cmdblocks.text: Your kind hunt the ningyo for their flesh. Your kind sink each other's ships and blame the sea. I keep what sinks. I keep who sinks.
cmdblocks.name: The Orochi

cmdblocks.text: It talks. Nobody said it talks.
cmdblocks.name: Sayo

cmdblocks.text: I do not find that funny.
cmdblocks.name: The Orochi

cmdblocks.text: Show me you are not like the others. Show me with your hands.
cmdblocks.name: The Orochi

cmdblocks.text: The great head sinks until its chin rests on the rail, and the whole ship groans.
Enough. You fight well. Without humour, which I approve of.
cmdblocks.name: The Orochi

cmdblocks.text: Take this. A scale is a promise: my water will not take you.
cmdblocks.name: The Orochi

cmdblocks.text: Got an Orochi Scale.
And this. It was a Crane captain's. He would want it spent by the living.
cmdblocks.name: The Orochi

cmdblocks.text: Got 20000 zeni.
It sinks without a ripple. The storm goes with it.
...I'm going home. I'm going home and I'm never telling anyone.
cmdblocks.name: Ship's master

cmdblocks.text: The sea is patient. So am I. Come back when you are stronger.
cmdblocks.name: The Orochi

cmdblock.text: The sea is very still, and very dark.
